Genesis: Beréchit bara élohim ét hachchamayim veét haarets
Beqadmin bera Adonai yat chemayya veyat ara:
Vehaarets hayeta tohou vabohou vekhochek al-pené tehom verouakh élohim merakhepet al-pené hammayim
Veara havat tsadeya veréqanya vakhachoka paras al appé tehoma veroukha min qodam Adonai menachcheba al appé mayya:
Vayyomer élohim yehi or vayehi-or
Vaamar Adonai yehé nehora vahava nehora:
Vayyar élohim et-haor ki-tob vayyabdél élohim bén haor oubén hakhochek
Vakhaza Adonai yat nehora aré tab veapréch Adonai bén nehora oubén khachoka:
Vayyiqra élohim laor yom velakhochek qara layela vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom ekhad
Ouqera Adonai linhora yemama velakhachoka qera léleya vahava remach vahava tsepar yoma khad:
Vayyomer élohim yehi raqia betok hammayim vihi mabdil bén mayim lamayim
Vaamar Adonai yehi reqia bimtsiout mayya vihi maprich bén mayya lemayya:
Vayyaas élohim et-haraqia vayyabdél bén hammayim acher mittakhat laraqia oubén hammayim acher méal laraqia vayehi-kén
Vaabad Adonai yat reqia veapréch bén mayya di milra lirqia oubén mayya di méal lirqia vahava kén:
Vayyiqra élohim laraqia chamayim vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom chéni
Ouqera Adonai lirqia chemayya vahava remach vahava tsepar yom tinyan:
Vayyomer élohim yiqqavou hammayim mittakhat hachchamayim el-maqom ekhad vetéraeh hayyabbacha vayehi-kén
Vaamar Adonai yitkanchoun mayya mittekhot chemayya laatar khad vetitkhazé yabbechta vahava kén:
Vayyiqra élohim layyabbacha erets oulemiqvéh hammayim qara yammim vayyar élohim ki-tob
Ouqera Adonai leyabbechta ara oulebét kenichout mayya qera yammé vakhaza Adonai aré tab:
Vayyomer élohim tadeché haarets deche éseb mazria zera éts peri oseh peri lemino acher zaro-bo al-haarets vayehi-kén
Vaamar Adonai tadét ara ditea isba debar zaréh mizdera ilan périn abad périn liznéh di bar zaréh béh al ara vahava kén:
Vattotsé haarets deche éseb mazria zera leminéhou veéts oseh-peri acher zaro-bo leminéhou vayyar élohim ki-tob
Veappéqat ara ditea isba debar zaréh mizdera liznohi veilan abéd périn debar zaréh béh liznohi vakhaza Adonai aré tab:
Vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom chelichi
Vahava remach vahava tsepar yom telitai:
Vayyomer élohim yehi meorot birqia hachchamayim lehabdil bén hayyom oubén hallayela vehayou leotot oulemoadim ouleyamim vechanim
Vaamar Adonai yehon nehorin birqia dichmayya leapracha bén yemama oubén léleya vihon leatin oulezimnin oulemimené behon yomin ouchenin:
Vehayou limorot birqia hachchamayim lehair al-haarets vayehi-kén
Vihon linhorin birqia dichmayya leanhara al ara vahava kén:
Vayyaas élohim et-chené hammeorot haggedolim et-hammaor haggadol lememchelet hayyom veet-hammaor haqqaton lememchelet hallayla veét hakkokabim
Vaabad Adonai yat terén nehorayya rabrebayya yat nehora rabba lemichlat bimama veyat nehora zeéra lemichlat beléleya veyat kokebayya:
Vayyittén otam élohim birqia hachchamayim lehair al-haarets
Vihab yatehon Adonai birqia dichmayya leanhara al ara:
Velimchol bayyom ouballayla oulehabdil bén haor oubén hakhochek vayyar élohim ki-tob
Oulemichlat bimama oubeléleya ouleapracha bén nehora oubén khachoka vakhaza Adonai aré tab:
Vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom rebii
Vahava remach vahava tsepar yom rebiai:
Vayyomer élohim yichretsou hammayim cherets nepech khayya veop yeopép al-haarets al-pené reqia hachchamayim
Vaamar Adonai yirkhachoun mayya rekhéch napcha khayta veopa yeparakh al ara al appé reqia dichmayya:
Vayyibra élohim et-hattanninim haggedolim veét kol-nepech hakhayya haromeset acher charetsou hammayim leminéhem veét kol-op kanap leminéhou vayyar élohim ki-tob
Oubera Adonai yat tanninayya rabrebayya veyat kol napcha khayta dirkhicha di arkhichou mayya liznéhon veyat kol opa deparakh liznohi vakhaza Adonai aré tab:
Vayebarek otam élohim lémor perou ourebou oumilou et-hammayim bayyammim vehaop yireb baarets
Oubarik yatehon Adonai lemémar pouchou ousegou oumelou yat mayya beyammayya veopa yisgé beara:
Vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom khamichi
Vahava remach vahava tsepar yom khamichai:
Vayyomer élohim totsé haarets nepech khayya leminah behéma varemes vekhayeto-erets leminah vayehi-kén
Vaamar Adonai tappéq ara napcha khayta liznah beir ourekhéch vekhévat ara liznah vahava kén:
Vayyaas élohim et-khayyat haarets leminah veet-habbehéma leminah veét kol-remes haadama leminéhou vayyar élohim ki-tob
Vaabad Adonai yat khévat ara liznah veyat beira liznah veyat kol rikhacha deara liznohi vakhaza Adonai aré tab:
Vayyomer élohim naaseh adam betsalménou kidmouténou veyirdou bidgat hayyam oubeop hachchamayim oubabbehéma oubekol-haarets oubekol-haremes haromés al-haarets
Vaamar Adonai naabid énacha betsalména kidmoutana veyichletoun benouné yamma oubeopa dichmayya oubibira oubekol ara oubekol rikhacha derakhéch al ara:
Vayyibra élohim et-haadam betsalmo betselem élohim bara oto zakar ouneqéba bara otam
Oubera Adonai yat adam betsalméh betsalma daAdonai bera yatéh dekar venouqeba bera yatehon:
Vayebarek otam élohim vayyomer lahem élohim perou ourebou oumilou et-haarets vekibchouha ouredou bidgat hayyam oubeop hachchamayim oubekol-khayya haromeset al-haarets
Oubarik yatehon Adonai vaamar lehon Adonai pouchou ousegou oumelou yat ara outeqoupou alah oucheloutou benouné yamma oubeopa dichmayya oubekol khayta derakhécha al ara:
Vayyomer élohim hinnéh natatti lakem et-kol-éseb zoréa zera acher al-pené kol-haarets veet-kol-haéts acher-bo peri-éts zoréa zara lakem yiheyeh leokla
Vaamar Adonai ha yehabit lekon yat kol isba debar zaréh mizdera di al appé kol ara veyat kol ilana di béh péré ilana debar zaréh mizdera lekon yehé lemékal:
Oulekol-khayyat haarets oulekol-op hachchamayim oulekol romés al-haarets acher-bo nepech khayya et-kol-yereq éseb leokla vayehi-kén
Oulekal khévat ara oulekal opa dichmayya oulekol derakhéch al ara di béh napcha khayta yat kol yeroq isba lemékal vahava kén:
Vayyar élohim et-kol-acher asa vehinnéh-tob meod vayehi-ereb vayehi-boqer yom hachchichchi
Vakhaza Adonai yat kol di abad veha taqqin lakhada vahava remach vahava tsepar yom chetitai:
Vayekullou hachchamayim vehaarets vekol-tsebaam
Veichtaklalou chemayya veara vekol khéléhon:
Vayekal élohim bayyom hachchebii melakto acher asa vayyichbot bayyom hachchebii mikkol-melakto acher asa
Vechétsé Adonai beyoma chebiaa abidtéh di abad venakh beyoma chebiaa mikkol abidtéh di abad:
Vayebarek élohim et-yom hachchebii vayeqaddéch oto ki bo chabat mikkol-melakto acher-bara élohim laasot
Oubarik Adonai yat yoma chebiaa veqaddich yatéh aré béh nakh mikkol abidtéh di bera Adonai lemebad:
élleh toledot hachchamayim vehaarets behibbaream beyom asot Adonai élohim erets vechamayim
Illén touledat chemayya veara kad itberiou beyoma di abad Adonai élohim ara ouchemayya:
Vekol siakh hassadeh terem yiheyeh baarets vekol-éseb hassadeh terem yitsmakh ki lo himtir Adonai élohim al-haarets veadam ayin laabod et-haadama
Vekol ilané khaqla ad la havou beara vekol isba dekhaqla ad la tsemakh aré la akhit mitra Adonai élohim al ara veénach lét lemiplakh yat admeta:
Veéd yaaleh min-haarets vehichqa et-kol-pené haadama
Vaanana hava saléq min ara veachqé yat kol appé admeta:
Vayyitser Adonai élohim et-haadam apar min-haadama vayyippakh beappayv nichmat khayyim vayehi haadam lenepech khayya
Oubera Adonai élohim yat adam apra min admeta ounepakh beappohi nichmeta dekhayyé vahavat beadam lerouakh memalla:
Vayyitta Adonai élohim gan-beéden miqqedem vayyasem cham et-haadam acher yatsar
Ounetsib Adonai élohim gineta beéden milleqadmin veachvé tamman yat adam di bera:
Vayyatsmakh Adonai élohim min-haadama kol-éts nekhmad lemareh vetob lemaakal veéts hakhayyim betok haggan veéts haddaat tob vara
Veatsmakh Adonai élohim min ara kol ilan dimraggég lemekhézé vetab lemékal veilan khayya bimtsiout gineta veilan deoklin pérohi khakkimin bén tab lebich:
Venahar yotsé mééden lehachqot et-haggan oumichcham yipparéd vehaya learbaa rachim
Venahara hava napiq mééden leachqaa yat gineta oumittamman yitparich vahavé learbea réché naharin:
Chém haekhad pichon hou hassobéb ét kol-erets hakhavila acher-cham hazzahab
Choum khad pichon hou maqqip yat kol ara dakhavila di tamman dahaba:
Ouzehab haarets hahiv tob cham habbedolakh veeben hachchoham
Vedahaba deara hahi tab taman bedalekha veabné bourela:
Vechém-hannahar hachchéni gikhon hou hassobéb ét kol-erets kouch
Vechoum nahara tinyana gikhon hou maqqip yat kol ara dekouch:
Vechém hannahar hachchelichi khiddeqel hou haholék qidmat achchour vehannahar harebii hou perat
Vechoum nahara telitaa digelat hou mehallék lemaddinekha deattour venahara rebiaa hou perat:
Vayyiqqakh Adonai élohim et-haadam vayyannikhéhou began-éden leobdah oulechomrah
Oudebar Adonai élohim yat adam veachréh begineta deéden lemiplekhah oulemitrah:
Vayetsav Adonai élohim al-haadam lémor mikkol éts-haggan akol tokél
Oupaqqid Adonai élohim al adam lemémar mikkol ilan gineta mékal tékoul:
Oumééts haddaat tob vara lo tokal mimmennou ki beyom akolka mimmennou mot tamout
Ouméilan deoklin pérohi khakkimin bén tab lebich la tékoul minnéh aré beyoma detékoul minnéh mémat temout:
Vayyomer Adonai élohim lo-tob héyot haadam lebaddo eéseh-lo ézer kenegdo
Vaamar Adonai élohim la taqqin lemehévé adam bilkhodohi aabéd léh semak leqibléh:
Vayyitser Adonai élohim min-haadama kol-khayyat hassadeh veét kol-op hachchamayim vayyabé el-haadam lirot mah-yiqra-lo vekol acher yiqra-lo haadam nepech khayya hou chemo
Oubera Adonai élohim min ara kol khévat bera veyat kol opa dichmayya veaytéh levat adam lemekhézé mah yiqré léh vekol di hava qaré léh adam napcha khayta hou cheméh:
Vayyiqra haadam chémot lekol-habbehéma ouleop hachchamayim oulekol khayyat hassadeh ouleadam lo-matsa ézer kenegdo
Ouqera adam chemahan lekol beira ouleopa dichmayya oulekal khévat bera ouleadam la achkakh samék leqibléh:
Vayyappél Adonai élohim tardéma al-haadam vayyichan vayyiqqakh akhat mitstsalotayv vayyisgor basar takhtenna
Ourema Adonai élohim chineta al adam oudemék ounesib khada méilohi oumelé bisra tekhotah:
Vayyiben Adonai élohim et-hatstséla acher-laqakh min-haadam leichcha vayebieha el-haadam
Oubena Adonai élohim yat ila dinsib min adam leitteta veaytah levat adam:
Vayyomer haadam zot happaam etsem méatsamay oubasar mibbesari lezot yiqqaré ichcha ki méich luqekha-zot
Vaamar haadam hada zimna garma miggarmay oubisra mibbisri leda yitqeré itteta aré mibbala nesiba da:
Al-kén yaazob-ich et-abiv veet-immo vedabaq beichto vehayou lebasar ekhad
Al kén yichboq gebar bét michkebé abouhi veimméh veyidbaq beittetéh vihon lebisra khad:
Vayyiheyou chenéhem aroummim haadam veichto velo yitbochachou
Vahavo tarvéhon artilain adam veittetéh vela mitkalmin:
Vehannakhach haya aroum mikkol khayyat hassadeh acher asa Adonai élohim vayyomer el-haichcha ap ki-amar élohim lo tokelou mikkol éts haggan
Vekhivya hava khakkim mikkol khévat bera di abad Adonai élohim vaamar leitteta beqoucheta aré amar Adonai la tékeloun mikkol ilan gineta:
Vattomer haichcha el-hannakhach mipperi éts-haggan nokél
Vaamarat itteta lekhivya mippéré ilan gineta nékoul:
Oumipperi haéts acher betok-haggan amar élohim lo tokelou mimmennou velo tiggeou bo pen-temutoun
Oumippéré ilana di bimtsiout gineta amar Adonai la tékeloun minnéh vela teqarboun béh dilema temoutoun:
Vayyomer hannakhach el-haichcha lo-mot temutoun
Vaamar khivya leitteta la mout temoutoun:
Ki yodéa élohim ki beyom akolkem mimmennou venipqekhou énékem vihyitem kélohim yodeé tob vara
Aré gallé qodam Adonai aré beyoma detékeloun minnéh veyitpattekhan énékon outehon kerabrebin khakkimin bén tab lebich:
Vattére haichcha ki tob haéts lemaakal veki taava-hv laénayim venekhmad haéts lehaskil vattiqqakh mippiryo vattokal vattittén gam-leichah immah vayyokal
Vakhazat itteta aré tab ilan lemékal vaaré assé hou leaynin oumeraggég ilana leistakkala béh ounesébat méibbéh vaakalat vihabat ap lebalah immah vaakal:
Vattippaqakhna éné chenéhem vayyédeou ki érummim hém vayyitperou aléh teéna vayyaasou lahem khagorot
Veitpattakha éné tarvéhon vidaou aré artilain inoun vekhattitou lehon tarpé teénin vaabadou lehon zerazin:
Vayyichmeou et-qol Adonai élohim mithallék baggan lerouakh hayyom vayyitkhabbé haadam veichto mippené Adonai élohim betok éts haggan
Ouchemaou yat qal mémera daAdonai élohim mehallék begineta limnakh yoma veitammar adam veittetéh min qodam Adonai élohim bego ilan gineta:
Vayyiqra Adonai élohim el-haadam vayyomer lo ayyekka
Ouqera Adonai élohim leadam vaamar léh an at:
Vayyomer et-qoleka chamati baggan vaira ki-érom anoki vaékhabé
Vaamar yat qal mémerak chamit begineta oudekhélit aré artilay ana veitammarit:
Vayyomer mi higgid leka ki érom atta hamin-haéts acher tsivvitika lebilti akol-mimmennou akaleta
Vaamar man khavé lak aré artilay at hamin ilana dipaqqedtak bedil dela lemékal minnéh akalt:
Vayyomer haadam haichcha acher natatta immadi hiv natena-li min-haéts vaokél
Vaamar haadam itteta dihabta immi hi yahabat li min ilana vaakalit:
Vayyomer Adonai élohim laichcha mah-zot asit vattomer haichcha hannakhach hichchiani vaokél
Vaamar Adonai élohim leitteta mah da abdat vaamarat itteta khivya atayani vaakalit:
Vayyomer Adonai élohim el-hannakhach ki asita zot arour atta mikkol-habbehéma oumikkol khayyat hassadeh al-gekhoneka télék veapar tokal kol-yemé khayyéka
Vaamar Adonai élohim lekhivya aré abadta da lit at mikkol beira oumikkol khévat bara al meak tézil veapra tékoul kol yomé khayyayk:
Veéba achit béneka oubén haichcha oubén zaraka oubén zarah hou yechoupeka roch veatta techoupennou aqéb
Oudebabou échavvé bénak oubén itteta oubén benak oubén benahah hou yehé dekir lak mah diabadta léh milleqadmin veat tehé natir léh lesopa:
El-haichcha amar harba arbeh itstsebonék vehéronék beetseb téledi banim veel-ichék techouqaték vehou yimchol-bak
Leitteta amar asgaa asgé tsaarayki veiddouyayki betsear téledi benin oulevat balik tehé tioubetik vehou yichlat bik:
Ouleadam amar ki-chamata leqol ichteka vattokal min-haéts acher tsivvitika lémor lo tokal mimmennou aroura haadama baaboureka beitstsabon tokelenna kol yemé khayyéka
Ouleadam amar aré qabbéleta lemémar ittetak vaakalta min ilana di paqqédetak lemémar la tékoul minnéh lita ara bedilak baamal tikelinah kol yomé khayyayk:
Veqots vedardar tatsmiakh lak veakalta et-éseb hassadeh
Vekoubin veatdin tatsmakh lak vetékoul yat isba dekhaqla:
Bezéat appéka tokal lekhem ad choubeka el-haadama ki mimmenna luqqakheta ki-apar atta veel-apar tachoub
Beziata deappak tékoul lakhma ad detitoub leara deminnah itberéta aré apra at ouleapra tetoub:
Vayyiqra haadam chém ichto khavva ki hiv hayeta ém kol-khay
Ouqera adam choum ittetéh khavva aré hi havat imma dekal bené énacha:
Vayyaas Adonai élohim leadam ouleichto kotnot or vayyalbichém
Vaabad Adonai élohim leadam ouleittetéh lebouchin diqar al mechak bisréhon vealbichinoun:
Vayyomer Adonai élohim hén haadam haya keakhad mimmennou ladaat tob vara veatta pen-yichlakh yado velaqakh gam mééts hakhayyim veakal vakhay leolam
Vaamar Adonai élohim ha adam hava yekhiday bealma minnéh lemida tab oubich oukean dilema yochit yedéh veyissab ap méilan khayyay veyékoul vikhé lealam:
Vayechallekhéhou Adonai élohim miggan-éden laabod et-haadama acher luqqakh michcham
Vechallekhéh Adonai élohim miggineta deéden lemiplakh yat admeta deitberi mittamman:
Vayegarech et-haadam vayyachkén miqqedem legan-éden et-hakkerubim veét lahat hakhereb hammithappeket lichmor et-derek éts hakhayyim
Vetarik yat adam veachré milleqadmin legineta deéden yat keroubayya veyat chenan kharba demithappeka lemitar yat orakh ilan khayyay:
Vehaadam yada et-khavva ichto vattahar vattéled et-qayin vattomer qaniti ich et-Adonai
Veadam yeda yat khavva ittetéh veaddiat vilidat yat qayin vaameret qaniti gabra min qodam Adonai:
Vattosep laledet et-akhiv et-habel vayehi-hebel roéh tson veqayin haya obéd adama
Veosipat lemélad yat akhohi yat habel vahava hebel raé ana veqayin hava palakh beara:
Vayehi miqqéts yamim vayyabé qayin mipperi haadama minkha la-Adonai
Vahava missop yomin veayti qayin méibba deara tiqroubeta qodam Adonai:
Vehebel hébi gam-hv mibbekorot tsono oumékhelbéhen vayyicha Adonai el-hebel veel-minkhato
Vehebel ayti ap hou mibbakkiré anéh oumichamminhon vahavat raava min qodam Adonai behebel oubeqourebanéh:
Veel-qayin veel-minkhato lo chaa vayyikhar leqayin meod vayyippelou panayv
Oubeqayin oubeqourebanéh la havat raava outeqép leqayin lakhada veitkebichou appohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-qayin lamma khara lak velamma napelou panéka
Vaamar Adonai leqayin lema teqip lak oulema itkebichou appayk:
Halo im-tétib seét veim lo tétib lappetakh khattat robéts veéléka techouqato veatta timchol-bo
Hala im totib obadak yichtebéq lak veim la totib obadak leyom dina khetak netir diatid leitparea minnak im la tetoub veim tetoub yichtebéq lak:
Vayyomer qayin el-hebel akhiv vayehi bihyotam bassadeh vayyaqom qayin el-hebel akhiv vayyahargéhou
Vaamar qayin lehebel akhohi vahava bemehévéhon bekhaqla veqam qayin al hebel akhohi veqatléh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-qayin é hebel akhika vayyomer lo yadati hachomér akhi anoki
Vaamar Adonai leqayin an hebel akhouk vaamar la yadaana hanatér akhi ana:
Vayyomer meh asita qol demé akhika tsoaqim élay min-haadama
Vaamar meh abadta qal dam zarin diatidin lemépaq min akhouk qablin qodamay min ara:
Veatta arour atta min-haadama acher patseta et-piha laqakhat et-demé akhika miyyadeka
Oukean lit at min ara diptakhat yat poumah veqabbilat yat deméh deakhouk min yedak:
Ki taabod et-haadama lo-tosép tét-kokhah lak na vanad tiheyeh baarets
Aré tiplakh beara la tosip lemittan khélah lak mitaltél vegalé tehé beara:
Vayyomer qayin el-Adonai gadol avoni minneso
Vaamar qayin qodam Adonai saggi khobi millemichbaq:
Hén gérachta oti hayyom méal pené haadama oumippanéka essatér vehayiti na vanad baarets vehaya kol-motsei yahargéni
Ha tariketa yati yoma dén méal appé ara oumin qodamak lét epchar leittammara vaéhi metaltél vegalé beara vihé kol deyichkekhinani yiqtelinani:
Vayyomer lo Adonai lakén kol-horég qayin chibatayim yuqqam vayyasem Adonai leqayin ot lebilti hakkot-oto kol-motseo
Vaamar léh Adonai bekén kol qatil qayin lechaba darin yitpera minnéh vechavvi Adonai leqayin ata bedil dela lemiqtal yatéh kol diyichkekhunéh:
Vayyétsé qayin millipné Adonai vayyécheb beerets-nod qidmat-éden
Ounepaq qayin min qodam Adonai vitéb beara galé oumittaltal dahava abida alohi milleqadmin degineta deéden:
Vayyéda qayin et-ichto vattahar vattéled et-khanok vayehi boneh ir vayyiqra chém hair kechém beno khanok
Vida qayin yat ittetéh veaddiat vilédat yat khanok vahava bané qarta ouqera chema deqarta kechoum beréh khanok:
Vayyivvaléd lakhanok et-irad veirad yalad et-mekhouyaél oumekhiyyayél yalad et-metouchaél oumetouchaél yalad et-lamek
Veityelid lakhanok yat irad veirad olid yat mekhouyaél oumekhiyyayél olid yat metouchaél oumetouchaél olid yat lamek:
Vayyiqqakh-lo lemek cheté nachim chém haakhat ada vechém hachchénit tsilla
Ounesib léh lemek tartén nechin choum khada ada vechoum tinyéta tsilla:
Vattéled ada et-yabal hou haya abi yochéb ohel oumiqneh
Vilédat ada yat yabal hou hava rabbehon deyatebé machkenin oumaré beir:
Vechém akhiv youbal hou haya abi kol-topés kinnor veougab
Vechoum akhohi youbal hou hava rabbehon dekal dimnaggén al poum nibla yadeé zemar kinnora veabbouba:
Vetsilla gam-hiv yaleda et-toubal qayin lotéch kol-khoréch nekhochet oubarzel vaakhot toubal-qayin naama
Vetsilla ap hi yelédat yat toubal qayin rabbehon dekal deyadeé ibidat nekhacha ouparzela vaakhatéh detoubal qayin naama:
Vayyomer lemek lenachayv ada vetsilla chemaan qoli neché lemek hazénna imrati ki ich haragti lepitsi veyeled lekhabburati
Vaamar lemek linchohi ada vetsilla chiman qali neché lemek atséta lemémeri la gabra qetalit dibdiléh ana sabil khobin veap la ouléma khabbalit dibdiléh yichtétsé zari:
Ki chibatayim yuqqam-qayin velemek chibim vechiba
Aré chaba darin iteliou leqayin hala lelemek beréh chabin vechaba:
Vayyéda adam od et-ichto vattéled bén vattiqra et-chemo chét ki chat-li élohim zera akhér takhat hebel ki harago qayin
Vida adam od yat ittetéh vilédat bar ouqerat yat cheméh chét aré amarat yehab li Adonai bar okharan khalap hebel diqatléh qayin:
Oulechét gam-hv yullad-bén vayyiqra et-chemo énoch az houkhal liqro bechém Adonai
Oulechét ap hou ityelid bar ouqera yat cheméh énoch bekén beyomohi khalou bené énacha milletsallaa bichma daAdonai:
Zeh séper toledot adam beyom bero élohim adam bidmout élohim asa oto
Dén separ touledat adam beyoma dibra Adonai adam bidmout élohim abad yatéh:
Zakar ouneqéba beraam vayebarek otam vayyiqra et-chemam adam beyom hibbaream
Dekar venouqeba beranoun oubarik yatehon ouqera yat chemahon adam beyoma deitberiou:
Vayekhi adam chelochim oumeat chana vayyoled bidmouto ketsalmo vayyiqra et-chemo chét
Vakhaya adam mea outelatin chenin veolid bidmoutéh dedamé léh ouqera yat cheméh chét:
Vayyiheyou yemé-adam akharé holido et-chét chemoneh méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vahavo yomé adam batar deolid yat chét tamné mea chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayyiheyou kol-yemé adam acher-khay techa méot chana ouchelochim chana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yomé adam dakhaya techa mea outelatin chenin oumit:
Vayekhi-chét khaméch chanim oumeat chana vayyoled et-énoch
Vakhaya chét mea vakhaméch chenin veolid yat énoch:
Vayekhi-chét akharé holido et-énoch cheba chanim ouchemoneh méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vakhaya chét batar deolid yat énoch tamné mea oucheba chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayyiheyou kol-yemé-chét chetém esréh chana outecha méot chana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yomé chét techa mea vetarté asré chenin oumit:
Vayekhi énoch tichim chana vayyoled et-qénan
Vakhaya énoch tichin chenin veolid yat qénan:
Vayekhi énoch akharé holido et-qénan khaméch esréh chana ouchemoneh méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vakhaya énoch batar deolid yat qénan tamné mea vakhaméch asré chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayyiheyou kol-yemé énoch khaméch chanim outecha méot chana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yomé énoch techa mea vakhaméch chenin oumit:
Vayekhi qénan chibim chana vayyoled et-mahalalél
Vakhaya qénan chabin chenin veolid yat mahalalél:
Vayekhi qénan akharé holido et-mahalalél arbaim chana ouchemoneh méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vakhaya qénan batar deolid yat mahalalél tamné mea vearbein chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayyiheyou kol-yemé qénan eser chanim outecha méot chana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yomé qénan techa mea vaasar chenin oumit:
Vayekhi mahalalél khaméch chanim vechichchim chana vayyoled et-yared
Vakhaya mahalalél chittin vakhaméch chenin veolid yat yared:
Vayekhi mahalalél akharé holido et-yered chelochim chana ouchemoneh méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vakhaya mahalalél batar deolid yat yered tamné mea outelatin chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayyihyou kol-yemé mahalalél khaméch vetichim chana ouchemoneh méot chana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yomé mahalalél tamné mea vetichin vakhaméch chenin oumit:
Vayekhi-yered chetayim vechichchim chana oumeat chana vayyoled et-khanok
Vakhaya yered mea vechittin vetartén chenin veolid yat khanok:
Vayekhi-yered akharé holido et-khanok chemoneh méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vakhaya yered batar deolid yat khanok tamné mea chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayyiheyou kol-yemé-yered chetayim vechichchim chana outecha méot chana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yomé yered techa mea vechittin vetartén chenin oumit:
Vayekhi khanok khaméch vechichchim chana vayyoled et-metouchalakh
Vakhaya khanok chittin vakhaméch chenin veolid yat metouchalakh:
Vayyithallék khanok et-haélohim akharé holido et-metouchelakh cheloch méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vehallik khanok bedakhalta daAdonai batar deolid yat metouchelakh telat mea chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayehi kol-yemé khanok khaméch vechichchim chana oucheloch méot chana
Vahava kol yomé khanok telat mea vechittin vakhaméch chenin:
Vayyithallék khanok et-haélohim veénennou ki-laqakh oto élohim
Vehallik khanok bedakhalta daAdonai velaytohi aré la amét yatéh Adonai:
Vayekhi metouchelakh cheba ouchemonim chana oumeat chana vayyoled et-lamek
Vakhaya metouchelakh mea vetamnin oucheba chenin veolid yat lamek:
Vayekhi metouchelakh akharé holido et-lemek chetayim ouchemonim chana oucheba méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vakhaya metouchelakh batar deolid yat lemek cheba mea vetamnin vetartén chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayyihyou kol-yemé metouchelakh técha vechichchim chana outecha méot chana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yomé metouchelakh techa mea vechittin outecha chenin oumit:
Vayekhi-lemek chetayim ouchemonim chana oumeat chana vayyoled bén
Vakhaya lemek mea vetamnin vetartén chenin veolid bar:
Vayyiqra et-chemo noakh lémor zeh yenakhaménou mimmaasénou ouméitstsebon yadénou min-haadama acher érerah Adonai
Ouqera yat cheméh noakh lemémar dén yenakhaminnana méobadana oumilléout yedana min ara di lattah Adonai:
Vayekhi-lemek akharé holido et-noakh khaméch vetichim chana vakhaméch méot chana vayyoled banim oubanot
Vakhaya lemek batar deolid yat noakh khaméch mea vetichin vakhaméch chenin veolid benin oubenan:
Vayehi kol-yemé-lemek cheba vechibim chana oucheba méot chana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yomé lemek cheba mea vechabin oucheba chenin oumit:
Vayehi-noakh ben-khaméch méot chana vayyoled noakh et-chém et-kham veet-yapet
Vahava noakh bar khaméch mea chenin veolid noakh yat chém yat kham veyat yapet:
Vayehi ki-hékhél haadam larob al-pené haadama oubanot yulledou lahem
Vahava kad cheriou bené énacha lemisgé al appé ara oubenata ityelidou lehon:
Vayyirou bené-haélohim et-benot haadam ki tobot hénna vayyiqkhou lahem nachim mikkol acher bakharou
Vakhazo bené rabrebayya yat benat énacha aré chappiran inoun ounesibou lehon nechin mikkol di itreiou:
Vayyomer Adonai lo-yadon roukhi baadam leolam bechaggam hou basar vehayou yamayv méa veesrim chana
Vaamar Adonai la yitqayam dara bicha hadén qodamay lealam bedil deinoun bisra veobadéhon bichaya arka yehibat lehon mea veasrin chenin im yetouboun:
Hannepilim hayou baarets bayyamim hahém vegam akharé-kén acher yaboou bené haélohim el-benot haadam veyaledou lahem hémma haggibborim acher méolam anché hachchém
Gibbarayya havo beara beyomayya hainnoun veap batar kén di yaaloun bené rabrebayya levat benat énacha vilidan lehon inoun gibbarayya diméalema énachin dichma:
Vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam baarets vekol-yétser makhchebot libbo raq ra kol-hayyom
Vakhaza Adonai aré segiat bichat énacha beara vekol yitsra makhchebat libbéh lekhod bich kol yoma:
Vayyinnakhem Adonai ki-asa et-haadam baarets vayyitatstséb el-libbo
Vetab Adonai bemémeréh aré abad yat énacha beara vaamar bemémeréh lemittebar taqepehon kiroutéh:
Vayyomer Adonai emkheh et-haadam acher-barati méal pené haadama méadam ad-behéma ad-remes vead-op hachchamayim ki nikhamti ki asitim
Vaamar Adonai emkhé yat anacha di beréti méal appé ara méénacha ad beira ad rikhacha vead opa dichmayya aré tabit bemémeri aré abadtinoun:
Venoakh matsa khén beéné Adonai
Venoakh achkakh rakhamin qodam Adonai:
élleh toledot noakh noakh ich tsaddiq tamim haya bedorotayv et-haélohim hitehallek-noakh
Illén touledat noakh noakh gebar zakkay chelim hava bedarohi bedakhalta daAdonai hallik noakh:
Vayyoled noakh chelocha banim et-chém et-kham veet-yapet
Veolid noakh telata benin yat chém yat kham veyat yapet:
Vattichchakhét haarets lipné haélohim vattimmalé haarets khamas
Veitkhabbalat ara qodam Adonai veitmeliat ara khatopin:
Vayyar élohim et-haarets vehinnéh nichkhata ki-hichkhit kol-basar et-darko al-haarets
Vakhaza Adonai yat ara veha itkhabbalat aré khabbilou kol bisra énach yat orkhéh al ara:
Vayyomer élohim lenoakh qéts kol-basar ba lepanay ki-malea haarets khamas mippenéhem vehinni machkhitam et-haarets
Vaamar Adonai lenoakh qitstsa dekal bisra allat liqodamay aré itmeliat ara khatopin min qodam obadéhon bichayya veha ana mekhabbelhon im ara:
Aséh leka tébat atsé-goper qinnim taaseh et-hattéba vekaparta otah mibbayit oumikhouts bakkoper
Ibéd lak tébota deain deqadrom medorin tabéd yat tébota vetekhpé yatah miggav oumibbara bekapera:
Vezeh acher taaseh otah cheloch méot amma orek hattéba khamichchim amma rokhbah ouchelochim amma qomatah
Vedén ditaabbéd yatah telat mea ammin oureka detébota khamchin ammin petayah outelatin ammin roumah:
Tsohar taaseh lattéba veel-amma tekallenna milmala oupetakh hattéba betsiddah tasim takhtiyyim cheniyyim ouchelichim taaseha
Néhor tabéd letébota ouleamta techaklelinnah milleélla vetara detébota besitrah techavvi medorin arain tinyanin outelitain tabedinnah:
Vaani hinni mébi et-hammabboul mayim al-haarets lechakhét kol-basar acher-bo rouakh khayyim mittakhat hachchamayim kol acher-baarets yigva
Vaana ha ana mayté yat topana mayya al ara lekhabbala kol bisra di béh roukha dekhayyé mittekhot chemayya kol di beara yemout:
Vahaqimoti et-beriti ittak oubata el-hattéba atta oubanéka veichteka ouneché-banéka ittak
Veaqém yat qeyami immak vetéol letébota at oubenak veittetak ouneché benak immak:
Oumikkol-hakhay mikkol-basar chenayim mikkol tabi el-hattéba lehakhayot ittak zakar ouneqéba yiheyou
Oumikkal dekhay mikkol bisra terén mikkola taél letébota leqayyama immak dekar venaqeba yehon:
Méhaop leminéhou oumin-habbehéma leminah mikkol remes haadama leminéhou chenayim mikkol yaboou éléka lehakhayot
Méopa liznohi oumin beira liznah oumikkol rikhacha deara liznohi terén mikkolla yaaloun levatak leqayyama:
Veatta qakh-leka mikkol-maakal acher yéakél veasapta éléka vehaya leka velahem leokla
Veat sab lak mikkol mékal dimitakél vetiknoch levatak vihé lak oulehon lemékal:
Vayyaas noakh kekol acher tsivva oto élohim kén asa
Vaabad nokh kekol di paqqéd yatéh Adonai kén abad:
Vayyomer Adonai lenoakh bo-atta vekol-béteka el-hattéba ki-oteka raiti tsaddiq lepanay baddor hazzeh
Vaamar Adonai lenoakh oul at vekol énach bétak letébota aré yatak khazéti zakkay qodamay bedara hadén:
Mikkol habbehéma hattehora tiqqakh-leka chiba chiba ich veichto oumin-habbehéma acher lo tehora hiv chenayim ich veichto
Mikkol beira dakya tissab lak chaba chaba dekar venaqeba oumin beira dila itaha dakya hi terén dekar venaqeba:
Gam méop hachchamayim chiba chiba zakar ouneqéba lekhayyot zera al-pené kol-haarets
Ap méopa dichmayya chaba chaba dekar venaqeba leqayyama zara al appé kol ara:
Ki leyamim od chiba anoki mamtir al-haarets arbaim yom vearbaim layela oumakhiti et-kol-hayeqoum acher asiti méal pené haadama
Aré lizman yomin od chaba ana makhét mitra al ara arbein yemamin vearbein lélavan veemkhé yat kol yeqouma di abdat méal appé ara:
Vayyaas noakh kekol acher-tsivvahou Adonai
Vaabad noakh kekol di paqqedéh Adonai:
Venoakh ben-chéch méot chana vehammabboul haya mayim al-haarets
Venoakh bar chit mea chenin vetopana hava mayya al ara:
Vayyabo noakh oubanayv veichto ouneché-banayv itto el-hattéba mippené mé hammabboul
Veal noakh oubenohi veittetéh ouneché benohi imméh letébota min qodam mé topana:
Min-habbehéma hattehora oumin-habbehéma acher énenna tehora oumin-haop vekol acher-romés al-haadama
Min beira dakya oumin beira di létaha dakya oumin opa vekol di rakhéch al ara:
Chenayim chenayim baou el-noakh el-hattéba zakar ouneqéba kaacher tsivva élohim et-noakh
Terén terén allou levat noakh letébota dekar venaqeba kema di paqqéd Adonai yat noakh:
Vayehi lechibat hayyamim oumé hammabboul hayou al-haarets
Vahava lizman chibat yomin oumé topana havo al ara:
Bichnat chéch-méot chana lekhayyé-noakh bakhodech hachchéni bechiba-asar yom lakhodech bayyom hazzeh nibqeou kol-mayenot tehom rabba vaarubbot hachchamayim niptakhou
Bichnat chit mea chenin lekhayyé noakh beyarkha tinyana bechibat asra yoma leyarkha beyoma hadén itbezaou kol mabboué tehoma rabba vekavvé chemayya itpattakhou:
Vayehi haggechem al-haarets arbaim yom vearbaim layela
Vahava mitra nakhat al ara arbein yemamin vearbein lélavan:
Beetsem hayyom hazzeh ba noakh vechém-vekham vayepet bené-noakh veéchet noakh ouchelochet neché-banayv ittam el-hattéba
Bikran yoma hadén al noakh vechém vekham vayepet bené noakh veittat noakh outelata neché benohi immehon letébota:
Hémma vekol-hakhayya leminah vekol-habbehéma leminah vekol-haremes haromés al-haarets leminéhou vekol-haop leminéhou kol tsippor kol-kanap
Innoun vekol khayta liznah vekol beira liznah vekol rikhacha derakhéch al ara liznohi vekol opa liznohi kol tsippar kol deparakh:
Vayyaboou el-noakh el-hattéba chenayim chenayim mikkol-habbasar acher-bo rouakh khayyim
Veallou im noakh letébota terén terén mikkol bisra di béh roukha dekhayé:
Vehabbaim zakar ouneqéba mikkol-basar baou kaacher tsivva oto élohim vayyisgor Adonai baado
Vealayya dekar venaqeba mikkol bisra allou kema di paqqéd yatéh Adonai vaagén Adonai bemémeréh alohi:
Vayehi hammabboul arbaim yom al-haarets vayyirbou hammayim vayyisou et-hattéba vattarom méal haarets
Vahava topana arbein yomin al ara ousegiou mayya ounetalou yat tébota veittaramat méal ara:
Vayyigberou hammayim vayyirbou meod al-haarets vattélek hattéba al-pené hammayim
Outeqipou mayya ousegiou lakhada al ara oumehalleka tébota al appé mayya:
Vehammayim gaberou meod meod al-haarets vayekussou kol-heharim haggebohim acher-takhat kol-hachchamayim
Oumayya teqipou lakhada lakhada al ara veitkhapiou kol tourayya ramayya di tekhot kol chemayya:
Khaméch esréh amma milmala gaberou hammayim vayekussou heharim
Khaméch asréh ammin milélla teqipou mayya veitkhapiou touraya:
Vayyigva kol-basar haromés al-haarets baop oubabbehéma oubakhayya oubekol-hachcherets hachchoréts al-haarets vekol haadam
Oumit kol bisra derakhéch al ara beopa oubibira oubekhayta oubekol rikhacha derakhéch al ara vekol énacha:
Kol acher nichmat-rvakh khayyim beappayv mikkol acher bekharaba métou
Kol di nichmeta roukha dekhayyin beanpohi mikkol di beyabbechta mitou:
Vayyimakh et-kol-hayeqoum acher al-pené haadama méadam ad-behéma ad-remes vead-op hachchamayim vayyimmakhou min-haarets vayyichchaer ak-noakh vaacher itto battéba
Oumekha yat kol yeqouma di al appé ara méénacha ad beira ad rikhacha vead opa dichmayya veitmekhiou min ara veichtaar beram noakh vedi imméh betébota:
Vayyigberou hammayim al-haarets khamichchim oumeat yom
Outeqipou mayya al ara mea vekhamchin yomin:
Vayyizkor élohim et-noakh veét kol-hakhayya veet-kol-habbehéma acher itto battéba vayyaabér élohim rouakh al-haarets vayyachokkou hammayim
Oudekir Adonai yat noakh veyat kol khayta veyat kol beira di imméh betébota veabar Adonai roukha al ara venakhou mayya:
Vayyissakerou mayenot tehom vaarubbot hachchamayim vayyikkalé haggechem min-hachchamayim
Veistekarou mabboué tehoma vekavvé chemayya veitkeli mitra min chemayya:
Vayyachoubou hammayim méal haarets halok vachob vayyakhserou hammayim miqtséh khamichchim oumeat yom
Vetabou mayya méal ara azelin vetayebin vakhasarou mayya missop mea vekhamchin yomin:
Vattanakh hattéba bakhodech hachchebii bechiba-asar yom lakhodech al haré ararat
Venakhat tébota beyarkha chebiaa bechibat asar yoma leyarkha al touré qardou:
Vehammayim hayou halok vekhasor ad hakhodech haasiri baasiri beekhad lakhodech nirou raché heharim
Oumayya havo azelin vekhaserin ad yarkha asiraa baasiraa bekhad leyarkha itkhaziou réché tourayya:
Vayehi miqqéts arbaim yom vayyiptakh noakh et-khallon hattéba acher asa
Vahava missop arbein yomin oupetakh noakh yat kavvat tébota di abad:
Vayechallakh et-haoréb vayyétsé yatso vachob ad-yebochet hammayim méal haarets
Vechallakh yat areba ounepaq mippaq vetayib ad deyabbichou mayya méal ara:
Vayechallakh et-hayyona méitto lirot haqallou hammayim méal pené haadama
Vechallakh yat yona millevatéh lemekhézé haqalliou mayya méal appé ara:
Velo-matsea hayyona manoakh lekap-raglah vattachob élayv el-hattéba ki-mayim al-pené kol-haarets vayyichlakh yado vayyiqqakheha vayyabé otah élayv el-hattéba
Vela achkakhat yona menakh leparsat raglah vetabat levatéh letébota aré mayya al appé kol ara veochit yedéh venasebah veaél yatah levatéh letébota:
Vayyakhel od chibat yamim akhérim vayyosep challakh et-hayyona min-hattéba
Veorik od chaba yomin okhoranin veosép challakh yat yona min tébota:
Vattabo élayv hayyona leét ereb vehinnéh aléh-zayit tarap bepiha vayyéda noakh ki-qallou hammayim méal haarets
Vaatat levatéh yona leiddan ramcha veha terap zéta tebir nakhit bepoumah vida noakh aré qalliou maya méal ara:
Vayyiyyakhel od chibat yamim akhérim vayechallakh et-hayyona velo-yasepa choub-élayv od
Veorik od chaba yomin okhoranin vechallakh yat yona vela osépat lemittoub levatéh od:
Vayehi beakhat vechéch-méot chana barichon beekhad lakhodech kharebou hammayim méal haarets vayyasar noakh et-mikséh hattéba vayyar vehinnéh kharebou pené haadama
Vahava bechit mea vekhad chenin beqadmaa bekhad leyarkha negoubou mayya méal ara veadi noakh yat khopaa detébota vakhaza veha negoubou appé ara:

Vayehi kebo abram mitsrayema vayyirou hammitsrim et-haichcha ki-yapa hiv meod
Vahava kad al abram lemitsrayim vakhazo mitsraé yat itteta aré chappira hi lakhada:
Vayyirou otah saré paroh vayehalelou otah el-paroh vattuqqakh haichcha bét paroh
Vakhazo yatah rabrebé paroh vechabbakhou yatah leparoh veiddabbarat itteta lebét paroh:
Ouleabram hétib baabourah vayehi-lo tson-vbaqar vakhamorim vaabadim ouchepakhot vaatonot ougemallim
Ouleabram otib bedilah vahavo léh an vetorin vakhamarin veabdin veamhan veatnan vegamlin:
Vayenagga Adonai et-paroh negaim gedolim veet-béto al-debar saray échet abram
Veayti Adonai al paroh maktachin rabrebin veal énach bétéh al ésaq saray ittat abram:
Vayyiqra paroh leabram vayyomer mah-zot asita li lamma lo-higgadta li ki ichteka hiv
Ouqera paroh leabram vaamar ma da abadt li lema la khavvéta li aré ittetak hi:
Lama amarta akhoti hiv vaeqqakh otah li leichcha veatta hinnéh ichteka qakh valék
Lema amart akhati hi oudebarit yatah li leittou oukean ha ittetak debar veizél:
Vayetsav alayv paroh anachim vayechallekhou oto veet-ichto veet-kol-acher-lo
Oupaqqéd alohi paroh gouberin vealviou yatéh veyat ittetéh veyat kol diléh:
Vayyaal abram mimmitsrayim hou veichto vekol-acher-lo velot immo hannegba
Ouseliq abram mimmitsrayim hou veittetéh vekol diléh velot imméh ledaroma:
Veabram kabéd meod bammiqneh bakkesep oubazzahab
Veabram taqqip lakhada bibira bekaspa oubedahaba:
Vayyélek lemassaayv minnegeb vead-bét-él ad-hammaqom acher-haya cham oholoh battekhilla bén bét-él oubén haay
Vaazal lematlanohi middaroma vead bét él ad atra di peras tamman machkenéh beqadméta bén bét él oubén ay:
El-meqom hammizbéakh acher-asa cham barichona vayyiqra cham abram bechém Adonai
Laatar madbekha di abad tamman beqadméta vetsalli tamman abram bichma daAdonai:
Vegam-lelot haholék et-abram haya tson-vbaqar veohalim
Veap lelot deazél im abram hava an vetorin oumachkenin:
Velo-nasa otam haarets lachebet yakhdav ki-haya rekoucham rab velo yakelou lachebet yakhdav
Vela sobarat yatehon ara lemitab kakhada aré hava qinyanehon saggi vela yekilou lemitab kakhada:
Vayehi-rib bén roé miqnéh-abram oubén roé miqnéh-lot vehakkenaani vehapperizzi az yochéb baarets
Vahavat matstsouta bén raé beiréh deabram oubén raé beiréh delot oukenaanaa ouperizzaa bekén yatib beara:
Vayyomer abram el-lot al-na tehi meriba béni oubéneka oubén roay oubén roéka ki-anachim akhim anakhenou
Vaamar abram lelot la kean tehé matstsouta béna oubénak oubén raavati oubén raavatak aré gouberin akhin anakhena:
Halo kol-haarets lepanéka hippared na méalay im-hassemol veémina veim-hayyamin veasmeila
Hala kol ara qodamak itperach kean millevati im at letsippouna vaana ledaroma veim at ledaroma vaana letsippouna:
Vayyissa-lot et-énayv vayyar et-kol-kikkar hayyardén ki kullah machqeh lipné chakhét Adonai et-sedom veet-amora kegan-Adonai keerets mitsrayim boaka tsoar
Ouzeqap lot yat énohi vakhaza yat kol méchar yardena aré kullah bét chaqya qodam khabbalout Adonai yat sedom veyat amora kegineta daAdonai keara demitsrayim maté letsoar:
Vayyibkhar-lo lot ét kol-kikkar hayyardén vayyissa lot miqqedem vayyipparedou ich méal akhiv
Oubekhar léh lot yat kol méchar yardena ounetal lot milleqadmin veittaprachou gebar millevat akhouhi:
Abram yachab beerets-kenaan velot yachab bearé hakkikkar vayyeéhal ad-sedom
Abram yatéb beara diknaan velot yatéb beqirevé méchera ouperas ad sedom:
Veanché sedom raim vekhattaim la-Adonai meod
Veénachin s" vaanaché disdom bichin bemamonehon vekhayyabin bigviyyatehon qodam Adonai lakhada:
Va-Adonai amar el-abram akharé hippared-lot méimmo sa na énéka oureéh min-hammaqom acher-atta cham tsapona vanegba vaqédema vayamma
VaAdonai amar leabram batar deitparech lot méimméh zeqop kean énak vakhazé min atra diat tamman letsippouna ouledaroma oulemadinekha oulemaaraba:
Ki et-kol-haarets acher-atta roeh leka ettenenna oulezaraka ad-olam
Aré yat kol ara di at khazé lak etteninnah velibnak ad alam:
Vesamti et-zaraka kaapar haarets acher im-yvkal ich limnot et-apar haarets gam-zaraka yimmaneh
Vaachavvé yat benak saggiin keapra deara kema di la epchar ligbar lemimné yat apra deara ap benak la yittimnoun:
Qoum hithallék baarets leorkah oulerokhbah ki leka ettenenna
Qoum hallik beara leorkah veliptayah aré lak etteninnah:
Vayyeéhal abram vayyabo vayyécheb beéloné mamré acher bekhebron vayyiben-cham mizbéakh la-Adonai
Ouperas abram vaata vitéb bemécheré mamré di bekhebron oubena tamman midbekha qodam Adonai:
Vayehi bimé amrapel melek-chinar aryok melek ellasar kedorlaomer melek élam vetidal melek goyim
Vahava beyomé amrapel malka debabel aryok malka deellasar kedarelaomer malka deélam vetidal malka deammé:
Asou milkhama et-bera melek sedom veet-bircha melek amora chinab melek adma vecheméber melek tseboyim oumelek bela hi-tsoar
Sedarou ny" abadou qeraba im bera malka disdom veim bircha malka daamora chinab malka deadma vecheméber malka ditsboyim oumalka debela hi tsoar:
Kol-élleh khaberou el-émeq hassiddim hou yam hammelakh
Kol illén itkenachou leméchar khaqlayya hou atar yamma demilkha:
Chetém esréh chana abedou et-kedorlaomer oucheloch-esréh chana maradou
Tarté asré chenin pelakhou yat kedarelaomer outelat asré chenin meradou:
Oubearba esréh chana ba kedorlaomer vehammelakim acher itto vayyakkou et-repaim beachterot qarnayim veet-hazzouzim beham veét haémim bechavéh qiryatayim
Oubearba asré chenin ata kedarelaomer oumalkayya deimméh oumekho yat gibbarayya di beachterot qarnayim veyat taqqipayya dibhemta veyat émetané dibchavéh qiryatayim:
Veet-hakhori beharram séir ad él paran acher al-hammidbar
Veyat khoraé di betourehon deséir ad méchar paran dismik al madbera:
Vayyachoubou vayyaboou el-én michpat hiv qadéch vayyakkou et-kol-sedéh haamaléqi vegam et-haémori hayyochéb bekhatsetson tamar
Vetabou vaatou leméchar pilloug dina hi reqam oumekho yat kol khaqal amalqaa veap yat émoraa deyatéb beén gedi:
Vayyétsé melek-sedom oumelek amora oumelek adma oumelek tseboyim oumelek bela hiv-tsoar vayyaarkou ittam milkhama beémeq hassiddim
Ounepaq malka disdom oumalka daamora oumalka deadma oumalka ditsboyim oumalka debela hi tsoar vesaddarou immehon qeraba beméchar khaqlayya:
ét kedorlaomer melek élam vetidal melek goyim veamrapel melek chinar vearyok melek ellasar arbaa melakim et-hakhamichcha
Im kedarelaomer malka deélam vetidal malka deammin veamrapel malka debabel vearyok malka deellasar arbea malkin loqobél khamcha:
Veémeq hassiddim beérot beérot khémar vayyanousou melek-sedom vaamora vayyippelou-chamma vehannicharim hera nasou
Ouméchar khaqlayya bérin bérin masqan khémara vaaraqou malka disdom vaamora ounepalou tamman oudeichtaarou letoura araqou:
Vayyiqkhou et-kol-rekouch sedom vaamora veet-kol-oklam vayyélékou
Ouchebo yat kol qinyana disdom vaamora veyat kol mékalehon vaazalou:
Vayyiqkhou et-lot veet-rekucho ben-akhi abram vayyélékou vehou yochéb bisdom
Ouchebo yat lot veyat qinyanéh bar akhouhi deabram vaazalou vehou yatéb bisdom:
Vayyabo happalit vayyaggéd leabram haibri vehou chokén beéloné mamré haémori akhi echkol vaakhi anér vehém baalé berit-abram
Vaata mechézaba vekhavvi leabram ibraa vehou charé bemécheré mamré émoraa akhouhi deechkol vaakhouhi deanér veinnoun énaché qeyaméh deabram:
Vayyichma abram ki nichba akhiv vayyareq et-khanikayv yelidé béto chemona asar oucheloch méot vayyirdop ad-dan
Ouchema abram aré ichtebi akhouhi vezaréz yat oulémohi yelidé bétéh telat mea vetamné asar ouredap ad dan:
Vayyékhaléq aléhem layla hou vaabadayv vayyakkém vayyirdepém ad-khoba acher missemol ledammaseq
Veitpelég aléhon léleya hou veabdohi oumekhonoun ouredapinnoun ad khoba di mitstsippouna ledammaseq:
Vayyacheb ét kol-harekouch vegam et-lot akhiv ourekucho héchib vegam et-hannachim veet-haam
Vaatéb yat kol qinyana veap yat lot bar akhouhi veqinyanéh atéb veap yat nechayya veyat amma:
Vayyétsé melek-sedom liqrato akharé choubo méhakkot et-kedorlaomer veet-hammelakim acher itto el-émeq chavéh hou émeq hammelek
Ounepaq malka disdom leqaddamoutéh batar detab millemimkhé yat kedarelaomer veyat malkayya di imméh leméchar mapna hou atar bét résa demalka:
Oumalki-tsedeq melek chalém hotsi lekhem vayayin vehou kohén leél elyon
Oumalki tsedeq malka dirouchelem appéq lekhém vakhamar vehou mechamméch qodam él illaa:
Vayebarekéhou vayyomar barouk abram leél elyon qonéh chamayim vaarets
Oubarekéh vaamar berik abram leél illaa diqinyanéh chemayya veara:
Oubarouk él elyon acher-miggén tsaréka beyadeka vayyitten-lo maasér mikkol
Ouberik él illaa dimsar saneak bidak vihab léh khad min asra mikkolla:
Vayyomer melek-sedom el-abram ten-li hannepech veharekouch qakh-lak
Vaamar malka disdom leabram hab li napchata veqinyana debar lak:
Vayyomer abram el-melek sedom harimoti yadi el-Adonai él elyon qonéh chamayim vaarets
Vaamar abram lemalka disdom arémit yeday bitslo qodam Adonai qodam él illaa diqinyanéh chemayya veara:
Im-mikhout vead serok-naal veim-eqqakh mikkol-acher-lak velo tomar ani heécharti et-abram
Im mikhouta vead arqat mesana veim essab mikkol di lak vela témar ana atarit yat abram:
Biladay raq acher akelou hannearim vekhéleq haanachim acher halekou itti anér echkol oumamré hém yiqkhou khelqam
Lekhod middiakalou oulémayya vekhoulaq gubrayya di azalou immi anér echkol oumamré innoun yeqabbeloun khalaqehon:
Akhar haddebarim haélleh haya debar-Adonai el-abram bammakhazeh lémor al-tira abram anoki magén lak sekareka harbéh meod
Batar pitgamayya haillén hava pitgama daAdonai im abram binboua lemémar la tidkhal abram mémeri teqop lak agrak saggi lakhada:
Vayyomer abram adonay Adonai mah-titten-li veanoki holék ariri ouben-mecheq béti hou dammeseq éliezer
Vaamar abram Adonai éllohim mah titten li vaana azél bela velad oubar parnasa hadén dibbéti hou dammasqaa éliezer:
Vayyomer abram hén li lo natatta zara vehinnéh ben-béti yoréch oti
Vaamar abram ha li la yehabt velad veha bar béti yarit yati:
Vehinnéh debar-Adonai élayv lémor lo yiracheka zeh ki-im acher yétsé mimmééka hou yiracheka
Veha pitgama daAdonai imméh lemémar la yirtinnak dén élahén bar detolid hou yirtinnak:
Vayyotsé oto hakhoutsa vayyomer habbet-na hachchamayma ousepor hakkokabim im-toukal lispor otam vayyomer lo koh yihyeh zareka
Veappéq yatéh lebara vaamar isteki kean lichmayya oumené kokebayya im tikkol lemimné yatehon vaamar léh kedén yehon benak:
Veheémin ba-Adonai vayyakhchebeha lo tsedaqa
Vehémin bemémera daAdonai vekhachebah léh lezakou:
Vayyomer élayv ani Adonai acher hotsétika méour kasdim latet leka et-haarets hazzot lerichtah
Vaamar léh ana Adonai diappéqetak méoura dekasdaé lemittan lak yat ara hada leméretah:
Vayyomar adonay Adonai bamma éda ki irachenna
Vaamar Adonai éllohim bema idda aré éretinah:
Vayyomer élayv qekha li egla mechullechet veéz mechullechet veayil mechullach vetor vegozal
Vaamar léh qaréb qodamay eglin telata veizzin telata vedikrin telat vechapnina oubar yona:
Vayyiqqakh-lo et-kol-élleh vayebattér otam battavek vayyittén ich-bitro liqrat rééhou veet-hatstsippor lo batar
Veqaréb qodamohi yat kol illén oupallig yatehon bechaveh vihab palgayya pilloug loqobél khabréh veyat opa la pallig:
Vayyéred haayit al-happegarim vayyachchéb otam abram
Ounekhat opa al paglayya veaprakh yatehon abram:
Vayehi hachchemech labo vetardéma napela al-abram vehinnéh éma khachéka gedola nopelet alayv
Vahava chimcha leméal vechinta nepalat al abram veha éma qebal saggi nepalat alohi:
Vayyomer leabram yadoa téda ki-gér yihyeh zaraka beerets lo lahem vaabadoum veinnou otam arba méot chana
Vaamar leabram midda tidda aré dayyarin yehon benak beara dela dilehon veyiplekhoun behon viannoun yatehon arba mea chenin:
Vegam et-haggoy acher yaabodou dan anoki veakharé-kén yétseou birkouch gadol
Veap yat amma diyiplekhoun behon dayin ana oubatar kén yipqoun beqinyana saggi:
Veatta tabo el-abotéka bechalom tiqqabér beséba toba
Veat téol levat abahatak bichlam titqebar besébou taba:
Vedor rebii yachoubou hénna ki lo-chalém avon haémori ad-hénna
Vedara rebiaa yetouboun haka aré la chelim khoba deémoraa ad kean:
Vayehi hachchemech baa vaalata haya vehinnéh tannour achan velappid éch acher abar bén haggezarim haélleh
Vahava chimcha allat veqabla hava veha tannour ditnan oubeour deechchata di ada bén palgayya haillén:
Bayyom hahou karat Adonai et-abram berit lémor lezaraka natatti et-haarets hazzot minnehar mitsrayim ad-hannahar haggadol nehar-perat
Beyoma hahou gezar Adonai im abram qeyam lemémar libnak yehabit yat ara hada min nahara demitsrayim vead nahara rabba nahara perat:
Et-haqqéni veet-haqqenizzi veét haqqadmoni
Yat chalmaé veyat qenizzaé veyat qadmonaé:
Veet-hakhitti veet-happerizzi veet-harepaim
Veyat khittaé veyat perizzaé veyat gibbaraé:
Veet-haémori veet-hakkenaani veet-haggirgachi veet-hayebousi
Veyat émoraé veyat kenaanaé veyat girgachaé veyat yebousaé:
Vesaray échet abram lo yaleda lo velah chipkha mitsrit ouchemah hagar
Vesaray ittat abram la yelidat léh velah amta mitsréta ouchemah hagar:
Vattomer saray el-abram hinnéh-na atsarani Adonai milledet bo-na el-chipkhati oulay ibbaneh mimmenna vayyichma abram leqol saray
Vaamarat saray leabram ha kean manani Adonai millemélad oul kean levat amti maim itbené minnah veqabbil abram lemémar saray:
Vattiqqakh saray échet-abram et-hagar hammitsrit chipkhatah miqqéts eser chanim lechebet abram beerets kenaan vattittén otah leabram ichah lo leichcha
Oudebarat saray ittat abram yat hagar mitsréta amtah missop asar chenin lemittab abram beara diknaan vihabat yatah leabram balah léh leintou:
Vayyabo el-hagar vattahar vattére ki harata vattéqal gebirtah beénéha
Veal levat hagar veaddiat vakhazat aré addiat ouqelat ribbanetah beénahah:
Vattomer saray el-abram khamasi aléka anoki natatti chipkhati bekhéqeka vattére ki harata vaéqal beénéha yichpot Adonai béni oubénéka
Vaamarat saray leabram din li alak ana yehabit amti lak vakhazat aré addiat ouqelét beénahah yedin Adonai béni oubénak:
Vayyomer abram el-saray hinnéh chipkhaték beyadék asi-la hattob beénayik vatteanneha saray vattibrakh mippanéha
Vaamar abram lesaray ha amtik bidik ibidi lah kidtaqqin beénayeki veanitah saray veareqat miqqodamahah:
Vayyimtsaah malak Adonai al-én hammayim bammidbar al-haayin bederek chour
Veachkekhah malaka daAdonai al éna demayya bemadbera al éna beorkha dekhagra:
Vayyomar hagar chipkhat saray é-mizzeh bat veana téléki vattomer mippené saray gebirti anoki borakhat
Vaamar hagar amta desaray menan at ateya oulean at azela vaamarat min qodam saray ribbaneti ana areqa ny" araqat:
Vayyomer lah malak Adonai choubi el-gebirték vehitanni takhat yadéha
Vaamar lah malaka daAdonai toubi levat ribbonetik veichtabedi tekhot yedaha:
Vayyomer lah malak Adonai harba arbeh et-zarék velo yissapér mérob
Vaamar lah malaka daAdonai asgaa asgé yat benayeki vela yittimnoun missegé:
Vayyomer lah malak Adonai hinnak hara veyoladt bén veqarat chemo yichmaél ki-chama Adonai el-onyék
Vaamar lah malaka daAdonai ha at meadya vetéledin bar vetiqrin cheméh yichmaél aré qabbil Adonai tselotik:
Vehou yihyeh pere adam yado bakkol veyad kol bo veal-pené kol-ekhayv yichkon
Vehou yehé marod beénacha hou yehé tserik lekolla vida dibné anacha yehon tserikin léh veal appé kol akhohi yichré:
Vattiqra chém-Adonai haddobér éléha atta él roi ki amera hagam halom raiti akharé roi
Vetsalliat bichma daAdonai demitmallél immah amarat at hou élaha dekhazé kolla aré amarat habram haka ny" haap ana charéti khazeya batar deitgeli li:
Al-kén qara labbeér beér lakhay roi hinnéh bén-qadéch oubén bared
Al kén qera libéra beéra demalak qayyama ittakhazi alah ha hi bén reqam oubén khagra:
Vattéled hagar leabram bén vayyiqra abram chem-beno acher-yaleda hagar yichmaél
Vilidat hagar leabram bar ouqera abram choum beréh dilidat hagar yichmaél:
Veabram ben-chemonim chana vechéch chanim beledet-hagar et-yichmaél leabram
Veabram bar temanan vechit chenin kad yelidat hagar yat yichmaél leabram:
Vayehi abram ben-tichim chana vetécha chanim vayyéra Adonai el-abram vayyomer élayv ani-él chadday hithallék lepanay vehyéh tamim
Vahava abram bar tichin outecha chenin veitgeli Adonai leabram vaamar léh ana él chadday pelakh qodamay vehévé chelim:
Veettena beriti béni oubéneka vearbeh oteka bimod meod
Veettén qeyami bén mémeri oubénak veasgé yatak lakhada lakhada:
Vayyippol abram al-panayv vayedabbér itto élohim lémor
Ounepal abram al appohi oumallél imméh Adonai lemémar:
Ani hinnéh beriti ittak vehayita leab hamon goyim
Ana ha gezar bny" ynnv qeyami immak outehé leab saggi ammin:
Velo-yiqqaré od et-chimka abram vehaya chimka abraham ki ab-hamon goyim netattika
Vela yitqeré od yat chemak abram vihé chemak abraham aré ab saggi ammin yehabittak:
Vehipréti oteka bimod meod ounetattika legoyim oumelakim mimmeka yétséou
Veappéch yatak lakhada lakhada veetteninnak lekinchin oumalkin dechallitin beammayya minnak yipqoun:
Vahaqimoti et-beriti béni oubéneka oubén zaraka akharéka ledorotam librit olam lihyot leka lélohim oulezaraka akharéka
Vaaqém yat qeyami bén mémeri oubénak oubén benak batrak ledaréhon liqyam alam leméhavé lak lélaha velibnak batrak:
Venatatti leka oulezaraka akharéka ét erets meguréka ét kol-erets kenaan laakhuzzat olam vehayiti lahem lélohim
Veettén lak velibnak batrak yat ara totaboutak yat kol ara diknaan leakhasanat alam veehévé lehon lélaha:
Vayyomer élohim el-abraham veatta et-beriti tichmor atta vezaraka akharéka ledorotam
Vaamar Adonai leabraham veat yat qeyami tittar at oubenak batrak ledaréhon:
Zot beriti acher tichmerou béni oubénékem oubén zaraka akharéka himmol lakem kol-zakar
Da qeyami di titteroun bén mémeri oubénékon oubén benak batrak migzar lekon kol dekoura:
Ounemaltem ét besar orlatkem vehaya leot berit béni oubénékem
Vetigzeroun yat bisra deorlatekon outehé ny" outehé leat qeyam bén mémeri oubénékon:
Ouben-chemonat yamim yimmol lakem kol-zakar ledorotékem yelid bayit oumiqnat-kesep mikkol ben-nékar acher lo mizzaraka hou
Oubar temanya yomin yitgezar ny" yigzar lekon kol dekoura ledaratékon yelidé béta ouzebiné kaspa mikkol bar ammin dela mibbenak hou:
Himmol yimmol yelid béteka oumiqnat kaspeka vehayeta beriti bibsarkem librit olam
Itgazzara yitgazzeroun ny" migzar yigzar yelid bétak ouzebin kaspak outehé qeyami bebisrékon liqyam alam:
Vearél zakar acher lo-yimmol et-besar orlato venikreta hannepech hahiv méamméha et-beriti hépar

Oukean atéb ittat gabra aré nebiyya hou vitsallé alak outekhé veim létak metib da aré mémat temout at vekol di lak:
Vayyachkém abimelek babboqer vayyiqra lekol-abadayv vayedabbér et-kol-haddebarim haélleh beoznéhem vayyireou haanachim meod
Veaqdém abimelek betsapra ouqera lekol abdohi oumallil yat kol pitgamayya haillén qodaméhon oudekhilou gouberayya lakhada:
Vayyiqra abimelek leabraham vayyomer lo meh-asita lanou oumeh-khatati lak ki-hébéta alay veal-mamlakti khataa gedola maasim acher lo-yéasou asita immadi
Ouqera abimelek leabraham vaamar léh mah abadta lana oumah khabit ny" khatét lak aré aytéta alay veal malkouti khoba rabba obadin di la kacherin leitabada abadta immi:
Vayyomer abimelek el-abraham ma raita ki asita et-haddabar hazzeh
Vaamar abimelek leabraham ma khazéta aré abadta yat pitgama hadén:
Vayyomer abraham ki amarti raq én-yirat élohim bammaqom hazzeh vaharagouni al-debar ichti
Vaamar abraham aré amarit lekhod lét dakhalta daAdonai beatra hadén veyiqtelunnani al ésaq itteti:
Vegam-omna akhoti bat-abi hiv ak lo bat-immi vattehi-li leichcha
Ouberam beqoucheta akhati bat abba hi beram la bat immi vahavat li leintou:
Vayehi kaacher hitou oti élohim mibbét abi vaomar lah zeh khasdék acher taasi immadi el kol-hammaqom acher nabo chamma imri-li akhi hou
Vahava kad taou ammayya batar obadé yedéhon yati qarib Adonai ledakhaltéh mibbét abba vaamarit lah dén ny" da téboutik di tabedi immi lekol atra dinhak letamman émari alay akhi hou:
Vayyiqqakh abimelek tson oubaqar vaabadim ouchepakhot vayyittén leabraham vayyacheb lo ét sara ichto
Oudebar abimelek an vetorin veabdin veamhan vihab leabraham vaatéb léh yat sara ittetéh:
Vayyomer abimelek hinnéh artsi lepanéka battob beénéka chéb
Vaamar abimelek ha ari qodamak bidtaqqin beénayk tib:
Oulesara amar hinnéh natatti elep kesep leakhik hinnéh hou-lak kesout énayim lekol acher ittak veét kol venokakhat
Oulesara amar ha yehabit elep salin diksap leakhik ha hou lik kesout diqar aynin kholap dichlakhit debartik vakhazét yatik veyat kol deimmak veal kol mah daamarat ittokakhat:
Vayyitpallél abraham el-haélohim vayyirpa élohim et-abimelek veet-ichto veamhotayv vayyélédou
Vetsalli abraham qodam Adonai veassi Adonai yat abimelek veyat ittetéh veamhatéh veitrevakhou:
Ki-atsor atsar Adonai bead kol-rekhem lebét abimelek al-debar sara échet abraham
Aré mékhad akhad Adonai beappé kol patakh valeda lebét abimelek al ésaq sara ittat abraham:
Va-Adonai paqad et-sara kaacher amar vayyaas Adonai lesara kaacher dibbér
Vayya dekir yat sara kema di amar vaabad Adonai lechara kema di mallil:
Vattahar vattéled sara leabraham bén lizqunayv lammoéd acher-dibber oto élohim
Veaddiat vilidat sara leabraham bar lesibetohi lizman di mallil yatéh Adonai:
Vayyiqra abraham et-chem-beno hannolad-lo acher-yaleda-lo sara yitskhaq
Ouqera abraham yat choum beréh deityelid léh dilidat léh sara yitskhaq:
Vayyamol abraham et-yitskhaq beno ben-chemonat yamim kaacher tsivva oto élohim
Ougezar abraham yat yitskhaq beréh bar temanya yomin kema di paqqid yatéh Adonai:
Veabraham ben-meat chana behivvaled lo ét yitskhaq beno
Veabraham bar mea chenin kad ityelid léh yat yitskhaq beréh:
Vattomer sara tsekhoq asa li élohim kol-hachchoméa yitsekhaq-li
Vaameret sara khedva abad li Adonai kol dichma yekhéddé li:
Vattomer mi millél leabraham héniqa banim sara ki-yaladti bén lizqunayv
Vaameret man mehéman daamar leabraham qeyam detoniq benin sara aré yelédit bar lesibetohi:
Vayyigdal hayyeled vayyiggamal vayyaas abraham michteh gadol beyom higgamél et-yitskhaq
Oureba rabya veitkhasil vaabad abraham michteya rabba beyoma deitkhasil yat yitskhaq:
Vattére sara et-ben-hagar hammitsrit acher-yaleda leabraham metsakhéq
Vakhazat sara yat bar hagar mitsréta diylidat leabraham mekhayik:
Vattomer leabraham garéch haama hazzot veet-benah ki lo yirach ben-haama hazzot im-beni im-yitskhaq
Vaameret leabraham tarék amta hada veyat berah aré la yérat bar amta hada im beri im yitskhaq:
Vayyéra haddabar meod beéné abraham al odot beno
Oubeéch pitgama lakhada beéné abraham al ésaq beréh:
Vayyomer élohim el-abraham al-yéra beénéka al-hannaar veal-amateka kol acher tomar éléka sara chema beqolah ki beyitskhaq yiqqaré leka zara
Vaamar Adonai leabraham la yabéch beénayk al ouléma veal amtak kol di témar lak sara qabbél minnah aré beyitskhaq yitqeroun lak benin:
Vegam et-ben-haama legoy asimennou ki zaraka hou
Veap yat bar amta leam achavvinnéh aré benak hou:
Vayyachkém abraham babboqer vayyiqqakh-lekhem vekhémat mayim vayyittén el-hagar sam al-chikmah veet-hayyeled vayechallekheha vattélek vattéta bemidbar beér chaba
Veaqdém abraham betsapra ounesib lakhama veraqeba demayya vihab lehagar chavvi al katpah veyat rabya vechalkhah vaazalat vetaat bemadbera ny" bemadbér beér chaba:
Vayyiklou hammayim min-hakhémet vattachlék et-hayyeled takhat akhad hassikhim
Ouchelimou mayya min raqeba ouremat yat rabya tekhot khad min ilanayya:
Vattélek vattécheb lah minneged harkhéq kimtakhavé qechet ki amera al-ereh bemot hayyaled vattécheb minneged vattissa et-qolah vattébk
Vaazallat vitibat lah miqqobél arkhéqat ny" arkhiq kemégar qachta aré ameret la ekhézé bemota derabya vitibat miqqobél vaarimat yat qalah oubekat:
Vayyichma élohim et-qol hannaar vayyiqra malak élohim el-hagar min-hachchamayim vayyomer lah mah-lak hagar al-tirei ki-chama élohim el-qol hannaar baacher hou-cham
Ouchemia qodam Adonai yat qaléh derabya ouqera malaka daAdonai lehagar min chemayya vaamar lah ma lik hagar la tidkhali aré chemia qodam Adonai yat qaléh derabya baatar dehou tamman:
Qoumi sei et-hannaar vehakhaziqi et-yadék bo ki-legoy gadol asimennou
Qoumi touli yat rabya veatqipi yat yedék béh aré leam saggi achavvinnéh:
Vayyipqakh élohim et-énéha vattére beér mayim vattélek vattemallé et-hakhémet mayim vattachq et-hannaar
Ougela Adonai yat énahah vakhazat béra demayya vaazalat oumelat yat raqeba mayya veachqiat yat rabya:
Vayehi élohim et-hannaar vayyigdal vayyécheb bammidbar vayehi robeh qachchat
Vahava mémera daAdonai besaadéh derabya oureba vitéb bemadbera vahava rabé qachta:
Vayyécheb bemidbar paran vattiqqakh-lo immo ichcha méerets mitsrayim
Vitéb bemadbera deparan ounesibat léh imméh itteta méara demitsrayim:
Vayehi baét hahiv vayyomer abimelek oupikol sar-tsebao el-abraham lémor élohim immeka bekol acher-atta oseh
Vahava beiddana hahi vaamar abimelek oupikol rab khéléh leabraham lemémar mémera daAdonai besaadak bekol di at abéd:
Veatta hichchabea li bélohim hénna im-tichqor li oulenini oulenekdi kakhesed acher-asiti immeka taaseh immadi veim-haarets acher-garta bah
Oukean qayyém li bemémera daAdonai haka dela techaqqar bi oubibri oubebar beri ketébota di abadit immak tabéd immi veim ara deittotabta bah:
Vayyomer abraham anoki ichchabéa
Vaamar abraham ana aqayyém:
Vehokiakh abraham et-abimelek al-odot beér hammayim acher gazelou abdé abimelek
Veokakh abraham yat abimelek al ésaq béra demayya di annisou abdé abimelek:
Vayyomer abimelek lo yadati mi asa et-haddabar hazzeh vegam-atta lo-higgadta li vegam anoki lo chamati bilti hayyom
Vaamar abimelek la yedait man abad yat pitgama hadén veap at la khavvéta li veap ana la chemait ellahén yoma dén:
Vayyiqqakh abraham tson oubaqar vayyittén laabimelek vayyikretou chenéhem berit
Oudebar abraham an vetorin vihab laabimelek ougezarou tarvéhon qeyam:
Vayyatstséb abraham et-cheba kibsot hatstson lebaddehen
Vaaqim abraham yat cheba khourepan dean bilkhodéhen:
Vayyomer abimelek el-abraham ma hénna cheba kebasot haélleh acher hitstsabta lebaddana
Vaamar abimelek leabraham ma innoun cheba khourepan illén daaqémeta bilkhodéhen:
Vayyomer ki et-cheba kebasot tiqqakh miyyadi baabour tiheyeh-li leéda ki khaparti et-habbeér hazzot
Vaamar aré yat cheba khourepan teqabbél min yedi bedil dithé li lesahadou aré khaparit yat béra hadén ny" hada:
Al-kén qara lammaqom hahou beér chaba ki cham nichbeou chenéhem
Al kén qera leatra hahou beér chaba aré tamman qayyamou tarvéhon:
Vayyikretou berit bibér chaba vayyaqom abimelek oupikol sar-tsebao vayyachoubou el-erets pelichtim
Ougezarou qeyam bibér chaba veqam abimelek oupikol rab khéléh vetabou leara pelichtaé:
Vayyitta echel bibér chaba vayyiqra-cham bechém Adonai él olam
Ounetséb nitsba ny" ilana bibér chaba vetsalli tamman bichma daAdonai élaha dealma:
Vayyagor abraham beerets pelichtim yamim rabbim
Veittotab abraham beara pelichtaé yomin saggiin:
Vayehi akhar haddebarim haélleh vehaélohim nissa et-abraham vayyomer élayv abraham vayyomer hinnéni
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillén vayya nassi yat abraham vaamar léh abraham vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer qakh-na et-binka et-yekhideka acher-ahabta et-yitskhaq velek-leka el-erets hammoriyya vehaaléhou cham leola al akhad heharim acher omar éléka
Vaamar debar kean yat berak yat yekhidak di rekhamta yat yitskhaq veizél lak leara poulekhana veasqéh qodamay tamman laalata al khad min tourayya di émar lak:
Vayyachkém abraham babboqer vayyakhaboch et-khamoro vayyiqqakh et-chené nearayv itto veét yitskhaq beno vayebaqqa atsé ola vayyaqom vayyélek el-hammaqom acher-amar-lo haélohim
Veaqdém abraham betsapra vezaréz yat khamaréh oudebar yat terén oulémohi imméh veyat yitskhaq beréh vetsallakh aé laalata veqam veazal leatra di amar léh Adonai:
Bayyom hachchelichi vayyissa abraham et-énayv vayyar et-hammaqom mérakhoq
Beyoma telitaa ouzeqap abraham yat énohi vakhaza yat atra mérakhiq:
Vayyomer abraham el-nearayv chebou-lakem poh im-hakhamor vaani vehannaar néleka ad-koh venichetakhaveh venachouba alékem
Vaamar abraham leoulémohi orikou lekon haka im khamara vaana veouléma nitmeté ad ka venisgoud ounetoub levatkon:
Vayyiqqakh abraham et-atsé haola vayyasem al-yitskhaq beno vayyiqqakh beyado et-haéch veet-hammaakelet vayyélekou chenéhem yakhdav
Ouneséb abraham yat aé daalata vechavvi al yitskhaq beréh ouneséb bidéh yat echchata veyat sakkina vaazalou tarvéhon batra kakhada:
Vayyomer yitskhaq el-abraham abiv vayyomer abi vayyomer hinnenni beni vayyomer hinnéh haéch vehaétsim veayyéh hasseh leola
Vaamar yitskhaq leabraham abouhi vaamar abba vaamar ha ana beri vaamar ha echchata veaayya vean imera laalata:
Vayyomer abraham élohim yireh-lo hasseh leola beni vayyélekou chenéhem yakhdav
Vaamar abraham qodam Adonai gelé léh imera laalata beri vaazalou tarvéhon kakhada:
Vayyaboou el-hammaqom acher amar-lo haélohim vayyiben cham abraham et-hammizbéakh vayyaarok et-haétsim vayyaaqod et-yitskhaq beno vayyasem oto al-hammizbéakh mimmaal laétsim
Veatou leatra di amar léh Adonai oubena tamman abraham yat madbekha vesaddar yat aayya vaaqad yat yitskhaq beréh vechavvi yatéh al madbekha él min aayya:
Vayyichlakh abraham et-yado vayyiqqakh et-hammaakelet lichkhot et-beno
Veochét abraham yat yedéh ouneséb yat sakkina lemékas yat beréh:
Vayyiqra élayv malak Adonai min-hachchamayim vayyomer abraham abraham vayyomer hinnéni
Ouqera léh malaka daAdonai min chemayya vaamar abraham abraham vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer al-tichlakh yadeka el-hannaar veal-taas lo meouma ki atta yadati ki-yeré élohim atta velo khasakta et-binka et-yekhideka mimmenni
Vaamar la tochét yedak leouléma vela tabéd léh middaam aré kean yedana ny" yedait aré dakhala daAdonai at vela menata yat berak yat yekhidak minni:
Vayyissa abraham et-énayv vayyar vehinnéh-ayil akhar neékhaz bassebak beqarnayv vayyélek abraham vayyiqqakh et-haayil vayyaaléhou leola takhat beno
Ouzeqap abraham yat énohi batar illén vakhaza veha dikra batar akhid beilana beqarnohi vaazal abraham ouneséb yat dikra veasqéh laalata khalap beréh:
Vayyiqra abraham chém-hammaqom hahou Adonai yireh acher yéamér hayyom behar Adonai yéraeh
Oupelakh vetsalli abraham tamman beatra hahou vaamar qodam Adonai haka yehon palkhan darayya bekén yitammar beyoma hadén betoura hadén abraham qodam Adonai pelakh:
Vayyiqra malak Adonai el-abraham chénit min-hachchamayim
Ouqera malaka daAdonai leabraham tinyanout min chemayya:
Vayyomer bi nichbati neum-Adonai ki yaan acher asita et-haddabar hazzeh velo khasakta et-binka et-yekhideka
Vaamar bemémeré qayyémit amar Adonai aré khalap di abadta yat pitgama hadén vela menata yat berak yat yekhidak:
Ki-barék abarekka veharba arbeh et-zaraka kekokebé hachchamayim vekakhol acher al-sepat hayyam veyirach zaraka ét chaar oyebayv
Aré baraka abarekinnak veasgaa asgé yat benak kekokebé chemayya oukekhala di al kép yamma veyirtoun benak yat qirvé sanéhon:
Vehitbarekou bezaraka kol goyé haarets éqeb acher chamata beqoli
Veyitbarekoun bedil benak kol ammayya deara khalap di qabbéleta lemémeri:
Vayyachob abraham el-nearayv vayyaqoumou vayyélekou yakhdav el-beér chaba vayyécheb abraham bibér chaba
Vetab abraham levat oulémohi veqamou vaazalou kakhada libér chaba vitéb abraham bibér chaba:
Vayehi akharé haddebarim haélleh vayyuggad leabraham lémor hinnéh yaleda milka gam-hiv banim lenakhor akhika
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillén veitkhava leabraham lemémar ha yelédat milka ap hi benin lenakhor akhouk:
Et-vts bekoro veet-bouz akhiv veet-qemouél abi aram
Yat outs boukeréh veyat bouz akhouhi veyat qemouél abouhi daaram:
Veet-kesed veet-khazo veet-pildach veet-yidlap veét betouél
Veyat kesed veyat khazo veyat pildach veyat yidlap veyat betouél:
Oubetouél yalad et-ribqa chemona élleh yaleda milka lenakhor akhi abraham
Oubetouél olid yat ribqa temanya illén yelédat milka lenakhor akhouhi deabraham:
Oupilagcho ouchemah reouma vattéled gam-hiv et-tebakh veet-gakham veet-takhach veet-maaka
Oulekhénatéh ouchemah reouma vilédat ap hi yat tebakh veyat gakham veyat takhach veyat maaka:
Vayyihyou khayyé sara méa chana veesrim chana vecheba chanim chené khayyé sara
Vahavo khayyé sara mea veesrin oucheba chenin chené khayyé sara:
Vattamot sara beqiryat arba hiv khebron beerets kenaan vayyabo abraham lispod lesara velibkotah
Oumitat sara beqiryat arba hi khebron beara diknaan vaata abraham lemispeda lesara oulemibkah:
Vayyaqom abraham méal pené méto vayedabbér el-bené-khét lémor
Veqam abraham méal appé mitéh oumallél im bené khittaa lemémar:
Gér-vetochab anoki immakem tenou li akhuzzat-qeber immakem veeqbera méti millepanay
Dayyar vetotab ana immekon habou li akhsanat qeboura immekon veiqbar miti min qodamay:
Vayyaanou bené-khét et-abraham lémor lo
Veatibou bené khittaa yat abraham lemémar léh:
Chemaénou adoni nesi élohim atta betokénou bemibkhar qebarénou qebor et-méteka ich mimmennou et-qibro lo-yikleh mimmeka miqqebor méteka
Qabbél minnana ribbonana rab qodam Adonai at bénana bichpar qibrana qebar yat mitak ennach minnana yat qibréh la yimna minnak millemiqbar mitak:
Vayyaqom abraham vayyichtakhou leam-haarets libné-khét
Veqam abraham ousegid leamma deara libné khittaa:
Vayedabbér ittam lémor im-yéch et-napchekem liqbor et-méti millepanay chemaouni oupigou-li beepron ben-tsokhar
Oumallél immehon lemémar im it raava benapchekon lemiqbar yat miti min qodamay qabbilou minni oubeou li min epron bar tsokhar:
Veyitten-li et-mearat hammakpéla acher-lo acher biqtséh sadéhou bekesep malé yittenenna li betokekem laakhuzzat-qaber
Veyitten li yat mearat kapelta di léh di bistar khaqléh bekaspa chelim yitteninah li bénékon leakhasanat qeboura:
Veepron yochéb betok bené-khét vayyaan epron hakhitti et-abraham beozné bené-khét lekol baé chaar-iro lémor
Veepron yatéb bego bené khittaa veatéb epron khittaa yat abraham qodam bené khittaa lekol alé tera qartéh lemémar:
Lo-adoni chemaéni hassadeh natatti lak vehammeara acher-bo leka netattiha leéné bené-ammi netattiha lak qebor méteka
La ribboni qabbél minni khaqla yehabit lak oumearta di béh lak yehabitah leéné bené ammi yehabitah lak qebar mitak:
Vayyichtakhou abraham lipné am haarets
Ousegid abraham qodam amma deara:
Vayedabbér el-epron beozné am-haarets lémor ak im-atta lou chemaéni natatti kesep hassadeh qakh mimmenni veeqbera et-méti chamma
Oumallél im epron qodam amma deara lemémar beram im at abéd li tibou qabbél minni ettén kaspa demé khaqla sab minni veeqbar yat miti tamman:
Vayyaan epron et-abraham lémor lo
Veatéb epron yat abraham lemémar léh:
Adoni chemaéni erets arba méot cheqel-kesep béni oubéneka mah-hiv veet-méteka qebor
Ribboni qabbél minni ara chavya arba mea silin diksap béna oubénak mah hi veyat mitak qebar:
Vayyichma abraham el-epron vayyichqol abraham leepron et-hakkesep acher dibber beozné bené-khét arba méot cheqel kesep obér lassokhér
Veqabbél abraham min epron outeqal abraham leepron yat kaspa demallél qodam bené khittaa arba mea silin diksap mitqabbél sekhora ny" demitqabbél sekhorata bekol medineta:
Vayyaqom sedéh epron acher bammakpéla acher lipné mamré hassadeh vehammeara acher-bo vekol-haéts acher bassadeh acher bekol-gebulo sabib
Veqam khaqal epron di bekapelta di qodam mamré khaqla oumearta di béh vekol ilané di bekhaqla di bekal tekhouméh sekhor sekhor:
Leabraham lemiqna leéné bené-khét bekol baé chaar-iro
Leabraham lizbinohi leéné bené khittaa bekol alé tera qartéh:
Veakharé-kén qabar abraham et-sara ichto el-mearat sedéh hammakpéla al-pené mamré hiv khebron beerets kenaan
Oubatar kén qebar abraham yat sara ittetéh bimarat khaqal kapelta al appé mamré hi khebron beara diknaan:
Vayyaqom hassadeh vehammeara acher-bo leabraham laakhuzzat-qaber méét bené-khét
Veqam khaqla oumearta di béh leabraham leakhasanat qeboura min bené khittaa:
Veabraham zaqén ba bayyamim va-Adonai bérak et-abraham bakkol
Veabraham sib al beyomin vayya berik yat abraham bekolla:
Vayyomer abraham el-abdo zeqan béto hammochél bekol-acher-lo sim-na yadeka takhat yeréki
Vaamar abraham leabdéh saba debétéh dechallit bekol di léh chavi kean yedak tekhot yarki:
Veachbiaka ba-Adonai élohé hachchamayim vélohé haarets acher lo-tiqqakh ichcha libni mibbenot hakkenaani acher anoki yochéb beqirbo
Vaaqayyém alak bemémera daAdonai élaha dichmayya vélaha deara dela tissab itteta libri mibbenat kenaanaé di ana yatéb bénéhon:
Ki el-artsi veel-moladti télék velaqakhta ichcha libni leyitskhaq
élahén leari ouleyalladouti tézil vetissab itteta libri leyitskhaq:
Vayyomer élayv haebed oulay lo-tobeh haichcha laleket akharay el-haarets hazzot hehachéb achib et-binka el-haarets acher-yatsata michcham
Vaamar léh abda maim la tébé itteta lemété batray leara hada haataba atéb yat berak leara di nepaqta mittamman:
Vayyomer élayv abraham hichchamer leka pen-tachib et-beni chamma
Vaamar léh abraham istammar lak dilema tatéb yat beri letamman:

Adonai élohé hachchamayim acher leqakhani mibbét abi ouméerets moladti vaacher dibber-li vaacher nicheba-li lémor lezaraka ettén et-haarets hazzot hou yichlakh malako lepanéka velaqakhta ichcha libni michcham

Veim la tébé itteta lemété batrak outehé zakkaa mimmomati da lekhod yat beri la tatéb letamman:
