Vayyétsé mocheh liqrat khoteno vayyichtakhou vayyichchaq-lo vayyichalou ich-lerééhou lechalom vayyaboou haohéla
Ounepaq mcheh leqadamout khamouhi ousegid ounechiq léh oucheilou gebar lekhabréh lichlam vealou lemachkena:
Vayesappér mocheh lekhoteno ét kol-acher asa Adonai leparoh oulemitsrayim al odot yisraél ét kol-hattelaa acher metsaatam badderek vayyatstsilém Adonai
Veichtai mcheh lakhamouhi yat kol di abad Adonai leparoh oulemitsraé al ésaq yisraél yat kol aqta di achkakhtinoun beorkha vechézebanoun Adonai:
Vayyikhad yitro al kol-hattoba acher-asa Adonai leyisraél acher hitstsilo miyyad mitsrayim
Vakhadi yitro al kol tabta di abad Adonai leyisraél di chézebéh mida demitsraé:
Vayyomer yitro barouk Adonai acher hitstsil etkem miyyad mitsrayim oumiyyad paroh acher hitstsil et-haam mittakhat yad-mitsrayim
Vaamar yitro berik Adonai di chézib yatekon mida demitsraé oumida deparoh di chézib yat ama mittekhot marvat mitsraé:
Atta yadati ki-gadol Adonai mikkol-haélohim ki baddabar acher zadou aléhem
Kean yedana aré rab Adonai velét élah bar minéh aré bepitgama di khachibou mitsraé lemidan yat yisraél béh daninoun:
Vayyiqqakh yitro khotén mocheh ola ouzebakhim lélohim vayyabo aharon vekol ziqné yisraél leékol-lekhem im-khotén mocheh lipné haélohim
Veqarib yitro khamouhi demcheh alavan veniksat qoudechin qodam Adonai vaata aharon vekol sabé yisraél lemékal lakhma im khamouhi demcheh qodam Adonai:
Vayehi mimmokhorat vayyécheb mocheh lichpot et-haam vayyaamod haam al-mocheh min-habboqer ad-haareb
Vahava miyoma debatrohi vitéb mcheh lemidan yat ama veqam ama ilavohi demcheh min tsapra ad ramcha:
Vayyar khotén mocheh ét kol-acher-hv oseh laam vayyomer ma-haddabar hazzeh acher atta oseh laam maddoua atta yochéb lebaddeka vekol-haam nitstsab aléka min-boqer ad-areb
Vakhaza khamouhi demcheh yat kol di hou abéd leama vaamar ma pitgama hadén di at abéd leama ma dén at yatéb bilkhodak vekol ama qayemin ilavak min tsapra ad ramcha:
Vayyomer mocheh lekhoteno ki-yabo élay haam lidroch élohim
Vaamar mcheh lakhamouhi aré atan levati ama lemitba oulepan min qodam Adonai:
Ki-yihyeh lahem dabar ba élay vechapatti bén ich oubén rééhou vehodati et-khuqqé haélohim veet-torotayv
Kad havé lehon dina atan levati vedaina bén gabra oubén khabréh oumehodana lehon yat qeyamaya daAdonai veyat orayatéh:
Vayyomer khotén mocheh élayv lo-tob haddabar acher atta oseh
Vaamar khamouhi demcheh léh la taqin pitgama deat abéd:
Nabol tibbol gam-atta gam-haam hazzeh acher immak ki-kabéd mimmeka haddabar lo-tvkal asohou lebaddeka
Mila tileh ap at ap ama hadén diimak aré yaqir minak pitgama la tikkol lemebedéh bilkhodak:
Atta chema beqoli iatseka vihi élohim immak héyéh atta laam moul haélohim vehébéta atta et-haddebarim el-haélohim
Kean qabbél mini amalkinak vihé mémera daAdonai besadak hévé at leama teba oulepan min qodam Adonai outehé mayti at yat pitgamaya liqodam Adonai:
Vehizharta ethem et-hakhuqqim veet-hattorot vehodata lahem et-hadderek yélekou bah veet-hammaaseh acher yaasoun
Vetazhar yatehon yat qeyamaya veyat orayta outehoda lehon yat orekha diyhakoun bah veyat obada diyabedoun:
Veatta tekhézeh mikkol-haam anché-khayil yiré élohim anché émet soneé batsa vesamta aléhem saré alapim saré méot saré khamichchim vesaré asarot
Veat tekhezé mikkol ama gubrin dekhéla dakhalaya daAdonai gubrin diqchot desanan leqabbala mamon outemané aléhon rabbané alpin rabbané mavata rabbané khamchin verabbané isoreyata:
Vechapetou et-haam bekol-ét vehaya kol-haddabar haggadol yabiou éléka vekol-haddabar haqqaton yichpetou-hém vehaqél méaléka venaseou ittak
Vidounoun yat ama bekol idan vihé kol pitgam rab yaytoun levatak vekol pitgam zeér yedounoun inoun veyiqloun minak visoberoun imak:
Im et-haddabar hazzeh taaseh vetsivveka élohim veyakolta amod vegam kol-haam hazzeh al-meqomo yabo bechalom
Im yat pitgama hadén tabéd vipaqdinak Adonai vetikkol leméqam veap kol ama hadén al atréh yehak bichlam:
Vayyichma mocheh leqol khoteno vayyaas kol acher amar
Veqabbil mcheh lemémera dakhamouhi vaabad kol di amar:
Vayyibkhar mocheh anché-khayil mikkol-yisraél vayyittén otam rachim al-haam saré alapim saré méot saré khamichchim vesaré asarot
Oubekhar mcheh gubrin dekhéla mikkol yisraél oumani yatehon réchin al ama rabbané alpin rabbané mavata rabbané khamchin verabbané isoreyata:
Vechapetou et-haam bekol-ét et-haddabar haqqacheh yebioun el-mocheh vekol-haddabar haqqaton yichpoutou hém
Vedaynin yat ama bekol idan yat pitgam qaché maytin levat mcheh vekol pitgam zeér dayenin inoun:
Vayechallakh mocheh et-khoteno vayyélek lo el-artso
Vechalakh mcheh yat khamouhi vaazal léh learéh:
Bakhodech hachchelichi letsét bené-yisraél méerets mitsrayim bayyom hazzeh baou midbar sinay
Beyarkha telitaa lemippaq bené yisraél méara demitsrayim beyoma hadén ato lemadbera desinay:
Vayyisou mérepidim vayyaboou midbar sinay vayyakhanou bammidbar vayyikhan-cham yisraél neged hahar
Ounetalou mérepidim vaato lemadbera desinay ouchero bemadbera ouchera taman yisraél loqobél toura:
Oumocheh ala el-haélohim vayyiqra élayv Adonai min-hahar lémor koh tomar lebét yaaqob vetaggéd libné yisraél
Oumcheh seléq qodam Adonai ouqera léh Adonai min toura lemémar kidnan témar lebét yaaqob outekhavi libné yisraél:
Attem reitem acher asiti lemitsrayim vaessa etkem al-kanpé necharim vaabi etkem élay
Attoun khazittoun di abadit lemitsrayim ounetalit yatekon kidal gadpé nichrin veqarébit yatekon lepalekhani:
Veatta im-chamoa tichmeou beqoli ouchemartem et-beriti vihyitem li segulla mikkol-haammim ki-li kol-haarets
Oukean im qabbala teqabbeloun lemémeri vetitroun yat qeyami outehon qodamay khabbibin mikkol ammaya aré di li kol ara:
Veattem tihyou-li mamleket kohanim vegoy qadoch élleh haddebarim acher tedabbér el-bené yisraél
Veattoun tehon qodamay malkin kahanin veam qadich ilén pitgamaya di temalél im bené yisraél:
Vayyabo mocheh vayyiqra leziqné haam vayyasem lipnéhem ét kol-haddebarim haélleh acher tsivvahou Adonai
Vaata mcheh ouqera lesabé ama vesadar qodaméhon yat kol pitgamaya hailén depaqdéh Adonai:
Vayyaanou kol-haam yakhdav vayyomerou kol acher-dibber Adonai naaseh vayyacheb mocheh et-dibré haam el-Adonai
Vaatibou kol ama kakhada vaamarou kol di malil Adonai nabéd vaatéb mcheh yat pitgamé ama qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh hinnéh anoki ba éléka beab heanan baabour yichma haam bedabberi immak vegam-beka yaaminou leolam vayyaggéd mocheh et-dibré haam el-Adonai
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh ha ana mitgeli lak beéba daanana bedil deyichma ama bemalalouti imak veap bak yehémenoun lealam vekhavi mcheh yat pitgamé ama qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh lék el-haam veqiddachtam hayyom oumakhar vekibbesou simlotam
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh izél levat ama outezamninoun yoma dén oumekhar vikhavroun lebouchéhon:
Vehayou nekonim layyom hachchelichi ki bayyom hachchelichi yéréd Adonai leéné kol-haam al-har sinay
Vihon zeminin leyoma telitaa aré beyoma telitaa yitgeli Adonai leéné kol ama al toura desinay:
Vehigbalta et-haam sabib lémor hichchamerou lakem alot bahar ounegoa beqatséhou kol-hannogéa bahar mot youmat
Outetakhém yat ama sekhor sekhor lemémar istamarou lekon milmisaq betoura oulemiqrab besopéh kol deyiqrab betoura itqetala yitqetél:
Lo-tigga bo yad ki-saqol yissaqél o-yaroh yiyyareh im-behéma im-ich lo yikhyeh bimchok hayyobél hémma yaalou bahar
La tiqrab béh yeda aré itregama yitregém o ichtedaa yichtedi im beira im énacha la yitqayam bemégad chopara inoun merachan lemisaq betoura:
Vayyéred mocheh min-hahar el-haam vayeqaddéch et-haam vayekabbesou simlotam
Ounekhat mcheh min toura levat ama vezamin yat ama vekhavarou lebouchéhon:
Vayyomer el-haam héyou nekonim lichlochet yamim al-tiggechou el-ichcha
Vaamar leama hévo zeminin litlata yomin la tiqreboun letsad itteta:
Vayehi bayyom hachchelichi biheyot habboqer vayehi qolot ouberaqim veanan kabéd al-hahar veqol chopar khazaq meod vayyekhérad kol-haam acher bammakhaneh
Vahava beyoma telitaa bemehévé tsapra vahava qalin oubarqin vaanana taqip al toura veqal chopara taqip lakhada veza kol ama di bemachrita:
Vayyotsé mocheh et-haam liqrat haélohim min-hammakhaneh vayyiteyatstsebou betakhtit hahar
Veappéq mcheh yat ama leqadamout mémera daAdonai min machrita veitattadou bechippolé toura:
Vehar sinay achan kullo mippené acher yarad alayv Adonai baéch vayyaal achano keechen hakkibchan vayyekhérad kol-hahar meod
Vetoura desinay tanan kuléh min qodam deitgeli alohi Adonai beechata ouseliq tenanéh kitnana deattouna veza kol toura lakhada:
Vayehi qol hachchopar holék vekhazéq meod mocheh yedabbér vehaélohim yaanennou beqol
Vahava qal chopara azél vetaqép lakhada mcheh memalél oumin qodam Adonai mitané léh beqal:
Vayyéred Adonai al-har sinay el-roch hahar vayyiqra Adonai lemocheh el-roch hahar vayyaal mocheh
Veitgeli Adonai al toura desinay leréch toura ouqera Adonai lemcheh leréch toura ouseliq mcheh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh réd haéd baam pen-yehersou el-Adonai lirot venapal mimmennou rab
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh khout ashéd beama dilema yepagroun qodam Adonai lemekhézé veyippél minhon sagi:
Vegam hakkohanim hanniggachim el-Adonai yitqaddachou pen-yiprots bahem Adonai
Veap kahanaya diqribin lechamacha qodam Adonai yitqadchoun dilema yiqtol behon Adonai:
Vayyomer mocheh el-Adonai lo-yvkal haam laalot el-har sinay ki-atta haédota banou lémor hagbél et-hahar veqiddachto
Vaamar mcheh qodam Adonai la yikkol ama lemisaq letoura desinay aré at ashédeta bana lemémar takhim yat toura veqadéchehi:
Vayyomer élayv Adonai lek-réd vealita atta veaharon immak vehakkohanim vehaam al-yehersou laalot el-Adonai pen-yiprots-bam
Vaamar léh Adonai izél khout vetisaq at veaharon imak vekahanaya veama la yepagroun lemisaq liqodam Adonai dilema yiqtol behon:
Vayyéred mocheh el-haam vayyomer aléhem
Ounekhat mcheh leama vaamar lehon:
Vayedabbér élohim ét kol-haddebarim haélleh lémor
Oumalil Adonai yat kol pitgamaya hailén lemémar:
Anoki Adonai élohéka acher hotsétika méerets mitsrayim mibbét abadim
Ana Adonai élahak di appéqetak méara demitsrayim mibbét abdouta:
Lo-yihyeh-leka élohim akhérim al-panaay
La yehé lak élah okhoran bar mini:
Lo-taaseh-leka pesel vekol-temouna acher bachchamayim mimmaal vaacher baarets mittaakhat vaacher bammayim mittakhat laarets
La tabéd lak tselém vekol demout di bichmaya miléla vedi beara milra vedi bemaya milra leara:
Lo-tichtakhaveh lahem velo toobdém ki anoki Adonai élohéka él qanna poqéd avon abot al-banim al-chilléchim veal-ribbéim lesoneay
La tisgoud lehon vela tiplekhinoun aré ana Adonai élahak él qana masar khobé abahan al benin maradin al dar telitay veal dar rebiay lesaneay kad mechalmin benaya lemekhété batar abahatehon:
Veoseh khesed laalapim leohabay oulechomeré mitsvotay
Veabéd tibou lealpé darin lerakhamay oulenateré piqoday:
Lo tissa et-chém-Adonai élohéka lachchav ki lo yenaqqeh Adonai ét acher-yissa et-chemo lachchav
La témé bichma daAdonai élahak lemagana aré la yizakké Adonai yat diyémé bichméh lechiqra:
Zakor et-yom hachchabbat leqaddecho
Havé dekir yat yoma dechabbeta leqadachoutéh:
Chéchet yamim taabod veasita kol-melakteka
Chitta yomin tiplakh vetabéd kol ibidtak:
Veyom hachchebii chabbat la-Adonai élohéka lo-taaseh kol-melaka atta oubinka-vbitteka abdeka vaamateka oubehemteka vegéreka acher bicharéka
Veyoma chebiaa chabbeta qodam Adonai élahak la tabéd kol ibidta at ouberak ouberattak abdak veamtak oubeirak vegiyorak di beqirvak:
Ki chéchet-yamim asa Adonai et-hachchamayim veet-haarets et-hayyam veet-kol-acher-bam vayyanakh bayyom hachchebii al-kén bérak Adonai et-yom hachchabbat vayeqaddechéhou
Aré chitta yomin abad Adonai yat chemaya veyat ara yat yama veyat kol di behon venakh beyoma chebiaa al kén barik Adonai yat yoma dechabbeta veqadchéh:
Kabbéd et-abika veet-immeka lemaan yaarikoun yaméka al haadama acher-Adonai élohéka notén lak
Yaqar yat abouk veyat imak bedil deyorekoun yomayk al ara daAdonai élahak yahéb lak:
Lo tirtsakh lo tinap lo tignob lo-taaneh beréaka éd chaqer
La tiqtol nepach la tegoup la tignoub la tashéd bekhabrak sahadouta dechiqra:
Lo takhmod bét réeka lo-takhmod échet réeka veabdo vaamato vechoro vakhamoro vekol acher leréeka
La takhméd bét khabrak la takhméd ittat khabrak veabdéh veamtéh vetoréh vakhamaréh vekol di lekhabrak:
Vekol-haam roim et-haqqolot veet-hallappidim veét qol hachchopar veet-hahar achén vayyar haam vayyanouou vayyaamdou mérakhoq
Vekol ama khazan yat qalaya veyat baoraya veyat qal chopara veyat toura tanén vakhaza ama vezaou veqamou mérakhiq:
Vayyomerou el-mocheh dabbér-atta immanou venichmaa veal-yedabbér immanou élohim pen-namout
Vaamarou lemcheh malél at imana ouneqabbél vela yitmalél imana min qodam Adonai dilema nemout:
Vayyomer mocheh el-haam al-tiraou ki lebaabour nassot etkem ba haélohim oubaabour tihyeh yirato al-penékem lebilti tekhétaou
Vaamar mcheh leama la tidkhaloun aré bedil lenasaa yatekon itgeli lekon yeqara daAdonai oubedil dithé dakhaltéh al appékon bedil dela tekhouboun:
Vayyaamod haam mérakhoq oumocheh niggach el-haarapel acher-cham haélohim
Veqam ama mérakhiq oumcheh qaréb letsad amiteta ditaman yeqara daAdonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh koh tomar el-bené yisraél attem reitem ki min-hachchamayim dibbarti immakem
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh kidnan témar libné yisraél attoun khazittoun aré min chemaya malélit imkon:
Lo taasoun itti élohé kesep vélohé zahab lo taasou lakem
La tabedoun qodamay dakhalan diksap vedakhalan didhab la tabedoun lekon:
Mizbakh adama taaseh-li vezabakhta alayv et-olotéka veet-chelaméka et-tsoneka veet-beqareka bekol-hammaqom acher azkir et-chemi abo éléka oubéraktika
Madbakh admeta tabéd qodamay outehé dabbakh alohi yat alavatak veyat niksat qoudechak min anak oumin torak bekol atra di achré yat chekinti letaman echlakh birketi lak veébarékinak:
Veim-mizbakh abanim taaseh-li lo-tibneh ethen gazit ki kharbeka hénapta aléha vattekhaleleha
Veim madbakh abnin tabéd qodamay la tibné yatehon pesilan dilma terim kharbak alah outekhallinah:
Velo-taaleh bemaalot al-mizbekhi acher lo-tiggaleh ervateka alayv
Vela tisaq bedargin al madbekhi di la titgelé eryetak alohi:
Veélleh hammichpatim acher tasim lipnéhem
Veilén dinaya di tasdar qodaméhon:
Ki tiqneh ebed ibri chéch chanim yaabod oubachchebiit yétsé lakhopchi khinnam
Aré tizban abda bar yisraél chit chenin yiplakh oubachbiéta yippoq lebar khorin magan:
Im-begappo yabo begappo yétsé im-baal ichcha hou veyatsea ichto immo
Im bilkhodohi yéol bilkhodohi yippoq im beél itteta hou vetippoq ittetéh iméh:
Im-adonayv yitten-lo ichcha veyaleda-lo banim o banot haichcha viladéha tihyeh ladonéha vehou yétsé begappo
Im ribbonéh yitten léh itteta outelid léh benin o benan itteta oubenaha tehé leribbonaha vehou yippoq bilkhodohi:
Veim-amor yomar haebed ahabti et-adoni et-ichti veet-banay lo étsé khopchi
Veim mémar yémar abda rakhémena yat ribboni yat itteti veyat benay la eppoq lebar khorin:
Vehiggicho adonayv el-haélohim vehiggicho el-haddelet o el-hammezouza veratsa adonayv et-ozno bammartséa vaabado leolam
Viqarebinéh ribbonéh liqodam dayanaya viqarebinéh levat dacha o levat mezuzta veyartsa ribbonéh yat oudenéh bemartsea vihé léh abad palakh lealam:
Veki-yimkor ich et-bitto leama lo tétsé ketsét haabadim
Vaaré yezabbén gebar yat berattéh leamhou la tippoq kemapqanout abdaya:
Im-raa beéné adonéha acher-lo yeadah vehepdah leam nokri lo-yimchol lemokrah bebigdo-ba
Im bicha beéné ribbonah diqaymah léh veyipreqinah ligbar okhoran lét léh rechou lezabbonah bemichletéh bah:
Veim-libno yiadenna kemichpat habbanot yaaseh-lah
Veim libréh yeqayminah kehilkat benat yisraél yabéd lah:
Im-akheret yiqqakh-lo cheérah kesoutah veonatah lo yigra
Im okhoranta yisab léh ziyounah kesoutah veonatah la yimna:
Veim-cheloch-élleh lo yaaseh lah veyatsea khinnam én kasep
Veim telat ilén la yabéd lah vetippoq magan bela kesap:
Makkéh ich vamét mot youmat
Deyimkhé leénach veyiqtelinéh itqetala yitqetél:
Vaacher lo tsada vehaélohim inna leyado vesamti leka maqom acher yanous chamma
Oudela keman léh oumin qodam Adonai ittimsar lidéh veéchavi lak atar di yéiroq letaman:
Veki-yazid ich al-rééhou lehorgo beorma méim mizbekhi tiqqakhennou lamout
Vaaré yarcha gebar al khabréh lemiqteléh binkilou min madbekhi tidberinéh limmat:
Oumakkéh abiv veimmo mot youmat
Oudeyimkhé abouhi veiméh itqetala yitqetél:
Vegonéb ich oumekaro venimtsa beyado mot youmat
Vediyignoub napcha min bené yisraél vizabbeninéh veyichtekakh bidéh itqetala yitqetél:
Oumeqallél abiv veimmo mot youmat
Vediylout abouhi veiméh itqetala yitqetél:
Veki-yeriboun anachim vehikka-ich et-rééhou beeben o beegrop velo yamout venapal lemichkab
Vaaré yintsoun gubrin veyimkhé gebar yat khabréh beabna o bekoureméza vela yemout veyippol leboutelan:
Im-yaqoum vehithallék bakhouts al-michanto veniqqa hammakkeh raq chibto yittén verappo yerappé
Im yeqoum vihalik bebara al boureyéh vihé zakkaa makheya lekhod boutelanéh yittén vaagar asya yechalém:
Veki-yakkeh ich et-abdo o et-amato bachchébet oumét takhat yado naqom yinnaqém
Vaaré yimkhé gebar yat abdéh o yat amtéh bechaletan vimout tekhot yedéh itdana yittedan:
Ak im-yom o yomayim yaamod lo yuqqam ki kaspo hou
Beram im yoma o terén yomin yitqayam la yittedan aré kaspéh hou:
Veki-yinnatsou anachim venagepou ichcha hara veyatseou yeladéha velo yihyeh ason anoch yéanéch kaacher yachit alayv baal haichcha venatan biplilim
Vaaré yintsoun gubrin veyimkhoun itteta maadya veyippeqoun valedaha vela yehé mota itgebaa yitgebé kema di yechavi alohi baalah deitteta veyittén al mémar dayanaya:
Veim-ason yihyeh venatatta nepech takhat napech
Veim mota yehé vetittén napcha kholap napcha:
Ayin takhat ayin chén takhat chén yad takhat yad regel takhat ragel
éna kholap éna china kholap china yeda kholap yeda ragla kholap ragla:
Keviyya takhat keviyya petsa takhat patsa khabboura takhat khabboura
Kevaa kholap kevaa pida kholap pida machqopé kholap machqopé:
Veki-yakkeh ich et-én abdo o-et-én amato vechikhatah lakhopchi yechallekhennou takhat éno
Vaaré yimkhé gebar yat éna deabdéh o yat éna deamtéh vikhabbelinah lebar khorin yipterinéh kholap énéh:
Veim-chén abdo o-chén amato yappil lakhopchi yechallekhennou takhat chinno
Veim china deabdéh o china deamtéh yappél lebar khorin yipterinéh kholap chinéh:
Veki-yiggakh chor et-ich o et-ichcha vamét saqol yissaqél hachchor velo yéakél et-besaro oubaal hachchor naqi
Vaaré yagakh tora yat gabra o yat itteta vimout itregama yitregém tora vela yitakél yat bisréh oumaréh detora yehé zakkaa:
Veim chor naggakh hou mittemol chilchom vehouad bibalayv velo yichmerennou vehémit ich o ichcha hachchor yissaqél vegam-bealayv youmat
Veim tor nagakh hou méittemalé oumidqamohi veyittashéd bemaréh vela natréh veyiqtol gabra o itteta tora yitregém veap maréh yitqetél:
Im-koper youchat alayv venatan pidyon napcho kekol acher-yvchat alayv
Im mamon yechavoun alohi veyittén poureqan napchéh kekol di yechavoun alohi:
O-bén yiggakh o-bat yiggakh kammichpat hazzeh yéaseh lo
O lebar yisraél yagakh tora o lebat yisraél yagakh kedina hadén yitabéd léh:
Im-ebed yiggakh hachchor o ama kesep chelochim cheqalim yittén ladonayv vehachchor yissaqél
Im leabda yagakh tora o leamta kesap telatin silin yittén leribbonéh vetora yitregém:
Veki-yiptakh ich bor o ki-yikreh ich bor velo yekassennou venapal-chamma chor o khamor
Vaaré yiptakh gebar gob o aré yikreh gebar gob vela yekasinéh veyippél taman tora o khamara:
Baal habbor yechallém kesep yachib libalayv vehammét yiheyeh-lo
Maré degubba yechalém kaspa yatib lemarohi ouméta yehé diléh:
Veki-yiggop chor-ich et-chor rééhou vamét oumakerou et-hachchor hakhay vekhatsou et-kaspo vegam et-hammét yekhétsoun
Vaaré yigop tor digbar yat tora dekhabréh vimout vizabbenoun yat tora khaya vipalgoun yat kaspéh veap yat demé méta yepalgoun:
O noda ki chor naggakh hou mittemol chilchom velo yichmerennou bealayv challém yechallém chor takhat hachchor vehammét yiheyeh-lo
O ityeda aré tor nagakh hou méittemalé oumidqamohi vela nateréh maréh chalama yechalém tora khalap tora ouméta yehé diléh:
Ki yignob-ich chor o-seh outebakho o mekaro khamichcha baqar yechallém takhat hachchor vearba-tson takhat hasseh
Aré yignoub gebar tor o imar veyikkesinéh o yezabbeninéh khamcha torin yechalém khalap tora vearba ana kholap imra:
Im-bammakhteret yimmatsé haggannab vehukka vamét én lo damim
Im bemakhtarta yichtekakh ganaba veyitmekhé vimout lét léh dam:
Im-zarekha hachchemech alayv damim lo challém yechallém im-én lo venimkar bignébato
Im éna desahadaya nepalat alohi dema léh chalama yechalém im lét léh veyizdabban bignubtéh:
Im-himmatsé timmatsé beyado haggenéba michchor ad-khamor ad-seh khayyim chenayim yechallém
Im ichtekakha yichtekakh bidéh genubta mittor ad khamar ad imar kad inoun khayin al khad terén yechalém:
Ki yaber-ich sadeh o-kerem vechillakh et-beiroh oubiér bisdéh akhér métab sadéhou oumétab karmo yechallém
Aré yokil gebar khaqal o keram vichalakh yat beiréh veyékoul bakhaqal okhoran chepar khaqléh ouchepar karméh yechalém:
Ki-tétsé éch oumatsea qotsim veneékal gadich o haqqama o hassadeh challém yechallém hammabir et-habbeéra
Aré tittappaq nour veyachkakh koubin veyékoul gedichin o qoma o khaqla chalama yechalém deadléq yat deleqta:
Ki-yittén ich el-rééhou kesep o-kélim lichmor vegunnab mibbét haich im-yimmatsé haggannab yechallém chenayim
Aré yittén gebar lekhabréh kesap o manin lemitar veyitganboun mibbét gabra im yichtekakh ganaba yechalém al khad terén:
Im-lo yimmatsé haggannab veniqrab baal-habbayit el-haélohim im-lo chalakh yado bimleket rééhou
Im la yichtekakh ganaba veyitqaréb maré debéta liqodam dayanaya im la ochit yedéh bema dimsar léh khabréh:
Al-kol-debar-pecha al-chor al-khamor al-seh al-salma al-kol-abéda acher yomar ki-hv zeh ad haélohim yabo debar-chenéhem acher yarchioun élohim yechallém chenayim lerééhou
Al kol pitgam dekhob al tor al khamar al imar al kesou al kol abedta di yémar aré hou dén liqodam dayanaya yéol din tarvéhon di yekhayboun dayanaya yechalém al khad terén lekhabréh:
Ki-yittén ich el-rééhou khamor o-chor o-seh vekol-behéma lichmor oumét o-nichbar o-nichba én roeh
Aré yittén gebar lekhabréh khamar o tor o imar vekol beira lemitar oumit o ittebar o ichtebi lét dekhazé:
Chebuat Adonai tihyeh bén chenéhem im-lo chalakh yado bimleket rééhou velaqakh bealayv velo yechallém
Momata daAdonai tehé bén tarvéhon im la ochit yedéh bema dimsar léh khabréh viqabbél maréh minéh momata vela yechalém:
Veim-ganob yigganéb méimmo yechallém libalayv
Veim itgenaba yitgenéb méiméh yechalém lemarohi:
Im-tarop yittarép yebiéhou éd hatterépa lo yechallém
Im ittebara yittebar yayti sahadin ditbira la yechalém:
Veki-yichal ich méim rééhou venichbar o-mét bealayv én-immo challém yechallém
Vaaré yichal gebar min khabréh veyittebar o mit maréh lét iméh chalama yechalém:
Im-bealayv immo lo yechallém im-sakir hou ba biskaro
Im maréh iméh la yechalém im agira hou al beagréh:
Veki-yepatteh ich betoula acher lo-orasa vechakab immah mahor yimharenna lo leichcha
Vaaré yechadél gebar betulta di la mearsa veyichkoub imah qayama yeqayminah léh leintou:
Im-maén yemaén abiha letittah lo kesep yichqol kemohar habbetoulot
Im mitsba la yitsbé abouha lemittenah léh kaspa yitqol kemoharé betulta:
Mekachchépa lo tekhayyeh
Kharacha la takhé:
Kol-chokéb im-behéma mot youmat
Kol deyichkoub im beira itqetala yitqetél:
Zobéakh laélohim yokhoram bilti la-Adonai lebaddo
Dedabbakh letavat ammaya yitqetél elahén lichma daAdonai bilkhodohi:
Vegér lo-toneh velo tilkhatsennou ki-gérim héyitem beerets mitsrayim
Vegiyora la tonoun vela teiqoun léh aré dayarin hévétoun beara demitsrayim:
Kol-almana veyatom lo teannoun
Kol armela veyittam la teanoun:
Im-annéh teanneh oto ki im-tsaoq yitsaq élay chamoa echma tsaaqato
Im anaa teané yatéh aré im miqbal yiqbél qodamay qabbala éqabbél qebiltéh:
Vekhara appi veharagti etkem bekhareb vehayou nechékem almanot oubenékem yetomim
Veyitqép rougezi veeqtol yatekon bekharba vihevyan nechékon armelin oubenékon yatmin:
Im-kesep talveh et-ammi et-heani immak lo-tihyeh lo kenocheh lo-tesimoun alayv nechek
Im kaspa tozép beami leanya di imak la tehé léh kerachya la techavvon alohi khibbouleya:
Im-khabol takhbol salmat réeka ad-bo hachchemech techibennou lo
Im machkona tisab kesouta dekhabrak ad méal chimcha tetibinéh léh:
Ki hiv kesoutoh lebaddah hiv simlato leoro bammeh yichkab vehaya ki-yitsaq élay vechamati ki-khannoun ani
Aré hi kesoutéh bilkhodah hi totebéh lemachkéh bema yichkoub vihé aré yiqbél qodamay veéqabbél qebiltéh aré khanana ana:
élohim lo teqallél venasi beammeka lo taor
Dayana la teqil verabba beamak la telout:
Meléateka vedimaka lo teakhér bekor banéka titten-li
Bikkourak vedimak la teakhér boukera dibnayk tapréch qodamay:
Kén-taaseh lechoreka letsoneka chibat yamim yihyeh im-immo bayyom hachchemini titteno-li
Kén tabéd letorak leanak chiba yomin yehé im iméh beyoma teminaa tiprechinéh qodamay:
Veanché-qodech tihyoun li oubasar bassadeh terépa lo tokélou lakkeleb tachlikoun oto
Veénachin qadichin tehon qodamay oubesar telich min khéva khayta la tékeloun lekalba tirmoun yatéh:
Lo tissa chéma chav al-tachet yadeka im-racha lihyot éd khamas
La teqabbél chema dichqar la techavi yedak im khayaba lemehévé léh sahid cheqar:
Lo-tihyeh akharé-rabbim leraot velo-taaneh al-rib lintot akharé rabbim lehattot
La tehé batar sagiin leabacha vela titmena milalapa ma dibénak al dina batar sagié chelam dina:
Vedal lo tehdar beribo
Veal miskéna la terakhém bedinéh:
Ki tipga chor oyibka o khamoro toeh hachéb techibennou lo
Aré tipga tora desaneak o khamaréh detaé ataba tetibinéh léh:
Ki-tireh khamor sonaaka robéts takhat massao vekhadalta méazob lo azob taazob immo
Aré tekhézé khamara desaneak rebia tekhot toanéh vetittimna milmichbaq léh michbaq tichboq ma diblibbak alohi outeparéq iméh:
Lo tatteh michpat ebyoneka beribo
La tatslé din miskénak bedinéh:
Middebar-cheqer tirkhaq venaqi vetsaddiq al-taharog ki lo-atsdiq racha
Mippitgama dechiqra hévé rakhiq vedizké vedi nepaq deké min dina la tiqtol aré la ézakké khayaba:
Vechokhad lo tiqqakh ki hachchokhad yeavvér piqkhim visallép dibré tsaddiqim
Vechokhada la teqabbél aré chokhada meavér éné khakkimin oumeqalqél pitgamin teritsin:
Vegér lo tilkhats veattem yedatem et-nepech haggér ki-gérim héyitem beerets mitsrayim
Vegiyora la teiqoun veattoun yedatoun yat napcha degiyora aré dayarin havétoun beara demitsrayim:
Vechéch chanim tizra et-artseka veasapta et-tebouatah
Vechit chenin tizra yat arak vetiknoch yat alaltah:
Vehachchebiit tichmetenna ounetachtah veakelou ebyoné ammeka veyitram tokal khayyat hassadeh kén-taaseh lekarmeka lezéteka
Ouchebiéta tachmetinah vetartechinah veyékeloun miskené amak ouchearehon tékoul khévat bara kén tabéd lekarmak lezétak:
Chéchet yamim taaseh maaséka oubayyom hachchebii tichbot lemaan yanouakh choreka vakhamoreka veyinnapéch ben-amateka vehaggér
Chitta yomin tabéd obadayk oubeyoma chebiaa tanouakh bedil dinouakh torak vekhamarak veyichcheqot bar amtak vegiyora:
Oubekol acher-amarti alékem tichchamérou vechém élohim akhérim lo tazkirou lo yichchama al-pika
Oubekol di amarit lekon tistamroun vechoum taavat ammaya la tidkeroun la yichtema al poumekon:
Chaloch regalim takhog li bachchana
Telat zimnin tékhog qodamay bechatta:
Et-khag hammatstsot tichmor chibat yamim tokal matstsot kaacher tsivvitika lemoéd khodech haabib ki-bo yatsata mimmitsrayim velo-yéraou panay réqam
Yat khaga depatiraya titar chiba yomin tékoul patira kema dipaqédittak lizman yarkha daabiba aré béh nepaqta mimitsrayim vela yitkhazoun qodamay réqanoun:
Vekhag haqqatsir bikkouré maaséka acher tizra bassadeh vekhag haasip betsét hachchana beospeka et-maaséka min-hassadeh
Vekhaga dakhatsada bikkouré obadayk di tizra bekhaqla vekhaga diknacha bemippeqa dechatta bemiknechak yat obadayk min khaqla:
Chaloch peamim bachchana yéraeh kol-zekoureka el-pené haadon Adonai
Telat zimnin bechatta yitkhazoun kol dekourak qodam ribbon alema Adonai:
Lo-tizbakh al-khaméts dam-zibkhi velo-yalin khéleb-khaggi ad-boqer
La tikkos al khamia dam piskhi vela yebitoun bar min madbekha tarbé niksat khaga ad tsapra:
Réchit bikkouré admateka tabi bét Adonai élohéka lo-tebachchél gedi bakhaléb immo
Réch bikkouré arak tayti lebét miqdecha daAdonai élahak la tékeloun besar bakhalab:
Hinnéh anoki choléakh malak lepanéka lichmorka baddarek velahabiaka el-hammaqom acher hakinoti
Ha ana chalakh malaka qodamak lemitrak beorkha ouleooloutak leatra diatqénit:
Hichchamer mippanayv ouchema beqolo al-tammér bo ki lo yissa lepichakem ki chemi beqirbo
Istammar min qodamohi veqabbél lemémeréh la tesaréb leqibléh aré la yichboq lekhobékon aré bichmi mémeréh:
Ki im-chamoa tichma beqolo veasita kol acher adabbér veayabti et-oyebéka vetsarti et-tsoreréka
Aré im qabbala teqabbél lemémeréh vetabéd kol deémalél veesné yat saneak veaiq ledimiqin lak:
Ki-yélék malaki lepanéka vehébiaka el-haémori vehakhitti vehapperizzi vehakkenaani hakhivvi vehayebousi vehikkhadtiv
Aré yehak malaki qodamak veyaélinak levat émoraé vekhittaé ouperizaé oukenaanaé khivaé vibousaé veéchétsinoun:
Lo-tichtakhaveh lélohéhem velo toobdém velo taaseh kemaaséhem ki harés teharesém vechabbér techabbér matstsébotéhem
La tisgoud letaavatehon vela tiplekhinoun vela tabéd keobadéhon aré pagara tepagrinoun vetabbara tetabbar qamatehon:
Vaabadtem ét Adonai élohékem oubérak et-lakhmeka veet-méméka vahasiroti makhala miqqirbeka
Vetiplekhoun qodam Adonai élahakon vibarék yat mékelak veyat michteyak veadi marin bichin mibbénak:
Lo tihyeh mechakkéla vaaqara beartseka et-mispar yaméka amallé
La tehé metakkela veaqra bearak yat minyan yomayk achlim:
Et-émati achallakh lepanéka vehammoti et-kol-haam acher tabo bahem venatatti et-kol-oyebéka éléka orep
Yat émeti achalakh qodamak veitebar yat kol ama deat até laagakha behon veemsar yat kol baalé debabak qodamak mekhazré qedal:

Vetabéd perasa litra machkena tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir obad tsayyar:
Veasita lammasak khamichcha ammoudé chittim vetsippita otam zahab vavéhem zahab veyatsaqta lahem khamichcha adné nekhochet
Vetabéd liprasa khamcha ammoudé chittin vetakhappé yatehon dahaba vavéhon dahaba vetattik lehon khamcha samké nekhacha:
Veasita et-hammizbéakh atsé chittim khaméch ammot orek vekhaméch ammot rokhab raboua yihyeh hammizbéakh vechaloch ammot qomato
Vetabéd yat madbekha deaé chittin khaméch ammin urka vakhaméch ammin pouteya merabba yehé madbekha outelat ammin rouméh:
Veasita qarnotayv al arba pinnotayv mimmennou tihyéna qarnotayv vetsippita oto nekhochet
Vetabéd qarnohi al arba zivyatéh minnéh tehevyan qarnohi vetakhappé yatéh nekhacha:
Veasita sirotayv ledachcheno veyaayv oumizreqotayv oumizlegotayv oumakhtotayv lekol-kélayv taaseh nekhochet
Vetabéd pesakteravatéh lemispé qitméh oumagropeyatéh oumizreqatéh vetsinnoureyatéh oumakhteyatéh lekol manohi tabéd nekhacha:
Veasita lo mikbar maaséh rechet nekhochet veasita al-harechet arba tabbeot nekhochet al arba qetsotayv
Vetabéd léh serada obad metsadta dinkhacha vetabéd al metsadta arba izqan dinkhacha al arba sitrohi:
Venatatta otah takhat karkob hammizbéakh millematta vehayeta harechet ad khatsi hammizbéakh
Vetittén yatah tekhot sobabé madbekha millera outehé metsadta ad palgout madbekha:
Veasita baddim lammizbéakh baddé atsé chittim vetsippita otam nekhochet
Vetabéd arikhayya lemadbekha arikhé deaé chittin vetakhapé yatehon nekhacha:
Vehouba et-baddayv battabbaot vehayou habbaddim al-cheté tsalot hammizbéakh bisét oto
Veyaél yat arikhohi beizqata vihon arikhayya al terén sitré madbekha bemittal yatéh:
Neboub lukhot taaseh oto kaacher hera oteka bahar kén yaasou
Khalil loukhé tabéd yatéh kema di akhazi yatak betoura kén yabedoun:
Veasita ét khatsar hammichkan lipat negeb-témana qelaim lekhatsér chéch mochzar méa baamma orek lappéa haekhat
Vetabéd yat darat machkena lerouakh ébar daroma seradin ledareta debouts chezir mea beammin urka leébar khad:
Veammudayv esrim veadnéhem esrim nekhochet vavé haammudim vakhachuqéhem kasep
Veammoudohi esrin vesamkéhon esrin nekhacha vavé ammoudayya vekibbouchéhon kesap:
Vekén lipat tsapon baorek qelaim méa orek veammudav esrim veadnéhem esrim nekhochet vavé haammudim vakhachuqéhem kasep
Vekén lerouakh tsippouna beurka seradin mea urka veammoudohi esrin vesamkéhon esrin nekhacha vavé ammoudayya vekibbouchéhon diksap:
Verokhab hekhatsér lipat-yam qelaim khamichchim amma ammudéhem asara veadnéhem asara
Oupouteya dedarta lerouakh maarba seradin khamchin ammin ammoudéhon asra vesamkéhon asra:
Verokhab hekhatsér lipat qédema mizrakha khamichchim amma
Oupouteya dedarta lerouakh qiddouma maddinekha khamchin ammin:
Vakhaméch esréh amma qelaim lakkatép ammudéhem chelocha veadnéhem chelocha
Vakhaméch esré ammin seradin leibra ammoudéhon telata vesamkéhon telata:
Velakkatép hachchénit khaméch esréh qelaim ammudéhem chelocha veadnéhem chelocha
Ouleibra tinyana khaméch esré seradin ammoudéhon telata vesamkéhon telata:
Oulechaar hekhatsér masak esrim amma tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar maaséh roqém ammudéhem arbaa veadnéhem arbaa
Velitra darta perasa esrin ammin tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir obad tsayyar ammoudéhon arbea vesamkéhon arbea:
Kol-ammoudé hekhatsér sabib mekhuchchaqim kesep vavéhem kasep veadnéhem nekhochet
Kol ammoudé darta sekhor sekhor mekabbechin kesap vavéhon kesap vesamkéhon nekhacha:
Orek hekhatsér méa baamma verokhab khamichchim bakhamichchim veqoma khaméch ammot chéch mochzar veadnéhem nekhochet
Urka dedarta mea beammin oupouteya khamchin bekhamchin verouma khaméch ammin debouts chezir vesamkéhon nekhacha:
Lekol kelé hammichkan bekol abodato vekol-yetédotayv vekol-yitdot hekhatsér nekhochet
Lekol mané machkena bekol palekhanéh vekol sikkohi vekol sikké dedarta nekhacha:
Veatta tetsavveh et-bené yisraél veyiqkhou éléka chemen zayit zak katit lammaor lehaalot nér tamid
Veat tepaqqéd yat bené yisraél veyisseboun lak michkha zéta dakya katicha leanhara leadlaqa botsinayya tedira:
Beohel moéd mikhouts lapparoket acher al-haédout yaarok oto aharon oubanayv méereb ad-boqer lipné Adonai khuqqat olam ledorotam méét bené yisraél
Bemachkan zimna mibbara leparukta dial sahadouta yesaddar yatéh aharon oubenohi méramcha ad tsapra qodam Adonai qeyam alam ledaréhon min bené yisraél:
Veatta haqréb éléka et-aharon akhika veet-banayv itto mittok bené yisraél lekahano-li aharon nadab vaabihou elazar veitamar bené aharon
Veat qaréb levatak yat aharon akhouk veyat benohi imméh miggo bené yisraél lechammacha qodamay aharon nadab vaabihou elazar veitamar bené aharon:
Veasita bigdé-qodech leaharon akhika lekabod ouletiparet
Vetabéd lebouché qoudecha leaharon akhouk liqar ouletuchbekhan:
Veatta tedabbér el-kol-khakmé-léb acher millétiv rouakh khokma veasou et-bigdé aharon leqaddecho lekahano-li
Veat temallél im kol khakkimé libba diachlémit imméh rouakh khokmeta veyabedoun yat lebouché aharon leqaddachoutéh lechammacha qodamay:
Veélleh habbegadim acher yaasou khochen veépod oumeil ouketonet tachbéts mitsnepet veabnét veasou bigdé-qodech leaharon akhika oulebanayv lekahano-li
Veillén lebouchayya di yabedoun khouchena veépoda oumeila vekittouna merammetsa mitsnepta vehemyana veyabedoun lebouché qoudecha leaharon akhouk velibnohi lechammacha qodamay:
Vehém yiqkhou et-hazzahab veet-hattekélet veet-haargaman veet-tolaat hachchani veet-hachchéch
Veinnoun yisseboun yat dahaba veyat tikla veyat argevana veyat tseba zehori veyat boutsa:
Veasou et-haépod zahab tekélet veargaman tolaat chani vechéch mochzar maaséh khochéb
Veyabedoun yat époda dahaba tikla veargevana tseba zehori oubouts chezir obad oman:
Cheté ketépot khoberot yiheyeh-lo el-chené qetsotayv vekhubbar
Tartén katpin melappepan yehon léh al terén sitrohi veyitlapap:
Vekhécheb apuddato acher alayv kemaaséhou mimmennou yihyeh zahab tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar
Vehemyan tiqqounéh di alohi keobadohi minnéh yehé dahaba tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir:
Velaqakhta et-cheté abné-choham oupittakhta aléhem chemot bené yisraél
Vetissab yat tartén abné bourela vetiglop aléhen chemahat bené yisraél:
Chichcha michchemotam al haeben haekhat veet-chemot hachchichcha hannotarim al-haeben hachchénit ketoledotam
Chitta michchemahatehon al abna khada veyat chemahat chitta deichtaarou al abna tinyéta ketouledatehon:
Maaséh kharach eben pittoukhé khotam tepattakh et-cheté haabanim al-chemot bené yisraél musabbot michbetsot zahab taaseh otam
Obad oman eben taba ketab meparach kiglop deizqa tiglop yat tartén abnayya al chemahat bené yisraél mechaqqean merammetsan didhab tabéd yatehon:
Vesamta et-cheté haabanim al kitpot haépod abné zikkaron libné yisraél venasa aharon et-chemotam lipné Adonai al-cheté ketépayv lezikkaron
Outechavvi yat tartén abnaya al kitpé époda abné dakerana libné yisraél veyittol aharon yat chemahatehon qodam Adonai al terén kitpohi ledakerana:
Veasita michbetsot zahab
Vetabéd merammetsan didhab:
Oucheté charcherot zahab tahor migbalot taaseh otam maaséh abot venatatta et-charcherot haabotot al-hammichbetsot
Vetartén tikkin dehab deké metakhman tabéd yatehon obad gedilou vetittén yat tikkayya gedilata al merammetsata:
Veasita khochen michpat maaséh khochéb kemaaséh épod taasennou zahab tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar taaseh oto
Vetabéd khchen dina obad oman keobad époda tabedinnéh dahaba tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir tabéd yatéh:
Raboua yiheyeh kapoul zeret orko vezeret rokhbo
Merabba yehé ép zerta urkéh vezerta petayéh:
Oumilléta bo millouat eben arbaa tourim aben tour odem pitda oubareqet hattour haekhad
Vetachlém béh achlamout abna arbea sidrin eben taba sidra qadmaa samqan yarqan oubarqan sidra khad:
Vehattour hachchéni nopek sappir veyahalom
Vesidra tinyana izmaragdin vechabziz vesibhalom:
Vehattour hachchelichi lechem chebo veakhlama
Vesidra telitaa qankiré tarqeya veén egla:
Vehattour harebii tarchich vechoham veyachepéh mechubbatsim zahab yihyou bemillouotam
Vesidra rebiaa keroum yamma oubourela oupantéré merammetsan didhab yehon beachlamoutehon:
Vehaabanim tiheyéna al-chemot bené-yisraél chetém esréh al-chemotam pittoukhé khotam ich al-chemo tiheyéna lichné asar chabet
Veabnayya yehevyan al chemahat bené yisraél tarté esré al chemahathon ketab meparach kiglop deizqa gebar al cheméh tehevyan litrén asar chibtin:
Veasita al-hakhochen charechot gablout maaséh abot zahab tahor
Vetabéd al khouchena tikkin metakhman obad gedilou dehab deké:
Veasita al-hakhochen cheté tabbeot zahab venatatta et-cheté hattabbaot al-chené qetsot hakhochen
Vetabéd al khouchena tartén izqan didhab vetittén yat tartén izqata al terén sitré khouchena:
Venatatta et-cheté abotot hazzahab al-cheté hattabbaot el-qetsot hakhochen
Vetittén yat tartén gedilan didhab al tartén izqata lesitré khouchena:
Veét cheté qetsot cheté haabotot tittén al-cheté hammichbetsot venatatta al-kitpot haépod el-mvl panayv
Veyat tartén gedilan deal tartén sitrohi tittén al tartén merammetsata vetittén al kitpé époda loqobél appohi:
Veasita cheté tabbeot zahab vesamta otam al-chené qetsot hakhochen al-sepato acher el-éber haépod bayeta
Vetabéd tartén izqan didhab outechavvi yatehon al terén sitré khouchena al siptéh di leibra deépoda millegayv:
Veasita cheté tabbeot zahab venatatta otam al-cheté kitpot haépod millematta mimmoul panayv leummat makhbarto mimmaal lekhécheb haépod
Vetabéd tartén izqan didhab vetittén yatehon al tartén kitpé époda millera milloqobél appohi loqobél bét lopé méillavé lehemyan époda:
Veyirkesou et-hakhochen mittabbeotav el-tabbeot haépod biptil tekélet liheyot al-khécheb haépod velo-yizzakh hakhochen méal haépod
Veyekhdoun yat khouchena méizqetéh leizqeta deépoda bekhouta ditkelta leméhévé al hemyan époda vela yitparéq khouchena méillavé époda:
Venasa aharon et-chemot bené-yisraél bekhochen hammichpat al-libbo beboo el-haqqodech lezikkaron lipné-Adonai tamid
Veyittol aharon yat chemahat bené yisraél bekhchen dina al libbéh beméaléh leqoudecha ledoukerana qodam Adonai tedira:
Venatatta el-khochen hammichpat et-haourim veet-hattummim vehayou al-léb aharon beboo lipné Adonai venasa aharon et-michpat bené-yisraél al-libbo lipné Adonai tamid
Vetittén bekhchen dina yat ourayya veyat tummayya vihon al libba deaharon beméaléh qodam Adonai veyittol aharon yat dina dibné yisraél al libbéh qodam Adonai tedira:
Veasita et-meil haépod kelil tekélet
Vetabéd yat meila deépoda gemir tikla:
Vehaya pi-rocho betoko sapa yiheyeh lepiv sabib maaséh orég kepi takhra yiheyeh-lo lo yiqqaréa
Vihé poum réchéh kapil legavvéh tora yehé maqqap lepouméh sekhor sekhor obad makhé kepoum chiryan yehé léh la yitbeza:
Veasita al-chvlayv rimmoné tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani al-chvlayv sabib oupaamoné zahab betokam sabib
Vetabéd al chipolohi rimmoné tikla veargevana outseba zehori al chipolohi sekhor sekhor vezaggin dedahaba bénéhon sekhor sekhor:
Paamon zahab verimmon paamon zahab verimmon al-chvlé hammeil sabib
Zagga dedahaba verimmona zaga dedahaba verimona al chipolé meila sekhor sekhor:
Vehaya al-aharon lecharét venichma qolo beboo el-haqqodech lipné Adonai oubetséto velo yamout
Vihé al aharon lechammacha veyichtema qaléh beméaléh leqoudecha qodam Adonai oubemippeqéh vela yemout:
Veasita tsits zahab tahor oupittakhta alayv pittoukhé khotam qodech la-Adonai
Vetabéd tsitsa didhab deké vetiglop alohi ketab meparach qodech layya:
Vesamta oto al-petil tekélet vehaya al-hammitsnapet el-mvl pené-hammitsnepet yihyeh
Outechavvi yatéh al khouta ditkelta vihé al mitsnepta loqobél appé mitsnepta yehé:
Vehaya al-métsakh aharon venasa aharon et-avon haqqodachim acher yaqdichou bené yisraél lekol-mattenot qodchéhem vehaya al-mitskho tamid leratson lahem lipné Adonai
Vihé al bét énohi deaharon veyittol aharon yat avayat qoudechayya di yeqaddechoun bené yisraél lekol mattenat qoudechéhon vihé al bét énohi tedira leraava lehon qodam Adonai:
Vechibbatsta hakketonet chéch veasita mitsnepet chéch veabnét taaseh maaséh roqém
Outeramméts kittouna boutsa vetabéd mitsnepta deboutsa vehemyana tabéd obad tsayyar:
Velibné aharon taaseh kuttonot veasita lahem abnétim oumigbaot taaseh lahem lekabod ouletiparet
Velibné aharon tabéd kittounin vetabéd lehon hemyanin vekobain tabéd lehon liqar ouletuchbekhan:
Vehilbachta otam et-aharon akhika veet-banayv itto oumachakhta otam oumilléta et-yadam veqiddachta otam vekihanou li
Vetalbéch yatehon yat aharon akhouk veyat benohi imméh outerabbé yatehon outeqaréb yat qurbanhon outeqaddéch yatehon vichammechoun qodamay:
Vaaséh lahem miknesé-bad lekassot besar erva mimmotnayim vead-yerékayim yihyou
Veibéd lehon miknesin debouts lekassaa besar eryeta mékhartsan vead yarkan yehon:
Vehayou al-aharon veal-banayv beboam el-ohel moéd o begichtam el-hammizbéakh lecharét baqqodech velo-yisou avon vamétou khuqqat olam lo oulezaro akharayv
Vihon al aharon veal benohi beméalhon lemachkan zimna o bemiqrabehon lemadbekha lechammacha beqoudecha vela yeqabbeloun khoba vimoutoun qeyam alam léh velibnohi batrohi:
Vezeh haddabar acher-taaseh lahem leqaddéch otam lekahén li leqakh par ekhad ben-baqar veélim chenayim temimim
Vedén pitgama di tabéd lehon leqaddacha yatehon lechammacha qodamay sab tor khad bar toré vedikrin terén chalmin:
Velekhem matstsot vekhallot matstsot beloulot bachchemen oureqiqé matstsot mechukhim bachchamen solet khittim taaseh otam
Oulekhém pattir ougeritsin pattirin depilan bimchakh veespogin pattirin dimchikhin bimchakh sulta khittin tabéd yatehon:
Venatatta otam al-sal ekhad vehiqrabta otam bassal veet-happar veét chené haélim
Vetittén yatehon al salla khad outeqaréb yatehon besalla veyat tora veyat terén dikrin:
Veet-aharon veet-banayv taqrib el-petakh ohel moéd verakhatsta otam bammayim
Veyat aharon veyat benohi teqaréb litra machkan zimna vetaskhé yatehon bemayya:
Velaqakhta et-habbegadim vehilbachta et-aharon et-hakkuttonet veét meil haépod veet-haépod veet-hakhochen veapadta lo bekhécheb haépod
Vetissab yat lebouchayya vetalbéch yat aharon yat kittouna veyat meil époda veyat époda veyat khouchena vetatqén léh behemyan époda:
Vesamta hammitsnepet al-rocho venatatta et-nézer haqqodech al-hammitsnapet
Outechavvi mitsnepta al réchéh vetittén yat kelila deqoudecha al mitsnepta:
Velaqakhta et-chemen hammichkha veyatsaqta al-rocho oumachakhta oto
Vetissab yat michkha dirbouta outeriq al réchéh outerabbi yatéh:
Veet-banayv taqrib vehilbachtam kuttonot
Veyat benohi teqaréb vetalbéchinnoun kittounin:
Vekhagarta otam abnét aharon oubanayv vekhabachta lahem migbaot vehayeta lahem kehunna lekhuqqat olam oumilléta yad-aharon veyad-banayv
Outezaréz yatehon hemyanin aharon oubenohi vetatqan lehon kobain outehé lehon kehunta liqyam alam outeqaréb qurbana deaharon vequrbana dibnohi:
Vehiqrabta et-happar lipné ohel moéd vesamak aharon oubanayv et-yedéhem al-roch happar
Outeqaréb yat tora liqodam machkan zimna veyismok aharon oubenohi yat yedéhon al réch tora:
Vechakhatta et-happar lipné Adonai petakh ohel moéd
Vetikkos yat tora qodam Adonai bitra machkan zimna:
Velaqakhta middam happar venatatta al-qarnot hammizbéakh beetsbaeka veet-kol-haddam tichpok el-yesod hammizbéakh
Vetissab middema detora vetittén al qarnat madbekha beetsbaak veyat kol dema téchod lisoda demadbekha:
Velaqakhta et-kol-hakhéleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veét hayyoteret al-hakkabéd veét cheté hakkelayot veet-hakhéleb acher aléhen vehiqtarta hammizbékha
Vetissab yat kol tarba dekhapé yat gavva veyat khitsra dial kabda veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarba di aléhen vetasséq lemadbekha:
Veet-besar happar veet-oro veet-pircho tisrop baéch mikhouts lammakhaneh khattat hou
Veyat bisra detora veyat machkéh veyat oukeléh toqid benoura mibbara lemachrita khattata hou:
Veet-haayil haekhad tiqqakh vesamekou aharon oubanayv et-yedéhem al-roch haayil
Veyat dikra khad tissab veyismekoun aharon oubenohi yat yedéhon al réch dikra:
Vechakhatta et-haayil velaqakhta et-damo vezaraqta al-hammizbéakh sabib
Vetikkos yat dikra vetissab yat deméh vetizroq al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Veet-haayil tenattéakh lintakhayv verakhatsta qirbo oukeraayv venatatta al-netakhayv veal-rocho
Veyat dikra tepallég leébarohi outekhallil gavvéh oukeraohi vetittén al ébarohi veal réchéh:
Vehiqtarta et-kol-haayil hammizbékha ola hou la-Adonai réakh nikhoakh ichcheh la-Adonai hou
Vetasséq yat kol dikra lemadbekha alata hou qodam Adonai leitqabbala beraava qurbana qodam Adonai hou:
Velaqakhta ét haayil hachchéni vesamak aharon oubanayv et-yedéhem al-roch haayil
Vetissab yat dikra tinyana veyismok aharon oubenohi yat yedéhon al réch dikra:

Vechakhatta et-haayil velaqakhta middamo venatatta al-tenouk ozen aharon veal-tenouk ozen banayv hayemanit veal-bohen yadam hayemanit veal-bohen raglam hayemanit vezaraqta et-haddam al-hammizbéakh sabib

Vetikkos yat dikra vetissab midméh vetittén al roum oudena deaharon veal roum oudena dibnohi deyammina veal ilyon yedéhon deyammina veal ilyon ragléhon deyammina vetizroq yat dema al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Velaqakhta min-haddam acher al-hammizbéakh oumichchemen hammichkha vehizzéta al-aharon veal-begadayv veal-banayv veal-bigdé banayv itto veqadach hou oubegadayv oubanayv oubigdé banayv itto
Vetissab min dema di al madbekha oumimmichkha dirbouta vetaddé al aharon veal lebouchohi veal benohi veal lebouché benohi imméh veyitqaddach hou oulebouchohi oubenohi oulebouché benohi imméh:
Velaqakhta min-haayil hakhéleb vehaalya veet-hakhéleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veét yoteret hakkabéd veét cheté hakkelayot veet-hakhéleb acher aléhen veét choq hayyamin ki él milluim hou
Vetissab min dikra tarba veallita veyat tarba dekhapé yat gavva veyat khatsar kabda veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarba di aléhen veyat choqa deyammina aré dekar qurbana hou:
Vekikkar lekhem akhat vekhallat lekhem chemen akhat veraqiq ekhad missal hammatstsot acher lipné Adonai
Oupitta dilkhém khad ougeritsta dilkhém mechakh khada veespog khad missalla depattirayya di qodam Adonai:
Vesamta hakkol al kappé aharon veal kappé banayv vehénapta otam tenoupa lipné Adonai
Outechavvi kolla al yeda deaharon veal yeda dibnohi outerim yatehon aramouta qodam Adonai:
Velaqakhta otam miyyadam vehiqtarta hammizbékha al-haola leréakh nikhoakh lipné Adonai ichcheh hou la-Adonai
Vetissab yatehon midéhon vetasséq lemadbekha al alata leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai qurbana hou qodam Adonai:
Velaqakhta et-hekhazeh méél hammilluim acher leaharon vehénapta oto tenoupa lipné Adonai vehaya leka lemana
Vetissab yat khedya middekar qurbanayya di leaharon outerim yatéh aramouta qodam Adonai vihé lak lokholaq:
Veqiddachta ét khazéh hattenoupa veét choq hatterouma acher hounap vaacher houram méél hammilluim méacher leaharon ouméacher lebanayv
Outeqaddéch yat khedya daaramouta veyat choqa deaprachouta di ittaram vedi ittaprach middekar qurbanayya middi leaharon oumiddi libnohi:
Vehaya leaharon oulebanayv lekhoq-olam méét bené yisraél ki terouma hou outerouma yihyeh méét bené-yisraél mizzibkhé chalméhem teroumatam la-Adonai
Vihé leaharon velibnohi liqyam alam min bené yisraél aré aprachouta hou veaprachouta yehé min bené yisraél minniksat qoudechéhon aprachoutehon qodam Adonai:
Oubigdé haqqodech acher leaharon yihyou lebanayv akharayv lemochkha bahem oulemallé-bam et-yadam
Oulebouché qoudecha di leaharon yehon libnohi batrohi ledakkaa behon ouleqaraba behon yat qurbanehon:
Chibat yamim yilbacham hakkohén takhtayv mibbanayv acher yabo el-ohel moéd lecharét baqqodech
Chibat yomin yalbéchinnoun kahana tekhotohi mibbenohi di yéol lemachkan zimna lechammacha beqoudecha:
Veét él hammilluim tiqqakh oubichchalta et-besaro bemaqom qadoch
Veyat dekar qurbanayya tissab outebachchél yat bisréh baatar qaddich:
Veakal aharon oubanayv et-besar haayil veet-hallekhem acher bassal petakh ohel moéd
Veyékoul aharon oubenohi yat besar dikra veyat lakhma di besalla litra machkan zimna:
Veoklou otam acher kuppar bahem lemallé et-yadam leqaddéch otam vezar lo-yokal ki-qodech hém
Veyékeloun yatehon di yitkappar behon leqaraba yat qurbanehon leqaddacha yatehon vekhillonay la yékoul aré qoudecha innoun:
Veim-yivvatér mibbesar hammilluim oumin-hallekhem ad-habboqer vesarapta et-hannotar baéch lo yéakél ki-qodech hou
Veim yichtaar mibbesar qurbanayya oumin lakhma ad tsapra vetoqid yat deichtaar benoura la yitakél aré qoudecha hou:
Veasita leaharon oulebanayv kaka kekol acher-tsivviti otaka chibat yamim temallé yadam
Vetabéd leaharon velibnohi kedén kekol di paqqédit yatak chibat yomin teqaréb qurbanehon:
Oupar khattat taaseh layyom al-hakkippurim vekhittéta al-hammizbéakh bekapperka alayv oumachakhta oto leqaddecho
Vetora dekhattata tabéd leyoma al kippourayya outedakké al madbekha bekapparoutak alohi outerabbé yatéh leqaddachoutéh:
Chibat yamim tekappér al-hammizbéakh veqiddachta oto vehaya hammizbéakh qodech qodachim kol-hannogéa bammizbéakh yiqdach
Chibat yomin tekappér al madbekha outeqaddéch yatéh vihé madbekha qodech qoudechayya kol deyiqrab bemadbekha yitqaddach:
Vezeh acher taaseh al-hammizbéakh kebasim bené-chana chenayim layyom tamid
Vedén di tabéd al madbekha immerin bené chena terén leyoma tedira:
Et-hakkebes haekhad taaseh babboqer veét hakkebes hachchéni taaseh bén haarbayim
Yat immera khad tabéd betsapra veyat imra tinyana tabéd bén chimchayya:
Veissaron solet baloul bechemen katit reba hahin venések rebiit hahin yayin lakkebes haekhad
Veisrona sulta depila bimchakh katicha rabout hina veniska rabout hina khamra leimra khad:
Veét hakkebes hachchéni taaseh bén haarbayim keminkhat habboqer oukeniskah taaseh-lah leréakh nikhoakh ichcheh la-Adonai
Veyat imra tinyana tabéd bén chimchayya keminkhat tsapra oukeniskah tabéd lah leitqabbala beraava qurbana qodam Adonai:
Olat tamid ledorotékem petakh ohel-moéd lipné Adonai acher ivvaéd lakem chamma ledabbér éléka cham
Alata tedira ledarékon bitra machkan zimna qodam Adonai diézammén mémeri lekon tamman lemallala immak tamman:
Venoadti chamma libné yisraél veniqdach bikbodi
Veézammén mémeri tamman libné yisraél veyitqaddach biqari:
Veqiddachti et-ohel moéd veet-hammizbéakh veet-aharon veet-banayv aqaddéch lekahén li
Veéqaddéch yat machkan zimna veyat madbekha veyat aharon veyat benohi éqaddéch lechammacha qodamay:
Vechakanti betok bené yisraél vehayiti lahem lélohim
Veachré chekinti bego bené yisraél veehévé lehon leélah:
Veyadeou ki ani Adonai élohéhem acher hotséti otam méerets mitsrayim lechokni betokam ani Adonai élohéhem
Veyiddeoun aré ana Adonai élahahon di appéqit yatehon méara demitsrayim leachraa chekinti bénéhon ana Adonai élahahon:
Veasita mizbéakh miqtar qetoret atsé chittim taaseh oto
Vetabéd madbekha leaqtara alohi qetoret bousemayya deaé chittin tabéd yatéh:
Amma orko veamma rokhbo raboua yihyeh veammatayim qomato mimmennou qarnotayv
Ammeta urkéh veammeta petayéh merabba yehé vetartén ammin rouméh minnéh qarnohi:
Vetsippita oto zahab tahor et-gaggo veet-qirotayv sabib veet-qarnotayv veasita lo zér zahab sabib
Vetakhapé yatéh dehab deké yat iggaréh veyat katelohi sekhor sekhor veyat qarnohi vetabéd léh dér didhab sekhor sekhor:
Oucheté tabbeot zahab taaseh-lo mittakhat lezéro al cheté tsalotayv taaseh al-chené tsiddayv vehaya lebattim lebaddim lasét oto bahémma
Vetartén izqan didhab tabéd léh millera ledéréh al tartén zivyatéh tabéd al terén sitrohi vihé leatra laarikhayya lemittal yatéh behon:
Veasita et-habbaddim atsé chittim vetsippita otam zahab
Vetabéd yat arikhayya deaé chittin vetakhapé yatehon dahaba:
Venatatta oto lipné happaroket acher al-aron haédout lipné hakkapporet acher al-haédout acher ivvaéd leka chamma
Vetittén yatéh qodam parukta di al arona desahadouta liqodam kappurta di al sahadouta di azammén mémeri lak tamman:
Vehiqtir alayv aharon qetoret sammim babboqer babboqer behétibo et-hannérot yaqtirenna
Veyaqtar alohi aharon qetoret bousemin bitspar bitspar beatqanoutéh yat botsinayya yasséqinnah:
Oubehaalot aharon et-hannérot bén haarbayim yaqtirenna qetoret tamid lipné Adonai ledorotékem
Oubeadlaqout aharon yat botsinayya bén chimchayya yasséqinnah qetoret bousemayya tedira qodam Adonai ledarékon:
Lo-taalou alayv qetoret zara veola ouminkha venések lo tissekou alayv
La tasseqoun alohi qetoret bousemin noukerain vaalata ouminkhata veniska la tenassekoun alohi:
Vekipper aharon al-qarnotayv akhat bachchana middam khattat hakkippurim akhat bachchana yekappér alayv ledorotékem qodech-qodachim hou la-Adonai
Vikappér aharon al qarnohi khada bechatta middema khattat kippourayya khada bechatta yekappér alohi ledarékon qodech qoudechin hou qodam Adonai:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Ki tissa et-roch bené-yisraél lipqudéhem venatenou ich koper napcho la-Adonai bipqod otam velo-yihyeh bahem negep bipqod otam
Aré teqabbél yat khuchban bené yisraél leminyanéhon veyittenoun gebar purqan napchéh qodam Adonai kad timné yatehon vela yehé behon mota kad timné yatehon:
Zeh yittenou kol-haobér al-happequdim makhatsit hachcheqel becheqel haqqodech esrim géra hachcheqel makhatsit hachcheqel terouma la-Adonai
Dén yittenoun kol deabar al minyanayya palgout sila besilé qoudecha esrin main sila palgout sila aprachouta qodam Adonai:
Kol haobér al-happequdim mibben esrim chana vamaela yittén teroumat Adonai
Kol deabar al minyanayya mibbar esrin chenin ouleélla yittén aprachouta qodam Adonai:
Heachir lo-yarbeh vehaddal lo yamit mimmakhatsit hachchaqel latét et-teroumat Adonai lekappér al-napchotékem
Deattir la yasgé oudemiskén la yazér mippalgout sila lemittan yat aprachouta qodam Adonai lekappara al napchatékon:
Velaqakhta et-kesep hakkippurim méét bené yisraél venatatta oto al-abodat ohel moéd vehaya libné yisraél lezikkaron lipné Adonai lekappér al-napchotékem
Vetissab yat kesap kippourayya min bené yisraél vetittén yatéh al palekhan machkan zimna vihé libné yisraél ledakerana qodam Adonai lekappara al napchatékon:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Veasita kiyyor nekhochet vekanno nekhochet lerokhtsa venatatta oto bén-ohel moéd oubén hammizbéakh venatatta chamma mayim
Vetabéd kiyyora dinkhacha oubesiséh nekhacha leqiddouch vetittén yatéh bén machkan zimna oubén madbekha vetittén tamman mayya:
Verakhatsou aharon oubanayv mimmennou et-yedéhem veet-ragléhem
Viqaddechoun aharon oubenohi minnéh yat yedéhon veyat ragléhon:
Beboam el-ohel moéd yirkhatsou-mayim velo yamoutou o begichtam el-hammizbéakh lecharét lehaqtir ichcheh la-Adonai
Beméalhon lemachkan zimna yeqaddechoun mayya vela yemoutoun o bemiqrabehon lemadbekha lechammacha leassaqa qurbana qodam Adonai:
Verakhatsou yedéhem veragléhem velo yamoutou vehayeta lahem khoq-olam lo oulezaro ledorotam
Viqaddechoun yedéhon veragléhon vela yemoutoun outehé lehon qeyam alam léh velibnohi ledaréhon:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Veatta qakh-leka besamim roch mor-deror khaméch méot veqinnemon-besem makhatsito khamichchim oumatayim ouqenéh-bosem khamichchim oumatayim
Veat sab lak bousemin récha méra dakya matqal khaméch mea veqinneman besem palgoutéh matqal matan vekhamchin ouqenéh bousema matqal matan vekhamchin:
Veqidda khaméch méot becheqel haqqodech vechemen zayit hin
Ouqetsiata matqal khaméch mea besilé qoudecha oumechakh zéta melé hina:
Veasita oto chemen michkhat-qodech roqakh mirqakhat maaséh roqéakh chemen michkhat-qodech yihyeh
Vetabéd yatéh mechakh rebout qoudecha bosem mebassam obad bousemanou mechakh rebout qoudecha yehé:
Oumachakhta bo et-ohel moéd veét aron haédout
Outerabbi béh yat machkan zimna veyat arona desahadouta:
Veet-hachchulkhan veet-kol-kélayv veet-hammenora veet-kéléha veét mizbakh haqqetoret
Veyat patora veyat kol manohi veyat menarta veyat manaha veyat madbekha diqtoret bousemayya:
Veet-mizbakh haola veet-kol-kélayv veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Veyat madbakh daalata veyat kol manohi veyat kiyyora veyat besiséh:
Veqiddachta otam vehayou qodech qodachim kol-hannogéa bahem yiqdach
Outeqaddéch yatehon vihon qodech qoudechayya kol deyiqrab behon yitqaddach:
Veet-aharon veet-banayv timchakh veqiddachta otam lekahén li
Veyat aharon veyat benohi terabbi outeqaddéch yatehon lechammacha qodamay:
Veel-bené yisraél tedabbér lémor chemen michkhat-qodech yihyeh zeh li ledorotékem
Veim bené yisraél temallél lemémar mechakh rebout qoudecha yehé dén qodamay ledarékon:
Al-besar adam lo yisak oubematkunto lo taasou kamohou qodech hou qodech yihyeh lakem
Al bisra daanacha la yitnassak oubidmoutéh la tabedoun kevatéh qoudecha hou qoudecha yehé lekon:
Ich acher yirqakh kamohou vaacher yittén mimmennou al-zar venikrat méammayv
Gebar di yebassam dikvatéh vedi yittén minnéh al khillonay veyichtétsé méamméh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh qakh-leka sammim natap ouchekhélet vekhelbena sammim oulebona zakka bad bebad yihyeh
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh sab lak bousemin netopa vetoupera vekhelbenéta bousemin oulebouneta dakita matqal bematqal yehé:
Veasita otah qetoret roqakh maaséh roqéakh memullakh tahor qodech
Vetabéd yatah qetoret bousemin bosem obad bousemanou mearab deké qoudecha:
Vechakhaqta mimmenna hadéq venatatta mimmenna lipné haédout beohel moéd acher ivvaéd leka chamma qodech qodachim tihyeh lakem
Vetichkhoq minnah vetaddiq vetittén minnah qodam sahadouta bemachkan zimna di ézammén mémeri lak tamman qodech qoudechin tehé lekon:
Vehaqqetoret acher taaseh bematkuntah lo taasou lakem qodech tihyeh leka la-Adonai
Ouqetoret bousemin di tabéd bidmoutah la tabedoun lekon qoudecha tehé lak qodam Adonai:
Ich acher-yaaseh kamoha lehariakh bah venikrat méammayv
Gebar deyabéd dikvatah laarakha bah veyichtétsé méamméh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Reéh qarati bechém betsalél ben-vri ben-khvr lemattéh yehouda
Khazé derabbéti bechoum betsalél bar ouri bar khour lechibta dihouda:
Vaamallé oto rouakh élohim bekhokma oubitbouna oubedaat oubekol-melaka
Veachlémit imméh rouakh min qodam Adonai bekhokmeta oubesoukeletanou oubemadda oubekol ibida:
Lakhchob makhachabot laasot bazzahab oubakkesep oubannekhochet
Leallapa oumanvan lemebad bedahaba oubekaspa oubinkhacha:
Oubakharochet eben lemallot oubakharochet éts laasot bekol-melaka
Oubeamanout eben taba leachlama oubenaggarout aa lemebad bekol ibida:
Vaani hinnéh natatti itto ét oholiab ben-akhisamak lemattéh-dan oubeléb kol-khakam-léb natatti khokma veasou ét kol-acher tsivvitika
Vaana ha yehabit imméh yat oholiab bar akhisamak lechibta dedan oubelibba kol khakkimé libba yehabit khokmeta veyabedoun yat kol di paqédittak:
ét ohel moéd veet-haaron laédout veet-hakkapporet acher alayv veét kol-kelé haohel
Yat machkan zimna veyat arona lesahadouta veyat kappurta di alohi veyat kol mané machkena:
Veet-hachchulkhan veet-kélayv veet-hammenora hattehora veet-kol-kéléha veét mizbakh haqqetoret
Veyat patora veyat manohi veyat menarta dakita veyat kol manaha veyat madbekha diqtoret bousemaya:
Veet-mizbakh haola veet-kol-kélayv veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Veyat madbekha daalata veyat kol manohi veyat kiyora veyat besiséh:
Veét bigdé hasserad veet-bigdé haqqodech leaharon hakkohén veet-bigdé banayv lekahén
Veyat lebouché chimoucha veyat lebouché qoudecha leaharon kahana veyat lebouché benohi lechammacha:
Veét chemen hammichkha veet-qetoret hassammim laqqodech kekol acher-tsivvitika yaasou
Veyat michkha dirbouta veyat qetoret bousemayya leqoudecha kekol di paqqédetak yabedoun:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh lemémar:
Veatta dabbér el-bené yisraél lémor ak et-chabbetotay tichmorou ki ot hiv béni oubénékem ledorotékem ladaat ki ani Adonai meqaddichkem
Veat mallél im bené yisraél lemémar beram yat yomé chabbayya di li titteroun aré at hi bén mémeri oubénékon ledarékon lemidda aré ana Adonai meqaddichkon:
Ouchemartem et-hachchabbat ki qodech hiv lakem mekhaleléha mot youmat ki kol-haoseh bah melaka venikreta hannepech hahiv miqqereb amméha
Vetitteroun yat chabbeta aré qoudecha hi lekon mekhallelinnah itqetala yitqetél aré kol deyabed bah ibida veyichtétsé anacha hahou miggo amméh:
Chéchet yamim yéaseh melaka oubayyom hachchebii chabbat chabbaton qodech la-Adonai kol-haoseh melaka beyom hachchabbat mot youmat
Chitta yomin yitabéd ibida oubeyoma chebiaa chebat chabbeta qoudecha qodam Adonai kol deyabéd ibidta beyoma dechabbeta itqetala yitqetél:
Vechamerou bené-yisraél et-hachchabbat laasot et-hachchabbat ledorotam berit olam
Veyitteroun bené yisraél yat chabbeta lemebad yat chabbeta ledaréhon qeyam alam:
Béni oubén bené yisraél ot hiv leolam ki-chéchet yamim asa Adonai et-hachchamayim veet-haarets oubayyom hachchebii chabat vayyinnapach
Bén mémeri oubén bené yisraél at hi lealam aré chitta yomin abad Adonai yat chemayya veyat ara oubeyoma chebiaa chebat venakh:
Vayyittén el-mocheh kekalloto ledabbér itto behar sinay chené lukhot haédout lukhot eben ketubim beetsba élohim
Vihab lemcheh kad chétsé lemallala imméh betoura desinay terén loukhé sahadouta loukhé abna ketibin beetsbea daAdonai:

Vayyar haam ki-bochéch mocheh laredet min-hahar vayyiqqahél haam al-aharon vayyomerou élayv qoum aséh-lanou élohim acher yélekou lepanénou ki-zeh mocheh haich acher heélanou méerets mitsrayim lo yadanou meh-haya lo

Vakhaza amma aré okhar mcheh lemékhat min toura veitkenéch amma al aharon vaamarou léh qoum abéd lana dakhalan diyhakoun qodamana aré dén mcheh gabra di asseqana méara demitsrayim la yedana ma hava léh:
Vayyomer aléhem aharon pareqou nizmé hazzahab acher beozné nechékem benékem oubenotékem vehabiou élay
Vaamar lehon aharon periqou qadaché dedahaba di beoudené nechékon benékon oubenatékon veaytiyyou levati:
Vayyitpareqou kol-haam et-nizmé hazzahab acher beoznéhem vayyabiou el-aharon
Veitperiqou kol amma yat qadaché dedahaba di beoudenéhon veaytiyyou leaharon:
Vayyiqqakh miyyadam vayyatsar oto bakheret vayyaaséhou égel masséka vayyomerou élleh élohéka yisraél acher heélouka méerets mitsrayim
Ounesib midéhon vetsar yatéh bezipa veabedéh égel matteka vaamarou illén dakhaltak yisraél di asseqouk méara demitsrayim:
Vayyar aharon vayyiben mizbéakh lepanayv vayyiqra aharon vayyomar khag la-Adonai makhar
Vakhaza aharon oubena madbekha qodamohi ouqera aharon vaamar khagga qodam Adonai mekhar:
Vayyachkimou mimmokhorat vayyaalou olot vayyaggichou chelamim vayyécheb haam leékol vechato vayyaqoumou letsakhéq
Veaqdimou beyoma debatrohi veassiqou alavan veqaribou niksin veaskhar amma lemékal oulemichté veqamou lekhayyaka:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lek-réd ki chikhét ammeka acher heéléta méerets mitsrayim
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh izél khout aré khabbil ammak di asseqta méara demitsrayim:
Sarou mahér min-hadderek acher tsivvitim asou lahem égel masséka vayyichtakhavou-lo vayyizbekhou-lo vayyomerou élleh élohéka yisraél acher heélouka méerets mitsrayim
Satou bipria min orekha di paqqedtinnoun abadou lehon égal matteka ousegidou léh vedabbakhou léh vaamarou illén dakhaltak yisraél di asseqouk méara demitsrayim:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh raiti et-haam hazzeh vehinnéh am-qechéh-orep hou
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh gelé qodamay amma hadén veha amma qeché qedal hou:
Veatta hannikha li veyikhar-appi bahem vaakallém veeéseh oteka legoy gadol
Oukean hannakh baoutak min qodamay veyitqép rougezi behon veéchétsinnoun veebéd yatak leam saggi:
Vayekhal mocheh et-pené Adonai élohayv vayyomer lama Adonai yekhéreh appeka beammeka acher hotséta méerets mitsrayim bekoakh gadol oubeyad khazaqa
Vetsalli mcheh qodam Adonai élahéh vaamar lema Adonai yitqép rougezak beammak di appeqta méara demitsrayim bekhél rab oubida taqqipa:
Lamma yomerou mitsrayim lémor beraa hotsiam laharog otam beharim oulekallotam méal pené haadama choub mékharon appeka vehinnakhém al-haraa leammeka
Lema yémeroun mitsraé lemémar bebicheta appeqtinnoun leqattala yatehon béné tourayya oulechétsayoutehon méal appé ara toub mitteqop rougezak veatéb min bicheta demellelta lemebad leammak:
Zekor leabraham leyitskhaq ouleyisraél abadéka acher nichbata lahem bak vattedabbér aléhem arbeh et-zarakem kekokebé hachchamayim vekol-haarets hazzot acher amarti ettén lezarakem venakhalou leolam
Idkar leabraham leyitskhaq ouleyisraél abdayk di qayyemta lehon bemémerak oumallelta immehon asgé yat benékon kekokebé chemayya vekol ara hada di amarit ettén libnékon veyakhsenoun laalam:
Vayyinnakhem Adonai al-haraa acher dibber laasot leammo
Vetab Adonai min bicheta di mallél lemebad leamméh:
Vayyipen vayyéred mocheh min-hahar ouchené lukhot haédout beyado lukhot ketubim michchené ebréhem mizzeh oumizzeh hém ketubim
Veitpené ounekhat mcheh min toura outerén loukhé sahadouta bidéh loukhé ketibin mitterén ibréhon mikka oumikka innoun ketibin:
Vehallukhot maaséh élohim hémma vehammiktab miktab élohim hou kharout al-hallukhot
Veloukhayya obada daAdonai innoun ouketaba ketaba daAdonai hou meparach al loukhayya:
Vayyichma yehochoua et-qol haam beréoh vayyomer el-mocheh qol milkhama bammakhaneh
Ouchema yehochua yat qal amma kad meyabbebin vaamar lemcheh qal qeraba bemachrita:
Vayyomer én qol anot geboura veén qol anot khaloucha qol annot anoki choméa
Vaamar la qal gibbarin denatskhin biqraba veap la qal khallachin demittabberin qal dimkhayyekin ana chema:
Vayehi kaacher qarab el-hammakhaneh vayyar et-haégel oumekholot vayyikhar-ap mocheh vayyachlék miyyadav et-hallukhot vayechabbér otam takhat hahar
Vahava kad qarib lemachrita vakhaza yat egla vekhingin outeqép rougeza demcheh ourema midohi yat loukhayya vetabbar yatehon bechippolé toura:
Vayyiqqakh et-haégel acher asou vayyisrop baéch vayyitkhan ad acher-daq vayyizer al-pené hammayim vayyachq et-bené yisraél
Ouneséb yat egla di abadou veoqéd benoura vechap ad dahava daqqiq ouzera al appé mayya veachqé yat bené yisraél:
Vayyomer mocheh el-aharon meh-asa leka haam hazzeh ki-hébéta alayv khataa gedola
Vaamar mcheh leaharon ma abad lak amma hadén aré aytéta alohi khoba rabba:
Vayyomer aharon al-yikhar ap adoni atta yadata et-haam ki bera hou
Vaamar aharon la yitqép rougeza deribboni at yedaat yat amma aré bebich hou:
Vayyomerou li aséh-lanou élohim acher yélekou lepanénou ki-zeh mocheh haich acher heélanou méerets mitsrayim lo yadanou meh-haya lo
Vaamarou li ibéd lana dakhalan di yehakan qodamana aré dén mcheh gabra di asseqana méara demitsrayim la yedana mah hava léh:
Vaomar lahem lemi zahab hitparaqou vayyittenou-li vaachlikéhou baéch vayyétsé haégel hazzeh
Vaamarit lehon leman dahaba pariqou vihabou li ouremitéh benoura ounepaq egla hadén:
Vayyar mocheh et-haam ki paroua hou ki-peraoh aharon lechimtsa beqaméhem
Vakhaza mcheh yat amma aré betil hou aré batélinnoun aharon laasaboutehon choum bich ledaréhon:
Vayyaamod mocheh bechaar hammakhaneh vayyomer mi la-Adonai élay vayyéasepou élayv kol-bené lévi
Veqam mcheh bitra machrita vaamar man dakhalayya daAdonai yétoun levati veitkannachou levatéh kol bené lévi:
Vayyomer lahem koh-amar Adonai élohé yisraél simou ich-kharbo al-yeréko ibrou vachoubou michchaar lachaar bammakhaneh vehirgou ich-et-akhiv veich et-rééhou veich et-qerobo
Vaamar lehon kidnan amar Adonai élaha deyisraél chavvou gebar kharbéh al yarkéh ibarou vetoubou mittera litra bemachrita ouqetoulou gebar yat akhouhi ougebar yat khabréh veénach yat qaribéh:
Vayyaasou bené-lévi kidbar mocheh vayyippol min-haam bayyom hahou kichlochet alpé ich
Vaabadou bené lévi kepitgama demcheh ounepal min amma beyoma hahou kitlata alpin gabra:
Vayyomer mocheh milou yedkem hayyom la-Adonai ki ich bibno oubeakhiv velatét alékem hayyom beraka
Vaamar mcheh qaribou yedkon qurbana yoma dén qodam Adonai aré gebar bibréh oubeakhouhi ouleaytaa alékon yoma dén birkan:
Vayehi mimmokhorat vayyomer mocheh el-haam attem khatatem khataa gedola veatta eéleh el-Adonai oulay akappera bead khattatkem
Vahava beyoma debatrohi vaamar mcheh leamma attoun khabtoun khoba rabba oukean essaq qodam Adonai maim akappér al khobékon:
Vayyachob mocheh el-Adonai vayyomar anna khata haam hazzeh khataa gedola vayyaasou lahem élohé zahab
Vetab mcheh liqodam Adonai vaamar bebaou khab amma hadén khoba rabba vaabadou lehon dakhalan didhab:
Veatta im-tissa khattatam veim-ayin mekhéni na missipreka acher katabeta
Oukean im chabqat lekhobéhon veim la mekhéni kean missiprak di ketabta:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh mi acher khata-li emkhennou missipri
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh man di khab qodamay emkhinnéh misipri:
Veatta lék nekhéh et-haam el acher-dibbarti lak hinnéh malaki yélék lepanéka oubeyom poqdi oupaqadti aléhem khattatam
Oukean izzél dabbar yat amma laatar di mallélit lak ha malaki yehak qodamak oubeyom asarouti veasar aléhon khobéhon:
Vayyiggop Adonai et-haam al acher asou et-haégel acher asa aharon
Oumekha Adonai yat amma al di ichtabadou leegla di abad aharon:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lék aléh mizzeh atta vehaam acher heélita méerets mitsrayim el-haarets acher nichbati leabraham leyitskhaq ouleyaaqob lémor lezaraka ettenenna
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh izzél saq mikka at veamma deasseqta méara demitsrayim leara di qayyémit leabraham leyitskhaq ouleyaaqob lemémar libnayk etteninnah:
Vechalakhti lepanéka malak vegérachti et-hakkenaani haémori vehakhitti vehapperizzi hakhivvi vehayebousi
Veechlakh qodamak malaka veétarék yat kenaanaé émoraé vekhittaé ouperizzaé khivvaé vibousaé:
El-erets zabat khalab oudebach ki lo eéleh beqirbeka ki am-qechéh-orep atta pen-akelka baddarek
Leara abda khalab oudebach aré la asalléq chekinti mibbénak aré am qeché qedal at dilema achétsinnak beorkha:
Vayyichma haam et-haddabar hara hazzeh vayyitabbalou velo-chatou ich edyo alayv
Ouchema amma yat pitgama bicha hadén veitabbalou vela chavviyou gebar tiqqoun zénéh alohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh émor el-bené-yisraél attem am-qechéh-orep rega ekhad eéleh beqirbeka vekillitika veatta horéd edyeka méaléka veédea ma eéseh-lak
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh émar libné yisraél attoun am qeché qedal chaa khada asalléq chekinti mibbénak veéchétsinnak oukean adi tiqqoun zénak minnak ougelé qodamay ma abéd lak:
Vayyitenatstselou bené-yisraél et-edyam méhar khoréb
Veadiou bené yisraél yat tiqqoun zénéhon mittoura dekhoréb:
Oumocheh yiqqakh et-haohel venata-lo mikhouts lammakhaneh harkhéq min-hammakhaneh veqara lo ohel moéd vehaya kol-mebaqqéch Adonai yétsé el-ohel moéd acher mikhouts lammakhaneh

Oumcheh nesib yat machkena ouparséh léh mibbara lemachrita arkhéq min machrita veqaré léh machkan bét oulepana vihé kol detaba oulepan min qodam Adonai nepaq lemachkan bét oulepana mibbara lemachrita:
Vehaya ketsét mocheh el-haohel yaqoumou kol-haam venitstsebou ich petakh oholo vehibbitou akharé mocheh ad-boo haohéla
Vahava kad nepaq mcheh lemachkena qayyemin kol amma oumitattedin gebar bitra machkena oumistakkelin akhoré mcheh ad dealél lemachkena:
Vehaya kebo mocheh haohéla yéréd ammoud heanan veamad petakh haohel vedibber im-mocheh
Vahava kad alél mcheh lemachkena nakhit ammouda daanana veqaém bitra machkena oumitmallél im mcheh:
Veraa kol-haam et-ammoud heanan oméd petakh haohel veqam kol-haam vehichetakhavou ich petakh oholo
Vakhazan kol amma yat ammouda daanana qaém bitra machkena veqayyemin kol amma vesagedin gebar bitra machkenéh:
Vedibber Adonai el-mocheh panim el-panim kaacher yedabbér ich el-rééhou vechab el-hammakhaneh oumechareto yehochoua bin-nvn naar lo yamich mittok haohel
Oumitmallél Adonai im mcheh mamlal im mamlal kema dimmallél gebar im khabréh vetab lemachrita oumechoumechanéh yehochua bar noun ouléma la adé miggo machkena:
Vayyomer mocheh el-Adonai reéh atta omér élay haal et-haam hazzeh veatta lo hodatani ét acher-tichlakh immi veatta amarta yedatika bechém vegam-matsata khén beénay
Vaamar mcheh qodam Adonai khazé deat amar li asséq yat amma hadén veat la hodatani yat di tichlakh immi veat amart rabbitak bechoum veap achkakhta rakhamin qodamay:
Veatta im-na matsati khén beénéka hodiéni na et-derakeka veédaaka lemaan emtsa-khén beénéka oureéh ki ammeka haggoy hazzeh
Oukean im kean achkakhit rakhamin qodamak hodani kean yat orakh toubak veidda rakhamak bedil deachkakh rakhamin qodamak ougelé qadamak aré ammak amma hadén:
Vayyomar panay yélékou vahanikhoti lak
Vaamar chekinti tehak veaniakh lak:
Vayyomer élayv im-én panéka holekim al-taalénou mizzeh
Vaamar qodamohi im lét chekintak mehalleka bénana la tasqinana mikka:
Oubammeh yivvada épo ki-matsati khén beénéka ani veammeka halo belekteka immanou veniplinou ani veammeka mikkol-haam acher al-pené haadama
Oubammeh yityadda haka aré achkakhit rakhamin qodamak ana veammak hala beméhak chekintak immana veyitabbedan lana perichan li ouleammak mechanné mikkol amma di al appé ara:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh gam et-haddabar hazzeh acher dibbarta eéseh ki-matsata khén beénay vaédaaka bechém
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh ap yat pitgama hadén di mallelta ebéd aré achkakhta rakhamin qodamay verabbitak bechoum:
Vayyomar haréni na et-kebodeka
Vaamar akhazéni kean yat yeqarak:
Vayyomer ani aabir kol-tvbi al-panéka veqarati bechém Adonai lepanéka vekhannoti et-acher akhon verikhamti et-acher arakhém
Vaamar ana abar kol toubi al appayk veeqré bichma daAdonai qodamak veékhon leman deékhon veérakhém al man deérakhém:
Vayyomer lo toukal lirot et-panay ki lo-yirani haadam vakhay
Vaamar la tikoul lemekhézé yat appé chekinti aré la yekhézinani énacha veyitqayyam:
Vayyomer Adonai hinnéh maqom itti venitstsabta al-hatstsour
Vaamar Adonai ha atar matqan qodamay vetitattad al tinnara:
Vehaya baabor kebodi vesamtika beniqrat hatstsour vesakkoti kappi aléka ad-obri
Vihé beméabar yeqari veéchavvinak bimarat tinnara veagén bemémeri alak ad deeébar:
Vahasiroti et-kappi veraita et-akhoray oupanay lo yéraou
Veadé yat dibrat yeqari vetekhézé yat debatray vediqodamay la yitkhazoun:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh pesol-leka chené-lukhot abanim karichonim vekatabti al-hallukhot et-haddebarim acher hayou al-hallukhot harichonim acher chibbarta
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh pesal lak terén loukhé abnayya keqadmaé veektob al loukhayya yat pitgamayya di havo al loukhayya qadmaé di tebarta:
Vehyéh nakon labboqer vealita babboqer el-har sinay venitstsabta li cham al-roch hahar
Vehévé zammin letsapra vetissaq betsapra letoura desinay vetitattad qodamay tamman al réch toura:
Veich lo-yaaleh immak vegam-ich al-yéra bekol-hahar gam-hatstson vehabbaqar al-yirou el-mvl hahar hahou
Veénach la yissaq immak veap énach la yitkhazé bekol toura ap ana vetoré la yiroun loqobél toura hahou:
Vayyipsol chené-lukhot abanim karichonim vayyachkém mocheh babboqer vayyaal el-har sinay kaacher tsivva Adonai oto vayyiqqakh beyado chené lukhot abanim
Oupesal terén loukhé abnayya keqadmaé veaqdém mcheh betsapra ouseléq letoura desinay kema depaqqéd Adonai yatéh ouneséb bidéh terén loukhé abnayya:
Vayyéred Adonai beanan vayyityatstséb immo cham vayyiqra bechém Adonai
Veitgeli Adonai baanana veitattad imméh tamman ouqera bichma daAdonai:
Vayyaabor Adonai al-panayv vayyiqra Adonai Adonai él rakhoum vekhannoun erek appayim verab-khesed veémet
Veabar Adonai chekintéh al appohi ouqera Adonai Adonai élaha rakhamana vekhannana markhiq regaz oumasgé lemebad tabvan ouqechot:
Notsér khesed laalapim nosé avon vapecha vekhattaa venaqqéh lo yenaqqeh poqéd avon abot al-banim veal-bené banim al-chilléchim veal-ribbéim
Natar tibou lealpé darin chabéq laavayan velimrod oulekhobin salakh lidtaybin leoraytéh velidla taybin la mezakké masar khobé abahan al benin veal bené benin maradin al dar telitay veal dar rebiay:
Vayemahér mocheh vayyiqqod artsa vayyichtakhou
Veokhi mcheh oukera al ara ousegid:
Vayyomer im-na matsati khén beénéka adonay yélek-na adonay beqirbénou ki am-qechéh-orep hou vesalakhta laavonénou oulekhattaténou ounekhaltanou
Vaamar im kean achkakhit rakhamin qodamak Adonai tehak kean chekinta daAdonai bénana aré am qeché qedal hou vetichboq lekhobana velakhataana vetakhsenana:
Vayyomer hinnéh anoki korét berit neged kol-ammeka eéseh niplaot acher lo-nibreou bekol-haarets oubekol-haggoyim veraa kol-haam acher-atta beqirbo et-maaséh Adonai ki-nora hou acher ani oseh immak
Vaamar ha ana gezar qeyam qodam kol ammak aabbéd perichan di la itberiou bekol ara oubekol ammayya veyekhézé kol amma di at bénéhon yat obada daAdonai aré dakhél hou di ana abéd immak:
Chemor-leka ét acher anoki metsavveka hayyom hinni goréch mippanéka et-haémori vehakkenaani vehakhitti vehapperizzi vehakhivvi vehayebousi
Tar lak yat di ana mepaqdak yoma dén ha ana metarék min qodamak yat émoraé oukenaanaé vekhittaé ouperizzaé vekhivvaé vibousaé:
Hichchamer leka pen-tikrot berit leyochéb haarets acher atta ba aléha pen-yihyeh lemoqéch beqirbeka
Istammar lak dilema tigzar qeyam leyatéb ara di at alél alah dilema yehé letaqla bénak:
Ki et-mizbekhotam tittotsoun veet-matstsébotam techabbéroun veet-achérayv tikrotoun
Aré yat agoréhon tetaroun veyat qamathon tetabberoun veyat achéréhon teqatstsetsoun:
Ki lo tichetakhaveh leél akhér ki Adonai qanna chemo él qanna hou
Aré la tisgod letaavat ammayya aré Adonai qanna cheméh él qanna hou:
Pen-tikrot berit leyochéb haarets vezanou akharé élohéhem vezabekhou lélohéhem veqara leka veakalta mizzibkho
Dilema tigzar qeyam leyatéb ara veyitoun batar taavathon veyidbekhoun letaavathon veyiqroun lak vetékoul middibkhéhon:
Velaqakhta mibbenotayv lebanéka vezanou benotayv akharé élohéhen vehiznou et-banéka akharé élohéhen
Vetissab mibbenathon libnayk veyitayyan benathon batar taavathon veyitayyan yat benayk batar taavathon:
élohé masséka lo taaseh-lak
Dakhalan dematka la tabéd lak:
Et-khag hammatstsot tichmor chibat yamim tokal matstsot acher tsivvitika lemoéd khodech haabib ki bekhodech haabib yatsata mimmitsrayim
Yat khagga depattirayya tittar chiba yomin tékoul pattira kema di paqqédetak lizman yarkha deabbiba aré beyarkha deabbiba nepaqta mimmitsrayim:
Kol-peter rekhem li vekol-miqneka tizzakar peter chor vaseh
Kol patakh valeda dili vekol beirak dikrin taqdéch bekor tor veimar:
Oupeter khamor tipdeh beseh veim-lo tipdeh vaarapto kol bekor banéka tipdeh velo-yéraou panay réqam
Ouboukera dakhamara tiproq beimera veim la tiproq vetanqepéh kol boukera dibnayk tiproq vela yitkhazoun qodamay réqanin:
Chéchet yamim taabod oubayyom hachchebii tichbot bekharich oubaqqatsir tichbot
Chitta yomin tiplakh oubeyoma chebiaa tenouakh bizroa oubakhatsada tenouakh:
Vekhag chabuot taaseh leka bikkouré qetsir khittim vekhag haasip teqoupat hachchana
Vekhagga dechabouayya tabéd lak bikkouré khatsad khittin vekhagga diknacha bemipqa dechatta:
Chaloch peamim bachchana yéraeh kol-zekoureka et-pené haadon Adonai élohé yisraél
Telat zimnin bechatta yitkhazoun kol dekourayk qodam ribbon alema Adonai élaha deyisraél:
Ki-orich goyim mippanéka vehirkhabti et-gebuleka velo-yakhmod ich et-artseka baaloteka léraot et-pené Adonai élohéka chaloch peamim bachchana
Aré atarék ammin min qodamak veapté yat tekhoumak vela yakhméd énach yat arak bemisqak leitkhazzaa qodam Adonai élahak telat zimnin bechatta:
Lo-tichkhat al-khaméts dam-zibkhi velo-yalin labboqer zebakh khag happasakh
