La tikkos al khamia dam piskhi vela yebitoun letsapra bar mimmadbekha tarbé niksat khagga depiskha:
Réchit bikkouré admateka tabi bét Adonai élohéka lo-tebachchél gedi bakhaléb immo
Réch bikkouré arak tayté lebét maqdecha daAdonai élahak la tékeloun besar bakhalab:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh ketob-leka et-haddebarim haélleh ki al-pi haddebarim haélleh karatti itteka berit veet-yisraél
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh ketab lak yat pitgamayya haillén aré al mémar pitgamayya haillén gezarit immak qeyam veim yisraél:
Vayehi-cham im-Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla lekhem lo akal oumayim lo chata vayyiktob al-hallukhot ét dibré habberit aseret haddebarim
Vahava tamman qodam Adonai arbein yemamin vearbein lélavan lakhma la akal oumayya la cheté ouketab al loukhayya yat pitgamé qeyama asra pitgamin:
Vayehi beredet mocheh méhar sinay ouchené lukhot haédout beyad-mocheh beridto min-hahar oumocheh lo-yada ki qaran or panayv bedabbero itto
Vahava kad nekhat mcheh mittoura desinay outerén loukhé sahadouta bida demcheh bemékhatéh min toura oumcheh la yeda aré segé ziv yeqara deappohi bemallaloutéh imméh:
Vayyar aharon vekol-bené yisraél et-mocheh vehinnéh qaran or panayv vayyireou miggechet élayv
Vakhaza aharon vekol bené yisraél yat mcheh veha segé ziv yeqara deappohi oudekhilou milleitqeraba levatéh:
Vayyiqra aléhem mocheh vayyachoubou élayv aharon vekol-hannesiim baéda vayedabbér mocheh aléhem
Ouqera lehon mcheh vetabou levatéh aharon vekol rabrebayya biknichta oumallél mcheh immehon:
Veakharé-kén niggechou kol-bené yisraél vayetsavvém ét kol-acher dibber Adonai itto behar sinay
Oubatar kén itqeribou kol bené yisraél oupaqqédinnoun yat kol di mallél Adonai imméh betoura desinay:
Vayekal mocheh middabbér ittam vayyittén al-panayv masveh
Vechétsé mcheh milmallala immehon vihab al appohi bét appé:
Oubebo mocheh lipné Adonai ledabbér itto yasir et-hammasveh ad-tséto veyatsa vedibber el-bené yisraél ét acher yetsuvveh
Vekad alél mcheh loqodam Adonai lemallala imméh adi yat bét appohi ad mippeqéh venapéq oumemallél im bené yisraél yat di mitpaqqad:
Veraou bené-yisraél et-pené mocheh ki qaran or pené mocheh vehéchib mocheh et-hammasveh al-panayv ad-boo ledabbér itto
Vakhazan bené yisraél yat appé mcheh aré segé ziv yeqara deappé mcheh vaatéb mcheh yat bét appé al appohi ad dealél lemallala imméh:
Vayyaqhél mocheh et-kol-adat bené yisraél vayyomer aléhem élleh haddebarim acher-tsivva Adonai laasot otam
Veaknéch mcheh yat kol kenichta dibné yisraél vaamar lehon illén pitgamayya di paqqéd Adonai lemebad yatehon:
Chéchet yamim téaseh melaka oubayyom hachchebii yihyeh lakem qodech chabbat chabbaton la-Adonai kol-haoseh bo melaka youmat
Chitta yomin titabéd ibidta oubeyoma chebiaa yehé lekon qoudecha chabba chabbeta qodam Adonai kol deyabéd béh ibidta yitqetél:
Lo-tebaarou éch bekol mochebotékem beyom hachchabbat
La tebaaroun echchata bekol motebanékon beyoma dechabbeta:
Vayyomer mocheh el-kol-adat bené-yisraél lémor zeh haddabar acher-tsivva Adonai lémor
Vaamar mcheh lekol kenichta dibné yisraél lemémar dén pitgama di paqqéd Adonai lemémar:
Qekhou méittekem terouma la-Adonai kol nedib libbo yebieha ét teroumat Adonai zahab vakesep ounekhochet
Sabou minnekon aprachouta qodam Adonai kol deyitreé libbéh yayté yat aprachouta qodam Adonai dahaba vekaspa ounekhacha:
Outekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch veizzim
Vetikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts oumeazzé:
Veorot élim meoddamim veorot tekhachim vaatsé chittim
Oumachké dedikré mesammeqé oumachké desasgona veaé chittin:
Vechemen lammaor oubesamim lechemen hammichkha veliqtoret hassammim
Oumichkha leanharouta oubousemayya limchakh rebouta veliqtoret bousemayya:
Veabné-choham veabné milluim laépod velakhochen
Veabné bourela veabné achlamouta lechaqqaa beépoda oubekhouchena:
Vekol-khakam-léb bakem yaboou veyaasou ét kol-acher tsivva Adonai
Vekol khakkimé libba bekon yétoun veyaabdoun yat kol di paqqéd Adonai:
Et-hammichkan et-oholo veet-mikséhou et-qerasayv veet-qerachayv et-berikhav et-ammudayv veet-adanayv
Yat machkena yat peraséh veyat khopaéh yat pourepohi veyat dappohi yat abrohi yat ammoudohi veyat samkohi:
Et-haaron veet-baddayv et-hakkapporet veét paroket hammasak
Yat arona veyat arikhohi yat kappurta veyat parukta diprasa:
Et-hachchulkhan veet-baddayv veet-kol-kélayv veét lekhem happanim
Yat patora veyat arikhohi veyat kol manohi veyat lekhém appayya:
Veet-menorat hammaor veet-kéléha veet-nérotéha veét chemen hammaor
Veyat menarta deanhoré veyat manaha veyat botsinaha veyat michkha deanharouta:
Veet-mizbakh haqqetoret veet-baddayv veét chemen hammichkha veét qetoret hassammim veet-masak happetakh lepetakh hammichkan
Veyat madbekha diqtoret bousemayya veyat arikhohi veyat michkha dirbouta veyat qetoret bousemayya veyat perasa detara litra machkena:
ét mizbakh haola veet-mikbar hannekhochet acher-lo et-baddayv veet-kol-kélayv et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Yat madbekha daalata veyat serada dinkhacha diléh yat arikhohi veyat kol manohi yat kiyora veyat besiséh:
ét qalé hekhatsér et-ammudayv veet-adanéha veét masak chaar hekhatsér
Yat seradé darta yat ammoudohi veyat samkaha veyat perasa ditra darta:
Et-yitdot hammichkan veet-yitdot hekhatsér veet-méteréhem
Yat sikké machkena veyat sikké dedarta veyat attounéhon:
Et-bigdé hasserad lecharét baqqodech et-bigdé haqqodech leaharon hakkohén veet-bigdé banayv lekahén
Yat lebouché chimmoucha lechammacha beqoudecha yat lebouché qoudecha leaharon kahana veyat lebouché benohi lechammacha:
Vayyétseou kol-adat bené-yisraél millipné mocheh
Ounepaqou kol kenichta dibné yisraél min qodam mcheh:
Vayyaboou kol-ich acher-nesao libbo vekol acher nadeba roukho oto hébiou et-teroumat Adonai limleket ohel moéd oulekol-abodato oulebigdé haqqodech
Vaato kol gebar deitreé libbéh vekol di achlémat roukhéh yatéh aytiou yat aprachouta qodam Adonai laabidat machkan zimna oulekal pulkhanéh velilbouché qoudecha:
Vayyaboou haanachim al-hannachim kol nedib léb hébiou khakh vanezem vetabbaat vekoumaz kol-keli zahab vekol-ich acher hénip tenoupat zahab la-Adonai
Oumaytan gubrayya al nechayya kol deitreé libbéh aytiou chérin vechibkin veizqan oumakhouk kol man didhab vekol gebar di arém aramout dahaba qodam Adonai:
Vekol-ich acher-nimtsa itto tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch veizzim veorot élim meoddamim veorot tekhachim hébiou
Vekol gebar deichtekakh imméh tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts oumeazzé oumachké dedikré mesammeqé oumachké sasgona aytiou:
Kol-mérim teroumat kesep ounekhochet hébiou ét teroumat Adonai vekol acher nimtsa itto atsé chittim lekol-meleket haaboda hébiou
Kol daarém aramout kesap ounekhach aytiou yat aprachouta qodam Adonai vekol di ichtekakh imméh aé chittin lekol ibidat pulkhana aytiou:
Vekol-ichcha khakmat-léb beyadéha tavou vayyabiou matveh et-hattekélet veet-haargaman et-tolaat hachchani veet-hachchéch
Vekol itteta khakkimat libba bidaha meazzela oumaytan kad azél yat tikla veyat argevana yat tseba zehori veyat boutsa:
Vekol-hannachim acher nasa libban otana bekhokma tavou et-haizzim
Vekol nechayya deitreé libbehen immehen bekhokma azzelan yat méazya:
Vehannesiim hébiou ét abné hachchoham veét abné hammilluim laépod velakhochen
Verabrebayya aytiou yat abné bourela veyat abné achlamouta lechaqqaa beépoda oubekhouchena:
Veet-habbosem veet-hachchamen lemaor oulechemen hammichkha veliqtoret hassammim
Veyat bousema veyat michkha leanharouta oulemichkha dirbouta veliqtoret bousemayya:
Kol-ich veichcha acher nadab libbam otam lehabi lekol-hammelaka acher tsivva Adonai laasot beyad-mocheh hébiou bené-yisraél nedaba la-Adonai
Kol gebar veitteta deitreé libbehon immehon leaytaa lekol ibidta di paqqéd Adonai lemebad bida demcheh aytiou bené yisraél nedabta qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer mocheh el-bené yisraél reou qara Adonai bechém betsalél ben-vri ben-khvr lemattéh yehouda
Vaamar mcheh libné yisraél khazo derabbi Adonai bechoum betsalél bar ouri bar khour lechibta dihouda:
Vayemallé oto rouakh élohim bekhokma bitbouna oubedaat oubekol-melaka
Veachlém imméh rouakh neboua min qodam Adonai bekhokmeta besoukeletanou oubemadda oubekol ibida:
Velakhchob makhachabot laasot bazzahab oubakkesep oubannekhochet
Ouleallapa oumanvan lemebad bedahaba oubekaspa oubinkhacha:
Oubakharochet eben lemallot oubakharochet éts laasot bekol-meleket makhachabet
Oubeoumanout eben taba leachlama oubenaggarout aa lemebad bekol ibidat oumanvan:
Oulehorot natan belibbo hou veoholiab ben-akhisamak lemattéh-dan
Ouleallapa yehab belibbéh hou veoholiab bar akhisamak lechibta dedan:
Millé otam khokmat-léb laasot kol-meleket kharach vekhochéb veroqém battekélet oubaargaman betolaat hachchani oubachchéch veorég osé kol-melaka vekhochebé makhachabot
Achlém immehon khakkimout libba lemebad kol ibidat naggar veamman vetsayyar betikla oubeargevana bitsba zehori oubeboutsa oumakhé abedé kol ibida oumalpé oumanvan:
Veasa betsalél veoholiab vekol ich khakam-léb acher natan Adonai khokma outebouna bahémma ladaat laasot et-kol-meleket abodat haqqodech lekol acher-tsivva Adonai
Vaabad betsalél veoholiab vekol gebar khakkim libba dihab Adonai khokma vesoukeletanouta behon lemidda lemebad yat kol ibidat palekhan qoudecha lekol di paqqéd Adonai:
Vayyiqra mocheh el-betsalél veel-oholiab veel kol-ich khakam-léb acher natan Adonai khokma belibbo kol acher nesao libbo leqorba el-hammelaka laasot otah
Ouqera mcheh libtsalél ouleoholiab oulekal gebar khakkim libba dihab Adonai khokmeta belibbéh kol deitreé libbéh lemiqrab leibidta lemebad yatéh:
Vayyiqkhou millipné mocheh ét kol-hatterouma acher hébiou bené yisraél limleket abodat haqqodech laasot otah vehém hébiou élayv od nedaba babboqer babboqer
Ounesibou min qodam mcheh yat kol aprachouta di aytiou bené yisraél leibidat palekhan qoudecha lemebad yatah veinnoun maytan léh od nedabta bitspar bitspar:
Vayyaboou kol-hakhakamim haosim ét kol-meleket haqqodech ich-ich mimmelakto acher-hémma osim
Vaato kol khakkimayya deabedin yat kol ibidat qoudecha gebar gebar méibidtéh deinnoun abedin:
Vayyomerou el-mocheh lémor marbim haam lehabi middé haaboda lammelaka acher-tsivva Adonai laasot otah
Vaamarou lemcheh lemémar masgan amma leaytaa missat palekhana leibidta depaqqéd Adonai lemebad yatah:
Vayetsav mocheh vayyaabirou qol bammakhaneh lémor ich veichcha al-yaasou-od melaka litroumat haqqodech vayyikkalé haam méhabi
Oupaqqéd mcheh veaabarou karoza bemachrita lemémar gebar veitteta la yaabdoun od ibidta leaprachout qoudecha oupesaq amma milleaytaa:
Vehammelaka hayeta dayyam lekol-hammelaka laasot otah vehotér
Veibidta havat missat lekol ibidta lemebad yatah vitarat:
Vayyaasou kol-khakam-léb beosé hammelaka et-hammichkan eser yeriot chéch mochzar outekélet veargaman vetolaat chani kerubim maaséh khochéb asa otam
Vaabadou kol khakkimé libba beabedé ibidta yat machkena asar yerian debouts chezir vetikla veargevana outseba zehori tsourat keroubin obad amman abad yatehon:
Orek hayeria haakhat chemoneh veesrim baamma verokhab arba baamma hayeria haekhat midda akhat lekol-hayeriot
Urka diriata khada asrin outemanya ammin oupouteya arba ammin diriata khada mechakhta khada lekol yeriata:
Vayekhabbér et-khaméch hayeriot akhat el-ekhat vekhaméch yeriot khibbar akhat el-ekhat
Velapép yat khaméch yerian khada im khada vekhaméch yerian lapép khada im khada:
Vayyaas luleot tekélet al sepat hayeria haekhat miqqatsa bammakhbaret kén asa bispat hayeria haqqitsona bammakhberet hachchénit
Vaabad anoubin detikla al sipta diriata khada missitra bét lopé kén abad besipta diriata besitra bét lopé tinyéta:
Khamichchim lulaot asa bayria haekhat vakhamichchim lulaot asa biqtséh hayeria acher bammakhberet hachchénit maqbilot halloulaot akhat el-ekhat
Khamchin anoubin abad biriata khada vekhamchin anoubin abad besitra diriata debét lopé tinyéta mekavvenan anoubayya khada loqobél khada:
Vayyaas khamichchim qarsé zahab vayekhabbér et-hayeriot akhat el-akhat baqqerasim vayehi hammichkan ekhad
Vaabad khamchin pourepin didhab velapép yat yeriata khada im khada bepourepayya vahava machkena khad:
Vayyaas yeriot izzim leohel al-hammichkan achté-esréh yeriot asa otam
Vaabad yerian dimazzé liprasa al machkena khad asar yerian abad yatehen:
Orek hayeria haakhat chelochim baamma vearba ammot rokhab hayeria haekhat midda akhat leachté esréh yeriot
Urka diriata khada telatin beammin vearba ammin pouteya diriata khada mechakhta khada lekhad asar yerian:
Vayekhabbér et-khaméch hayeriot lebad veet-chéch hayeriot lebad
Velapép yat khaméch yerian lekhod veyat chét yerian lekhod:
Vayyaas lulaot khamichchim al sepat hayeria haqqitsona bammakhbaret vakhamichchim lulaot asa al-sepat hayeria hakhoberet hachchénit
Vaabad anoubin khamchin al sipta diriata besitra bét lopé vekhamchin anoubin abad al sipta diriata debét lopé tinyéta:
Vayyaas qarsé nekhochet khamichchim lekhabbér et-haohel lihyot ekhad
Vaabad pourepin dinkhacha khamchin lelappapa yat machkena leméhévé khad:
Vayyaas mikseh laohel orot élim meoddamim oumikséh orot tekhachim milmaela
Vaabad khopaa lemachkena machké dedikré mesammeqé vekhopaa machké desasgona milleélla:
Vayyaas et-haqqerachim lammichkan atsé chittim omedim
Vaabad yat dappayya lemachkena deaé chittin qayemin:
Eser ammot orek haqqarech veamma vakhatsi haamma rokhab haqqerech haekhad
Asar ammin urka dedappa veammeta oupalgout ammeta pouteya dedappa khad:
Cheté yadot laqqerech haekhad mechoullabot akhat el-ekhat kén asa lekol qarché hammichkan
Tartén tsirin ledappa khad mechallebin khada loqobél khada kén abad lekol dappé machkena:
Vayyaas et-haqqerachim lammichkan esrim qerachim lipat negeb témana
Vaabad yat dappayya lemachkena esrin dappin lerouakh ébar daroma:
Vearbaim adné-kesep asa takhat esrim haqqerachim chené adanim takhat-haqqerech haekhad lichté yedotayv ouchené adanim takhat-haqqerech haekhad lichté yedotayv
Vearbein samkin diksap abad tekhot esrin dappin terén samkin tekhot dappa khad litrén tsirohi outerén samkin tekhot dappa khad litrén tsirohi:
Ouletsela hammichkan hachchénit lipat tsapon asa esrim qerachim
Velistar machkena tinyéta lerouakh tsippouna abad esrin dappin:
Vearbaim adnéhem kasep chené adanim takhat haqqerech haekhad ouchené adanim takhat haqqerech haekhad
Vearbein samkéhon diksap terén samkin tekhot dappa khad outerén samkin tekhot dappa khad:
Ouleyarketé hammichkan yamma asa chichcha qerachim
Velisyapé machkena maarba abad chitta dappin:
Ouchené qerachim asa limqutsot hammichkan bayyarkatayim
Outerén dappin abad lezaveyat machkena besopéhon:
Vehayou toamim millematta veyakhdav yihyou tammim el-rocho el-hattabbaat haekhat kén asa lichnéhem lichné hammiqtsoot
Vahavo mekavvenin millera vekakhada havo mekavvenin al réchéh leizqata khada kén abad letarvéhon litrén zaveyan:
Vehayou chemona qerachim veadnéhem kesep chichcha asar adanim chené adanim chené adanim takhat haqqerech haekhad
Vahavo temanya dappin vesamkéhon diksap chitta asar samkin terén samkin terén samkin tekhot dappa khad:
Vayyaas berikhé atsé chittim khamichcha leqarché tsela-hammichkan haekhat
Vaabad abberé deaé chittin khamcha ledappé setar machkena khad:
Vakhamichcha berikhim leqarché tsela-hammichkan hachchénit vakhamichcha berikhim leqarché hammichkan layyarkatayim yamma
Vekhamcha abberin ledappé setar machkena tinyéta vekhamcha abberin ledappé machkena lesopéhon maarba:
Vayyaas et-habberiakh hattikon libroakh betok haqqerachim min-haqqatseh el-haqqatseh
Vaabad yat abbera metsiaa leabara bego dappayya min seyapé lisyapé:
Veet-haqqerachim tsippa zahab veet-tabbeotam asa zahab battim labberikhim vayetsap et-habberikhim zahab
Veyat dappayya khapa dahaba veyat izqatehon abad dahaba atra leabberayya vakhapa yat abberayya dahaba:
Vayyaas et-happaroket tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar maaséh khochéb asa otah kerubim
Vaabad yat parukta tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir obad amman abad yatah tsourat keroubin:
Vayyaas lah arbaa ammoudé chittim vayetsappém zahab vavéhem zahab vayyitsoq lahem arbaa adné-kasep
Vaabad léh arbea ammoudé chittin vakhapanoun dahaba vavéhon dahaba veattik lehon arbea samkin diksap:
Vayyaas masak lepetakh haohel tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar maaséh roqém
Vaabad perasa litra machkena tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir obad tsayyar:
Veet-ammoudayv khamichcha veet-vavéhem vetsippa rachéhem vakhachuqéhem zahab veadnéhem khamichcha nekhochet
Veyat ammoudohi khamcha veyat vavéhon vakhapa réchéhon vekibbouchéhon dahaba vesamkéhon khamcha nekhacha:
Vayyaas betsalél et-haaron atsé chittim ammatayim vakhétsi orko veamma vakhétsi rokhbo veamma vakhétsi qomato
Vaabad betsalél yat arona deaé chittin tartén ammin oupalga urkéh veammeta oupalga petayéh veamta oupalga rouméh:
Vayetsappéhou zahab tahor mibbayit oumikhouts vayyaas lo zér zahab sabib
Vakhapahi dehab deké miggav oumibbara vaabad léh dér didhab sekhor sekhor:
Vayyitsoq lo arba tabbeot zahab al arba paamotayv oucheté tabbaot al-tsalo haekhat oucheté tabbaot al-tsalo hachchénit
Veattik léh arba izqan didhab al arba zivyatéh vetartén izqan al sitréh khad vetartén izqan al sitréh tinyéta:
Vayyaas baddé atsé chittim vayetsap otam zahab
Vaabad arikhé deaé chittin vakhapa yatehon dahaba:
Vayyabé et-habbaddim battabbaot al tsalot haaron lasét et-haaron
Veaél yat arikhayya beizqata al sitré arona lemittal yat arona:
Vayyaas kapporet zahab tahor ammatayim vakhétsi orkah veamma vakhétsi rokhbah
Vaabad kappurta dehab deké tartén ammin oupalga urkah veammeta oupalga petayah:
Vayyaas chené kerubim zahab miqcha asa otam michchené qetsot hakkapporet
Vaabad terén keroubin didhab negid abad yatehon mitterén sitré kappurta:
Keroub-ekhad miqqatsa mizzeh oukeroub-ekhad miqqatsa mizzeh min-hakkapporet asa et-hakkerubim michchené qetsotayv
Kerouba khad missitra mikka oukerouba khad missitra mikka min kappurta abad yat keroubayya mitterén sitrohi:
Vayyihyou hakkerubim poresé kenapayim lemala sokekim bekanpéhem al-hakkapporet oupenéhem ich el-akhiv el-hakkapporet hayou pené hakkerubim
Vahavo keroubayya perisan gadpéhon leélla natelin begadpéhon al kappurta veappéhon khad loqobél khad loqobél kappurta havo appé keroubayya:
Vayyaas et-hachchulkhan atsé chittim ammatayim orko veamma rokhbo veamma vakhétsi qomato
Vaabad yat patora deaé chittin tartén ammin urkéh veammeta petayéh veammeta oupalga rouméh:
Vayetsap oto zahab tahor vayyaas lo zér zahab sabib
Vakhapa yatéh dehab deké vaabad léh dér didhab sekhor sekhor:
Vayyaas lo misgeret topakh sabib vayyaas zér-zahab lemisgarto sabib
Vaabad léh gedanpa rouméh poucheka sekhor sekhor vaabad dér didhab ligdanpéh sekhor sekhor:
Vayyitsoq lo arba tabbeot zahab vayyittén et-hattabbaot al arba happéot acher learba raglayv
Veattik léh arba izqan didhab vihab yat izqata al arba zivyata di learba raglohi:
Leummat hammisgeret hayou hattabbaot battim labbaddim lasét et-hachchulkhan
Loqobél gedanpa havo izqata atra laarikhayya lemittal yat patora:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atsé chittim vayetsap otam zahab lasét et-hachchulkhan
Vaabad yat arikhayya deaé chittin vakhapa yatehon dahaba lemittal yat patora:
Vayyaas et-hakkélim acher al-hachchulkhan et-qearotayv veet-kappotayv veét menaqqiyyotayv veet-haqqesavot acher yussak bahén zahab tahor
Vaabad yat manayya di al patora yat magisohi veyat bazikohi veyat mekilatéh veyat qasvata di yitnassak behon dehab deké:
Vayyaas et-hammenora zahab tahor miqcha asa et-hammenora yerékah veqanah gebiéha kaptoréha ouperakhéha mimmenna hayou
Vaabad yat menarta dehab deké negid abad yat menarta chidah ouqenah kalidaha khézouraha vechochannaha minnah havo:
Vechichcha qanim yotseim mitstsiddéha chelocha qené menora mitstsiddah haekhad ouchelocha qené menora mitstsiddah hachchéni
Vechitta qenin napeqin missitraha telata qené menarta missitrah khad outelata qené menarta missitrah tinyana:
Chelocha gebiim mechuqqadim baqqaneh haekhad kaptor vaperakh ouchelocha gebiim mechuqqadim beqaneh ekhad kaptor vaparakh kén lechéchet haqqanim hayyotseim min-hammenora
Telata kallidin metsayyerin beqanya khad khézour vechochan outelata kallidin metsayyerin beqanya khad khézour vechochan kén lechitta qenin denapeqin min menarta:
Oubammenora arbaa gebiim mechouqqadim kaptoréha ouperakhéha
Oubimnarta arbea kallidin metsayyerin khézzouraha vechochannaha:
Vekaptor takhat chené haqqanim mimmenna vekaptor takhat chené haqqanim mimmenna vekaptor takhat-chené haqqanim mimmenna lechéchet haqqanim hayyotseim mimmenna
Vekhézour tekhot terén qenin minnah vekhézour tekhot terén qenin minnah vekhézour tekhot terén qenin minnah lechitta qenin denapeqin minnah:
Kaptoréhem ouqenotam mimmenna hayou kullah miqcha akhat zahab tahor
Khézouréhon ouqenéhon minnah havo kulah negida khada dehab deké:
Vayyaas et-nérotéha chiba oumalqakhéha oumakhtotéha zahab tahor
Vaabad yat botsinaha chiba vetsibyetaha oumakhitteyetaha dehab deké:
Kikkar zahab tahor asa otah veét kol-kéléha
Kikkera dehab deké abad yatah veyat kol manaha:
Vayyaas et-mizbakh haqqetoret atsé chittim amma orko veamma rokhbo raboua veammatayim qomato mimmennou hayou qarnotayv
Vaabad yat madbekha diqtoret bousemayya deaé chittin ammeta urkéh veammeta petayéh merabba vetartén ammin rouméh minnéh havo qarnohi:
Vayetsap oto zahab tahor et-gaggo veet-qirotayv sabib veet-qarnotayv vayyaas lo zér zahab sabib
Vakhapa yatéh dehab deké yat iggaréh veyat katelohi sekhor sekhor veyat qarnohi vaabad léh dér didhab sekhor sekhor:
Oucheté tabbeot zahab asa-lo mittakhat lezéro al cheté tsalotayv al chené tsiddayv lebattim lebaddim lasét oto bahem
Vetartén izqan didhab abad léh millera ledéréh al tartén zivyatéh al terén sitrohi leatra laarikhayya lemittal yatéh behon:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atsé chittim vayetsap otam zahab
Vaabad yat arikhayya deaé chittin vakhapa yatehon dahaba:
Vayyaas et-chemen hammichkha qodech veet-qetoret hassammim tahor maaséh roqéakh
Vaabad yat michkha dirbouta qoudecha veyat qetoret bousemayya deké obad bousemanou:
Vayyaas et-mizbakh haola atsé chittim khaméch ammot orko vekhaméch-ammot rokhbo raboua vechaloch ammot qomato
Vaabad yat madbekha daalata deaé chittin khaméch ammin urkéh vakhaméch ammin petayéh merabba outelata ammin rouméh:
Vayyaas qarnotayv al arba pinnotayv mimmennou hayou qarnotayv vayetsap oto nekhochet
Vaabad qarnohi al arba zivyatéh minnéh havo qarnohi vakhapa yatéh nekhacha:
Vayyaas et-kol-kelé hammizbéakh et-hassirot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizraqot et-hammizlagot veet-hammakhtot kol-kélayv asa nekhochet
Vaabad yat kol mané madbekha yat pesaktéravata veyat magropeyata veyat mizreqata yat tsinnoureyata veyat makhteyata kol manohi abad nekhacha:
Vayyaas lammizbéakh mikbar maaséh rechet nekhochet takhat karkubbo millematta ad-khetsyo
Vaabad lemadbekha serada obad metsadta dinkhacha tekhot sobabéh millera ad palgéh:
Vayyitsoq arba tabbaot bearba haqqetsavot lemikbar hannekhochet battim labbaddim
Veattik arba izqata bearba sitrata lisrada dinkhacha atra laarikhayya:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atsé chittim vayetsap otam nekhochet
Vaabad yat arikhayya deaé chittin vakhapa yatehon nekhacha:
Vayyabé et-habbaddim battabbaot al tsalot hammizbéakh lasét oto bahem neboub lukhot asa oto
Veaél yat arikhayya beizqata al sitré madbekha lemittal yatéh behon khalil loukhin abad yatéh:
Vayyaas ét hakkiyyor nekhochet veét kanno nekhochet bemarot hatstsobeot acher tsabeou petakh ohel moéd
Vaabad yat kiyora nekhacha veyat besiséh nekhacha bemekhzeyan nechayya deateyan letsallaa bitra machkan zimna:
Vayyaas et-hekhatsér lipat negeb témana qalé hekhatsér chéch mochzar méa baamma
Vaabad yat darta lerouakh ébar daroma seradé darta debouts chezir mea beammin:
Ammoudéhem esrim veadnéhem esrim nekhochet vavé haammoudim vakhachuqéhem kasep
Ammoudéhon esrin vesamkéhon esrin nekhacha vavé ammoudayya vekibbouchéhon kesap:
Velipat tsapon méa baamma ammoudéhem esrim veadnéhem esrim nekhochet vavé haammoudim vakhachuqéhem kasep
Oulerouakh tsippouna mea ammin ammoudéhon esrin vesamkéhon esrin nekhacha vavé ammoudayya vekibbouchéhon diksap:
Velipat-yam qelaim khamichchim baamma ammoudéhem asara veadnéhem asara vavé haammudim vakhachouqéhem kasep
Oulerouakh maarba seradin khamchin beammin ammoudéhon asra vesamkéhon asra vavé ammoudayya vekibbouchéhon diksap:
Velipat qédema mizrakha khamichchim amma
Oulerouakh qiddouma madinekha khamchin ammin:
Qelaim khaméch-esréh amma el-hakkatép ammoudéhem chelocha veadnéhem chelocha
Seradin khaméch esré ammin leibra ammoudéhon telata vesamkéhon telata:
Velakkatép hachchénit mizzeh oumizzeh lechaar hekhatsér qelaim khaméch esréh amma ammudéhem chelocha veadnéhem chelocha
Ouleibra tinyéta mikka oumikka litra darta seradin khaméch esré ammin ammoudéhon telata vesamkéhon telata
Kol-qalé hekhatsér sabib chéch mochzar
Kol seradé dedarta sekhor sekhor debouts chezir:
Vehaadanim laammudim nekhochet vavé haammoudim vakhachouqéhem kesep vetsippouy rachéhem kasep vehém mekhuchchaqim kesep kol ammudé hekhatsér
Vesamkayya leammoudayya nekhacha vavé ammoudayya vekibbouchéhon diksap vekhippouy réchéhon diksap veinnoun mekabbechin diksap kol ammoudé darta:
Oumasak chaar hekhatsér maaséh roqém tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar veesrim amma orek veqoma berokhab khaméch ammot leummat qalé hekhatsér
Ouperasa ditra darta obad tsayyar tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir veesrin ammin urka verouma bepouteya khaméch ammin loqobél seradé darta:
Veammudéhem arbaa veadnéhem arbaa nekhochet vavéhem kesep vetsippouy rachéhem vakhachuqéhem kasep
Veammoudéhon arbea vesamkéhon arbea nekhacha vavéhon diksap vekhippouy réchéhon vekibbouchéhon diksap:
Vekol-hayetédot lammichkan velekhatsér sabib nekhochet
Vekol sikkayya lemachkena ouledarta sekhor sekhor dinkhacha:
élleh peqoudé hammichkan michkan haédout acher puqqad al-pi mocheh abodat haleviyyim beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohén
Illén minyané machkena machkena desahadouta di itmené al mémera demcheh palekhan lévaé bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Oubetsalél ben-vri ben-khvr lemattéh yehouda asa ét kol-acher-tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Oubetsalél bar ouri bar khour lechibta dihouda abad yat kol di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Veitto oholiab ben-akhisamak lemattéh-dan kharach vekhochéb veroqém battekélet oubaargaman oubetolaat hachchani oubachchéch
Veimméh oholiab bar akhisamak lechibta dedan naggar veomman vetsayyar betikla oubeargevana oubitsba zehori oubeboutsa:
Kol-hazzahab heasouy lammelaka bekol meleket haqqodech vayehi zehab hattenoupa técha veesrim kikkar oucheba méot ouchelochim cheqel becheqel haqqodech
Kol dahaba deitabéd leibida bekol ibidat qoudecha vahava dehab aramouta esrin outecha kikkerin oucheba mea outelatin silin besilé qoudecha:
Vekesep peqoudé haéda meat kikkar veelep oucheba méot vakhamichcha vechibim cheqel becheqel haqqodech
Oukesap minyané kenichta mea kikkerin veelep oucheba mea vechibin vekhamcha silin besilé qoudecha:
Beqa laggulgolet makhatsit hachcheqel becheqel haqqodech lekol haobér al-happequdim mibben esrim chana vamala lechéch-méot elep ouchelochet alapim vakhaméch méot vakhamichchim
Tiqla legulgalta palgout sila besilé qoudecha lekol deabar al minyanayya mibbar esrin chenin ouleélla lechét mea outelata alpin vakhaméch mea vekhamchin:
Vayehi meat kikkar hakkesep latseqet ét adné haqqodech veét adné happaroket meat adanim limat hakkikkar kikkar laaden
Vahava mea kikkerin diksap leattaka yat samké qoudecha veyat samké deparukta mea samkin lima kikkerin kikkera lesamka:
Veet-haelep oucheba hamméot vakhamichcha vechibim asa vavim laammoudim vetsippa rachéhem vekhichchaq otam
Veyat alpa oucheba mea vechibin vekhamcha abad vavin leammoudayya vekhippa réchéhon vekabbéch yatehon:
Ounekhochet hattenoupa chibim kikkar vealpayim vearba-méot chaqel
Ounekhacha daaramouta chibin kikkerin outerén alpin vearba mea silin:
Vayyaas bah et-adné petakh ohel moéd veét mizbakh hannekhochet veet-mikbar hannekhochet acher-lo veét kol-kelé hammizbéakh
Vaabad bah yat samké tera machkan zimna veyat madbekha dinkhacha veyat serada dinkhacha di léh veyat kol mané madbekha:
Veet-adné hekhatsér sabib veet-adné chaar hekhatsér veét kol-yitdot hammichkan veet-kol-yitdot hekhatsér sabib
Veyat samké dedarta sekhor sekhor veyat samké tera darta veyat kol sikké machkena veyat kol sikké darta sekhor sekhor:
Oumin-hattekélet vehaargaman vetolaat hachchani asou bigdé-serad lecharét baqqodech vayyaasou et-bigdé haqqodech acher leaharon kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Oumin tikla veargevana outseba zehori abadou lebouché chimmoucha lechammacha beqoudecha vaabadou yat lebouché qoudecha di leaharon kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaas et-haépod zahab tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar
Vaabad yat époda dahaba tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir:
Vayeraqqeou et-pakhé hazzahab veqitstséts petilim laasot betok hattekélet oubetok haargaman oubetok tolaat hachchani oubetok hachchéch maaséh khochéb
Veraddidou yat tassé dahaba veqatstsitsou khoutin lemebad bego tikla oubego argevana oubego tseba zehori oubego boutsa obad amman:
Ketépot asou-lo khoberot al-chené qetsotayv khubbar
Katpan abadou léh melappepan al terén sitrohi yitlapép:
Vekhécheb apuddato acher alayv mimmennou hou kemaaséhou zahab tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Vehemyan tiqqounéh di alohi minnéh hou keobadohi dahaba tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaasou et-abné hachchoham musabbot michbetsot zahab meputtakhot pittoukhé khotam al-chemot bené yisraél
Vaabadou yat abné bourela mechaqqean merammetsan didhab gelipan ketab meparach al chemahat bené yisraél:
Vayyasem otam al kitpot haépod abné zikkaron libné yisraél kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Vechavvi yatehon al kitpa deépoda abné doukerana libné yisraél kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaas et-hakhochen maaséh khochéb kemaaséh épod zahab tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani vechéch mochzar
Vaabad yat khouchena obad amman keobadé époda dahaba tikla veargevana outseba zehori oubouts chezir:
Raboua haya kapoul asou et-hakhochen zeret orko vezeret rokhbo kapoul
Merabba hava ép abadou yat khouchena zerta urkéh vezerta petayéh ép:
Vayemalou-bo arbaa touré aben tour odem pitda oubareqet hattour haekhad
Veachlimou béh arbea sidré eben taba sidra qadmaa samqan yarqan oubarqan sidra khad:
Vehattour hachchéni nopek sappir veyahalom
Vesidra tinyana izmaragdin chabzéz vesabhalom:
Vehattour hachchelichi lechem chebo veakhlama
Vesidra telitaa qankéré tarqeya veén egla:
Vehattour harebii tarchich choham veyachepéh mousabbot michbetsot zahab bemilluotam
Vesidra rebiaa keroum yamma oubourela oupanteré mechaqqean merammetsan didhab beachlamoutehon:
Vehaabanim al-chemot bené-yisraél hénna chetém esréh al-chemotam pittoukhé khotam ich al-chemo lichném asar chabet
Veabnayya al chemahat bené yisraél innin tarté esré al chemahatehon ketab meparach kiglop deizqa gebar al cheméh litrén asar chibtin:
Vayyaasou al-hakhochen charcherot gablout maaséh abot zahab tahor
Vaabadou al khouchena tikkin metakhman obad gedilou dehab deké:
Vayyaasou cheté michbetsot zahab oucheté tabbeot zahab vayyittenou et-cheté hattabbaot al-chené qetsot hakhochen
Vaabadou tartén merammetsan didhab vetartén izqan didhab vihabou yat tartén izqata al terén sitré khouchena:
Vayyittenou cheté haabotot hazzahab al-cheté hattabbaot al-qetsot hakhochen
Vihabou tartén gedilata didhab al tartén izqata al sitré khouchena:
Veét cheté qetsot cheté haabotot natenou al-cheté hammichbetsot vayyittenoum al-kitpot haépod el-mvl panayv
Veyat tartén gedilan dial tartén sitrohi yehabou al tartén merammetsata vihabunnoun al katpé époda loqobél appohi:
Vayyaasou cheté tabbeot zahab vayyasimou al-chené qetsot hakhochen al-sepato acher el-éber haépod bayeta
Vaabadou tartén izqan didhab vechavviou al terén sitré khouchena al siptéh di leibra deépoda millegayv:
Vayyaasou cheté tabbeot zahab vayyittenoum al-cheté kitpot haépod millematta mimmoul panayv leummat makhbarto mimmaal lekhécheb haépod
Vaabadou tartén izqan didhab vihabunnoun al tartén kitpé époda millera milloqobél appohi loqobél bét lopé méillavé lehemyan époda:
Vayyirkesou et-hakhochen mittabbeotayv el-tabbeot haépod biptil tekélet liheyot al-khécheb haépod velo-yizzakh hakhochen méal haépod kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veyakhadoun yat khouchena meizqatéh leizqeta deépoda bekhouta ditkelta leméhevé al hemyan époda vela yitparéq khouchena méillavé époda kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaas et-meil haépod maaséh orég kelil tekélet
Vaabad yat meila deépoda obad makhé gemir tikla:
Oupi-hammeil betoko kepi takhra sapa lepiv sabib lo yiqqaréa
Oupoum meila kapil legavvéh kepoum chiryan tora maqqap lepouméh sekhor sekhor la yitbeza:
Vayyaasou al-chvlé hammeil rimmoné tekélet veargaman vetolaat chani mochzar
Vaabadou al chippolé meila rimmoné tikla veargevana outseba zehori chezir:
Vayyaasou paamoné zahab tahor vayyittenou et-happaamonim betok harimmonim al-chvlé hammeil sabib betok harimmonim
Vaabadou zaggayya dehab deké vihabou yat zaggayya bego rimmonayya al chippolé meila sekhor sekhor bego rimmonayya:
Paamon verimmon paamon verimmon al-chvlé hammeil sabib lecharét kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Zagga verimmona zagga verimmona al chippolé meila sekhor sekhor lechammacha kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaasou et-hakkotnot chéch maaséh orég leaharon oulebanayv
Vaabadou yat kittounin deboutsa obad makhé leaharon velibnohi:
Veét hammitsnepet chéch veet-paaré hammigbaot chéch veet-miknesé habbad chéch mochzar
Veyat mitsnepta deboutsa veyat chebakh kobaayya deboutsa veyat miknesé boutsa debouts chezir:
Veet-haabnét chéch mochzar outekélet veargaman vetolaat chani maaséh roqém kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veyat hemyana debouts chezir vetikla veargevana outseba zehori obad tsayyar kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaasou et-tsits nézer-haqqodech zahab tahor vayyiktebou alayv miktab pittoukhé khotam qodech la-Adonai
Vaabadou yat tsitsa kelila deqoudecha dehab deké ouketabou alohi gelipan ketab meparach qodech layya:
Vayyittenou alayv petil tekélet latét al-hammitsnepet milmaela kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Vihabou alohi khouta tekelta lemittan al mitsnepta milleélla kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vattékel kol-abodat michkan ohel moéd vayyaasou bené yisraél kekol acher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh kén asou
Ouchelim kol palekhan machkena machkan zimna vaabadou bené yisraél kekol di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh kén abadou:
Vayyabiou et-hammichkan el-mocheh et-haohel veet-kol-kélayv qerasayv qerachayv berikhav veammudayv vaadanayv
Veaytiou yat machkena lemcheh yat machkena veyat kol manohi pourepohi dappohi abberohi veammoudohi vesammekohi:
Veet-mikséh orot haélim hameoddamim veet-mikséh orot hattekhachim veét paroket hammasak
Veyat khopaa machké dedikré mesammeqé veyat khopaa machké desasgona veyat parukta diprasa:
Et-aron haédout veet-baddayv veét hakkapporet
Yat arona desahadouta veyat arikhohi veyat kapurta:
Et-hachchulkhan et-kol-kélayv veét lekhem happanim
Yat patora yat kol manohi veyat lekhém appayya:
Et-hammenora hattehora et-nérotéha nérot hammaaraka veet-kol-kéléha veét chemen hammaor
Yat menarta dakita yat botsinaha botsiné sidra veyat kol manaha veyat michkha deanharouta:
Veét mizbakh hazzahab veét chemen hammichkha veét qetoret hassammim veét masak petakh haohel
Veyat madbekha dedahaba veyat michkha dirbouta veyat qetoret bousemayya veyat perasa ditra machkena:
ét mizbakh hannekhochet veet-mikbar hannekhochet acher-lo et-baddayv veet-kol-kélayv et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Yat madbekha dinkhacha veyat serada dinkhacha diléh yat arikhohi veyat kol manohi yat kiyyora veyat besiséh:
ét qalé hekhatsér et-ammudéha veet-adanéha veet-hammasak lechaar hekhatsér et-métarayv vitédotéha veét kol-kelé abodat hammichkan leohel moéd
Yat seradé dedarta yat ammoudaha veyat sammekaha veyat perasa litra darta yat atounohi vesikkaha veyat kol mané palekhan machkena lemachkan zimna:
Et-bigdé hasserad lecharét baqqodech et-bigdé haqqodech leaharon hakkohén veet-bigdé banayv lekahén
Yat lebouché chimmoucha lechammacha beqoudecha yat lebouché qoudecha leaharon kahana veyat lebouché benohi lechammacha:
Kekol acher-tsivva Adonai et-mocheh kén asou bené yisraél ét kol-haaboda
Kekol di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh kén abadou bené yisraél yat kol palekhana:
Vayyar mocheh et-kol-hammelaka vehinnéh asou otah kaacher tsivva Adonai kén asou vayebarek otam mocheh
Vakhaza mcheh yat kol ibidta veha abadou yatah kema di paqqid Adonai kén abadou oubarik yatehon mcheh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Beyom-hakhodech harichon beekhad lakhodech taqim et-michkan ohel moéd
Beyoma yarkha qadmaa bekhad leyarkha teqim yat machkena machkan zimna:
Vesamta cham ét aron haédout vesakkota al-haaron et-happaroket
Outechavvi tamman yat arona desahadouta vetattél al arona yat parukta:
Vehébéta et-hachchulkhan vearakta et-erko vehébéta et-hammenora vehaaléta et-nérotéha
Vetaél yat patora vetasdar yat sidréh vetaél yat menarta vetadléq yat botsinaha:
Venatatta et-mizbakh hazzahab liqtoret lipné aron haédout vesamta et-masak happetakh lammichkan
Vetittén yat madbekha dedahaba liqtoret bousemayya qodam arona desahadouta outechavvi yat perasa detara lemachkena:
Venatatta ét mizbakh haola lipné petakh michkan ohel-moéd
Vetittén yat madbekha daalata qodam tera machkena machkan zimna:
Venatatta et-hakkiyyor bén-ohel moéd oubén hammizbéakh venatatta cham mayim
Vetittén yat kiyyora bén machkan zimna oubén madbekha vetittén tamman mayya:
Vesamta et-hekhatsér sabib venatatta et-masak chaar hekhatsér
Outechavvé yat darta sekhor sekhor vetittén yat perasa ditra darta:
Velaqakhta et-chemen hammichkha oumachakhta et-hammichkan veet-kol-acher-bo veqiddachta oto veet-kol-kélayv vehaya qodech
Vetissab yat michkha dirbouta outerabbé yat machkena veyat kol di béh outeqaddéch yatéh veyat kol manohi vihé qoudecha:
Oumachakhta et-mizbakh haola veet-kol-kélayv veqiddachta et-hammizbéakh vehaya hammizbéakh qodech qodachim
Outerabbé yat madbekha daalata veyat kol manohi outeqaddéch yat madbekha vihé madbekha qodech qoudechin:
Oumachakhta et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno veqiddachta oto
Outerabbé yat kiyyora veyat besiséh outeqaddéch yatéh:
Vehiqrabta et-aharon veet-banayv el-petakh ohel moéd verakhatsta otam bammayim
Outeqaréb yat aharon veyat benohi litra machkan zimna vetaskhé yatehon bemayya:
Vehilbachta et-aharon ét bigdé haqqodech oumachakhta oto veqiddachta oto vekihén li
Vetalbéch yat aharon yat lebouché qoudecha outerabbé yatéh outeqaddéch yatéh vichamméch qodamay:
Veet-banayv taqrib vehilbachta otam kuttonot
Veyat benohi teqaréb vetalbéch yatehon kittounin:
Oumachakhta otam kaacher machakhta et-abihem vekihanou li vehayeta lihyot lahem mochkhatam likhunnat olam ledorotam
Outerabbé yatehon kema di rabbéta yat abouhon vichammechoun qodamay outehé leméhevé lehon reboutehon lekahanout alam ledaréhon:
Vayyaas mocheh kekol acher tsivva Adonai oto kén asa
Vaabad mcheh kekol di paqqid Adonai yatéh kén abad:
Vayehi bakhodech harichon bachchana hachchénit beekhad lakhodech houqam hammichkan
Vahava beyarkha qadmaa bechatta tinyéta bekhad leyarkha ittaqam machkena:
Vayyaqem mocheh et-hammichkan vayyittén et-adanayv vayyasem et-qerachayv vayyittén et-berikhayv vayyaqem et-ammoudayv
Vaaqém mcheh yat machkena vihab yat sammekohi vechavvi yat dappohi vihab yat abrohi vaaqém yat ammoudohi:
Vayyipros et-haohel al-hammichkan vayyasem et-mikséh haohel alayv milmaela kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Ouperas yat perasa al machkena vechavvi yat khopaa demachkena alohi milleélla kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyiqqakh vayyittén et-haédout el-haaron vayyasem et-habbaddim al-haaron vayyittén et-hakkapporet al-haaron milmaela
Ounesib vihab yat sahadouta laarona vechavvi yat arikhayya al arona vihab yat kappurta al arona milélla:
Vayyabé et-haaron el-hammichkan vayyasem ét paroket hammasak vayyasek al aron haédout kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veaél yat arona lemachkena vechavvi yat parukta diprasa veattél al arona desahadouta kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyittén et-hachchulkhan beohel moéd al yerek hammichkan tsapona mikhouts lapparoket
Vihab yat patora bemachkan zimna al tsidda demachkena tsippouna mibbara leparukta:
Vayyaarok alayv érek lekhem lipné Adonai kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Vesaddar alohi siddour dilkhém qodam Adonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyasem et-hammenora beohel moéd nokakh hachchulkhan al yerek hammichkan negba
Vechavvi yat menarta bemachkan zimna loqobél patora al tsidda demachkena ledaroma:
Vayyaal hannérot lipné Adonai kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veadléq botsinaha qodam Adonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyasem et-mizbakh hazzahab beohel moéd lipné happaroket
Vechavvi yat madbekha dedahaba bemachkan zimna qodam parukta:
Vayyaqtér alayv qetoret sammim kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veaqtar alohi qetoret bousemin kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyasem et-masak happetakh lammichkan
Vechavvi yat perasa detara lemachkena:
Veét mizbakh haola sam petakh michkan ohel-moéd vayyaal alayv et-haola veet-hamminkha kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veyat madbekha daalata chavvi bitra machkena machkan zimna veasséq alohi yat alata veyat minkhata kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyasem et-hakkiyyor bén-ohel moéd oubén hammizbéakh vayyittén chamma mayim lerokhtsa
Vechavvi yat kiyora bén machkan zimna oubén madbekha vihab tamman mayya leqiddouch:
Verakhatsou mimmennou mocheh veaharon oubanayv et-yedéhem veet-ragléhem
Viqaddechoun minnéh mcheh veaharon oubenohi yat yedéhon veyat ragléhon:
Beboam el-ohel moéd oubeqorbatam el-hammizbéakh yirkhatsou kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Beméalhon lemachkan zimna oubemiqrabehon lemadbekha yeqaddechoun kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaqem et-hekhatsér sabib lammichkan velammizbéakh vayyittén et-masak chaar hekhatsér vayekal mocheh et-hammelaka
Vaaqém yat darta sekhor sekhor lemachkena oulemadbekha vihab yat perasa ditra darta vechétsé mcheh yat ibida:
Vayekas heanan et-ohel moéd oukebod Adonai malé et-hammichkan
Vakhapa anana yat machkan zimna viqara daAdonai itmeli yat machkena:
Velo-yakol mocheh labo el-ohel moéd ki-chakan alayv heanan oukebod Adonai malé et-hammichkan
Vela yakil mcheh leméal lemachkan zimna aré chera alohi anana viqara daAdonai itmeli yat machkena:
Oubehéalot heanan méal hammichkan yisou bené yisraél bekol maséhem
Oubeistallaqout anana méillavé machkena natelin bené yisraél bekol mattelanéhon:
Veim-lo yéaleh heanan velo yisou ad-yom héaloto
Veim la yistallaq anana vela natelin ad yoma deistallaqoutéh:
Ki anan Adonai al-hammichkan yomam veéch tihyeh layla bo leéné kol-bét-yisraél bekol-maséhem
Aré anana yeqara daAdonai al machkena bimama vekhézou echchata havé beléleya béh leéné kol bét yisraél bekol mattelanéhon:
Leviticus: Vayyiqra el-mocheh vayedabbér Adonai élayv méohel moéd lémor
Ouqera lemcheh oumallél Adonai imméh mimmachkan zimna lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél veamarta aléhem adam ki-yaqrib mikkem qorban la-Adonai min-habbehéma min-habbaqar oumin-hatstson taqribou et-qorbankem
Mallél im bené yisraél vetémar lehon énach aré yeqaréb minnekon qurbana qodam Adonai min beira min toré oumin ana teqareboun yat qurbankon:
Im-ola qorbano min-habbaqar zakar tamim yaqribennou el-petakh ohel moéd yaqrib oto lirtsono lipné Adonai
Im alata qurbanéh min toré dekar chelim yeqarebinnéh litra machkan zimna yeqaréb yatéh leraava léh qodam Adonai:
Vesamak yado al roch haola venirtsa lo lekappér alayv
Veyismok yedéh al réch alata veyitreé léh lekappara alohi:
Vechakhat et-ben habbaqar lipné Adonai vehiqribou bené aharon hakkohanim et-haddam vezareqou et-haddam al-hammizbéakh sabib acher-petakh ohel moéd
Veyikkos yat bar toré qodam Adonai viqareboun bené aharon kahanayya yat dema veyizreqoun yat dema al madbekha sekhor sekhor di bitra machkan zimna:
Vehipchit et-haola venittakh otah lintakhéha
Veyachlakh yat alata vipallég yatah leebraha:
Venatenou bené aharon hakkohén éch al-hammizbéakh vearekou étsim al-haéch
Veyittenoun bené aharon kahana echchata al madbekha visadderoun aayya al echchata:
Vearekou bené aharon hakkohanim ét hannetakhim et-haroch veet-happader al-haétsim acher al-haéch acher al-hammizbéakh
Visadderoun bené aharon kahanayya yat ebrayya yat récha veyat tarba al aayya di al echata di al madbekha:
Veqirbo oukeraayv yirkhats bammayim vehiqtir hakkohén et-hakkol hammizbékha ola ichchéh réakh-nikhoakh la-Adonai
Vegavéh oukeraohi yekhallél bemayya veyasséq kahana yat kola lemadbekha alata qurban demitqabbél beraava qodam Adonai:
Veim-min-hatstson qorbano min-hakkesabim o min-haizzim leola zakar tamim yaqribennou
Veim min ana qurbanéh min immerayya o min bené izayya laalata dekar chelim yeqarebinéh:
Vechakhat oto al yerek hammizbéakh tsapona lipné Adonai vezareqou bené aharon hakkohanim et-damo al-hammizbéakh sabib
Veyikkos yatéh al tsidda demadbekha tsippouna qodam Adonai veyizreqoun bené aharon kahanayya yat deméh al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Venittakh oto lintakhayv veet-rocho veet-pidro vearak hakkohén otam al-haétsim acher al-haéch acher al-hammizbéakh
Vipallég yatéh leébarohi veyat réchéh veyat tarbéh veyasdar kahana yatehon al aayya di al echchata di al madbekha:
Vehaqqereb vehakkeraayim yirkhats bammayim vehiqrib hakkohén et-hakkol vehiqtir hammizbékha ola hou ichchéh réakh nikhoakh la-Adonai
Vegavva oukeraayya yekhallél bemayya viqaréb kahana yat kola veyasséq lemadbekha alata hou qurban demitqabbél beraava qodam Adonai:
Veim min-haop ola qorbano la-Adonai vehiqrib min-hattorim o min-bené hayyona et-qorbano
Veim min opa alata qurbanéh qodam Adonai viqaréb min chapninayya o min bené yona yat qurbanéh:
Vehiqribo hakkohén el-hammizbéakh oumalaq et-rocho vehiqtir hammizbékha venimtsa damo al qir hammizbéakh
Viqarebinéh kahana lemadbekha veyimloq yat réchéh veyasséq lemadbekha veyittimtsé deméh al kotel madbekha:
Vehésir et-murato benotsatah vehichlik otah étsel hammizbéakh qédema el-meqom haddachen
Veyaaddé yat zepaqéh beoukeléh veyirmé yatah listar madbekha qidouma laatar demochedin qitma:
Vechissa oto biknapayv lo yabdil vehiqtir oto hakkohén hammizbékha al-haétsim acher al-haéch ola hou ichchéh réakh nikhoakh la-Adonai
Viparéq yatéh begadpohi la yapréch veyasséq yatéh kahana lemadbekha al aayya di al echchata alata hou qurban demitqabbél beraava qodam Adonai:
Venepech ki-taqrib qorban minkha la-Adonai solet yihyeh qorbano veyatsaq aléha chemen venatan aléha lebona
Veénach aré yeqaréb qurban minkhata qodam Adonai souleta yehé qurbanéh viriq alah michkha veyittén alah leboneta:
Vehébiah el-bené aharon hakkohanim veqamats michcham melo qumtso missoltah oumichchamnah al kol-lebonatah vehiqtir hakkohén et-azkaratah hammizbékha ichchéh réakh nikhoakh la-Adonai
Veyaytinnah levat bené aharon kahanayya veyiqmots mittamman melé qumtséh missulta oumimmichkhah al kol lebonetah veyasséq kahana yat adkartah lemadbekha qurban demitqabbél beraava qodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret min-hamminkha leaharon oulebanayv qodech qodachim méichché Adonai
Oudeichtaar min minkhata leaharon velibnohi qodech qoudechin miqqurbanayya daAdonai:
Veki taqrib qorban minkha maapéh tannour solet khallot matstsot beloulot bachchemen oureqiqé matstsot mechukhim bachchamen
Vaaré teqaréb qurban minkhata maapéh tannoura souleta geritsan pattiran depilan bimchakh veaspogin pattirin dimchikhin bimchakh:
Veim-minkha al-hammakhabat qorbaneka solet beloula bachchemen matstsa tihyeh
Veim minkhata al masréta qurbanak souleta depila bimchakh pattir tehé:
Patot otah pittim veyatsaqta aléha chamen minkha hiv
Betsa yatah bitsouin outeriq alah michkha minkhata hi:
Veim-minkhat markhechet qorbaneka solet bachchemen téaseh
Veim minkhata deradta qurbanak souleta bimchakh titabéd:
Vehébéta et-hamminkha acher yéaseh méélleh la-Adonai vehiqribah el-hakkohén vehiggichah el-hammizbéakh
Vetayté yat minkhata di yitabéd méillén qodam Adonai viqarbina levat kahana viqarbinnah lemadbekha:
Vehérim hakkohén min-hamminkha et-azkaratah vehiqtir hammizbékha ichchéh réakh nikhoakh la-Adonai
Veyapréch kahana min minkhata yat adkarta veyasséq lemadbekha qurban demitqabbél beraava qodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret min-hamminkha leaharon oulebanayv qodech qodachim méichché Adonai
Oudeichtaar min minkhata leaharon velibnohi qodech qoudechin miqqurbanayya daAdonai:
Kol-hamminkha acher taqribou la-Adonai lo téaseh khaméts ki kol-seor vekol-debach lo-taqtirou mimmennou ichcheh la-Adonai
Kol minkhata di teqareboun qodam Adonai la titabéd khamia aré kol khamir vekol debach la tasseqoun minnéh qurbana qodam Adonai:
Qorban réchit taqribou otam la-Adonai veel-hammizbéakh lo-yaalou leréakh nikhoakh
Qurban qadmay teqareboun yatehon qodam Adonai oulemadbekha la yittasseqoun leitqabbala beraava:
Vekol-qorban minkhateka bammelakh timlakh velo tachbit melakh berit élohéka méal minkhateka al kol-qorbaneka taqrib melakh
Vekol qurban minkhatak bemilkha timlakh vela tebattél melakh qeyam élahak méal minkhatak al kol qurbanak teqaréb milkha:
Veim-taqrib minkhat bikkourim la-Adonai abib qalouy baéch geres karmel taqrib ét minkhat bikkouréka
Veim teqaréb minkhat bikkourin qodam Adonai abib qelé benour pérokan rakkikan teqaréb yat minkhat bikkourak:
Venatatta aléha chemen vesamta aléha lebona minkha hiv
Vetittén alah michkha outechavvé alah leboneta minkhata hi:
Vehiqtir hakkohén et-azkaratah miggirsah oumichchamnah al kol-lebonatah ichcheh la-Adonai
Veyasséq kahana yat idkartah mippéroukah oumimmichkhah al kol lebonetah qurbana qodam Adonai:
Veim-zebakh chelamim qorbano im min-habbaqar hou maqrib im-zakar im-neqéba tamim yaqribennou lipné Adonai
Veim niksat qoudechayya qurbanéh im min toré hou meqaréb im dekar im nouqeba chelim yeqarebinéh qodam Adonai:
Vesamak yado al-roch qorbano ouchekhato petakh ohel moéd vezareqou bené aharon hakkohanim et-haddam al-hammizbéakh sabib
Veyismok yedéh al réch qurbanéh veyikkesinnéh bitra machkan zimna veyizreqoun bené aharon kahanayya yat dema al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Vehiqrib mizzebakh hachchelamim ichcheh la-Adonai et-hakhéleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veét kol-hakhéleb acher al-haqqereb
Viqaréb minniksat qoudechayya qurbana qodam Adonai yat tarba dekhapé yat gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:
Veét cheté hakkelayot veet-hakhéleb acher aléhen acher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabéd al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarba di aléhen di al gissayya veyat khatsra deal kabda al kaleyéta yaaddinnah:
Vehiqtirou oto bené-aharon hammizbékha al-haola acher al-haétsim acher al-haéch ichchéh réakh nikhoakh la-Adonai
Veyasqoun yatéh bené aharon lemadbekha al alata di al aayya di al echchata qurban demitqabbél beraava qodam Adonai:
Veim-min-hatstson qorbano lezebakh chelamim la-Adonai zakar o neqéba tamim yaqribennou
Veim min ana qurbanéh leniksat qoudechayya qodam Adonai dekar o nuqba chelim yeqarebinnéh:
Im-keseb hou-maqrib et-qorbano vehiqrib oto lipné Adonai
Im imar hou meqaréb yat qurbanéh viqaréb yatéh qodam Adonai:
Vesamak et-yado al-roch qorbano vechakhat oto lipné ohel moéd vezareqou bené aharon et-damo al-hammizbéakh sabib
Veyismok yat yedéh al réch qurbanéh veyikkos yatéh qodam machkan zimna veyizreqoun bené aharon yat deméh al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Vehiqrib mizzebakh hachchelamim ichcheh la-Adonai khelbo haalya temima leummat heatseh yesirenna veet-hakhéleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veét kol-hakhéleb acher al-haqqereb
Viqaréb minniksat qoudechayya qurbana qodam Adonai tarbéh alita chelimeta loqobél chezarta yedinnah veyat tareba dekhapé yat gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:
Veét cheté hakkelayot veet-hakhéleb acher aléhen acher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabéd al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarba di aléhen di al gissayya veyat khatsra deal kabda al kaleyéta yedinnah:
Vehiqtiro hakkohén hammizbékha lekhem ichcheh la-Adonai
Veyasseqinnéh kahana lemadbekha lekhém qurbana qodam Adonai:
Veim éz qorbano vehiqribo lipné Adonai
Veim min bené izzayya qurbanéh viqarebinnéh qodam Adonai:
Vesamak et-yado al-rocho vechakhat oto lipné ohel moéd vezareqou bené aharon et-damo al-hammizbéakh sabib
Veyismok yat yedéh al réchéh veyikkos yatéh qodam machkan zimna veyizreqoun bené aharon yat deméh al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Vehiqrib mimmennou qorbano ichcheh la-Adonai et-hakhéleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb veét kol-hakhéleb acher al-haqqereb
Viqaréb minnéh qurbanéh qurban qodam Adonai yat tarba dekhapé yat gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:
Veét cheté hakkelayot veet-hakhéleb acher aléhen acher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabéd al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarba di aléhen di al gissayya veyat khatsra di al kabda al kaleyéta yedinnah:
Vehiqtiram hakkohén hammizbékha lekhem ichcheh leréakh nikhoakh kol-khéleb la-Adonai
Veyasseqinnoun kahana lemadbekha lekhém qurbana leitqabbala beraava kol tarba qodam Adonai:
Khuqqat olam ledorotékem bekol mochebotékem kol-khéleb vekol-dam lo tokélou
Qeyam alam ledaratékon bekol motebanékon kol tarba vekol dema la tékeloun:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél lémor nepech ki-tekhéta bichgaga mikkol mitsvot Adonai acher lo téaséna veasa méakhat méhénna
Mallél im bené yisraél lemémar énach aré yékhob bechalou mikkol piqqoudayya daAdonai di la kachrin leitabada veyabéd min khad minnehon:
Im hakkohén hammachiakh yekhéta leachmat haam vehiqrib al khattato acher khata par ben-baqar tamim la-Adonai lekhattat
Im kahana rabba yékhob lekhobat amma viqaréb al khobetéh di khab tor bar toré chelim qodam Adonai lekhattata:
Vehébi et-happar el-petakh ohel moéd lipné Adonai vesamak et-yado al-roch happar vechakhat et-happar lipné Adonai
Veyayti yat tora litra machkan zimna loqodam Adonai veyismok yat yedéh al réch tora veyikkos yat tora qodom Adonai:
Velaqakh hakkohén hammachiakh middam happar vehébi oto el-ohel moéd
Veyissab kahana rabba middema detora veyaél yatéh lemachkan zimna:
Vetabal hakkohén et-etsbao baddam vehizza min-haddam cheba peamim lipné Adonai et-pené paroket haqqodech
Veyitbol kahana yat etsbeéh bidma veyaddi min dema cheba zimnin qodam Adonai qodam parouketa deqoudecha:
Venatan hakkohén min-haddam al-qarnot mizbakh qetoret hassammim lipné Adonai acher beohel moéd veét kol-dam happar yichpok el-yesod mizbakh haola acher-petakh ohel moéd
Veyittén kahana min dema al qarnat madbakh diqtoret bousemaya qodam Adonai di bemachkan zimna veyat kol dema detora yéchoud lisoda demadbekha daalata di bitra machkan zimna:
Veet-kol-khéleb par hakhattat yarim mimmennou et-hakhéleb hamekasseh al-haqqereb veét kol-hakhéleb acher al-haqqereb
Veyat kol terab tora dekhattata yapréch minnéh yat tarba dekhapé al gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:
Veét cheté hakkelayot veet-hakhéleb acher aléhen acher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabéd al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarba di aléhon di al gissayya veyat khitsra deal kabda al kaleyéta yedinnah:
Kaacher youram michchor zebakh hachchelamim vehiqtiram hakkohén al mizbakh haola
Kema di mittaprach mittor niksat qoudechayya veyasséqinnoun kahana al madbekha daalata:
Veet-or happar veet-kol-besaro al-rocho veal-keraayv veqirbo oupircho
Veyat mechak tora veyat kol bisréh al réchéh veal keraohi vegavvéh veoukeléh:
Vehotsi et-kol-happar el-mikhouts lammakhaneh el-maqom tahor el-chepek haddechen vesarap oto al-étsim baéch al-chepek haddechen yissarép
Veyappéq yat kol tora mibbara lemachrita laatar deké laatar bét méchad qitma veyoqid yatéh al aayya beechchata al atar bét méchad qitma yittoqad:
Veim kol-adat yisraél yichgou venelam dabar mééné haqqahal veasou akhat mikkol-mitsvot Adonai acher lo-téaséna veachémou
Veim kol kenichta deyisraél yichteloun vihé mekassa pitgama mééné qehala veyabedoun khad mikkol piqqoudayya daAdonai di la kacherin leitabada vikhoboun:
Venodea hakhattat acher khateou aléha vehiqribou haqqahal par ben-baqar lekhattat vehébiou oto lipné ohel moéd
Vetityeda khobeta di khabou alah viqarboun qehala tor bar toré lekhattata veyaytoun yatéh loqodam machkan zimna:
Vesamekou ziqné haéda et-yedéhem al-roch happar lipné Adonai vechakhat et-happar lipné Adonai
Veyismekoun sabé kenichta yat yedéhon al réch tora qodam Adonai veyikkos yat tora qodam Adonai:
Vehébi hakkohén hammachiakh middam happar el-ohel moéd
Veyaél kahana rabba min dema detora lemachkan zimna:
Vetabal hakkohén etsbao min-haddam vehizza cheba peamim lipné Adonai ét pené happaroket
Veyitbol kahana itsbeéh min dema veyaddi cheba zimnin qodam Adonai qodam parukta:
Oumin-haddam yittén al-qarnot hammizbéakh acher lipné Adonai acher beohel moéd veét kol-haddam yichpok el-yesod mizbakh haola acher-petakh ohel moéd
Oumin dema yittén al qarnat madbekha di qodam Adonai di bemachkan zimna veyat kol dema yéchod lisoda demadbekha daalata di bitra machkan zimna:
Veét kol-khelbo yarim mimmennou vehiqtir hammizbékha
Veyat kol tarbéh yapréch minnéh veyasséq lemadbekha:
Veasa lappar kaacher asa lepar hakhattat kén yaaseh-lo vekipper aléhem hakkohén venislakh lahem
Veyabéd letora kema di abad letora dekhattata kén yabéd léh vikappér aléhon kahana veyichtebéq lehon:
Vehotsi et-happar el-mikhouts lammakhaneh vesarap oto kaacher sarap ét happar harichon khattat haqqahal hou
Veyappéq yat tora lemibbara lemachrita veoqid yatéh kema di oqid yat tora qadmaa khattat qehala hou:
Acher nasi yekhéta veasa akhat mikkol-mitsvot Adonai élohayv acher lo-téaséna bichgaga veachém
Im rabba yékhob veyabéd khad mikkol piqqoudayya daAdonai élahéh di la kachrin leitabada bechalou veyékhob:
O-hoda élayv khattato acher khata bah vehébi et-qorbano seir izzim zakar tamim
O ityeda léh khobetéh di khab bah veyayti yat qurbanéh tsepir bar izzin dekar chelim:
Vesamak yado al-roch hassair vechakhat oto bimqom acher-yichkhat et-haola lipné Adonai khattat hou
Veyismok yedéh al récha ditspira veyikkos yatéh baatar deyikkos yat alata loqodam Adonai khattata hou:
Velaqakh hakkohén middam hakhattat beetsbao venatan al-qarnot mizbakh haola veet-damo yichpok el-yesod mizbakh haola
Veyissab kahana middema dekhattata beetsbeéh veyittén al qarnat madbekha daalata veyat deméh yéchod lisoda demadbekha daalata:
Veet-kol-khelbo yaqtir hammizbékha kekhéleb zebakh hachchelamim vekipper alayv hakkohén mékhattato venislakh lo
Veyat kol tarbéh yasséq lemadbekha kitrab niksat qoudechayya vikappér alohi kahana mékhobetéh veyichtebéq léh:
Veim-nepech akhat tekhéta bichgaga méam haarets baasotah akhat mimmitsvot Adonai acher lo-téaséna veachém
Veim énach khad yékhob bechalou méamma deara bemebedah khad mippiqqoudayya daAdonai di la kachrin leitabada veyékhob:
O hoda élayv khattato acher khata vehébi qorbano seirat izzim temima neqéba al-khattato acher khata
O ityeda léh khobetéh di khab veyayti qurbanéh tsepirat izzin chelemta neqoubeta al khobetéh di khab:
Vesamak et-yado al roch hakhattat vechakhat et-hakhattat bimqom haola
Veyismok yat yedéh al réch khattata veyikkos yat khattata baatar daalata:
Velaqakh hakkohén middamah beetsbao venatan al-qarnot mizbakh haola veet-kol-damah yichpok el-yesod hammizbéakh
Veyissab kahana midmah beetsbeéh veyittén al qarnat madbekha daalata veyat kol demah yéchod lisoda demadbekha:
Veet-kol-khelbah yasir kaacher housar khéleb méal zebakh hachchelamim vehiqtir hakkohén hammizbékha leréakh nikhoakh la-Adonai vekipper alayv hakkohén venislakh lo
Veyat kol tarbah yedé kema di mittada terab méal niksat qoudechayya veyasséq kahana lemadbekha leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai vikappér alohi kahana veyichtebéq léh:
Veim-kebes yabi qorbano lekhattat neqéba temima yebienna
Veim imar yayti qurbanéh lekhattata nuqba chelemta yaytinnah:
Vesamak et-yado al roch hakhattat vechakhat otah lekhattat bimqom acher yichkhat et-haola
Veyismok yat yedéh al réch khattata veyikkos yatah lekhattata beatra di yikkos yat alata:
Velaqakh hakkohén middam hakhattat beetsbao venatan al-qarnot mizbakh haola veet-kol-damah yichpok el-yesod hammizbéakh
Veyissab kahana middema dekhattata beetsbeéh veyittén al qarnat madbekha daalata veyat kol demah yéchod lisoda demadbekha:
Veet-kol-khelbah yasir kaacher yousar khéleb-hakkeseb mizzebakh hachchelamim vehiqtir hakkohén otam hammizbékha al ichché Adonai vekipper alayv hakkohén al-khattato acher-khata venislakh lo
Veyat kol tarbah yedé kema di mittada terab immera minniksat qoudechayya veyasséq kahana yatehon lemadbekha al qurbenayya daAdonai vikappér alohi kahana al khobetéh di khab veyichtebéq léh:
Venepech ki-tekhéta vechamea qol ala vehou éd o raa o yada im-lo yaggid venasa avono
Veénach aré yékhob veyichma qal momé vehou sahid o khaza o yeda im la yekhavvi viqabbél khobéh:
O nepech acher tigga bekol-dabar tamé o beniblat khayya teméa o beniblat behéma teméa o beniblat cherets tamé venelam mimmennou vehou tamé veachém
O énach di yiqrab bekol middaam mesaab o beniblat khayta mesaaba o beniblat beira mesaaba o beniblat rikhacha mesaab vihé mekassa minnéh vehou mesaab vekhab:
O ki yigga betumat adam lekol tumato acher yitma bah venelam mimmennou vehou yada veachém
O aré yiqrab besoabat énacha lekol sobetéh di yistaab bah vihé mekassa minnéh vehou yada vekhab:
O nepech ki tichchaba lebatté bispatayim lehara o lehétib lekol acher yebatté haadam bichbua venelam mimmennou vehou-yada veachém leakhat méélleh
O énach aré yeqayyém leparacha besipvan leabacha o leotaba lekol di yeparéch énacha beqiyyoum vihé mekassa minnéh vehou yada vekhab lakhada méillén:
Vehaya ki-yecham leakhat méélleh vehitvadda acher khata aléha
Vihé aré yékhob lakhada méillén vivaddi di khab alah:
Vehébi et-achamo la-Adonai al khattato acher khata neqéba min-hatstson kisba o-seirat izzim lekhattat vekipper alayv hakkohén mékhattato
Veyayti yat achméh qodam Adonai al khobetéh di khab neqoubeta min ana immerata o tsepirat izzin lekhatata vikappér alohi kahana mékhobetéh:
Veim-lo taggia yado dé seh vehébi et-achamo acher khata cheté torim o-chené bené-yona la-Adonai ekhad lekhattat veekhad leola
Veim la timté yedéh kemissat séta veyayti yat khobetéh di khab tartén chapninin o terén bené yona qodam Adonai khad lekhattata vekhad laalata:
Vehébi otam el-hakkohén vehiqrib et-acher lakhattat richona oumalaq et-rocho mimmoul orpo velo yabdil
Veyayti yatehon levat kahana viqaréb yat di lekhattata qadméta veyimloq yat réchéh milloqobél qedaléh vela yapréch:
Vehizza middam hakhattat al-qir hammizbéakh vehannichar baddam yimmatséh el-yesod hammizbéakh khattat hou
Veyaddi middema dekhattata al kotel madbekha oudeichtaar bidma yittimtsé lisoda demadbekha khattata hou:
Veet-hachchéni yaaseh ola kammichpat vekipper alayv hakkohén mékhattato acher-khata venislakh lo
Veyat tinyana yabéd alata kidkhazé vikappér alohi kahana mékhobetéh di khab veyichtebéq léh:
Veim-lo tassig yado lichté torim o lichné bené-yona vehébi et-qorbano acher khata asirit haépa solet lekhattat lo-yasim aléha chemen velo-yittén aléha lebona ki khattat hiv
Veim la tadbéq yedéh letartén chapninin o litrén bené yona veyayti yat qurbanéh di khab khad min asra bitlat sein sulta lekhattata la yechavvi alah michkha vela yittén alah lebunta aré khattata hi:
Vehébiah el-hakkohén veqamats hakkohén mimmenna melo qumtso et-azkaratah vehiqtir hammizbékha al ichché Adonai khattat hiv
Veyaytinnah levat kahana veyiqmots kahana minnah melé qumtséh yat idkartah veyasséq lemadbekha al qurbanayya daAdonai khattata hi:
Vekipper alayv hakkohén al-khattato acher-khata méakhat méélleh venislakh lo vehayeta lakkohén kamminkha
Vikappér alohi kahana al khobetéh di khab mékhada méillén veyichtebéq léh outehé lekahana keminkhata:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Nepech ki-timol maal vekhatea bichgaga miqqodché Adonai vehébi et-achamo la-Adonai ayil tamim min-hatstson beerkeka kesep-cheqalim becheqel-haqqodech leacham
énach aré yechaqqar cheqar veyékhob bechalou miqoudechayya daAdonai veyayti yat achméh qodam Adonai dekar chelim min ana bepursanéh kesap silin besilé qoudecha laachama:
Veét acher khata min-haqqodech yechallém veet-khamichito yosép alayv venatan oto lakkohén vehakkohén yekappér alayv beél haacham venislakh lo
Veyat di khab min qoudecha yechallém veyat khumchéh yosép alohi veyittén yatéh lekahana vekahana yekappér alohi bedikra daachama veyichtebéq léh:
Veim-nepech ki tekhéta veaseta akhat mikkol-mitsvot Adonai acher lo téaséna velo-yada veachém venasa avono
Veim énach aré yékhob veyabéd khada mikkol piqqodayya daAdonai di la kacherin leitabada vela yada veyékhob viqabbél khobéh:
Vehébi ayil tamim min-hatstson beerkeka leacham el-hakkohén vekipper alayv hakkohén al chiggato acher-chagag vehou lo-yada venislakh lo
Veyayti dekar chelim min ana bepursanéh laachama levat kahana vikappér alohi kahana al chaloutéh deichteli vehou la yada veyichtebéq léh:
Acham hou achom acham la-Adonai
Achama hou al khobetéh dehou khab achama yeqaréb qodam Adonai:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Nepech ki tekhéta oumaala maal ba-Adonai vekikhéch baamito bepiqqadon o-bitsoumet yad o begazél o achaq et-amito
énach aré yékhob vichaqqar cheqar qodam Adonai vikadéb bekhabréh bpiqqedona o bechuttapout yeda o bigzéla o annis yat khabréh:
O-matsa abéda vekikhech bah venichba al-chaqer al-akhat mikkol acher-yaaseh haadam lakhato bahénna
O achkakh abédeta vikaddéb bah veichteba al chiqra al khada mikkol di yabéd énacha lemékhab behén:
Vehaya ki-yekhéta veachém vehéchib et-haggezéla acher gazal o et-haocheq acher achaq o et-happiqqadon acher hopqad itto o et-haabéda acher matsa
Vihé aré yekhété veyékhob veyatéb yat gezéla di gezal o yat uchqa di achaq o yat piqqedona di itpaqqad levatéh o yat abédeta di achkakh:
O mikkol acher-yichchaba alayv lachcheqer vechillam oto berocho vakhamichitayv yosép alayv laacher hou lo yittenennou beyom achmato
O mikkol di yichteba alohi lechiqra vichallém yatéh beréchéh vekhumchéh yosép alohi ledi hou diléh yitteninnéh beyoma dekhobetéh:
Veet-achamo yabi la-Adonai ayil tamim min-hatstson beerkeka leacham el-hakkohén
Veyat achmah yayti loqodam Adonai dekar chelim min ana bepursanéh laachama levat kahana:
Vekipper alayv hakkohén lipné Adonai venislakh lo al-akhat mikkol acher-yaaseh leachma bah
Vikappér alohi kahana qodam Adonai veyichtebéq léh al khada mikkol di yabéd lemékhab bah:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Tsav et-aharon veet-banayv lémor zot torat haola hiv haola al moqeda al-hammizbéakh kol-hallayla ad-habboqer veéch hammizbéakh touqad bo
Paqqéd yat aharon veyat benohi lemémar da orayta daalata hi alata al demittoqeda al madbekha kol léleya ad tsapra veechchata demadbekha tehé yaqeda béh:
Velabach hakkohén middo bad oumikenesé-bad yilbach al-besaro vehérim et-haddechen acher tokal haéch et-haola al-hammizbéakh vesamo étsel hammizbéakh
Veyalbéch kahana lebouchin debouts oumiknesin debouts yalbéch al bisréh veyapréch yat qitma di tékoul echchata yat alata al madbekha vichavvinnéh bistar madbekha:
Oupachat et-begadayv velabach begadim akhérim vehotsi et-haddechen el-mikhouts lammakhaneh el-maqom tahor
Veyachlakh yat lebouchohi veyilbach lebouchin okhoranin veyappéq yat qitma lemibbara lemachrita laatar deké:
Vehaéch al-hammizbéakh touqad-bo lo tikbeh oubiér aléha hakkohén étsim babboqer babboqer vearak aléha haola vehiqtir aléha khelbé hachchelamim
Veechchata al madbekha tehé yaqeda béh la tittepé veyabar alah kahana aayya bitspar bitspar veyasdar allah alata veyasséq alah tarbé niksat qoudechayya:
éch tamid touqad al-hammizbéakh lo tikbeh
Echchata tedira tehé yaqeda al madbekha la tittepé:
Vezot torat hamminkha haqréb otah bené-aharon lipné Adonai el-pené hammizbéakh
Veda orayta deminkhata diqareboun yatah bené aharon qodam Adonai loqodam madbekha:
Vehérim mimmennou bequmtso missolet hamminkha oumichchamnah veét kol-hallebona acher al-hamminkha vehiqtir hammizbéakh réakh nikhoakh azkaratah la-Adonai
Veyapréch minnéh bequmtséh missulta deminkhata oumimmichkhah veyat kol lebouneta di al minkhata veyasséq lemadbekha leitqabbala beraava adkarta qodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret mimmenna yokelou aharon oubanayv matstsot téakél bemaqom qadoch bakhatsar ohel-moéd yokelouha
Oudeichtaar minnah yékeloun aharon oubenohi pattir titakél baatar qaddich bedarat michkan zimna yékelunnah:
Lo téapeh khaméts khelqam natatti otah méichchay qodech qodachim hiv kakhattat vekaacham
La titapé khamia kholaqehon yehabit yatah miqqurbanay qodech qoudechin hi kekhattata vekaachama:
Kol-zakar bibné aharon yokelenna khoq-olam ledorotékem méichché Adonai kol acher-yigga bahem yiqdach
Kol dekoura bibné aharon yékelunnah qeyam alam ledaratékon miqqurbanayya daAdonai kol deyiqrab behon yitqaddach:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Zeh qorban aharon oubanayv acher-yaqribou la-Adonai beyom himmachakh oto asirit haépa solet minkha tamid makhatsitah babboqer oumakhatsitah baareb
Dén qurban aharon oubenohi di yeqareboun qodam Adonai beyoma derabbiou yatéh khad min asra bitlat sein sulta minkhata tedira palgoutah betsapra oupalgoutah beramcha:
Al-makhabat bachchemen téaseh murbeket tebienna tupiné minkhat pittim taqrib réakh-nikhoakh la-Adonai
Al masréta bimchakh titabéd rebika taytinnah toupiné minkhat bitstsouin teqaréb leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai:
Vehakkohén hammachiakh takhtayv mibbanayv yaaseh otah khoq-olam la-Adonai kalil toqtar
Vekahana dimrabba tekhotohi mibbenohi yabéd yatah qeyam alam qodam Adonai gemir tittassaq:
Vekol-minkhat kohén kalil tihyeh lo téakél
Vekol minkhata dekahana gemir tehé la titakél:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-aharon veel-banayv lémor zot torat hakhattat bimqom acher tichchakhét haola tichchakhét hakhattat lipné Adonai qodech qodachim hiv
Mallél im aharon veim benohi lemémar da orayta dekhattata beatar di titnekés alata titnekés khattata qodam Adonai qodech qoudechin hi:
Hakkohén hamekhatté otah yokelenna bemaqom qadoch téakél bakhatsar ohel moéd
Kahana dimkappér bidmah yékelinnah baatar qaddich titakél bedarat machkan zimna:
Kol acher-yigga bibsarah yiqdach vaacher yizzeh middamah al-habbeged acher yizzeh aléha tekabbés bemaqom qadoch
Kol di yiqrab bebisrah yitqaddach vedi yaddi middemah al lebouch di yaddi alah titkhavvar baatar qaddich:
Oukeli-kheres acher tebuchchal-bo yichchabér veim-bikli nekhochet buchchala oumoraq vechuttap bammayim
Ouman dakhasap di titbachchél béh yittabar veim bemana dinkhacha titbachchél veyitmeréq veyichtattép bemayya:
Kol-zakar bakkohanim yokal otah qodech qodachim hiv
Kol dekoura bekahanayya yékoul yatah qodech qoudechin hi:
Vekol-khattat acher youba middamah el-ohel moéd lekappér baqqodech lo téakél baéch tissarép
Vekol khattata di yittaal middemah lemachkan zimna lekappara beqoudecha la titakél benoura tittoqad:
Vezot torat haacham qodech qodachim hou
Veda orayta daachama qodech qoudechin hou:
Bimqom acher yichkhatou et-haola yichkhatou et-haacham veet-damo yizroq al-hammizbéakh sabib
Beatra di yikkesoun yat alata yikkesoun yat achama veyat deméh yizraq al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Veét kol-khelbo yaqrib mimmennou ét haalya veet-hakhéleb hamekasseh et-haqqereb
Veyat kol tarbéh yapréch minnéh yat alita veyat tarba dekhapé yat gavva:
Veét cheté hakkelayot veet-hakhéleb acher aléhen acher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkabéd al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarba di aléhen di al gissayya veyat khitsra deal kabda al kaleyéta yedinnah:
Vehiqtir otam hakkohén hammizbékha ichcheh la-Adonai acham hou
Veyasséq yatehon kahana lemadbekha qurbana qodam Adonai achama hou:
Kol-zakar bakkohanim yokelennou bemaqom qadoch yéakél qodech qodachim hou
Kol dekoura bekahanayya yékelinnéh baatar qaddich yitakal qodech qoudechin hou:
Kakhattat kaacham tora akhat lahem hakkohén acher yekapper-bo lo yihyeh
Kekhattata kaachama orayta khada lehon kahana di yekappér béh diléh yehé:
Vehakkohén hammaqrib et-olat ich or haola acher hiqrib lakkohén lo yihyeh
Vekahana dimqaréb yat alat gebar mechak alata di yeqaréb lekahana diléh yehé:
Vekol-minkha acher téapeh battannour vekol-naasa bammarkhechet veal-makhabat lakkohén hammaqrib otah lo tiheyeh
Vekol minkhata di titapé betannoura vekol detitabéd beridta veal masréta lekahana dimqaréb yatah diléh tehé:
Vekol-minkha beloula-bachchemen vakharéba lekol-bené aharon tihyeh ich keakhiv
Vekol minkhata depila bimchakh oudela pila lekol bené aharon tehé gebar keakhohi:
Vezot torat zebakh hachchelamim acher yaqrib la-Adonai
Veda orayta deniksat qoudechayya di yeqaréb qodam Adonai:
Im al-toda yaqribennou vehiqrib al-zebakh hattoda khallot matstsot beloulot bachchemen oureqiqé matstsot mechukhim bachchamen vesolet murbeket khallot beloulot bachchamen
Im al todeta yeqarebinnéh viqaréb al niksat todeta geritsan pattiran depilan bimchakh veespogin pattirin dimchikhin bimchakh vesulta rebika geritsan depilan bimchakh:
Al-khallot lekhem khaméts yaqrib qorbano al-zebakh todat chelamayv
Al geritsan dilkhém khamia yeqaréb qurbanéh al niksat todat qoudechohi:
Vehiqrib mimmennou ekhad mikkol-qorban terouma la-Adonai lakkohén hazzoréq et-dam hachchelamim lo yihyeh
Viqaréb minnéh khad mikkol qoureban aprachouta qodam Adonai lekahana dizeraq yat dam niksat qoudechayya diléh yehé:
Oubesar zebakh todat chelamayv beyom qorbano yéakél lo-yanniakh mimmennou ad-boqer
Oubesar niksat todat qoudechohi beyom qurbanéh yitakél la yatsna minnéh ad tsapra:
Veim-neder o nedaba zebakh qorbano beyom haqribo et-zibkho yéakél oumimmokhorat vehannotar mimmennou yéakél
Veim nidra o nedabta niksat qurbenéh beyoma di yeqaréb yat niksetéh yitakél oubeyoma debatrohi oudeichtaar minnéh yitakél:
Vehannotar mibbesar hazzabakh bayyom hachchelichi baéch yissarép
Oudeichtaar mibbesar nikseta beyoma telitaa benoura yittoqad:
Veim héakol yéakél mibbesar-zebakh chelamayv bayyom hachchelichi lo yératseh hammaqrib oto lo yékhachéb lo piggoul yihyeh vehannepech haokelet mimmennou avonah tissa
Veim itakala yitakél mibbesar niksat qoudechohi beyoma telitaa la yehé leraava dimqaréb yatéh la yitkhachéb léh merakhaq yehé veénach detékoul minnéh khobéh yeqabbél:
Vehabbasar acher-yigga bekol-tamé lo yéakél baéch yissarép vehabbasar kol-tahor yokal basar
Oubesar qoudecha di yiqrab bekol mesaab la yitakél benoura yittoqad oubesar qoudecha kol di deké leqoudecha yékoul besar qoudecha:
Vehannepech acher-tokal basar mizzebakh hachchelamim acher la-Adonai vetumato alayv venikreta hannepech hahiv méamméha
Veénach di tékoul bisra minniksat qoudechayya di qodam Adonai vesobetéh alohi veyichtétsé énacha hahi méammah:
Venepech ki-tigga bekol-tamé betumat adam o bibhéma teméa o bekol-cheqets tamé veakal mibbesar-zebakh hachchelamim acher la-Adonai venikreta hannepech hahiv méamméha
Veénach aré tiqrab bekol mesaab besoabat énacha o bibira mesaaba o bekol chiqtsa mesaab veyékoul mibbesar niksat qoudechayya di qodam Adonai vichetétsé énacha hahi méammah:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél lémor kol-khéleb chor vekeseb vaéz lo tokélou
Mallél im bené yisraél lemémar kol terab tor veimmar veizza la tékeloun:
Vekhéleb nebéla vekhéleb terépa yéaseh lekol-melaka veakol lo tokelouhou
Outerab nebila outerab tebira yitabéd lekol ibidta oumékal la tékelunnéh:
Ki kol-okél khéleb min-habbehéma acher yaqrib mimmenna ichcheh la-Adonai venikreta hannepech haokelet méamméha
Aré kol deyékoul tarba min beira di yeqareboun minnah qurbana qodam Adonai veyichtétsé énacha di tékoul méammah:
Vekol-dam lo tokelou bekol mochebotékem laop velabbehéma
Vekol dema la tékeloun bekol motebanékon deopa vedibira:
Kol-nepech acher-tokal kol-dam venikreta hannepech hahiv méamméha
Kol énacha di tékoul kol dema veyichtétsé énacha hahi méammah:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél lémor hammaqrib et-zebakh chelamayv la-Adonai yabi et-qorbano la-Adonai mizzebakh chelamayv
Mallél im bené yisraél lemémar dimqaréb yat niksat qoudechohi qodam Adonai yayti yat qurbanéh loqodam Adonai minniksat qoudechohi:
Yadayv tebiéna ét ichché Adonai et-hakhéleb al-hekhazeh yebiennou ét hekhazeh lehanip oto tenoupa lipné Adonai
Yedohi taytoun yat qurbanayya daAdonai yat tarba al khedya yaytinnéh yat khedya laarama yatéh arouma qodam Adonai:
Vehiqtir hakkohén et-hakhéleb hammizbékha vehaya hekhazeh leaharon oulebanayv
Veyasséq kahana yat tarba lemadbekha vihé khedya leaharon velibnohi:
Veét choq hayyamin tittenou terouma lakkohén mizzibkhé chalmékem
Veyat choqa deyammina tittenoun aprachouta lekahana minniksat qoudechékon:
Hammaqrib et-dam hachchelamim veet-hakhéleb mibbené aharon lo tihyeh choq hayyamin lemana
Dimqaréb yat dam niksat qoudechayya veyat tarba mibbené aharon diléh tehé choqa deyammina lokholaq:
Ki et-khazéh hattenoupa veét choq hatterouma laqakhti méét bené-yisraél mizzibkhé chalméhem vaettén otam leaharon hakkohén oulebanayv lekhoq-olam méét bené yisraél
Aré yat khedya daaramouta veyat choqa deaprachouta nesébit min bené yisraél minniksat qoudechéhon vihabit yatehon leaharon kahana velibnohi liqyam alam min bené yisraél:
Zot michkhat aharon oumichkhat banayv méichché Adonai beyom hiqrib otam lekahén la-Adonai
Da rebout aharon ourebout benohi miqqurbanayya daAdonai beyoma diyqareboun yatehon lechammacha qodam Adonai:
Acher tsivva Adonai latét lahem beyom mochkho otam méét bené yisraél khuqqat olam ledorotam
Di paqqid Adonai lemittan lehon beyoma derabbi yatehon min bené yisraél qeyam alam ledaréhon:
Zot hattora laola lamminkha velakhattat velaacham velammillouim oulezebakh hachchelamim
Da orayta laalata leminkhata oulekhattata velaachama oulequrbanayya ouleniksat qoudechayya:
Acher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh behar sinay beyom tsavvoto et-bené yisraél lehaqrib et-qorbenéhem la-Adonai bemidbar sinay
Di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh betoura desinay beyoma dipaqqedéh yat bené yisraél leqaraba yat qurbanehon qodam Adonai bemadbera desinay:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Qakh et-aharon veet-banayv itto veét habbegadim veét chemen hammichkha veét par hakhattat veét chené haélim veét sal hammatstsot
Qaréb yat aharon veyat benohi imméh veyat lebouchayya veyat michkha dirbouta veyat tora dekhattata veyat terén dikrin veyat salla depattirayya:
Veét kol-haéda haqhél el-petakh ohel moéd
Veyat kol kenichta kenéch litra machkan zimna:
Vayyaas mocheh kaacher tsivva Adonai oto vattiqqahél haéda el-petakh ohel moéd
Vaabad mcheh kema di paqqid Adonai yatéh veitkenichat kenichta litra machkan zimna:
Vayyomer mocheh el-haéda zeh haddabar acher-tsivva Adonai laasot
Vaamar mcheh liknichta dén pitgama di paqqid Adonai lemebad:
Vayyaqréb mocheh et-aharon veet-banayv vayyirkhats otam bammayim
Veqarib mcheh yat aharon veyat benohi veaskhé yatehon bemayya:
Vayyittén alayv et-hakkuttonet vayyakhgor oto baabnét vayyalbéch oto et-hammeil vayyittén alayv et-haépod vayyakhgor oto bekhécheb haépod vayyepod lo bo
Vihab alohi yat kittouna vezaréz yatéh behemyana vealbéch yatéh yat meila vihab alohi yat époda vezaréz yatéh behemyan époda veatqén léh béh:
Vayyasem alayv et-hakhochen vayyittén el-hakhochen et-haourim veet-hattummim
Vechavvi alohi yat khouchena vihab bekhouchena yat ourayya veyat tumayya:
Vayyasem et-hammitsnepet al-rocho vayyasem al-hammitsnepet el-mvl panayv ét tsits hazzahab nézer haqqodech kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Vechavvi yat mitsnepta al réchéh vechavvi al mitsnepta loqobél appohi yat tsitsa dedahaba kelila deqoudecha kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyiqqakh mocheh et-chemen hammichkha vayyimchakh et-hammichkan veet-kol-acher-bo vayeqaddéch otam
Ounesib mcheh yat michkha dirbouta verabbi yat machkena veyat kol di béh veqaddich yatehon:
Vayyaz mimmennou al-hammizbéakh cheba peamim vayyimchakh et-hammizbéakh veet-kol-kélayv veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno leqaddecham
Veaddi minnéh al madbekha cheba zimnin verabbi yat madbekha veyat kol manohi veyat kiyyora veyat besiséh leqaddachoutehon:
Vayyitsoq michchemen hammichkha al roch aharon vayyimchakh oto leqaddecho
Vaariq mimmichkha dirbouta al récha deaharon verabbi yatéh leqaddachoutéh:
Vayyaqréb mocheh et-bené aharon vayyalbichém kuttonot vayyakhgor otam abnét vayyakhaboch lahem migbaot kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veqarib mcheh yat bené aharon vealbéchinnoun kittounin vezaréz yatehon hemyanin veatqén lehon kobain kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaggéch ét par hakhattat vayyismok aharon oubanayv et-yedéhem al-roch par hakhattat
Veqaréb yat tora dekhattata ousemak aharon oubenohi yat yedéhon al réch tora dekhattata:
Vayyichkhat vayyiqqakh mocheh et-haddam vayyittén al-qarnot hammizbéakh sabib beetsbao vayekhatté et-hammizbéakh veet-haddam yatsaq el-yesod hammizbéakh vayeqaddechéhou lekappér alayv
