Ounekés ounesib mcheh yat dema vihab al qarnat madbekha sekhor sekhor beetsbeéh vedakki yat madbekha veyat dema ariq lisoda demadbekha veqaddechéh lekappara alohi:
Vayyiqqakh et-kol-hakhéleb acher al-haqqereb veét yoteret hakkabéd veet-cheté hakkelayot veet-khelbehen vayyaqtér mocheh hammizbékha
Ounesib yat kol tarba di al gavva veyat khatsar kabda veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarbehen veasséq mcheh lemadbekha:
Veet-happar veet-oro veet-besaro veet-pircho sarap baéch mikhouts lammakhaneh kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veyat tora veyat machkéh veyat bisréh veyat okléh oqid benoura mibbara lemachrita kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaqréb ét él haola vayyismekou aharon oubanayv et-yedéhem al-roch haayil
Veqarib yat dikra daalata ousemakou aharon oubenohi yat yedéhon al réch dikra:
Vayyichkhat vayyizroq mocheh et-haddam al-hammizbéakh sabib
Ounekés ouzeraq mcheh yat dema al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Veet-haayil nittakh lintakhayv vayyaqtér mocheh et-haroch veet-hannetakhim veet-happader
Veyat dikra pallég leebrohi veasséq mcheh yat récha veyat ébarayya veyat tarba:
Veet-haqqereb veet-hakkeraayim rakhats bammayim vayyaqtér mocheh et-kol-haayil hammizbékha ola hou leréakh-nikhoakh ichcheh hou la-Adonai kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veyat gavva veyat keraayya khallil bemayya veasséq mcheh yat kol dikra lemadbekha alata hou leitqabbala beraava qurbana hou qodam Adonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaqréb et-haayil hachchéni él hammilluim vayyismekou aharon oubanayv et-yedéhem al-roch haayil
Veqarib yat dikra tinyana dekar qurbanayya ousemakou aharon oubenohi yat yedéhon al réch dikra:
Vayyichkhat vayyiqqakh mocheh middamo vayyittén al-tenouk ozen-aharon hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Ounekés ounesib mcheh min dema vihab al roum oudena deaharon deyammina veal ilyon yedéh deyammina veal ilyon ragléh deyammina:
Vayyaqréb et-bené aharon vayyittén mocheh min-haddam al-tenouk oznam hayemanit veal-bohen yadam hayemanit veal-bohen raglam hayemanit vayyizroq mocheh et-haddam al-hammizbéakh sabib
Veqarib yat bené aharon vihab mcheh min dema al roum oudenéhon deyammina veal ilyon yedéhon deyammina veal ilyon ragléhon deyammina ouzeraq mcheh yat dema al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Vayyiqqakh et-hakhéleb veet-haalya veet-kol-hakhéleb acher al-haqqereb veét yoteret hakkabéd veet-cheté hakkelayot veet-khelbehen veét choq hayyamin
Ounesib yat tarba veyat alita veyat kol tarba di al gavva veyat khatsar kabda veyat tartén kaleyan veyat tarbehen veyat choqa deyammina:
Oumissal hammatstsot acher lipné Adonai laqakh khallat matstsa akhat vekhallat lekhem chemen akhat veraqiq ekhad vayyasem al-hakhalabim veal choq hayyamin
Oumissalla depattirayya di qodam Adonai nesib geritsta pattira khada ougeritsta dilkhém mechakh khada veespog khad vechavvi al tarbayya veal choqa deyammina:
Vayyittén et-hakkol al kappé aharon veal kappé banayv vayyanep otam tenoupa lipné Adonai
Vihab yat kolla al yedé aharon veal yedé benohi vaarém yatehon arama qodam Adonai:
Vayyiqqakh mocheh otam méal kappéhem vayyaqtér hammizbékha al-haola milluim hém leréakh nikhoakh ichcheh hou la-Adonai
Ounesib mcheh yatehon méal yedéhon veasséq lemadbekha al alata qurbanayya innoun leitqabbala beraava qurbana hou qodam Adonai:
Vayyiqqakh mocheh et-hekhazeh vayenipéhou tenoupa lipné Adonai méél hammilluim lemocheh haya lemana kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Ounesib mcheh yat khedya vaariméh arama qodam Adonai middekar qurbanayya lemcheh hava lokholaq kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:

Vayyiqqakh mocheh michchemen hammichkha oumin-haddam acher al-hammizbéakh vayyaz al-aharon al-begadayv veal-banayv veal-bigdé banayv itto vayeqaddéch et-aharon et-begadayv veet-banayv veet-bigdé banayv itto

Ounesib mcheh mimmichkha dirbouta oumin dema di al madbekha veaddi al aharon al lebouchohi veal benohi veal lebouché benohi imméh veqaddich yat aharon yat lebouchohi veyat benohi veyat lebouché benohi imméh:
Vayyomer mocheh el-aharon veel-banayv bachchelou et-habbasar petakh ohel moéd vecham tokelou oto veet-hallekhem acher besal hammilluim kaacher tsivvéti lémor aharon oubanayv yokelouhou
Vaamar mcheh leaharon velibnohi bachchilou yat bisra bitra machkan zimna vetamman tékeloun yatéh veyat lakhma di besal qurbanayya kema di paqqédit lemémar aharon oubenohi yékelunnéh:
Vehannotar babbasar ouballakhem baéch tisropou
Oudeichtaar bebisra oubelakhma benoura toqedoun:
Oumippetakh ohel moéd lo tétseou chibat yamim ad yom melot yemé milluékem ki chibat yamim yemallé et-yedkem
Oumittera machkan zimna la tippeqoun chiba yomin ad yom michlam yomé qurbanékon aré chiba yomin yeqaréb yat qurbanekon:
Kaacher asa bayyom hazzeh tsivva Adonai laasot lekappér alékem
Kema di abad beyoma hadén paqqid Adonai lemebad lekappara alékon:
Oupetakh ohel moéd téchebou yomam valayla chibat yamim ouchemartem et-michmeret Adonai velo tamoutou ki-kén tsuvvéti
Oubitra machkan zimna téteboun yemam velélé chiba yomin vetitteroun yat matterat mémera daAdonai vela temoutoun aré kén itpaqqadit:
Vayyaas aharon oubanayv ét kol-haddebarim acher-tsivva Adonai beyad-mocheh
Vaabad aharon oubenohi yat kol pitgamayya di paqqid Adonai bida demcheh:
Vayehi bayyom hachchemini qara mocheh leaharon oulebanayv ouleziqné yisraél
Vahava beyoma teminaa qera mcheh leaharon velibnohi oulesabé yisraél:
Vayyomer el-aharon qakh-leka égel ben-baqar lekhattat veayil leola temimim vehaqréb lipné Adonai
Vaamar leaharon sab lak egal bar toré lekhattata oudekar laalata chalmin veqaréb qodam Adonai:
Veel-bené yisraél tedabbér lémor qekhou seir-izzim lekhattat veégel vakebes bené-chana temimim leola
Veim bené yisraél temallél lemémar sibou tsepir bar izzin lekhattata veégal veimmar bené chena chalmin laalata:
Vechor vaayil lichlamim lizboakh lipné Adonai ouminkha beloula bachchamen ki hayyom Adonai nira alékem
Vetor oudekar leniksat qoudechayya ledabbakha qodam Adonai ouminkhata depila bimchakh aré yoma dén yeqara daAdonai mitgeli lekon:
Vayyiqkhou ét acher tsivva mocheh el-pené ohel moéd vayyiqrebou kol-haéda vayyaamdou lipné Adonai
Ounesibou yat di paqqid mcheh loqodam machkan zimna ouqeribou kol kenichta veqamou qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer mocheh zeh haddabar acher-tsivva Adonai taasou veyéra alékem kebod Adonai
Vaamar mcheh dén pitgama di paqqid Adonai tabedoun veyitgeli lekon yeqara daAdonai:
Vayyomer mocheh el-aharon qerab el-hammizbéakh vaaséh et-khattateka veet-olateka vekappér baadka oubead haam vaaséh et-qorban haam vekappér baadam kaacher tsivva Adonai
Vaamar mcheh leaharon qerab lemadbekha veibéd yat khattatak veyat alatak vekappar alak veal amma veibéd yat qurban amma vekappar aléhon kema di paqqid Adonai:
Vayyiqrab aharon el-hammizbéakh vayyichkhat et-égel hakhattat acher-lo
Ouqeréb aharon lemadbekha ounekés yat egla dekhattata di léh:
Vayyaqribou bené aharon et-haddam élayv vayyitbol etsbao baddam vayyittén al-qarnot hammizbéakh veet-haddam yatsaq el-yesod hammizbéakh
Veqaribou bené aharon yat dema léh outebal etsbeéh bidma vihab al qarnat madbekha veyat dema ariq lisoda demadbekha:
Veet-hakhéleb veet-hakkelayot veet-hayyoteret min-hakkabéd min-hakhattat hiqtir hammizbékha kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veyat tarba veyat kaleyeta veyat khitsra min kabda min khattata asséq lemadbekha kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Veet-habbasar veet-haor sarap baéch mikhouts lammakhaneh
Veyat bisra veyat machka oqid benoura mibbara lemachrita:
Vayyichkhat et-haola vayyamtsiou bené aharon élayv et-haddam vayyizreqéhou al-hammizbéakh sabib
Ounekés yat alata veamtiou bené aharon léh yat dema ouzeraqéh al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Veet-haola himtsiou élayv lintakhéha veet-haroch vayyaqtér al-hammizbéakh
Veyat alata amtiou léh leébaraha veyat récha veasséq al madbekha:
Vayyirkhats et-haqqereb veet-hakkeraayim vayyaqtér al-haola hammizbékha
Vekhallil yat gavva veyat keraayya veasséq al alata lemadbekha:
Vayyaqréb ét qorban haam vayyiqqakh et-seir hakhattat acher laam vayyichkhatéhou vayekhatteéhou karichon
Veqaréb yat qurban amma ounesib yat tsepira dekhattata di leamma venakeséh vekappér bidméh keqadmaa:
Vayyaqréb et-haola vayyaaseha kammichpat
Veqaréb yat alata veabedah kidkhazé:
Vayyaqréb et-hamminkha vayemallé kappo mimmenna vayyaqtér al-hammizbéakh millebad olat habboqer
Veqaréb yat minkhata oumela yedéh minnah veasséq al madbekha bar méalat tsapra:
Vayyichkhat et-hachchor veet-haayil zebakh hachchelamim acher laam vayyamtsiou bené aharon et-haddam élayv vayyizreqéhou al-hammizbéakh sabib
Ounekés yat tora veyat dikra niksat qoudechayya di leamma veamtiou bené aharon yat dema léh ouzeraqéh al madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Veet-hakhalabim min-hachchor oumin-haayil haalya vehamekasseh vehakkelayot veyoteret hakkabéd
Veyat tarbayya min tora oumin dikra alita vekhapé gavva vekaleyeta vakhatsar kabda:
Vayyasimou et-hakhalabim al-hekhazot vayyaqtér hakhalabim hammizbékha
Vechavviou yat tarbayya al khedvata veasséq tarbayya lemadbekha:
Veét hekhazot veét choq hayyamin hénip aharon tenoupa lipné Adonai kaacher tsivva mocheh
Veyat khedvata veyat choqa deyammina arém aharon arama qodam Adonai kema di paqqid mcheh:
Vayyissa aharon et-yadav el-haam vayebarekém vayyéred méasot hakhattat vehaola vehachchelamim
Vaarém aharon yat yedohi al amma oubarékinnoun ounekhat millemebad khattata vaalata veniksat qoudechayya:
Vayyabo mocheh veaharon el-ohel moéd vayyétseou vayebarekou et-haam vayyéra kebod-Adonai el-kol-haam
Veal mcheh veaharon lemachkan zimna ounepaqou oubarikou yat amma veitgeli yeqara daAdonai lekol amma:
Vattétsé éch millipné Adonai vattokal al-hammizbéakh et-haola veet-hakhalabim vayyar kol-haam vayyaronnou vayyippelou al-penéhem
Ounepaqat echchata min qodam Adonai vaakalat al madbekha yat alata veyat tarbayya vakhaza kol amma vechabbakhou ounepalou al appéhon:
Vayyiqkhou bené-aharon nadab vaabihou ich makhtato vayyittenou bahén éch vayyasimou aléha qetoret vayyaqribou lipné Adonai éch zara acher lo tsivva otam
Ounesibou bené aharon nadab vaabihou gebar makhtitéh vihabou behon echchata vechavviou alah qetoret veqaribou qodam Adonai echchata noukeréta di la paqqid yatehon:
Vattétsé éch millipné Adonai vattokal otam vayyamoutou lipné Adonai
Ounepaqat echchata min qodam Adonai vaakalat yatehon oumitou qodam Adonai:
Vayyomer mocheh el-aharon hou acher-dibber Adonai lémor biqrobay eqqadéch veal-pené kol-haam ekkabéd vayyiddom aharon
Vaamar mcheh leaharon hou di mallil Adonai lemémar beqaribay itqaddach veal appé kol amma ityaqqar ouchetiq aharon:
Vayyiqra mocheh el-michaél veel eltsapan bené uzziél dod aharon vayyomer aléhem qirbou seou et-akhékem méét pené-haqqodech el-mikhouts lammakhaneh
Ouqera mcheh lemichaél ouleeltsapan bené uzziél akh abouhi deaharon vaamar lehon qeribou toulou yat akhoukon min qodam appé qoudecha lemibbara lemachrita:
Vayyiqrebou vayyissaoum bekuttonotam el-mikhouts lammakhaneh kaacher dibber mocheh
Ouqeribou ounetalunnoun bekittunnéhon lemibbara lemachrita kema di mallil mcheh:
Vayyomer mocheh el-aharon ouleelazar ouleitamar banayv rachékem al-tipraou oubigdékem lo-tipromou velo tamoutou veal kol-haéda yiqtsop vaakhékem kol-bét yisraél yibkou et-hasserépa acher sarap Adonai

Vaamar mcheh leaharon ouleelazar ouleitamar benohi réchékon la terabboun péroua oulebouchékon la tebazzeoun vela temoutoun veal kol kenichta yehé rougeza vaakhékon kol bét yisraél yibkoun yat yeqidta di oqid Adonai:
Oumippetakh ohel moéd lo tétseou pen-tamoutou ki-chemen michkhat Adonai alékem vayyaasou kidbar mocheh
Oumittera machkan zimna la tippeqoun dilema temoutoun aré mechakh rebouta daAdonai alékon vaabadou kepitgama demcheh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-aharon lémor
Oumallil Adonai leaharon lemémar:
Yayin vechékar al-técht atta oubanéka ittak beboakem el-ohel moéd velo tamoutou khuqqat olam ledorotékem
Khamar oumeravvé la tichté at oubenayk immak beméalkon lemachkan zimna vela temoutoun qeyam alam ledarékon:
Oulehabdil bén haqqodech oubén hakhol oubén hattamé oubén hattahor
Ouleapracha bén qoudecha oubén khulla oubén mesaaba oubén dakya:
Oulehorot et-bené yisraél ét kol-hakhuqqim acher dibber Adonai aléhem beyad-mocheh
Ouleallapa yat bené yisraél yat kol qeyamayya di mallil Adonai lehon bida demcheh:
Vayedabbér mocheh el-aharon veel elazar veel-itamar banayv hannotarim qekhou et-hamminkha hannoteret méichché Adonai veiklouha matstsot étsel hammizbéakh ki qodech qodachim hiv
Oumallil mcheh im aharon veim elazar veim itamar benohi deichtaarou sibou yat minkhata deichtaarat miqqurbanayya daAdonai veiklouha pattir bistar madbekha aré qodech qoudechin hi:
Vaakaltem otah bemaqom qadoch ki khoqka vekhoq-banéka hiv méichché Adonai ki-kén tsuvvéti
Vetékeloun yatah baatar qaddich aré kholaqak vokholaq benayk hi miqqurbanayya daAdonai aré kén itpaqqadit:
Veét khazéh hattenoupa veét choq hatterouma tokelou bemaqom tahor atta oubanéka oubenotéka ittak ki-khoqka vekhoq-banéka nittenou mizzibkhé chalmé bené yisraél
Veyat khedya daaramouta veyat choqa deaprachouta tékeloun baatar deké at oubenayk oubenatayk immak aré kholaqak vokholaq benayk ityehibou minniksat qoudechayya dibné yisraél:
Choq hatterouma vakhazéh hattenoupa al ichché hakhalabim yabiou lehanip tenoupa lipné Adonai vehaya leka oulebanéka itteka lekhoq-olam kaacher tsivva Adonai
Choqa deaprachouta vekhedya daaramouta al qurbané tarbayya yaytoun laarama arama qodam Adonai vihé lak velibnayk immak liqyam alam kema di paqqid Adonai:
Veét seir hakhattat daroch darach mocheh vehinnéh sorap vayyiqtsop al-elazar veal-itamar bené aharon hannotarim lémor
Veyat tsepira dekhattata mitba tabeé mcheh veha ittoqad ouregéz al elazar veal itamar bené aharon deichtaarou lemémar:
Maddoua lo-akaltem et-hakhattat bimqom haqqodech ki qodech qodachim hiv veotah natan lakem lasét et-avon haéda lekappér aléhem lipné Adonai
Madén la akaltoun yat khattata baatar qaddich aré qodech qoudechin hi veyatah yahéb lekon lesallakha al khobé kenichta lekappara aléhon qodam Adonai:
Hén lo-hvba et-damah el-haqqodech penima akol tokelou otah baqqodech kaacher tsivvéti
Ha la ittaal yat demah lebét qudcha gavvaa mékal tékeloun yatah bequdcha kema di paqqédit:
Vayedabbér aharon el-mocheh hén hayyom hiqribou et-khattatam veet-olatam lipné Adonai vattiqrena oti kaélleh veakalti khattat hayyom hayyitab beéné Adonai
Oumallil aharon im mcheh ha yoma dén qaribou yat khattatehon veyat alatehon qodam Adonai vaaraa yati aqan keillén veilloupon akalit khattata yoma dén hataqqén qodam Adonai:
Vayyichma mocheh vayyitab beénayv
Ouchema mcheh ouchepar beénohi:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh veel-aharon lémor aléhem
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh ouleaharon lemémar lehon:
Dabberou el-bené yisraél lémor zot hakhayya acher tokelou mikkol-habbehéma acher al-haarets
Mallilou im bené yisraél lemémar da khayta di tékeloun mikkol beira di al ara:
Kol mapreset parsa vechosaat chesa perasot maalat géra babbehéma otah tokélou
Kol di sediqan parsata oumattilpan tilpin parsata masseqa pichra bibira yatah tékeloun:
Ak et-zeh lo tokelou mimmaalé haggéra oumimmaprisé happarsa et-haggamal ki-maaléh géra hou ouparsa énennou mapris tamé hou lakem
Beram yat dén la tékeloun mimmasseqé pichra oumimmasdiqé parsata yat gamla aré massiq pichra hou ouparsata la sediqa mesaab hou lekon:
Veet-hachchapan ki-maaléh géra hou ouparsa lo yapris tamé hou lakem
Veyat tapza aré massiq pichra hou ouparsata la sediqa mesaab hou lekon:
Veet-haarnebet ki-maalat géra hiv ouparsa lo hiprisa teméa hiv lakem
Veyat arneba aré masseqa pichra hi ouparsata la sediqa mesaaba hi lekon:
Veet-hakhazir ki-mapris parsa hou vechosa chesa parsa vehou géra lo-yiggar tamé hou lakem
Veyat khazira aré sediq parsata hou oumattilepan tilpin parsatéh vehou pichra la pachar mesaab hou lekon:
Mibbesaram lo tokélou oubeniblatam lo tiggaou teméim hém lakem
Mibbisrehon la tékeloun oubinbiltehon la tiqreboun mesaabin innoun lekon:
Et-zeh tokelou mikkol acher bammayim kol acher-lo senappir veqasqeset bammayim bayyammim oubannekhalim otam tokélou
Yat dén tékeloun mikkol di bemayya kol di léh tsitsin veqalpin bemayya beyamemayya oubenakhalayya yatehon tékeloun:
Vekol acher én-lo senappir veqasqeset bayyammim oubannekhalim mikkol cherets hammayim oumikkol nepech hakhayya acher bammayim cheqets hém lakem
Vekol di lét léh tsitsin veqalpin beyammayya oubenakhalayya mikkol rikhacha demayya oumikkal napcha khayta di bemayya chiqtsa innoun lekon:
Vecheqets yihyou lakem mibbesaram lo tokélou veet-niblatam techaqqétsou
Vechiqtsa yehon lekon mibbisrehon la tékeloun veyat nebiltehon techaqqetsoun:
Kol acher én-lo senappir veqasqeset bammayim cheqets hou lakem
Kol di lét léh tsitsin veqalpin bemayya chiqtsa hou lekon:
Veet-élleh techaqqetsou min-haop lo yéoklou cheqets hém et-hannecher veet-happeres veét haozniyya
Veyat illén tachaqqetsoun min opa la yitakloun chiqtsa innoun nichra vear veazya:
Veet-haddaa veet-haayya leminah
Vedayta vetarapita liznah:
ét kol-oréb lemino
Yat kol oureba liznéh:
Veét bat hayyaana veet-hattakhmas veet-hachchakhap veet-hannéts leminéhou
Veyat bat naamita vetsitsa vetsippar chakhpa venatsa liznohi:
Veet-hakkos veet-hachchalak veet-hayyanchoup
Veqarya vechalénouna veqippopa:
Veet-hattinchemet veet-haqqaat veet-harakham
Oubavta veqata viraqréqa:
Veét hakhasida haanapa leminah veet-haddoukipat veet-haatallép
Vekhavvarita veibbou liznah venaggar toura vaatallépa:
Kol cherets haop haholék al-arba cheqets hou lakem
Kol rikhacha deopa dimhallék al arba chiqtsa hou lekon:
Ak et-zeh tokelou mikkol cherets haop haholék al-arba acher-lo keraayim mimmaal leraglayv lenattér bahén al-haarets
Beram yat dén tékeloun mikkol rikhacha deopa dimhallék al arba di léh qartsoulin méillavé raglohi leqappatsa behon al ara:
Et-élleh méhem tokélou et-haarbeh lemino veet-hassolam leminéhou veet-hakhargol leminéhou veet-hekhagab leminéhou
Yat illén minnehon tékeloun yat goba liznah veyat rachouna liznohi veyat khargola liznohi veyat khagaba liznohi:
Vekol cherets haop acher-lo arba raglayim cheqets hou lakem
Vekol rikhacha deopa di léh arba raglin chiqtsa hou lekon:
Ouleélleh tittammaou kol-hannogéa beniblatam yitma ad-haareb
Ouleillén tistaaboun kol deyiqrab binbiltehon yehé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vekol-hannosé minniblatam yekabbés begadayv vetamé ad-haareb
Vekol deyitol minnebiltehon yetsabba lebouchohi vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Lekol-habbehéma acher hiv mapreset parsa vechesa énenna chosaat vegéra énenna maala teméim hém lakem kol-hannogéa bahem yitma
Lekol beira di hi sediqa parsata vetilpin létaha mattilpa oupichra létaha masseqa mesaabin innoun lekon kol deyiqrab behon yehé mesaab:
Vekol holék al-kappayv bekol-hakhayya haholeket al-arba teméim hém lakem kol-hannogéa beniblatam yitma ad-haareb
Vekol dimhallék al yedohi bekol khayta dimhaleka al arba mesaabin innoun lekon kol deyiqrab binbiltehon yehé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vehannosé et-niblatam yekabbés begadayv vetamé ad-haareb teméim hémma lakem
Oudeyittol yat nebiltehon yetsabba lebouchohi vihé mesaab ad ramcha mesaabin innoun lekon:
Vezeh lakem hattamé bachcherets hachchoréts al-haarets hakholed vehaakbar vehatstsab leminéhou
Vedén lekon mesaaba berikhacha derakhéch al ara khulda veakbara vetsaba liznohi:
Vehaanaqa vehakkoakh vehalletaa vehakhomet vehattinchamet
Veyala vekokha vekhultéta vekhumta veachouta:
élleh hatteméim lakem bekol-hachcharets kol-hannogéa bahem bemotam yitma ad-haareb
Illén dimsaabin lekon bekol rikhacha kol deyiqrab behon bemotehon yehé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vekol acher-yippol-alayv méhem bemotam yitma mikkol-keli-éts o beged o-or o saq kol-keli acher-yéaseh melaka bahem bammayim youba vetamé ad-haereb vetahér
Vekol di yippél alohi minnehon bemotehon yehé mesaab mikkol man deaa o lebouch o mechak o saq kol man di titabéd ibida behon bemayya yittaal vihé mesaab ad ramcha veyidké:
Vekol-keli-kheres acher-yippol méhem el-toko kol acher betoko yitma veoto tichborou
Vekol man dakhasap di yippél minnehon legavvéh kol di begavvéh yistaab veyatéh tetabberoun:
Mikkol-haokel acher yéakél acher yabo alayv mayim yitma vekol-machqeh acher yichchateh bekol-keli yitma
Mikkol mékela demitakél di yaaloun alohi mayya yehé mesaab vekol machqéh di yichtété bekol man yehé mesaab:
Vekol acher-yippol minniblatam alayv yitma tannour vekirayim yuttats teméim hém outeméim yihyou lakem
Vekol di yippél minnebiltehon alohi yehé mesaab tannour vekirayim yittareoun mesaabin innoun oumesaabin yehon lekon:
Ak mayan oubor miqvéh-mayim yihyeh tahor venogéa beniblatam yitma
Beram mayan vegob bét kenichout mayya yehé deké oudeyiqrab binbiltehon yehé mesaab:
Veki yippol minniblatam al-kol-zera zéroua acher yizzaréa tahor hou
Vaaré yippél minnebiltehon al kol bar zera zéroua di yizdera deké hou:
Veki yuttan-mayim al-zera venapal minniblatam alayv tamé hou lakem
Vaaré yityahaboun mayya al bar zara veyippél minnebiltehon alohi mesaab hou lekon:
Veki yamout min-habbehéma acher-hi lakem leokla hannogéa beniblatah yitma ad-haareb
Vaaré yemout min beira di hi lekon lemékal deyiqrab binbiltah yehé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vehaokél minniblatah yekabbés begadayv vetamé ad-haareb vehannosé et-niblatah yekabbés begadayv vetamé ad-haareb
Oudeyékoul minnebiltah yetsabba lebouchohi vihé mesaab ad ramcha oudeyittol yat nebiltah yetsabba lebouchohi vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vekol-hachcherets hachchoréts al-haarets cheqets hou lo yéakél
Vekol rikhacha derakhéch al ara chiqtsa hou la yitakél:
Kol holék al-gakhon vekol holék al-arba ad kol-marbéh raglayim lekol-hachcherets hachchoréts al-haarets lo tokeloum ki-cheqets hém
Kol dimhallék al meohi vekol dimhallék al arba ad kol segiout raglain lekol rikhacha derakhéch al ara la tékelunnoun aré chiqtsa innoun:
Al-techaqqetsou et-napchotékem bekol-hachcherets hachchoréts velo tittammeou bahem venitmétem bam
La techaqqetsou yat napchatékon bekol rikhacha derakhéch vela tistaaboun behon vetistaaboun pon behon:
Ki ani Adonai élohékem vehitqaddichtem vihyitem qedochim ki qadoch ani velo tetammeou et-napchotékem bekol-hachcherets haromés al-haarets
Aré ana Adonai élahakon vetitqaddechoun outehon qaddichin aré qaddich ana vela tesaaboun yat napchatékon bekol rikhacha derakhéch al ara:
Ki ani Adonai hammaaleh etkem méerets mitsrayim lihyot lakem lélohim vihyitem qedochim ki qadoch ani
Aré ana Adonai deasséq yatekon méara demitsrayim lemehévé lekon leélah outehon qaddichin aré qaddich ana:
Zot torat habbehéma vehaop vekol nepech hakhayya haromeset bammayim oulekol-nepech hachchoretset al-haarets
Da orayta dibira oudeopa oudekol napchata khayta dirkhécha bemayya oulekal napcha dirkhécha al ara:
Lehabdil bén hattamé oubén hattahor oubén hakhayya hanneékelet oubén hakhayya acher lo téakél
Leapracha bén mesaaba oubén dakya oubén khayta demitakla oubén khayta di la mitakla:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél lémor ichcha ki tazria veyaleda zakar vetamea chibat yamim kimé niddat devotah titma
Mallél im bené yisraél lemémar itteta aré teaddi outelid dekar outehé mesaaba chibat yomin keyomé rikhouq sobetah tehé mesaaba:
Oubayyom hachchemini yimmol besar orlato
Oubeyoma teminaa yigzar bisra deorletéh:
Ouchelochim yom ouchelochet yamim téchéb bidmé tohora bekol-qodech lo-tigga veel-hammiqdach lo tabo ad-melot yemé tohorah
Outelatin outelata yomin tétéb bedam dekou bekol qoudecha la tiqrab oulemiqdecha la téol ad michlam yomé dakoutah:
Veim-neqéba téléd vetamea chebuayim keniddatah vechichchim yom vechéchet yamim téchéb al-demé tohora
Veim neqoubeta telid outehé mesaaba arbea asar kerikhouqah vechittin vechitta yomin tétéb al dam dekou:
Oubimlot yemé tohorah lebén o lebat tabi kebes ben-chenato leola ouben-yona o-tor lekhattat el-petakh ohel-moéd el-hakkohén
Oubemichlam yomé dakoutah libra o libratta tayti immar bar chattéh laalata oubar yona o chapnina lekhattata litra machkan zimna levat kahana:
Vehiqribo lipné Adonai vekipper aléha vetahara mimmeqor daméha zot torat hayyoledet lazzakar o lanneqéba
Viqarebinnéh qodam Adonai vikappér alah vetidké missoabat demaha da orayta deyalledta ledoukera o linqubta:
Veim-lo timtsa yadah dé seh velaqekha cheté-torim o chené bené yona ekhad leola veekhad lekhattat vekipper aléha hakkohén vetahéra
Veim la tachkakh yedah kemissat immera vetissab tartén chapninin o terén bené yona khad laalata vekhad lekhattata vikappér alah kahana vetidké:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh veel-aharon lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh veim aharon lemémar:
Adam ki-yihyeh beor-besaro seét o-sappakhat o baheret vehaya beor-besaro lenega tsaraat vehouba el-aharon hakkohén o el-akhad mibbanayv hakkohanim
énach aré yehé bimchak bisréh amqa o adya o bahara vihé bimchak bisréh lemaktach segirou veyittété levat aharon kahana o levat khad mibbenohi kahanayya:
Veraa hakkohén et-hannega beor-habbasar veséar bannega hapak laban oumaréh hannega amoq méor besaro nega tsaraat hou veraahou hakkohén vetimmé oto
Veyekhézé kahana yat maktacha bimchak bisra veséar bemaktacha ithapik lemekhévar oumekhézé maktacha ammiq bimchak bisréh maktach segirouta hou veyekhézinnéh kahana visaéb yatéh:
Veim-baheret lebana hiv beor besaro veamoq én-mareha min-haor ouseara lo-hapak laban vehisgir hakkohén et-hannega chibat yamim
Veim bahara khavvera hi bimchak bisréh veammiq lét mekhézaha min machka ouseara la ithapik lemekhévar veyasgar kahana yat maktacha chiba yomin:
Veraahou hakkohén bayyom hachchebii vehinnéh hannega amad beénayv lo-pasa hannega baor vehisgiro hakkohén chibat yamim chénit
Veyekhézinnéh kahana beyoma chebiaa veha maktecha qam kad hava la osép maktacha bemachka veyasgerinnéh kahana chiba yomin tinyanout:
Veraa hakkohén oto bayyom hachchebii chénit vehinnéh kéha hannega velo-pasa hannega baor vetiharo hakkohén mispakhat hiv vekibbes begadayv vetahér
Veyekhézé kahana yatéh beyoma chebiaa tinyanout veha amya maktacha vela osép maktacha bemachka vidakkinnéh kahana adita hi vitsabba lebouchohi veyidké:
Veim-pasoh tipseh hammispakhat baor akharé héraoto el-hakkohén letohorato venira chénit el-hakkohén
Veim osapa tosép adita bemachka batar diittakhazi lekahana ledakkoutéh veyittakhazi tinyanout lekahana:
Veraa hakkohén vehinnéh paseta hammispakhat baor vetimmeo hakkohén tsaraat hiv
Veyekhézé kahana veha osépat adita bemachka visaébinnéh kahana segirouta hi:
Nega tsaraat ki tihyeh beadam vehouba el-hakkohén
Maktach segirou aré tehé beénacha veyittété levat kahana:
Veraa hakkohén vehinnéh seét-lebana baor vehi hapeka séar laban oumikheyat basar khay basét
Veyekhézé kahana veha amqa khavvera bemachka vehi hapakat séar lekhivvar verchem bisra khayta beammiqta:
Tsaraat nochenet hiv beor besaro vetimmeo hakkohén lo yasgirennou ki tamé hou
Segirout attiqa hi bimchak bisréh visaébinnéh kahana la yasgerinéh aré mesaab hou:
Veim-paroakh tiprakh hatstsaraat baor vekisseta hatstsaraat ét kol-or hannega mérocho vead-raglayv lekol-maréh éné hakkohén
Veim misga tisgé segirouta bemachka vetakhapé segirouta yat kol mechak maktacha méréchéh vead raglohi lekol khézou éné kahana:
Veraa hakkohén vehinnéh kisseta hatstsaraat et-kol-besaro vetihar et-hannaga kullo hapak laban tahor hou
Veyekhézé kahana veha khapat segirouta yat kol bisréh vidakki yat maktacha kulléh ithapik lemekhévar deké hou:
Oubeyom héraot bo basar khay yitma
Oubeyoma deittakhazi béh bisra khayya yehé mesaab:
Veraa hakkohén et-habbasar hakhay vetimmeo habbasar hakhay tamé hou tsaraat hou
Veyekhézé kahana yat bisra khayya visaébinnéh bisra khayya mesaab hou segirout hou:
O ki yachoub habbasar hakhay venehpak lelaban ouba el-hakkohén
O aré yetoub bisra khayya veyithapik lemekhévar veyittété levat kahana:
Veraahou hakkohén vehinnéh nehpak hannega lelaban vetihar hakkohén et-hannega tahor hou
Veyekhézinnéh kahana veha ithapik maktacha lemekhévar vidakké kahana yat maktacha deké hou:
Oubasar ki-yihyeh bo-beoro chekhin venirpa
Oubisra aré yehé béh bemachkéh chikhana veyittassé:
Vehaya bimqom hachchekhin seét lebana o baheret lebana adamdamet venira el-hakkohén
Vihé baatar chikhana amqa khavvera o bahara khavvera samqa veyittakhazi lekahana:
Veraa hakkohén vehinnéh mareha chapal min-haor ousearah hapak laban vetimmeo hakkohén nega-tsaraat hiv bachchekhin parakha
Veyekhézé kahana veha mekhézaha makkik min machka ousearah ithapik lemekhévar visaébinéh kahana maktach segirouta hi bechikhana segiat:
Veim yirenna hakkohén vehinnéh én-bah séar laban ouchepala énenna min-haor vehi kéha vehisgiro hakkohén chibat yamim
Veim yekhézinnah kahana veha lét bah séar khivvar oumakkika létaha min machka vehi ameya veyasgerinnéh kahana chiba yomin:
Veim-pasoh tipseh baor vetimmé hakkohén oto nega hiv
Veim osapa tosép bemachka visaéb kahana yatéh maktacha hi:
Veim-takhtéha taamod habbaheret lo pasata tsarebet hachchekhin hiv vetiharo hakkohén
Veim beatraha qamat beharta la osépat rchem chikhana hi vidakkinnéh kahana:
O basar ki-yihyeh beoro mikvat-éch vehayeta mikheyat hammikva baheret lebana adamdemet o lebana
O bisra aré yehé bemachkéh kevaa denour outehé rchem kevaa bahara khavvera samqa o khavvera:
Veraa otah hakkohén vehinnéh nehpak séar laban babbaheret oumareha amoq min-haor tsaraat hiv bammikva parakha vetimmé oto hakkohén nega tsaraat hiv
Veyekhézé yatah kahana veha ithapik séar khivvar bebaherta oumekhézaha ammiq min machka segirouta hi bikvaa segia visaéb yatéh kahana maktach segirouta hi:
Veim yirenna hakkohén vehinnéh én-babbaheret séar laban ouchepala énenna min-haor vehiv kéha vehisgiro hakkohén chibat yamim
Veim yekhézinnah kahana veha lét bebaherta séar khivvar oumakkika létaha min machka vehi ameya veyasgrinnéh kahana chiba yomin:
Veraahou hakkohén bayyom hachchebii im-pasoh tipseh baor vetimmé hakkohén oto nega tsaraat hiv
Veyekhézinnéh kahana beyoma chebiaa im osapa tosép bemachka visaéb kahana yatéh maktach segirouta hi:
Veim-takhtéha taamod habbaheret lo-paseta baor vehiv kéha seét hammikva hiv vetiharo hakkohén ki-tsarebet hammikva hiv
Veim beatraha qamat baherta la osépat bemachka vehi ameya omeq kevaa hi vidakkinnéh kahana aré rchem kevaa hi:
Veich o ichcha ki-yihyeh bo naga beroch o bezaqan
Ougebar o itteta aré yehé béh maktacha berécha o bidqan:
Veraa hakkohén et-hannega vehinnéh maréhou amoq min-haor oubo séar tsahob daq vetimmé oto hakkohén neteq hou tsaraat haroch o hazzaqan hou
Veyekhézé kahana yat maktacha veha mekhézohi ammiq min machka oubéh séar summaq dadaq visaéb yatéh kahana nitqa hou segirout récha o diqna hou:
Veki-yireh hakkohén et-nega hanneteq vehinnéh én-maréhou amoq min-haor veséar chakhor én bo vehisgir hakkohén et-nega hanneteq chibat yamim
Vaaré yekhézé kahana yat maktach nitqa veha lét mekhézohi ammiq min machka veséar ukkam lét béh veyasgar kahana yat maktach nitqa chibat yomin:
Veraa hakkohén et-hannega bayyom hachchebii vehinnéh lo-pasa hanneteq velo-haya bo séar tsahob oumaréh hanneteq én amoq min-haor
Veyekhézé kahana yat maktacha beyoma chebiaa veha la osép nitqa vela hava béh séar summaq oumekhézé nitqa lét ammiq min machka:
Vehitgallakh veet-hanneteq lo yegalléakh vehisgir hakkohén et-hanneteq chibat yamim chénit
Vigallakh sokhorané nitqa oudeim nitqa la yegallakh veyasgar kahana yat nitqa chiba yomin tinyanout:
Veraa hakkohén et-hanneteq bayyom hachchebii vehinnéh lo-pasa hanneteq baor oumaréhou énennou amoq min-haor vetihar oto hakkohén vekibbes begadayv vetahér
Veyekhézé kahana yat nitqa beyoma chebiaa veha la osép nitqa bemachka oumekhézohi létohi ammiq min machka vidakké yatéh kahana vitsabba lebouchohi veyidké:
Veim-pasoh yipseh hanneteq baor akharé tohorato
Veim osapa yosép nitqa bemachka batar dakoutéh:
Veraahou hakkohén vehinnéh pasa hanneteq baor lo-yebaqqér hakkohén lasséar hatstsahob tamé hou
Veyekhézinnéh kahana veha osép nitqa bemachka la yebaqqér kahana leséar summaq mesaab hou:
Veim-beénayv amad hanneteq veséar chakhor tsamakh-bo nirpa hanneteq tahor hou vetiharo hakkohén
Veim kad hava qam nitqa veséar ukkam tsemakh béh ittassi nitqa deké hou vidakkinnéh kahana:
Veich o-ichcha ki-yihyeh beor-besaram beharot beharot lebanot
Ougebar o itteta aré yehé bimchak bisrehon baharan baharan khavveran:
Veraa hakkohén vehinnéh beor-besaram beharot kéhot lebanot bohaq hou parakh baor tahor hou
Veyekhézé kahana veha bimchak bisrehon baharan ameyan khavveran bahaqa hou sagé bemachka deké hou:
Veich ki yimmarét rocho qéréakh hou tahor hou
Ougebar aré yattar sear réchéh qerakh hou deké hou:
Veim mippeat panayv yimmarét rocho gibbéakh hou tahor hou
Veim milloqobél appohi yattar sear réchéh geloch hou deké hou:
Veki-yihyeh baqqarakhat o baggabbakhat nega laban adamdam tsaraat porakhat hiv beqarakhto o begabbakhto
Vaaré yehé beqarakhoutéh o biglochoutéh maktach khivvar sammoq segirout sageya hi beqarakhoutéh o biglochoutéh:
Veraa oto hakkohén vehinnéh seét-hannega lebana adamdemet beqarakhto o begabbakhto kemaréh tsaraat or basar
Veyekhézé yatéh kahana veha ammiq maktacha khavvera sammeqa beqarakhoutéh o biglochoutéh kemekhézé segirouta mechak bisra:
Ich-tsaroua hou tamé hou tammé yetammeennou hakkohén berocho nigo
Gebar segir hou mesaab hou sooba yesaébinnéh kahana beréchéh maktachéh:
Vehatstsaroua acher-bo hannega begadayv yihyou perumim verocho yihyeh paroua veal-sapam yateh vetamé tamé yiqra
Ousegira di béh maktacha lebouchohi yehon mebazzein veréchéh yehé peria veal sapam kaabéla yitattap vela tistaaboun vela tistaaboun yiqré:
Kol-yemé acher hannega bo yitma tamé hou badad yéchéb mikhouts lammakhaneh mochabo
Kol yomé di maktacha béh yehé mesaab mesaab hou bilkhodohi yétéb mibbara lemachrita motebéh:
Vehabbeged ki-yihyeh bo nega tsaraat bebeged tsemer o bebeged pichtim
Ouleboucha aré yehé béh maktach segirou bilbouch amar o bilbouch kittan:
O bicheti o beéreb lappichtim velatstsamer o beor o bekol-meleket or
O bechitya o bearba lekittana ouleamra o bemachka o bekol abidat mechak:
Vehaya hannega yeraqraq o adamdam babbeged o baor o-bachcheti o-baéreb o bekol-keli-or nega tsaraat hou vehora et-hakkohén
Vihé maktacha yaroq o sammoq bilboucha o bemachka o bechitya o bearba o bekal man dimchak maktach segirouta hou veyittakhazé lekahana:
Veraa hakkohén et-hannaga vehisgir et-hannega chibat yamim
Veyekhézé kahana yat maktacha veyasgar yat maktacha chibat yomin:
Veraa et-hannega bayyom hachchebii ki-pasa hannega babbeged o-bachcheti o-baéreb o baor lekol acher-yéaseh haor limlaka tsaraat mameret hannega tamé hou
Veyekhézé yat maktacha beyoma chebiaa aré osép maktacha bilboucha o bechitya o bearba o bemachka lekol di yitabéd machka leibida segirout mekhasra maktacha mesaab hou:
Vesarap et-habbeged o et-hachcheti o et-haéreb batstsemer o bappichtim o et-kol-keli haor acher-yihyeh bo hannaga ki-tsaraat mameret hiv baéch tissarép
Veyoqid yat leboucha o yat chitya o yat arba beamra o bekittana o yat kol man dimchak di yehé béh maktacha aré segirout mekhasra hi benoura tittoqad:
Veim yireh hakkohén vehinnéh lo-pasa hannega babbeged o bachcheti o baéreb o bekol-keli-or
Veim yekhézé kahana veha la osép maktacha bilboucha o bechitya o bearba o bekol man dimchak:
Vetsivva hakkohén vekibbesou ét acher-bo hannaga vehisgiro chibat-yamim chénit
Vipaqqéd kahana vikhavveroun yat di béh maktacha veyasgerinnéh chibat yomin tinyanout:
Veraa hakkohén akharé hukkabbés et-hannega vehinnéh lo-hapak hannega et-éno vehannega lo-pasa tamé hou baéch tisrepennou pekhetet hiv beqarakhto o begabbakhto
Veyekhézé kahana batar dekhavvarou yat maktacha veha la chena maktacha min kad hava oumaktacha la osép mesaab hou benoura toqedinnéh tabra hi bechekhiqoutéh o bekhaddatoutéh:
Veim raa hakkohén vehinnéh kéha hannega akharé hukkabbés oto veqara oto min-habbeged o min-haor o min-hachcheti o min-haéreb
Veim khaza kahana veha ameya maktacha batar dekhavvarou yatéh oubeza yatéh min leboucha o min machka o min chitya o min arba:
Veim-téraeh od babbeged o-bachcheti o-baéreb o bekol-keli-or porakhat hiv baéch tisrepennou ét acher-bo hannaga
Veim titkhazé od bilboucha o bechitya o bearba o bekal man dimchak sageya hi benoura toqedinnéh yat di béh maktacha:
Vehabbeged o-hachcheti o-haéreb o-kol-keli haor acher tekabbés vesar méhem hannaga vekubbas chénit vetahér
Ouleboucha o chitya o arba o kol man dimchak di yitkhavvar veyedé minnehon maktacha veyitstabba tinyanout veyidké:
Zot torat nega-tsaraat beged hatstsemer o happichtim o hachcheti o haéreb o kol-keli-or letaharo o letammeo
Da orayta demaktach segirou bilbouch amar o kittana o chitya o arba o kol man dimchak ledakkayoutéh o lesaaboutéh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Zot tiheyeh torat hammetsora beyom tohorato vehouba el-hakkohén
Da tehé orayta disgira biyoma dedakoutéh veyittété levat kahana:
Veyatsa hakkohén el-mikhouts lammakhaneh veraa hakkohén vehinnéh nirpa nega-hatstsaraat min-hatstsaroua
Veyippoq kahana lemibbara lemachrita veyekhézé kahana veha ittassi maktach segirouta min segira:
Vetsivva hakkohén velaqakh lammittahér cheté-tsipporim khayyot tehorot veéts erez oucheni tolaat veézob
Vipaqqéd kahana veyissab lemiddakké tartén tsipperin khayyin dokyan veaa dearza outseba zehori veézoba:
Vetsivva hakkohén vechakhat et-hatstsippor haekhat el-keli-kheres al-mayim khayyim
Vipaqqéd kahana veyikkos yat tsippera khada leman dakhasap al mé mabboua:
Et-hatstsippor hakhayya yiqqakh otah veet-éts haerez veet-cheni hattolaat veet-haézob vetabal otam veét hatstsippor hakhayya bedam hatstsippor hachchekhuta al hammayim hakhayyim
Yat tsippera khayta yissab yatah veyat aa dearza veyat tseba zehori veyat ézoba veyitbol yatehon veyat tsippera khayta bidma detsippera dinkisa al mé mabboua:
Vehizza al hammittahér min-hatstsaraat cheba peamim vetiharo vechillakh et-hatstsippor hakhayya al-pené hassadeh
Veyaddi al demiddakké min segirouta cheba zimnin vidakkinnéh vichallakh yat tsippera khayta al appé khaqla:
Vekibbes hammittahér et-begadayv vegillakh et-kol-searo verakhats bammayim vetahér veakhar yabo el-hammakhaneh veyachab mikhouts leoholo chibat yamim
Vitsabba demiddakké yat lebouchohi vigallakh yat kol saaréh veyaskhé bemayya veyidké oubatar kén yéol lemachrita vitéb mibbara lemachkenéh chaba yomin:
Vehaya bayyom hachchebii yegallakh et-kol-searo et-rocho veet-zeqano veét gabbot énayv veet-kol-searo yegalléakh vekibbes et-begadayv verakhats et-besaro bammayim vetahér
Vihé beyoma chebiaa yegallakh yat kol saaréh yat réchéh veyat diqnéh veyat gebiné énohi veyat kol saaréh yegallakh vitsabba yat lebouchohi veyaskhé yat bisréh bemayya veyidké:
Oubayyom hachchemini yiqqakh chené-kebasim temimim vekabsa akhat bat-chenatah temima ouchelocha esronim solet minkha beloula bachchemen velog ekhad chamen
Oubeyoma teminaa yissab terén immerin chalmin veimmarta khada bat chatta chelemta outelata esronin sulta minkhata depila bimchakh velugga khad demichkha:
Veheémid hakkohén hametahér ét haich hammittahér veotam lipné Adonai petakh ohel moéd
Viqim kahana dimdakké yat gabra demiddakké veyatehon qodam Adonai bitra machkan zimna:
Velaqakh hakkohén et-hakkebes haekhad vehiqrib oto leacham veet-log hachchamen vehénip otam tenoupa lipné Adonai
Veyissab kahana yat immera khada viqaréb yatéh laachama veyat lugga demichkha virim yatehon arama qodam Adonai:
Vechakhat et-hakkebes bimqom acher yichkhat et-hakhattat veet-haola bimqom haqqodech ki kakhattat haacham hou lakkohén qodech qodachim hou
Veyikkos yat immera baatar di yikkos yat khattata veyat alata baatar qaddich aré kekhattata achama hou lekahana qodech qoudechin hou:
Velaqakh hakkohén middam haacham venatan hakkohén al-tenouk ozen hammittahér hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Veyissab kahana middema daachama veyittén kahana al roum oudena demiddakké deyammina veal ilyon yedéh deyammina veal ilyon ragléh deyammina:
Velaqakh hakkohén millog hachchamen veyatsaq al-kap hakkohén hassemalit
Veyissab kahana millugga demichkha viriq al yeda dekahana dismala:
Vetabal hakkohén et-etsbao hayemanit min-hachchemen acher al-kappo hassemalit vehizza min-hachchemen beetsbao cheba peamim lipné Adonai
Veyitbol kahana yat etsbeéh deyammina min michkha di al yedéh dismala veyaddi min michkha beetsbeéh cheba zimnin qodam Adonai:
Oumiyyeter hachchemen acher al-kappo yittén hakkohén al-tenouk ozen hammittahér hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit al dam haacham
Oumichchear michkha di al yedéh yittén kahana al roum oudena demiddakké deyammina veal ilyon yedéh deyammina veal ilyon ragléh deyammina al dema daachama:
Vehannotar bachchemen acher al-kap hakkohén yittén al-roch hammittahér vekipper alayv hakkohén lipné Adonai
Oudeichtaar bemichkha di al yeda dekahana yittén al récha demiddakké vikappér alohi kahana qodam Adonai:
Veasa hakkohén et-hakhattat vekipper al-hammittahér mittumato veakhar yichkhat et-haola
Veyabéd kahana yat khattata vikappér al demiddakké mesobetéh oubatar kén yikkos yat alata:
Veheéla hakkohén et-haola veet-hamminkha hammizbékha vekipper alayv hakkohén vetahér
Veyasséq kahana yat alata veyat minkhata lemadbekha vikappér alohi kahana veyidké:
Veim-dal hou veén yado masseget velaqakh kebes ekhad acham litnoupa lekappér alayv veissaron solet ekhad baloul bachchemen leminkha velog chamen
Veim miskén hou velét yedéh madbeqa veyissab immar khad achama laarama lekappara alohi veisrona sulta khad depil bimchakh leminkha velugga demichkha:
Oucheté torim o chené bené yona acher tassig yado vehaya ekhad khattat vehaekhad ola
Vetartén chapninin o terén bené yona di tadbéq yedéh vihé khad khattata vekhad alata:
Vehébi otam bayyom hachchemini letohorato el-hakkohén el-petakh ohel-moéd lipné Adonai
Veyayti yatehon beyoma teminaa ledakkayoutéh levat kahana litra machkan zimna qodam Adonai:
Velaqakh hakkohén et-kebes haacham veet-log hachchamen vehénip otam hakkohén tenoupa lipné Adonai
Veyissab kahana yat immera daachama veyat lugga demichkha virim yatehon kahana arama qodam Adonai:
Vechakhat et-kebes haacham velaqakh hakkohén middam haacham venatan al-tenouk ozen-hammittahér hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Veyikkos yat immera daachama veyissab kahana middema daachama veyittén al roum oudena demiddakké deyammina veal ilyon yedéh deyammina veal ilyon ragléh deyammina:
Oumin-hachchemen yitsoq hakkohén al-kap hakkohén hassemalit
Oumin michkha yeriq kahana al yeda dekahana dismala:
Vehizza hakkohén beetsbao hayemanit min-hachchemen acher al-kappo hassemalit cheba peamim lipné Adonai
Veyaddi kahana beetsbeéh deyammina min michkha di al yedéh dismala cheba zimnin qodam Adonai:
Venatan hakkohén min-hachchemen acher al-kappo al-tenouk ozen hammittahér hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit al-meqom dam haacham
Veyittén kahana min michkha di al yedéh al roum oudena demiddakké deyammina veal ilyon yedéh deyammina veal ilyon ragléh deyammina al atar dema daachama:
Vehannotar min-hachchemen acher al-kap hakkohén yittén al-roch hammittahér lekappér alayv lipné Adonai
Oudeyichtaar min michkha di al yeda dekahana yittén al récha demiddakké lekappara alohi qodam Adonai:
Veasa et-haekhad min-hattorim o min-bené hayyona méacher tassig yado
Veyabéd yat khad min chapninayya o min bené yona middi tadbéq yedéh:
ét acher-tassig yado et-haekhad khattat veet-haekhad ola al-hamminkha vekipper hakkohén al hammittahér lipné Adonai
Yat di tadbéq yedéh yat khad khattata veyat khad alata al minkhata vikappér kahana al demiddakké qodam Adonai:
Zot torat acher-bo nega tsaraat acher lo-tassig yado betohorato
Da orayta di béh maktach segirou di la tadbéq yedéh bedakoutéh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh veel-aharon lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh veim aharon lemémar:
Ki taboou el-erets kenaan acher ani notén lakem laakhuzza venatatti nega tsaraat bebét erets akhuzzatkem
Aré téaloun leara diknaan di ana yahéb lekon leakhasana veettén maktach segirou bebét ara akhasnetekon:
Ouba acher-lo habbayit vehiggid lakkohén lémor kenega nira li babbayit
Veyété dediléh béta vikhavvi lekahana lemémar kemaktacha itkhazi li bebéta:
Vetsivva hakkohén oupinnou et-habbayit beterem yabo hakkohén lirot et-hannega velo yitma kol-acher babbayit veakhar kén yabo hakkohén lirot et-habbayit
Vipaqqéd kahana vipannoun yat béta ad la yéol kahana lemekhézé yat maktacha vela yistaab kol di bebéta oubatar kén yéol kahana lemekhézé yat béta:
Veraa et-hannega vehinnéh hannega beqirot habbayit cheqaarourot yeraqraqqot o adamdammot oumaréhen chapal min-haqqir
Veyekhézé yat maktacha veha maktacha bekatelé béta pakhatin yarqan o samqan oumekhézéhon makkik min katela:
Veyatsa hakkohén min-habbayit el-petakh habbayit vehisgir et-habbayit chibat yamim
Veyippoq kahana min béta litra béta veyasgar yat béta chiba yomin:
Vechab hakkohén bayyom hachchebii veraa vehinnéh pasa hannega beqirot habbayit
Vitoub kahana beyoma chebiaa veyekhézé veha osip maktacha bekatelé béta:
Vetsivva hakkohén vekhilletsou et-haabanim acher bahén hannaga vehichlikou ethen el-mikhouts lair el-maqom tamé
Vipaqqéd kahana vichallepoun yat abnayya di behon maktacha veyirmoun yatehon lemibbara leqarta laatar mesaab:
Veet-habbayit yaqtsia mibbayit sabib vechapekou et-heapar acher hiqtsou el-mikhouts lair el-maqom tamé
Veyat béta yeqallepoun miggayv sekhor sekhor veyirmoun yat apra di qallipou lemibbara leqarta laatar mesaab:
Velaqekhou abanim akhérot vehébiou el-takhat haabanim veapar akhér yiqqakh vetakh et-habbayit
Veyisseboun abnayya okhoranin veyaaloun laatar abnayya vaapar okhoran yissab vichoua yat béta:
Veim-yachoub hannega ouparakh babbayit akhar khilléts et-haabanim veakharé hiqtsot et-habbayit veakharé hittoakh
Veim yetoub maktacha veyisgé bebéta batar dechallipou yat abnayya oubatar deqallipou yat béta oubatar deittecha:
Ouba hakkohén veraa vehinnéh pasa hannega babbayit tsaraat mameret hiv babbayit tamé hou
Veyéol kahana veyekhézé veha osép maktacha bebéta segirout mekhasra hi bebéta mesaab hou:
Venatats et-habbayit et-abanayv veet-étsayv veét kol-apar habbayit vehotsi el-mikhouts lair el-maqom tamé
Vitara yat béta yat abnohi veyat aohi veyat kol apar béta veyappéq lemibbara leqarta laatar mesaab:
Vehabba el-habbayit kol-yemé hisgir oto yitma ad-haareb
Oudeyéol lebéta kol yomin deyasgar yatéh yehé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vehachchokéb babbayit yekabbés et-begadayv vehaokél babbayit yekabbés et-begadayv
Oudeyichkoub bebéta yetsabba yat lebouchohi oudeyékoul bebéta yetsabba yat lebouchohi:
Veim-bo yabo hakkohén veraa vehinnéh lo-pasa hannega babbayit akharé hittoakh et-habbayit vetihar hakkohén et-habbayit ki nirpa hannaga
Veim méal yéol kahana veyekhézé veha la osép maktacha bebéta batar deittecha yat béta vidakké kahana yat béta aré ittassi maktacha:
Velaqakh lekhatté et-habbayit cheté tsipporim veéts erez oucheni tolaat veézob
Veyissab ledakkaa yat béta tartén tsipperin veaa dearza outseba zehori veézoba:
Vechakhat et-hatstsippor haekhat el-keli-kheres al-mayim khayyim
Veyikkos yat tsippara khada leman dakhasap al mé mabboua:
Velaqakh et-éts-haerez veet-haézob veét cheni hattolaat veét hatstsippor hakhayya vetabal otam bedam hatstsippor hachchekhouta oubammayim hakhayyim vehizza el-habbayit cheba peamim
Veyissab yat aa dearza veyat ézoba veyat tseba zehori veyat tsippara khayta veyitbol yatehon bidma detsippara dinkisa oubemé mabboua veyaddi lebéta cheba zimnin:
Vekhitté et-habbayit bedam hatstsippor oubammayim hakhayyim oubatstsippor hakhayya oubeéts haerez oubaézob oubichni hattolaat
Vidakké yat béta bidma detsippara oubemé mabboua oubetsippara khayta oubeaa dearza oubeézoba oubitsba zehori:
Vechillakh et-hatstsippor hakhayya el-mikhouts lair el-pené hassadeh vekipper al-habbayit vetahér
Vichallakh yat tsippara khayta lemibbara leqarta leappé khaqla vikappar al béta veyidké:
Zot hattora lekol-nega hatstsaraat velannateq
Da orayta lekol maktach segirouta oulenitqa:
Ouletsaraat habbeged velabbayit
Velisgirout leboucha oulebéta:
Velasét velassappakhat velabbeharet
Ouleamqa ouleadya oulebahara:
Lehorot beyom hattamé oubeyom hattahor zot torat hatstsaraat
Leallapa beyoma mesaaba oubeyoma dakya da orayta disgirouta:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh veel-aharon lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh veim aharon lemémar:
Dabberou el-bené yisraél vaamartem aléhem ich ich ki yihyeh zab mibbesaro zobo tamé hou
Mallilou im bené yisraél vetémeroun lehon gebar gebar aré yehé daib mibbisréh dobéh mesaab hou:
Vezot tihyeh tumato bezobo rar besaro et-zobo o-hekhtim besaro mizzobo tumato hiv
Veda tehé sobetéh bedobéh rar bisréh yat dobéh o khatim bisréh middobéh sobetéh hi:
Kol-hammichkab acher yichkab alayv hazzab yitma vekol-hakkeli acher-yéchéb alayv yitma
Kol michkeba di yichkoub alohi dobana yehé mesaab vekol mana deyétéb alohi yehé mesaab:
Veich acher yigga bemichkabo yekabbés begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Ougebar di yiqrab bmichkebéh yetsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vehayyochéb al-hakkeli acher-yéchéb alayv hazzab yekabbés begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Oudeyétéb al mana deyétéb alohi dobana yetsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vehannogéa bibsar hazzab yekabbés begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Oudeyiqrab bibsar dobana yetsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Veki-yaroq hazzab battahor vekibbes begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Vaaré yéroq dobana bedakya vitsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vekol-hammerkab acher yirkab alayv hazzab yitma
Vekol merkeba di yirkoub alohi dobana yehé mesaab:
Vekol-hannogéa bekol acher yihyeh takhtayv yitma ad-haareb vehannosé otam yekabbés begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Vekol deyiqrab bekol di yehé tekhotohi yehé mesaab ad ramcha oudeyittol yatehon yetsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vekol acher yigga-bo hazzab veyadayv lo-chatap bammayim vekibbes begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Vekol di yiqrab béh dobana vidohi la chetap bemayya vitsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Oukeli-kheres acher-yigga-bo hazzab yichchabér vekol-keli-éts yichchatép bammayim
Ouman dakhasap di yiqrab béh dobana yittabar vekol man dea yichtattap bemayya:
Veki-yithar hazzab mizzobo vesapar lo chibat yamim letohorato vekibbes begadayv verakhats besaro bemayim khayyim vetahér
Vaaré yidké dobana middobéh veyimné léh chibat yomin ledakoutéh vitsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bisréh bemé mabboua veyidké:
Oubayyom hachchemini yiqqakh-lo cheté torim o chené bené yona ouba lipné Adonai el-petakh ohel moéd ounetanam el-hakkohén
Oubeyoma teminaa yissab léh tartén chapninin o terén bené yona veyété loqodam Adonai litra machkan zimna veyitteninnoun lekahana:
Veasa otam hakkohén ekhad khattat vehaekhad ola vekipper alayv hakkohén lipné Adonai mizzobo
Veyabéd yatehon kahana khad khattata vekhad alata vikappér alohi kahana qodam Adonai middobéh:
Veich ki-tétsé mimmennou chikbat-zara verakhats bammayim et-kol-besaro vetamé ad-haareb
Ougebar aré tippoq minnéh chikbat zara veyaskhé bemayya yat kol bisréh vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vekol-beged vekol-or acher-yihyeh alayv chikbat-zara vekubbas bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Vekol lebouch vekol mechak di yehé alohi chikbat zara veyitstabba bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Veichcha acher yichkab ich otah chikbat-zara verakhatsou bammayim vetameou ad-haareb
Veitteta di yichkoub gebar yatah chikbat zara veyaskhoun bemayya veyisaboun ad ramcha:
Veichcha ki-tihyeh zaba dam yihyeh zobah bibsarah chibat yamim tihyeh beniddatah vekol-hannogéa bah yitma ad-haareb
Veitteta aré tehé dayeba dam yehé dobah bebisrah chiba yomin tehé berikhouqah vekol deyiqrab bah yehé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vekol acher tichkab alayv beniddatah yitma vekol acher-téchéb alayv yitma
Vekol di tichkoub alohi berikhouqah yehé mesaab vekol di tétéb alohi yehé mesaab:
Vekol-hannogéa bemichkabah yekabbés begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Vekol deyiqrab bemichkebah yetsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Vekol-hannogéa bekol-keli acher-téchéb alayv yekabbés begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Vekol deyiqrab bekol mana di tétéb alohi yetsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Veim al-hammichkab hou o al-hakkeli acher-hiv yochebet-alayv benogo-bo yitma ad-haareb
Veim al michkeba hou o al mana di hi yateba alohi bemiqrebéh béh yehé mesaab ad ramcha:
Veim chakob yichkab ich otah outehi niddatah alayv vetamé chibat yamim vekol-hammichkab acher-yichkab alayv yitma
Veim michkab yichkoub gebar yatah outehé rikhouqah alohi vihé mesaab chibat yomin vekol michkeba di yichkoub alohi yehé mesaab:
Veichcha ki-yazoub zob damah yamim rabbim belo et-niddatah o ki-tazoub al-niddatah kol-yemé zob tumatah kimé niddatah tihyeh teméa hiv
Veitteta aré yedoub dob demah yomin saggiin bela iddan rikhouqah o aré tedoub al rikhouqah kol yomé dob sobetah keyoméh rikhouqah tehé mesooba hi:
Kol-hammichkab acher-tichkab alayv kol-yemé zobah kemichkab niddatah yiheyeh-lah vekol-hakkeli acher téchéb alayv tamé yihyeh ketumat niddatah
Kol michkeba di tichkoub alohi kol yomé dobah kemichkab rikhouqah yehé lah vekol mana di tétéb alohi mesaab yehé kesoabat rikhouqah:
Vekol-hannogéa bam yitma vekibbes begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haareb
Vekol deyiqrab behon yehé mesaab vitsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha:
Veim-tahara mizzobah vesapera lah chibat yamim veakhar tithar
Veim dekiat middobah vetimné lah chibat yomin oubatar kén tidké:
Oubayyom hachchemini tiqqakh-la cheté torim o chené bené yona vehébia otam el-hakkohén el-petakh ohel moéd
Oubeyoma teminaa tissab lah tartén chapninin o terén bené yona vetayti yatehon levat kahana litra machkan zimna:
Veasa hakkohén et-haekhad khattat veet-haekhad ola vekipper aléha hakkohén lipné Adonai mizzob tumatah
Veyabéd kahana yat khad khattata veyat khad alata vikappér alah kahana qodam Adonai middob sobetah:
Vehizzartem et-bené-yisraél mittumatam velo yamoutou betumatam betammeam et-michkani acher betokam
Vetaprechoun yat bené yisraél missoabathon vela yemoutoun besoabathon besaabehon yat machkeni di bénéhon:
Zot torat hazzab vaacher tétsé mimmennou chikbat-zera letoma-ba
Da orayta dedobena vedi tippoq minnéh chikbat zara leistaaba bah:
Vehaddava beniddatah vehazzab et-zobo lazzakar velanneqéba ouleich acher yichkab im-teméa
Velidsaoubeta berikhouqah veliddaib yat dobéh lidkar oulenuqba veligbar di yichkoub im mesaaba:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh akharé mot chené bené aharon beqorbatam lipné-Adonai vayyamoutou
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh batar demitou terén bené aharon beqarobéhon echchata noukeréta qodam Adonai oumitou:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh dabbér el-aharon akhika veal-yabo bekol-ét el-haqqodech mibbét lapparoket el-pené hakkapporet acher al-haaron velo yamout ki beanan éraeh al-hakkapporet
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh mallél im aharon akhouk vela yehé alél bekol iddan leqoudecha miggayv leparukta loqodam kappurta di al arona vela yemout aré baanana ana mitgeli al bét kappurta:
Bezot yabo aharon el-haqqodech bepar ben-baqar lekhattat veayil leola
Beda yehé alél aharon leqoudecha betor bar toré lekhattata oudekar laalata:
Ketonet-bad qodech yilbach oumikenesé-bad yihyou al-besaro oubeabnét bad yakhgor oubemitsnepet bad yitsnop bigdé-qodech hém verakhats bammayim et-besaro oulebécham

Kittouna deboutsa qoudecha yilbach oumiknesin debouts yehon al bisréh oubehemyana deboutsa yésar oubemitsnepta deboutsa yakhét beréchéh lebouché qoudecha innoun veyaskhé bemayya yat bisréh veyalbechinnoun:
Ouméét adat bené yisraél yiqqakh chené-seiré izzim lekhattat veayil ekhad leola
Oumin kenichta dibné yisraél yissab terén tsepiré izzin lekhattata oudekar khad laalata:
Vehiqrib aharon et-par hakhattat acher-lo vekipper baado oubead béto
Viqaréb aharon yat tora dekhattata di léh vikappér alohi veal énach bétéh:
Velaqakh et-chené hasseirim veheémid otam lipné Adonai petakh ohel moéd
Veyissab yat terén tsepirin viqim yatehon qodam Adonai bitra machkan zimna:
Venatan aharon al-chené hasseirim goralot goral ekhad la-Adonai vegoral ekhad laazazél
Veyittén aharon al terén tsepirin adbin adba khad lichma daAdonai veadba khad laazazél:
Vehiqrib aharon et-hassair acher ala alayv haggoral la-Adonai veasahou khattat
Viqaréb aharon yat tsepira di seliq alohi adba lichma daAdonai veyabidinéh khattata:
Vehassair acher ala alayv haggoral laazazél yoomad-khay lipné Adonai lekappér alayv lechallakh oto laazazél hammidbara
Outsepira di seliq alohi adba laazazél yittaqam kad khay qodam Adonai lekappara alohi lechallakh yatéh laazazél lemadbera:
Vehiqrib aharon et-par hakhattat acher-lo vekipper baado oubead béto vechakhat et-par hakhattat acher-lo
Viqaréb aharon yat tora dekhattata di léh vikappér alohi veal énach bétéh veyikkos yat tora dekhattata di léh:
Velaqakh melo-hammakhta gakhalé-éch méal hammizbéakh millipné Adonai oumelo khopnayv qetoret sammim daqqa vehébi mibbét lapparoket
Veyissab melé makhtita goumerin deechcha méillavé madbekha min qodam Adonai oumelé khopnohi qetoret bousemin daqqiqin veyaél miggayv leparukta:
Venatan et-haqqetoret al-haéch lipné Adonai vekissa anan haqqetoret et-hakkapporet acher al-haédout velo yamout
Veyittén yat qetoret bousemayya al echchata loqodam Adonai vekhapé anana qetareta yat kappurta di al sahadouta vela yemout:
Velaqakh middam happar vehizza beetsbao al-pené hakkapporet qédema velipné hakkapporet yazzeh cheba-peamim min-haddam beetsbao
Veyissab middema detora veyaddi beetsbeéh al appé kappurta qiddouma veloqodam kappurta yaddi cheba zimnin min dema beetsbeéh:
Vechakhat et-seir hakhattat acher laam vehébi et-damo el-mibbét lapparoket veasa et-damo kaacher asa ledam happar vehizza oto al-hakkapporet velipné hakkapporet
Veyikkos yat tsepira dekhattata di leamma veyaél yat deméh lemiggayv leparukta veyabéd lidméh kema di abad lidma detora veyaddi yatéh al kappurta veloqodam kappurta:
Vekipper al-haqqodech mittumot bené yisraél oumippichéhem lekol-khattotam vekén yaaseh leohel moéd hachchokén ittam betok tumotam
Vikappér al qoudecha missoabat bené yisraél oumimmerdéhon lekol khataéhon vekén yabéd lemachkan zimna decharé immehon bego soabatehon:
Vekol-adam lo-yihyeh beohel moéd beboo lekappér baqqodech ad-tséto vekipper baado oubead béto oubead kol-qehal yisraél
Vekol énach la yehé bemachkan zimna beméaléh lekappara beqoudecha ad mippeqéh vikappér alohi veal énach bétéh veal kol qehala deyisraél:
Veyatsa el-hammizbéakh acher lipné-Adonai vekipper alayv velaqakh middam happar oumiddam hassair venatan al-qarnot hammizbéakh sabib
Veyippoq lemadbekha di qodam Adonai vikappér alohi veyissab middema detora oumiddema ditspira veyittén al qarnat madbekha sekhor sekhor:
Vehizza alayv min-haddam beetsbao cheba peamim vetiharo veqiddecho mittumot bené yisraél
Veyaddé alohi min dema beetsbeéh cheba zimnin vidakkinnéh viqaddechinnéh missoabat bené yisraél:
Vekilla mikkappér et-haqqodech veet-ohel moéd veet-hammizbéakh vehiqrib et-hassair hekhay
Vichétsé millekappara al qoudecha veal machkan zimna veal madbekha viqaréb yat tsepira khayya:
Vesamak aharon et-cheté yadav al roch hassair hakhay vehitvadda alayv et-kol-avonot bené yisraél veet-kol-pichéhem lekol-khattotam venatan otam al-roch hassair vechillakh beyad-ich itti hammidbara

Veyismok aharon yat tartén yedohi al réch tsepira khayya veyivaddé alohi yat kol avayat bené yisraél veyat kol merdéhon lekol khataéhon veyittén yatehon al réch tsepira vichallakh beyad gebar dizmin limhak lemadbera:
Venasa hassair alayv et-kol-avonotam el-erets gezéra vechillakh et-hassair bammidbar
Veyittol tsepira alohi yat kol khobéhon leara dela yateba vichallakh yat tsepira bemadbera:
Ouba aharon el-ohel moéd oupachat et-bigdé habbad acher labach beboo el-haqqodech vehinnikham cham
Veyéol aharon lemachkan zimna veyachlakh yat lebouché boutsa di lebach beméaléh leqoudecha veyatsneinnoun tamman:
Verakhats et-besaro bammayim bemaqom qadoch velabach et-begadayv veyatsa veasa et-olato veet-olat haam vekipper baado oubead haam
Veyaskhé yat bisréh bemayya baatar qaddich veyilbach yat lebouchohi veyippoq veyabéd yat alatéh veyat alat amma vikappar alohi veal amma:
Veét khéleb hakhattat yaqtir hammizbékha
Veyat tarba dekhattata yasséq lemadbekha:
Vehamechalléakh et-hassair laazazél yekabbés begadayv verakhats et-besaro bammayim veakharé-kén yabo el-hammakhaneh
Oudemobil yat tsepira laazazél yetsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé yat bisréh bemayya oubatar kén yéol lemachrita:
Veét par hakhattat veét seir hakhattat acher houba et-damam lekappér baqqodech yotsi el-mikhouts lammakhaneh vesarepou baéch et-orotam veet-besaram veet-pircham
Veyat tora dekhattata veyat tsepira dekhattata di ittaal middimhon lekappara beqoudecha yittappeqoun lemibbara lemachrita veyoqedoun benoura yat machkéhon veyat bisrehon veyat okléhon:
Vehassorép otam yekabbés begadayv verakhats et-besaro bammayim veakharé-kén yabo el-hammakhaneh
Oudemoqid yatehon yetsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé yat bisréh bemayya oubatar kén yéol lemachrita:
Vehayeta lakem lekhuqqat olam bakhodech hachchebii beasor lakhodech teannou et-napchotékem vekol-melaka lo taasou haezrakh vehaggér haggar betokekem
Outehé lekon liqyam alam beyarkha chebiaa beasra leyarkha teannoun yat napchatékon vekol ibida la tabedoun yatstsiba vegiyyora deyitgayyeroun bénékon:
Ki-bayyom hazzeh yekappér alékem letahér etkem mikkol khattotékem lipné Adonai titharou
Aré beyoma hadén yekappér alékon ledakkaa yatekon mikkol khobékon qodam Adonai tidkoun:
Chabbat chabbaton hi lakem veinnitem et-napchotékem khuqqat olam
Chebat chebata hi lekon outeannoun yat napchatékon qeyam alam:
Vekipper hakkohén acher-yimchakh oto vaacher yemallé et-yado lekahén takhat abiv velabach et-bigdé habbad bigdé haqqodech
Vikappar kahana di rabbi yatéh vedi yeqaréb yat qurbanéh lechammacha tekhot abouhi veyilbach yat lebouché boutsa lebouché qoudecha:
Vekipper et-miqdach haqqodech veet-ohel moéd veet-hammizbéakh yekappér veal hakkohanim veal-kol-am haqqahal yekappér
Vikappar al miqdach qoudecha veal machkan zimna veal madbekha yekappar veal kahanayya veal kol amma diqhala yekappar:
Vehayeta-zot lakem lekhuqqat olam lekappér al-bené yisraél mikkol-khattotam akhat bachchana vayyaas kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Outehé da lekon liqyam alam lekappara al bené yisraél mikkol khobéhon khada bechatta vaabad kema di paqqéd Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-aharon veel-banayv veel kol-bené yisraél veamarta aléhem zeh haddabar acher-tsivva Adonai lémor
Mallél im aharon veim benohi veim kol bené yisraél vetémar lehon dén pitgama di paqqid Adonai lemémar:
Ich ich mibbét yisraél acher yichkhat chor o-keseb o-éz bammakhaneh o acher yichkhat mikhouts lammakhaneh
Gebar gebar mibbét yisraél di yikkos tor o immar o izza bemachrita o di yikkos mibbara lemachrita:
Veel-petakh ohel moéd lo hébio lehaqrib qorban la-Adonai lipné michkan Adonai dam yékhachéb laich hahou dam chapak venikrat haich hahou miqqereb ammo
Velitra machkan zimna la aytéh leqaraba qurbana qodam Adonai qodam machkena daAdonai dema yitkhachchab legabra hahou dema achad veyichtétsé anacha hahou miggo amméh:
Lemaan acher yabiou bené yisraél et-zibkhéhem acher hém zobekhim al-pené hassadeh vehébioum la-Adonai el-petakh ohel moéd el-hakkohén vezabekhou zibkhé chelamim la-Adonai otam
Bedil di yaytoun bené yisraél yat dibkhéhon di innoun dabekhin al appé khaqla veyaytunnoun loqodam Adonai litra machkan zimna levat kahana veyikkesoun niksat qoudechin qodam Adonai yatehon:
Vezaraq hakkohén et-haddam al-mizbakh Adonai petakh ohel moéd vehiqtir hakhéleb leréakh nikhoakh la-Adonai
Veyizroq kahana yat dema al madbekha daAdonai bitra machkan zimna veyasséq tarba leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai:
Velo-yizbekhou od et-zibkhéhem lasseirim acher hém zonim akharéhem khuqqat olam tiheyeh-zot lahem ledorotam
Vela yidbekhoun od yat dibkhéhon lachchédin di innoun taan batréhon qeyam alam tehé da lehon ledaréhon:
Vaaléhem tomar ich ich mibbét yisraél oumin-haggér acher-yagour betokam acher-yaaleh ola o-zabakh
Oulehon témar gebar gebar mibbét yisraél oumin giyyora deyitgayyeroun bénékon di yasséq alata o niksat qoudechayya:
Veel-petakh ohel moéd lo yebiennou laasot oto la-Adonai venikrat haich hahou méammayv
Velitra machkan zimna la aytinnéh lemebad yatéh qodam Adonai veyichtétsé anacha hahou méamméh:
Veich ich mibbét yisraél oumin-haggér haggar betokam acher yokal kol-dam venatatti panay bannepech haokelet et-haddam vehikratti otah miqqereb ammah
Ougebar gebar mibbét yisraél oumin giyyora deyitgayyeroun bénékon di yékoul kol dema veettén rougezi baanacha deyékoul yat dema veéchétsé yatéh miggo amméh:
Ki nepech habbasar baddam hiv vaani netattiv lakem al-hammizbéakh lekappér al-napchotékem ki-haddam hou bannepech yekappér
Aré nepach bisra bidma hi vaana yehabittéh lekon al madbekha lekappara al napchatékon aré dema hou al napcha mekappér:
Al-kén amarti libné yisraél kol-nepech mikkem lo-tokal dam vehaggér haggar betokekem lo-yokal dam
Al kén amarit libné yisraél kol énach minnekon la yékoul dema vegiyyora deyitgayyeroun bénékon la yékoul dema:
Veich ich mibbené yisraél oumin-haggér haggar betokam acher yatsoud tséd khayya o-op acher yéakél vechapak et-damo vekissahou beapar
Ougebar gebar min bené yisraél oumin giyyora deyitgayyeroun bénékon di yetsoud tséda khayta o opa di mitakél veyéchod yat deméh vikassinnéh beapra:
Ki-nepech kol-basar damo benapcho hou vaomar libné yisraél dam kol-basar lo tokélou ki nepech kol-basar damo hiv kol-okelayv yikkarét
Aré nepach kol bisra deméh benapchéh hou vaamarit libné yisraél dam kol bisra la tékeloun aré nepach kol bisra deméh hi kol deyékelinnéh yichtétsé:
Vekol-nepech acher tokal nebéla outerépa baezrakh oubaggér vekibbes begadayv verakhats bammayim vetamé ad-haereb vetahér
Vekol énach di yékoul nebila outebira beyatstsiba oubegiyyora vitsabba lebouchohi veyaskhé bemayya vihé mesaab ad ramcha veyidké:
Veim lo yekabbés oubesaro lo yirkhats venasa avono
Veim la yetsabba oubisréh la yaskhé viqabbél khobéh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél veamarta aléhem ani Adonai élohékem
Mallél im bené yisraél vetémar lehon ana Adonai élahakon:
Kemaaséh erets-mitsrayim acher yechabtem-bah lo taasou oukemaaséh erets-kenaan acher ani mébi etkem chamma lo taasou oubekhuqqotéhem lo télékou
Keobadé amma deara demitsrayim di yetebtoun bah la tabedoun oukeobadé amma deara diknaan di ana maél yatekon tamman la tabedoun oubenimoséhon la tehakoun:
Et-michpatay taasou veet-khuqqotay tichmerou laleket bahem ani Adonai élohékem
Yat dinay tabedoun veyat qeyamay titteroun lehallaka behon ana Adonai élahakon:
Ouchemartem et-khuqqotay veet-michpatay acher yaaseh otam haadam vakhay bahem ani Adonai
Vetitteroun yat qeyamay veyat dinay di yabéd yatehon anacha veyékhé behon lekhayyé alema ana Adonai:
Ich ich el-kol-cheér besaro lo tiqrebou legallot erva ani Adonai
Gebar gebar lekol qarib bisréh la tiqreboun legallaa erya ana Adonai:
Ervat abika veervat immeka lo tegalléh immeka hiv lo tegalleh ervatah
Eryat abouk veeryat immak la tegallé immak hi la tegallé eryetah:
Ervat échet-abika lo tegalléh ervat abika hiv
Eryat ittat abouk la tegallé eryat abouk hi:
Ervat akhoteka bat-abika o bat-immeka moledet bayit o moledet khouts lo tegalleh ervatan
Eryat akhatak bat abouk o bat immak dilida min abouk min ittat okhori o min immak ligbar okhoran la tegallé eryathen:
Ervat bat-binka o bat-bitteka lo tegalleh ervatan ki ervateka hénna
Eryat bat berak o bat berattak la tegallé eryathén aré eryetak innoun:
Ervat bat-échet abika moledet abika akhoteka hiv lo tegalleh ervatah
Eryat bat ittat abouk dilida min abouk akhatak hi la tegallé eryetah:
Ervat akhot-abika lo tegalléh cheér abika hiv
Eryat akhat abouk la tegallé qaribat abouk hi:
Ervat akhot-immeka lo tegalléh ki-cheér immeka hiv
Eryat akhat immak la tegallé aré qaribat immak hi:
Ervat akhi-abika lo tegalléh el-ichto lo tiqrab dodateka hiv
Eryat akh abouk la tegallé leittetéh la tiqrab ittat akh abouk hi:
Ervat kallateka lo tegalléh échet binka hiv lo tegalleh ervatah
Eryat kalletak la tegallé ittat berak hi la tegallé eryetah:
Ervat échet-akhika lo tegalléh ervat akhika hiv
Eryat ittat akhouk la tegallé eryat akhouk hi:
Ervat ichcha oubittah lo tegalléh et-bat-benah veet-bat-bittah lo tiqqakh legallot ervatah chaara hénna zimma hiv
Eryat itteta ouberattah la tegallé yat bat berah veyat bat berattah la tissab legallaa eryetah qariban innoun étsat khitin hi:
Veichcha el-akhotah lo tiqqakh litsror legallot ervatah aléha bekhayyéha
Veitteta im akhatah la tissab leaqaa legallaa eryetah alah bekhayyayha:
Veel-ichcha beniddat tumatah lo tiqrab legallot ervatah
Ouleitteta berikhouq sobetah la tiqrab legallaa eryetah:
Veel-échet amiteka lo-tittén chekobteka lezara letoma-ba
Oubeittat khabrak la tittén chekubtak lezara leistaaba bah:
Oumizzaraka lo-tittén lehaabir lammolek velo tekhallél et-chém élohéka ani Adonai
Oumibbenayk la tittén leabara lemolek vela takhél yat chema deélahak ana Adonai:
Veet-zakar lo tichkab michkebé ichcha toéba hiv
Veim dekoura la tichkoub michkebé itteta toebta hi:
Oubekol-behéma lo-tittén chekobteka letoma-ba veichcha lo-taamod lipné behéma leribah tebel hou
Oubekol beira la tittén chekubtak leistaaba bah veitteta la teqoum qodam beira lemichlat bah tibla hou:
Al-tittammeou bekol-élleh ki bekol-élleh nitmeou haggoyim acher-ani mechalléakh mippenékem
La tistaaboun bekol illén aré bekal illén istaabou ammayya di ana maglé min qodamékon:
Vattitma haarets vaepqod avonah aléha vattaqi haarets et-yochebéha
Veistaabat ara veasarit khobah alah veroqénat ara yat yatebaha:
Ouchemartem attem et-khuqqotay veet-michpatay velo taasou mikkol hattoébot haélleh haezrakh vehaggér haggar betokekem
Vetitteroun attoun yat qeyamay veyat dinay vela tabedoun mikkol toebta haillén yatstsiba vegiyyora deyitgayyeroun bénékon:
Ki et-kol-hattoébot haél asou anché-haarets acher lipnékem vattitma haarets
Aré yat kol toebta haillén abadou énaché ara di qodamékon veistaabat ara:
Velo-taqi haarets etkem betammaakem otah kaacher qaa et-haggoy acher lipnékem
Vela teroqén ara yatekon besoobékon yatah kema deroqénat yat ammayya di qodamékon:
Ki kol-acher yaaseh mikkol hattoébot haélleh venikretou hannepachot haosot miqqereb ammam
Aré kol di yabéd mikkol toebta haillén veyichtétsoun napchata diyabedoun miggo ammehon:
Ouchemartem et-michmarti lebilti asot mékhuqqot hattoébot acher naasou lipnékem velo tittammeou bahem ani Adonai élohékem
Vetitteroun yat matterat mémeri bedil dela lemebad minnimosé toebta deitabada qodamékon vela tistaaboun behon ana Adonai élahakon:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-kol-adat bené-yisraél veamarta aléhem qedochim tihyou ki qadoch ani Adonai élohékem
Mallél im kol kenichta dibné yisraél vetémar lehon qaddichin tehon aré qaddich ana Adonai élahakon:
Ich immo veabiv tiraou veet-chabbetotay tichmorou ani Adonai élohékem
Gebar min imméh oumin abouhi tehon dakhalin veyat yomé chabbayya dili titroun ana Adonai élahakon:
Al-tipnou el-haélilim vélohé masséka lo taasou lakem ani Adonai élohékem
La titpenoun batar taavan vedakhalan dematteka la tabedoun lekon ana Adonai élahakon:
Veki tizbekhou zebakh chelamim la-Adonai liretsonekem tizbakhouhou
Vaaré tikkesoun niksat qoudechayya qodam Adonai leraava lekon tikkesunnéh:
Beyom zibkhakem yéakél oumimmokhorat vehannotar ad-yom hachchelichi baéch yissarép
Beyoma deyitnekés yitakél oubeyoma debatrohi oudeichtaar ad yoma telitaa benoura yittoqad:
Veim héakol yéakél bayyom hachchelichi piggoul hou lo yératseh
Veim itakala yitakél beyoma telitaa merakhaq hou la yehé leraava:
Veokelayv avono yissa ki-et-qodech Adonai khillél venikreta hannepech hahiv méamméha
Oudeyékelinnéh khobéh yeqabbél aré yat qoudecha daAdonai akhél veyichtétsé anacha hahou meamméh:
Oubequtsrekem et-qetsir artsekem lo tekalleh peat sadeka liqtsor veleqet qetsireka lo telaqqét
Oubemekhtsadekon yat khatsada dearakon la techétsé pata dekhaqlak lemekhtsad ouleqata dakhatsadak la telaqqét:
Vekarmeka lo teolél ouperet karmeka lo telaqqét leani velaggér taazob otam ani Adonai élohékem
Vekarmak la tealél venitra dekarmak la telaqqét leanyé oulegiyyoré tichboq yatehon ana Adonai élahakon:
Lo tignobou velo-tekakhachou velo-techaqqerou ich baamito
La tigneboun vela tekaddeboun vela techaqqeroun énach bekhabréh:
Velo-tichchabeou bichmi lachchaqer vekhillalta et-chém élohéka ani Adonai
Vela tichchabeoun bichmi lechiqra vetakhél yat chema deélahak ana Adonai:
Lo-taachoq et-réaka velo tigzol lo-talin peullat sakir itteka ad-boqer
La taachoq yat khabrak vela teannés la tebit agra daagira levatak ad tsapra:
Lo-teqallél khéréch velipné ivvér lo tittén mikchol veyaréta méélohéka ani Adonai
La telout dela chama veqodam dela khazé la tesim taqla vetidkhal méélahak ana Adonai:
Lo-taasou avel bammichpat lo-tissa pené-dal velo tehdar pené gadol betsedeq tichpot amiteka
La tabedoun cheqar bedina la tissab appé maskéna vela tehdar appé rabba beqoucheta tedinéh lekhabrak:
Lo-télék rakil beamméka lo taamod al-dam réeka ani Adonai
La tékoul qouretsin beammak la teqoum al dema dekhabrak ana Adonai:
Lo-tisna et-akhika bilbabeka hokéakh tokiakh et-amiteka velo-tissa alayv khét
La tisné yat akhouk belibbak okakha tokakh yat khabrak vela teqabbél al di léh khoba:
Lo-tiqqom velo-tittor et-bené ammeka veahabta leréaka kamoka ani Adonai
La tiqqom vela tittar debabou libné ammak outerakhém lekhabrak kevatak ana Adonai:
Et-khuqqotay tichmorou behemteka lo-tarbia kilayim sadeka lo-tizra kilayim oubeged kilayim chaatnéz lo yaaleh aléka
Yat qeyamay titteroun beirak la tarkéb éroubin khaqlak la tizra éroubin oulebouch éroubin chaatnéza la yissaq alak:
Veich ki-yichkab et-ichcha chikbat-zera vehiv chipkha nekhérepet leich vehopdéh lo nipdata o khupcha lo nittan-la biqqoret tihyeh lo youmetou ki-lo khuppacha
Ougebar aré yichkoub im itteta chikbat zara vehi amta akhida ligbar veitperaqa la itperiqat bekaspa o khérouta la ityehibat lah bichtar biqqurta tehé la youmetoun aré la itkhararat:
Vehébi et-achamo la-Adonai el-petakh ohel moéd él acham
Veyayti yat achméh qodam Adonai litra machkan zimna dekar laachama:
Vekipper alayv hakkohén beél haacham lipné Adonai al-khattato acher khata venislakh lo mékhattato acher khata
Vikappér alohi kahana bedikra daachama qodam Adonai al khobetéh di khab veyichtebéq léh mékhobetéh di khab:
Veki-taboou el-haarets ounetatem kol-éts maakal vaaraltem orlato et-piryo chaloch chanim yihyeh lakem arélim lo yéakél
Vaaré téaloun leara vetitstseboun kol illan demékal outerakhaqoun rakhaqa yat ibbéh telat chenin yehé lekon merakhaq laabada la yitakél:
Oubachchana harebiit yihyeh kol-piryo qodech hilloulim la-Adonai
Oubechatta rebiéta yehé kol ibbéh qodech tuchbekhan qodam Adonai:
Oubachchana hakhamichit tokelou et-piryo lehosip lakem tebouato ani Adonai élohékem
Oubechatta khamichchéta tékeloun yat ibbéh leosapa lekon alaltéh ana Adonai élahakon:
Lo tokelou al-haddam lo tenakhachou velo teonénou
La tékeloun al dema la tenakhachoun vela teonoun:
Lo taqqipou peat rochekem velo tachkhit ét peat zeqaneka
La taqqepoun pata deréchekon vela tekhabbél yat pata dediqnak:
Veseret lanepech lo tittenou bibsarkem ouketobet qaaqa lo tittenou bakem ani Adonai
Vekhibboul al mit la tittenoun bebisreykon verouchemin kharitin la tittenoun bekon ana Adonai:
Al-tekhallél et-bitteka lehaznotah velo-tizneh haarets oumalea haarets zimma
La takhél yat berattak leatayoutah vela tité ara vetitmelé ara étsat khitin:
Et-chabbetotay tichmorou oumiqdachi tiraou ani Adonai
Yat yomé chabbayya dili titroun oulebét maqdechi tehon dakhalin ana Adonai:
Al-tipnou el-haobot veel-hayyiddeonim al-tebaqchou letoma bahem ani Adonai élohékem
La titpenoun batar biddin oudekourou la titbeoun leistaaba behon ana Adonai élahakon:
Mippené séba taqoum vehadarta pené zaqén veyaréta méélohéka ani Adonai
Min qodam desabbar beorayta teqoum outehaddar appé saba vetidkhal méélahak ana Adonai:
Veki-yagour itteka gér beartsekem lo tonou oto
Vaaré yitgayyar immak giyyora bearakon la tonoun yatéh:
Keezrakh mikkem yihyeh lakem haggér haggar ittekem veahabta lo kamoka ki-gérim héyitem beerets mitsrayim ani Adonai élohékem
Keyatstsiba minnekon yehé lekon giyyora deyitgayyar bénékon outerakhém léh kevatak aré dayyarin havétoun beara demitsrayim ana Adonai élahakon:
Lo-taasou avel bammichpat bammidda bammichqal oubammesoura
La tabedoun cheqar bedin bimchakhta bematqela oubimkilta:
Mozené tsedeq abné-tsedeq épat tsedeq vehin tsedeq yihyeh lakem ani Adonai élohékem acher-hotséti etkem méerets mitsrayim
Mozenavan diqchot matqelan diqchot mekilan diqchot vehinin diqchot yehon lekon ana Adonai élahakon di appéqit yatekon méara demitsrayim:
Ouchemartem et-kol-khuqqotay veet-kol-michpatay vaasitem otam ani Adonai
Vetitteroun yat kol qeyamay veyat kol dinay vetabedoun yatehon ana Adonai:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Veel-bené yisraél tomar ich ich mibbené yisraél oumin-haggér haggar beyisraél acher yittén mizzaro lammolek mot youmat am haarets yirgemouhou baaben
Veim bené yisraél témar gebar gebar mibbené yisraél oumin giyyora deyitgayroun beyisraél di yittén mizzaréh lemolek itqetala yitqetél amma bét yisraél yirgemunnéh beabna:
Vaani ettén et-panay baich hahou vehikratti oto miqqereb ammo ki mizzaro natan lammolek lemaan tammé et-miqdachi oulekhallél et-chém qodchi
Vaana ettén yat rougezi begabra hahou veéchétsé yatéh miggo amméh aré mizzaréh yehab lemolek bedil lesaaba yat maqdechi ouleakhalla yat chema deqoudechi:
Veim halém yalimou am haarets et-énéhem min-haich hahou betitto mizzaro lammolek lebilti hamit oto
Veim mikbach yikbechoun amma bét yisraél yat énéhon min gabra hahou bidyahéb mizzaréh lemolek bedil dela leqattala yatéh:
Vesamti ani et-panay baich hahou oubemichpakhto vehikratti oto veét kol-hazzonim akharayv liznot akharé hammolek miqqereb ammam
Veéchavvé ana yat rougezi begabra hahou oubisadohi veéchétsé yatéh veyat kol detaan batrohi lemité batar molek miggo ammehon:
Vehannepech acher tipneh el-haobot veel-hayyiddeonim liznot akharéhem venatatti et-panay bannepech hahiv vehikratti oto miqqereb ammo
Veénach di yitpené batar biddin oudekourou lemité batréhon veettén yat rougezi baanacha hahi veéchétsé yatéh miggo amméh:
Vehitqaddichtem vihyitem qedochim ki ani Adonai élohékem
Vetitqaddechoun outehon qaddichin aré ana Adonai élahakon:
Ouchemartem et-khuqqotay vaasitem otam ani Adonai meqaddichkem
Vetitteroun yat qeyamay vetabedoun yatehon ana Adonai meqaddichkon:
Ki-ich ich acher yeqallél et-abiv veet-immo mot youmat abiv veimmo qillél damayv bo
Aré gebar gebar di yelout yat abouhi veyat imméh itqetala yitqetél abouhi veimméh lat qetala khayyab:
Veich acher yinap et-échet ich acher yinap et-échet rééhou mot-yvmat hannoép vehannoapet
Ougebar di yegoup yat ittat gebar di yegoup yat ittat khabréh itqetala yitqetél gayyapa vegayyapta:
Veich acher yichkab et-échet abiv ervat abiv gilla mot-yvmetou chenéhem deméhem bam
Ougebar di yichkoub im ittat abouhi eryeta daabouhi galli itqetala yitqatteloun tarvéhon qetala khayyabin:
Veich acher yichkab et-kallato mot youmetou chenéhem tebel asou deméhem bam
Ougebar di yichkoub yat kalletéh itqetala yitqatteloun tarvéhon tibla abadou qetala khayyabin:
Veich acher yichkab et-zakar michkebé ichcha toéba asou chenéhem mot youmatou deméhem bam
Ougebar di yichkoub yat dekoura michkebé itteta toebta abadou tarvéhon itqetala yitqatteloun qetala khayyabin:
Veich acher yiqqakh et-ichcha veet-immah zimma hiv baéch yisrepou oto veethen velo-tihyeh zimma betokekem
Ougebar di yissab yat itteta veyat immah étsat khitin hi benoura yoqedoun yatéh veyatehen vela tehé étsat khitin bénékon:
Veich acher yittén chekobto bibhéma mot youmat veet-habbehéma taharogou
Ougebar di yittén chekabetéh bibira itqetala yitqetél veyat beira tiqteloun:
Veichcha acher tiqrab el-kol-behéma leriba otah veharagta et-haichcha veet-habbehéma mot youmatou deméhem bam
Veitteta di tiqrab lekol beira lemichlat bah vetiqtol yat itteta veyat beira itqetala yitqatteloun qetala khayyabin:
Veich acher-yiqqakh et-akhoto bat-abiv o bat-immo veraa et-ervatah vehi-tireh et-ervato khesed hou venikretou leéné bené ammam ervat akhoto gilla avono yissa
Ougebar di yissab yat akhatéh bat abouhi o bat imméh veyekhézé yat eryetah vehi tekhézé yat eryetéh qelana hou veyichtétsoun leéné bené ammehon eryat akhatéh galli khobéh yeqabbél:
Veich acher-yichkab et-ichcha dava vegilla et-ervatah et-meqorah heéra vehiv gilleta et-meqor daméha venikretou chenéhem miqqereb ammam
Ougebar di yichkoub yat itteta soabata vigalli yat eryetah yat qelanah galli vehi tegallé yat soabat demaha veyichtétsoun tarvéhon miggo ammehon:
