Vedi cheran semikin alohi chibta deyissachkar verabba libné yissachkar netanél bar tsouar:
Outsebao oupequdayv arbaa vakhamichchim elep vearba méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanohi khamchin vearbea alpin vearba mea:
Mattéh zebouloun venasi libné zebouloun éliab ben-khélon
Chibta dizbouloun verabba libné zebouloun éliab bar khélon:
Outsebao oupequdayv chiba vakhamichchim elep vearba méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanohi khamchin vechiba alpin vearba mea:
Kol-happequdim lemakhanéh yehouda meat elep ouchemonim elep vechéchet-alapim vearba-méot letsibotam richona yissaou
Kol minyanayya lemachrit yehouda mea outemanan vechitta alpin vearba mea lekhéléhon beqadméta natelin:
Degel makhanéh reoubén témana letsibotam venasi libné reoubén élitsour ben-chedéour
Téqas machrit reoubén daroma lekhéléhon verabba libné reoubén élitsour bar chedéour:
Outsebao oupequdayv chichcha vearbaim elep vakhaméch méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanohi arbein vechitta alpin vakhaméch mea:
Vehakhonim alayv mattéh chimon venasi libné chimon chelumiél ben-tsvrichadday
Vedi cheran semikin alohi chibta dechimon verabba libné chimon chelumiél bar tsourichadday:
Outsebao oupequdéhem ticha vakhamichchim elep oucheloch méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanéhon khamchin outecha alpin outelat mea:
Oumattéh gad venasi libné gad elyasap ben-reouél
Vechibta degad verabba libné gad elyasap bar reouél:
Outsebao oupequdéhem khamichcha vearbaim elep vechéch méot vakhamichchim
Vekhéléh ouminyanéhon arbein vekhamcha alpin vechit mea vekhamchin:
Kol-happequdim lemakhanéh reoubén meat elep veekhad vakhamichchim elep vearba-méot vakhamichchim letsibotam oucheniyyim yissaou
Kol minyanayya lemachrit reoubén mea vekhamchin vekhad alpin vearba mea vekhamchin lekhéléhon betinyéta natelin:
Venasa ohel-moéd makhanéh haleviyyim betok hammakhanot kaacher yakhanou kén yissaou ich al-yado ledigléhem
Venatél machkan zimna machrit lévaé bego machreyata kema decharan kén natelin gebar al atréh letiqséhon:
Degel makhanéh eprayim letsibotam yamma venasi libné eprayim élichama ben-ammihoud
Téqas machrit eprayim lekhéléhon maarba verabba libné eprayim élichama bar ammihoud:
Outsebao oupequdéhem arbaim elep vakhaméch méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanéhon arbein alpin vakhaméch mea:
Vealayv mattéh menachcheh venasi libné menachcheh gamliél ben-pedatsour
Vedismikin alohi chibta dimnachcheh verabba libné menachcheh gamliél bar pedatsour:
Outsebao oupequdéhem chenayim ouchelochim elep oumatayim
Vekhéléh ouminyanéhon telatin outerén alpin oumatan:
Oumattéh binyamin venasi libné binyamin abidan ben-gidoni
Vechibta debinyamin verabba libné binyamin abidan bar gidoni:
Outsebao oupequdéhem khamichcha ouchelochim elep vearba méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanéhon telatin vekhamcha alpin vearba mea:
Kol-happequdim lemakhanéh eprayim meat elep ouchemonat-alapim ouméa letsibotam ouchelichim yissaou
Kol minyanayya lemachrit eprayim mea vetamné alpin oumea lekhéléhon bitlitéta natelin:
Degel makhanéh dan tsapona letsibotam venasi libné dan akhiezer ben-ammichadday
Téqas machrit dan tsippouna lekhéléhon verabba libné dan akhiezer bar ammichadday:
Outsebao oupequdéhem chenayim vechichchim elep oucheba méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanéhon chittin outerén alpin oucheba mea:
Vehakhonim alayv mattéh achér venasi libné achér pagiél ben-okran
Vedi cheran semikin alohi chibta deachér verabba libné achér pagiél bar akeran:
Outsebao oupequdéhem ekhad vearbaim elep vakhaméch méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanéhon arbein vekhad alpin vakhaméch mea:
Oumattéh naptali venasi libné naptali akhira ben-énan
Vechibta denaptali verabba libné naptali akhira bar énan:
Outsebao oupequdéhem chelocha vakhamichchim elep vearba méot
Vekhéléh ouminyanéhon khamchin outelata alpin vearba mea:
Kol-happequdim lemakhanéh dan meat elep vechiba vakhamichchim elep vechéch méot laakharona yisou ledigléhem
Kol minyanayya lemachrit dan mea vekhamchin vechiba alpin vechit mea bebatréta natelin letiqséhon:
élleh peqoudé bené-yisraél lebét abotam kol-peqoudé hammakhanot letsibotam chéch-méot elep ouchelochet alapim vakhaméch méot vakhamichchim
Illén minyané bené yisraél lebét abahathon kol minyané machreyata lekhéléhon chit mea outelata alpin vakhaméch mea vekhamchin:
Vehaleviyyim lo hotpaqedou betok bené yisraél kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Velévaé la itmeniou bego bené yisraél kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyaasou bené yisraél kekol acher-tsivva Adonai et-mocheh kén-khanou ledigléhem vekén nasaou ich lemichpekhotayv al-bét abotayv
Vaabadou bené yisraél kekol di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh kén charan letiqséhon vekén natelin gebar lezarayathon al bét abahatohi:
Veélleh toledot aharon oumocheh beyom dibber Adonai et-mocheh behar sinay
Veillén touledat aharon oumcheh beyoma demallil Adonai im mcheh betoura desinay:
Veélleh chemot bené-aharon habbekor nadab vaabihou elazar veitamar
Veillén chemahat bené aharon boukera nadab vaabihou elazar veitamar:
élleh chemot bené aharon hakkohanim hammechukhim acher-millé yadam lekahén
Illén chemahat bené aharon kahanayya deitrabbiou di itqarab qurbanhon lechammacha:
Vayyamot nadab vaabihou lipné Adonai behaqribam éch zara lipné Adonai bemidbar sinay oubanim lo-hayou lahem vayekahén elazar veitamar al-pené aharon abihem
Oumit nadab vaabihou qodam Adonai beqarobéhon echchata noukeréta qodam Adonai bemadbera desinay oubenin la havo lehon vechamméch elazar veitamar al appé aharon abouhon:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Haqréb et-mattéh lévi vehaamadta oto lipné aharon hakkohén vechéretou oto
Qaréb yat chibta delévi outeqém yatéh qodam aharon kahana vichammechoun yatéh:
Vechamerou et-michmarto veet-michmeret kol-haéda lipné ohel moéd laabod et-abodat hammichkan
Veyitteroun yat mattartéh veyat matterat kol kenichta qodam machkan zimna lemiplakh yat palekhan machkena:
Vechamerou et-kol-kelé ohel moéd veet-michmeret bené yisraél laabod et-abodat hammichkan
Veyitteroun yat kol mané machkan zimna veyat matterat bené yisraél lemiplakh yat palekhan machkena:
Venatatta et-haleviyyim leaharon oulebanayv netounim netounim hémma lo méét bené yisraél
Vetittén yat lévaé leaharon velibnohi mesirin yehibin innoun léh min bené yisraél:
Veet-aharon veet-banayv tipqod vechamerou et-kehunnatam vehazzar haqqaréb youmat
Veyat aharon veyat benohi temanné veyitteroun yat kehunnathon vekhillonay deyiqrab yitqetal:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Vaani hinnéh laqakhti et-haleviyyim mittok bené yisraél takhat kol-bekor peter rekhem mibbené yisraél vehayou li haleviyyim
Vaana ha qarébit yat lévaé miggo bené yisraél khalap kol boukera patakh valeda mibbené yisraél vihon mechammechin qodamay lévaé:
Ki li kol-bekor beyom hakkoti kol-bekor beerets mitsrayim hiqdachti li kol-bekor beyisraél méadam ad-behéma li yihyou ani Adonai
Aré dili kol boukera beyoma diqtalit kol boukera beara demitsrayim aqdéchit qodamay kol boukera beyisraél méénacha ad beira dili yehon ana Adonai:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh bemidbar sinay lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh bemadbera desinay lemémar:
Peqod et-bené lévi lebét abotam lemichpekhotam kol-zakar mibben-khodech vamala tipqedém
Mené yat bené lévi lebét abahathon lezarayathon kol dekoura mibbar yarkha ouleélla timninnoun:
Vayyipqod otam mocheh al-pi Adonai kaacher tsuvva
Oumena yatehon mcheh al mémera daAdonai kema deitpaqqad:
Vayyiheyou-élleh bené-lévi bichmotam gérechon ouqehat oumerari
Vahavo illén bené lévi bichmahathon gérechon ouqehat oumerari:
Veélleh chemot bené-gérechon lemichpekhotam libni vechimi
Veillén chemahat bené gérechon lezarayathon libni vechimi:
Oubené qehat lemichpekhotam amram veyitshar khebron veuzziél
Oubené qehat lezarayathon amram veyitshar khebron veuzziél:
Oubené merari lemichpekhotam makhli oumouchi élleh hém michpekhot hallévi lebét abotam
Oubené merari lezarayathon makhli oumouchi illén innoun zarayat lévaé lebét abahathon:
Legérechon michpakhat hallibni oumichpakhat hachchimi élleh hém michpekhot haggérechunni
Legérechon zarit libni vezarit chimi illén innoun zarayat gérechon:
Pequdéhem bemispar kol-zakar mibben-khodech vamaela peqoudéhem chibat alapim vakhaméch méot
Minyanéhon beminyan kol dekoura mibbar yarkha ouleélla minyanéhon chaba alpin vakhaméch mea:
Michpekhot haggérechunni akharé hammichkan yakhanou yamma
Zarayat gérechon akhoré machkena yichroun maarba:
Ounesi bét-ab laggérechunni elyasap ben-laél
Verab bét abba lebét gérechon elyasap bar laél:
Oumichmeret bené-gérechon beohel moéd hammichkan vehaohel mikséhou oumasak petakh ohel moéd
Oumatterat bené gérechon bemachkan zimna machkena ouperasa khopaéh ouperasa ditra machkan zimna:
Veqalé hekhatsér veet-masak petakh hekhatsér acher al-hammichkan veal-hammizbéakh sabib veét métarayv lekol abodato
Ouseradé dedarta veyat perasa ditra darta di al machkena veal madbekha sekhor sekhor veyat attounohi lekol poulekhanéh:
Veliqhat michpakhat haamrami oumichpakhat hayyitshari oumichpakhat hakhebroni oumichpakhat haozziéli élleh hém michpekhot haqqehati
Veliqhat zarit amram vezarit yitshar vezarit khebron vezarit uzziél illén innoun zarayat qehat:
Bemispar kol-zakar mibben-khodech vamaela chemonat alapim vechéch méot chomeré michmeret haqqodech
Beminyan kol dekoura mibbar yarkha ouleélla temanya alpin vechit mea nateré mattarta deqoudecha:
Michpekhot bené-qehat yakhanou al yerek hammichkan témana
Zarayat bené qehat yichroun al tsidda demachkena daroma:
Ounesi bét-ab lemichpekhot haqqehati élitsapan ben-uzziél
Verab bét abba lezarayat qehat élitsapan bar uzziél:
Oumichmartam haaron vehachchulkhan vehammenora vehammizbekhot oukelé haqqodech acher yecharetou bahem vehammasak vekol abodato
Oumattartehon arona oupatora oumenarta oumadbekha oumané qoudecha di yechammechoun behon ouperasa vekol palekhanéh:
Ounesi nesié hallévi elazar ben-aharon hakkohén pequddat chomeré michmeret haqqodech
Vaamarkela dimmanna al rabrebé lévaé elazar bar aharon kahana demittekhot yedohi memannan nateré matterat qoudecha:
Limrari michpakhat hammakhli oumichpakhat hammouchi élleh hém michpekhot merari
Limrari zarit makhli vezarit mouchi illén innoun zarayat merari:
Oupequdéhem bemispar kol-zakar mibben-khodech vamaela chéchet alapim oumatayim
Ouminyanéhon beminyan kol dekoura mibbar yarkha ouleélla chitta alpin oumatan:
Ounesi bét-ab lemichpekhot merari tsouriél ben-abikhayil al yerek hammichkan yakhanou tsapona
Verab bét abba lezarayat merari tsouriél bar abikhayil al tsidda demachkena yichroun tsippouna:
Oupequddat michmeret bené merari qarché hammichkan ouberikhayv veammudayv vaadanayv vekol-kélayv vekol abodato
Vedi mesir lematterat bené merari dappé machkena veabrohi veammoudohi vesamkohi vekol manohi vekol poulekhanéh:
Veammudé hekhatsér sabib veadnéhem vitédotam ouméteréhem
Veammoudé dedarta sekhor sekhor vesamkéhon vesikkéhon veattounéhon:
Vehakhonim lipné hammichkan qédema lipné ohel-moéd mizrakha mocheh veaharon oubanayv chomerim michmeret hammiqdach lemichmeret bené yisraél vehazzar haqqaréb youmat
Vedi cheran qodam machkena qiddouma qodam machkan zimna maddinekha mcheh veaharon oubenohi naterin matterat maqdecha lematterat bené yisraél vekhillonay deyiqrab yitqetal:
Kol-peqoudé haleviyyim acher paqad mocheh veaharon al-pi Adonai lemichpekhotam kol-zakar mibben-khodech vamala chenayim veesrim alep
Kol minyané lévaé di mena mcheh veaharon al mémera daAdonai lezarayathon kol dekoura mibbar yarkha ouleélla asrin outerén alpin:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh peqod kol-bekor zakar libné yisraél mibben-khodech vamaela vesa ét mispar chemotam
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh mené kol boukerayya dikrayya libné yisraél mibbar yarkha ouleélla veqabbél yat minyan chemahathon:
Velaqakhta et-haleviyyim li ani Adonai takhat kol-bekor bibné yisraél veét behémat haleviyyim takhat kol-bekor bebehémat bené yisraél
Outeqaréb yat lévaé qodamay ana Adonai khalap kol boukera bibné yisraél veyat beira delévaé khalap kol boukera bibira dibné yisraél:
Vayyipqod mocheh kaacher tsivva Adonai oto et-kol-bekor bibné yisraél
Oumena mcheh kema di paqid Adonai yatéh yat kol boukera bibné yisraél:
Vayehi kol-bekor zakar bemispar chémot mibben-khodech vamala lipqudéhem chenayim veesrim elep chelocha vechibim oumatayim
Vahavo kol boukerayya dikrayya beminyan chemahan mibbar yarkha ouleélla leminyanéhon asrin outerén alpin matan vechabin outelata:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Qakh et-haleviyyim takhat kol-bekor bibné yisraél veet-behémat haleviyyim takhat behemtam vehayou-li haleviyyim ani Adonai
Qaréb yat lévaé khalap kol boukera bibné yisraél veyat beira delévaé khalap beirehon vihon mechammechin qodamay lévaé ana Adonai:
Veét pedouyé hachchelocha vehachchibim vehammatayim haodepim al-haleviyyim mibbekor bené yisraél
Veyat purqan matan vechabin outelata deyattirin al lévaé mibboukerayya dibné yisraél:
Velaqakhta khaméchet khaméchet cheqalim laggulgolet becheqel haqqodech tiqqakh esrim géra hachchaqel
Vetissab khaméch khaméch silin legulgalta besilé qoudecha tissab asrin main sila:
Venatatta hakkesep leaharon oulebanayv pedouyé haodepim bahem
Vetittén kaspa leaharon velibnohi purqan deyattirin behon:
Vayyiqqakh mocheh ét kesep happidyom méét haodepim al pedouyé haleviyyim
Ouneséb mcheh yat kesap purqanhon min deyattirin al periqé lévaé:
Méét bekor bené yisraél laqakh et-hakkasep khamichcha vechichchim oucheloch méot vaelep becheqel haqqodech
Min boukerayya dibné yisraél nesib yat kaspa alap outelat mea vechittin vekhaméch silin besilé qoudecha:
Vayyittén mocheh et-kesep happeduyim leaharon oulebanayv al-pi Adonai kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Vihab mcheh yat kesap periqayya leaharon velibnohi al mémera daAdonai kema di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh veel-aharon lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh veim aharon lemémar:
Naso et-roch bené qehat mittok bené lévi lemichpekhotam lebét abotam
Qabbilou yat khuchban bené qehat miggo bené lévi lezarayathon lebét abahathon:
Mibben chelochim chana vamala vead ben-khamichchim chana kol-ba latstsaba laasot melaka beohel moéd
Mibbar telatin chenin ouleélla vead bar khamchin chenin kol deaté lekhéla lemebad ibidta bemachkan zimna:
Zot abodat bené-qehat beohel moéd qodech haqqodachim
Dén poulekhan bené qehat bemachkan zimna qodech qoudechayya:
Ouba aharon oubanayv binsoa hammakhaneh vehoridou ét paroket hammasak vekissou-ba ét aron haédout
Veyéol aharon oubenohi bemittal machrita vipareqoun yat parukta diprasa vikassoun bah yat arona desahadouta:
Venatenou alayv kesouy or takhach ouparesou beged-kelil tekélet milmaela vesamou baddayv
Veyittenoun alohi khopaa dimchak sasgona veyipresoun lebouch gemir tikla milélla vichavvoun arikhohi:
Veal chulkhan happanim yipresou beged tekélet venatenou alayv et-haqqearot veet-hakkappot veet-hammenaqqiyyot veét qesot hannasek velekhem hattamid alayv yihyeh
Veal patora dilkhém appayya yipresoun lebouch tikla veyittenoun alohi yat magisayya veyat bazikayya veyat mekilata veyat qasvot nissouka oulekhém tedira alohi yehé:
Ouparesou aléhem beged tolaat chani vekissou oto bemikséh or takhach vesamou et-baddayv
Veyipresoun aléhon lebouch tseba zehori vikassoun yatéh bekhopaa dimchak sasgona vichavvoun yat arikhohi:
Velaqekhou beged tekélet vekissou et-menorat hammaor veet-nérotéha veet-malqakhéha veet-makhtotéha veét kol-kelé chamnah acher yecharetou-la bahem
Veyisseboun lebouch tikla vikassoun yat menarta deanhoré veyat botsinaha veyat tsibtaha veyat makhteytaha veyat kol mané michkha di yechammechoun léh behon:
Venatenou otah veet-kol-kéléha el-mikséh or takhach venatenou al-hammot
Veyittenoun yatah veyat kol manaha lekhopaa dimchak sasgona veyittenoun al arikha:
Veal mizbakh hazzahab yipresou beged tekélet vekissou oto bemikséh or takhach vesamou et-baddayv
Veal madbekha dedahaba yipresoun lebouch tikla vikassoun yatéh bekhopaa dimchak sasgona vichavvoun yat arikhohi:
Velaqekhou et-kol-kelé hachcharét acher yecharetou-bam baqqodech venatenou el-beged tekélet vekissou otam bemikséh or takhach venatenou al-hammot
Veyisseboun yat kol mané chimmoucha di yechammechoun behon beqoudecha veyittenoun lilbouch tikla vikassoun yatehon bekhopaa dimchak sasgona veyittenoun al arikha:
Vedichchenou et-hammizbéakh ouparesou alayv beged argaman
Veyissepoun yat qitma demadbekha veyipresoun alohi lebouch argevan:
Venatenou alayv et-kol-kélayv acher yecharetou alayv bahem et-hammakhtot et-hammizlagot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizraqot kol kelé hammizbéakh ouparesou alayv kesouy or takhach vesamou baddayv

Veyittenoun alohi yat kol manohi di yechammechoun alohi behon yat makhteyata veyat tsinnoreyata veyat magropeyata veyat mizreqayya kol mané madbekha veyipresoun alohi khopaa dimchak sasgona vichavoun arikhohi:
Vekilla aharon-vbanayv lekassot et-haqqodech veet-kol-kelé haqqodech binsoa hammakhaneh veakharé-kén yaboou bené-qehat lasét velo-yiggeou el-haqqodech vamétou élleh massa bené-qehat beohel moéd

Vichétsé aharon oubenohi lekassaa yat qoudecha veyat kol mané qoudecha bemittal machrita oubatar kén yéaloun bené qehat lemittal vela yiqreboun leqoudecha vela yemoutoun illén mattoul bené qehat bemachkan zimna:
Oupequddat elazar ben-aharon hakkohén chemen hammaor ouqetoret hassammim ouminkhat hattamid vechemen hammichkha pequddat kol-hammichkan vekol-acher-bo beqodech oubekélayv
Vedi mesir leelazar bar aharon kahana michkha deanharouta ouqetoret bousemayya ouminkhata tedira oumichkha dirbouta matrat kol machkena vekol di béh beqoudecha oubemanohi:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh veel-aharon lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh veim aharon lemémar:
Al-takritou et-chébet michpekhot haqqehati mittok haleviyyim
La techétsoun yat chibta zarayat qehat miggo lévaé:
Vezot asou lahem vekhayou velo yamoutou begichtam et-qodech haqqodachim aharon oubanayv yaboou vesamou otam ich ich al-abodato veel-massao
Veda ibidou lehon veyékhoun vela yemoutoun bemiqrabhon leqodech qoudechayya aharon oubenohi yéaloun vimannoun yatehon gebar gebar al poulekhanéh oulemattouléh:
Velo-yaboou lirot keballa et-haqqodech vamétou
Vela yéaloun lemekhézé kad mekassan yat mané qoudecha vela yemoutoun:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Naso et-roch bené gérechon gam-hém lebét abotam lemichpekhotam
Qabbél yat khuchban bené gérechon ap innoun lebét abahathon lezarayathon:
Mibben chelochim chana vamala ad ben-khamichchim chana tipqod otam kol-habba litsbo tsaba laabod aboda beohel moéd
Mibbar telatin chenin ouleélla ad bar khamchin chenin timné yatehon kol deaté lekhayyala khéla lemiplakh palekhana bemachkan zimna:
Zot abodat michpekhot haggérechunni laabod oulemassa
Dén palekhan zarayat gérechon lemiplakh oulemattol:
Venaseou et-yeriot hammichkan veet-ohel moéd mikséhou oumikséh hattakhach acher-alayv milmaela veet-masak petakh ohel moéd
Veyitteloun yat yeriat machkena veyat machkan zimna khopaéh vekhopaa desasgona di alohi milleélla veyat perasa ditra machkan zimna:
Veét qalé hekhatsér veet-masak petakh chaar hekhatsér acher al-hammichkan veal-hammizbéakh sabib veét méteréhem veet-kol-kelé abodatam veét kol-acher yéaseh lahem veabadou
Veyat seradé darta veyat perasa demaalana ditra darta di al machkena veal madbekha sekhor sekhor veyat attounéhon veyat kol mané palekhanhon veyat kol di yitmesar lehon veyiplekhoun:
Al-pi aharon oubanayv tihyeh kol-abodat bené haggérechunni lekol-massaam oulekol abodatam oupeqadtem aléhem bemichmeret ét kol-massaam
Al mémar aharon oubenohi yehé kol palekhan bené gérechon lekol mattoulehon oulekol palekhanhon outemannoun aléhon bemattera yat kol mattoulehon:
Zot abodat michpekhot bené haggérechunni beohel moéd oumichmartam beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohén
Dén palekhan zarayat bené gérechon bemachkan zimna oumattartehon bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Bené merari lemichpekhotam lebét-abotam tipqod otam
Bené merari lezarayathon lebét abahathon timné yatehon:
Mibben chelochim chana vamala vead ben-khamichchim chana tipqedém kol-habba latstsaba laabod et-abodat ohel moéd
Mibbar telatin chenin ouleélla vead bar khamchin chenin timninnoun kol deaté lekhéla lemiplakh yat palekhan machkan zimna:
Vezot michmeret massaam lekol-abodatam beohel moéd qarché hammichkan ouberikhayv veammoudayv vaadanayv
Veda matterat mattoulehon lekol palekhanhon bemachkan zimna dappé machkena veabrohi veammoudohi vesamkohi:
Veammoudé hekhatsér sabib veadnéhem vitédotam ouméteréhem lekol-keléhem oulekol abodatam oubechémot tipqedou et-kelé michmeret massaam
Veammoudé dedarta sekhor sekhor vesamkéhon vesikkéhon veattounéhon lekol manéhon oulekol palekhanhon oubichmahan temannoun yat mané matterat mattoulehon:
Zot abodat michpekhot bené merari lekol-abodatam beohel moéd beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohén
Dén palekhan zarayat bené merari lekol palekhanhon bemachkan zimna bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Vayyipqod mocheh veaharon ounesié haéda et-bené haqqehati lemichpekhotam oulebét abotam
Oumena mcheh veaharon verabrebé kenichta yat bené qehat lezarayathon oulebét abahathon:
Mibben chelochim chana vamala vead ben-khamichchim chana kol-habba latstsaba laaboda beohel moéd
Mibbar telatin chenin ouleélla vead bar khamchin chenin kol deaté lekhéla lepalekhana bemachkan zimna:
Vayyihyou pequdéhem lemichpekhotam alpayim cheba méot vakhamichchim
Vahavo meneyanéhon lezarayathon terén alpin cheba mea vekhamchin:
élleh peqoudé michpekhot haqqehati kol-haobéd beohel moéd acher paqad mocheh veaharon al-pi Adonai beyad-mocheh
Illén minyané zarayat qehat kol depalakh bemachkan zimna di mena mcheh veaharon al mémera daAdonai bida demcheh:
Oupeqoudé bené gérechon lemichpekhotam oulebét abotam
Ouminyané bené gérechon lezarayathon oulebét abahathon:
Mibben chelochim chana vamala vead ben-khamichchim chana kol-habba latstsaba laaboda beohel moéd
Mibbar telatin chenin ouleélla vead bar khamchin chenin kol deaté lekhéla lepalekhana bemachkan zimna:
Vayyiheyou peqoudéhem lemichpekhotam lebét abotam alpayim vechéch méot ouchelochim
Vahavo minyanéhon lezarayathon lebét abahathon terén alpin vechit mea outelatin:
élleh peqoudé michpekhot bené gérechon kol-haobéd beohel moéd acher paqad mocheh veaharon al-pi Adonai
Illén minyané zarayat bené gérechon kol depalakh bemachkan zimna di mena mcheh veaharon al mémera daAdonai:
Oupeqoudé michpekhot bené merari lemichpekhotam lebét abotam
Ouminyané zarayat bené merari lezarayathon lebét abahathon:
Mibben chelochim chana vamala vead ben-khamichchim chana kol-habba latstsaba laaboda beohel moéd
Mibbar telatin chenin ouleélla vead bar khamchin chenin kol deaté lekhéla lepalekhana bemachkan zimna:
Vayyihyou pequdéhem lemichpekhotam chelochet alapim oumatayim
Vahavo minyanéhon lezarayathon telata alpin oumatan:
élleh peqoudé michpekhot bené merari acher paqad mocheh veaharon al-pi Adonai beyad-mocheh
Illén minyané zarayat bené merari di mena mcheh veaharon al mémera daAdonai bida demcheh:
Kol-happequdim acher paqad mocheh veaharon ounesié yisraél et-haleviyyim lemichpekhotam oulebét abotam
Kol minyanayya di mena mcheh veaharon verabrebé yisraél yat lévaé lezarayathon oulebét abahathon:
Mibben chelochim chana vamala vead ben-khamichchim chana kol-habba laabod abodat aboda vaabodat massa beohel moéd
Mibbar telatin chenin ouleélla vead bar khamchin chenin kol deaté lemiplakh palekhan palekhana oupalekhan mattoul bemachkan zimna:
Vayyihyou pequdéhem chemonat alapim vakhaméch méot ouchemonim
Vahavo minyanéhon temanya alpin vakhaméch mea vetamnan:
Al-pi Adonai paqad otam beyad-mocheh ich ich al-abodato veal-massao oupequdayv acher-tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Al mémera daAdonai mena yatehon bida demcheh gebar gebar al palekhanéh veal mattouléh ouminyanohi di paqqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Tsav et-bené yisraél vichallekhou min-hammakhaneh kol-tsaroua vekol-zab vekol tamé lanapech
Paqqéd yat bené yisraél vichallekhoun min machrita kol disgir vekol dedaéb vekol dimsaab litmé napcha deénacha:
Mizzakar ad-neqéba techallékhou el-mikhouts lammakhaneh techallekhoum velo yetammeou et-makhanéhem acher ani chokén betokam
Middekar ad nouqeba techallekhoun lemibbara lemachrita techallekhunnoun vela yesaaboun yat machritehon di chekinti chareya bénéhon:
Vayyaasou-kén bené yisraél vayechallekhou otam el-mikhouts lammakhaneh kaacher dibber Adonai el-mocheh kén asou bené yisraél
Vaabadou kén bené yisraél vechallekhou yatehon lemibbara lemachrita kema di mallil Adonai im mcheh kén abadou bené yisraél:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél ich o-ichcha ki yaasou mikkol-khattot haadam limol maal ba-Adonai veachema hannepech hahiv
Mallél im bené yisraél gebar o itteta aré yabedoun mikkol khobé énacha lechaqqara cheqar qodam Adonai veyékhob énacha hahou:
Vehitvaddou et-khattatam acher asou vehéchib et-achamo berocho vakhamichito yosép alayv venatan laacher acham lo
Vivaddoun yat khobéhon di abadou veyatéb yat khobetéh beréchéh vekhumchéh yosép alohi veyittén lidkhab léh:
Veim-én laich goél lehachib haacham élayv haacham hammouchab la-Adonai lakkohén millebad él hakkippurim acher yekapper-bo alayv
Veim lét ligbar pariq laataba khobeta léh khobeta dimtéb qodam Adonai lekahana bar middekar kippourayya di yekappér béh alohi:
Vekol-terouma lekol-qodché bené-yisraél acher-yaqribou lakkohén lo yihyeh
Vekol aprachouta lekol qoudechayya dibné yisraél di yeqareboun lekahana dilléh yehé:
Veich et-qodachayv lo yihyou ich acher-yittén lakkohén lo yihyeh
Ougebar yat maasar qoudechéh dilléh yehon gebar diyittén lekahana dilléh yehé:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél veamarta aléhem ich ich ki-tisteh ichto oumaala bo maal
Mallél im bené yisraél vetémar lehon gebar gebar aré tisté ittetéh outechaqqér béh cheqar:
Vechakab ich otah chikbat-zera venelam mééné ichah venistera vehi nitmaa veéd én bah vehiv lo nitpasa
Veyichkoub gebar yatah chakebat zara vihé mekassa mééné balah oumittammera vehi mesaaba vesahid lét bah vehi la ittakhadat:
Veabar alayv rouakh-qina veqinné et-ichto vehiv nitmaa o-abar alayv rouakh-qina veqinné et-ichto vehi lo nitmaa
Veyebar alohi rouakh qina viqanné yat ittetéh vehi mesaaba o abar alohi rouakh qina viqanné yat ittetéh vehi la mesaaba:
Vehébi haich et-ichto el-hakkohén vehébi et-qorbanah aléha asirit haépa qemakh seorim lo-yitsoq alayv chemen velo-yittén alayv lebona ki-minkhat qenaot hou minkhat zikkaron mazkeret avon

Veyayti gabra yat ittetéh levat kahana veyayti yat qurbanah alah khad min asra bitlat sein qimkha searin la yeriq alohi michkha vela yittén alohi lebunta aré minkhat qinata hou minkhat doukerana madkarat khoba:
Vehiqrib otah hakkohén veheémidah lipné Adonai
Viqaréb yatah kahana viqiminnah qodam Adonai:
Velaqakh hakkohén mayim qedochim bikli-khares oumin-heapar acher yihyeh beqarqa hammichkan yiqqakh hakkohén venatan el-hammayim
Veyissab kahana mé kiyyor beman dakhasap oumin apra di yehé bisodé machkena yissab kahana veyittén lemayya:
Veheémid hakkohén et-haichcha lipné Adonai oupara et-roch haichcha venatan al-kappéha ét minkhat hazzikkaron minkhat qenaot hiv oubeyad hakkohén yihyou mé hammarim hamearerim
Viqim kahana yat itteta qodam Adonai veyipra yat récha deitteta vihéb al yedaha yat minkhat doukerana minkhat qinata hi oubida dekahana yehon mayya merirayya melattayya:
Vehichbia otah hakkohén veamar el-haichcha im-lo chakab ich otak veim-lo satit tuma takhat ichék hinnaqi mimmé hammarim hamearerim haélleh
Veyomé yatah kahana veyémar leitteta im la chekib gebar yatik veim la setit leistaaba bar mibbaalik hévé zakkaa mimmayya merirayya melattayya haillén:
Veat ki satit takhat ichék veki nitmét vayyittén ich bak et-chekobto mibbaladé ichék
Veat aré setit bar mibbaalik vaaré istaabt vihab gebar bik yat chekubtéh bar mibbaalik:
Vehichbia hakkohén et-haichcha bichbuat haala veamar hakkohén laichcha yittén Adonai otak leala velichbua betok ammék betét Adonai et-yerékék nopelet veet-bitnék tsaba
Veyomé kahana yat itteta bemomata dilvata veyémar kahana leitteta yehéb Adonai yatik lilvat oulemomé bego ammik bedihéb Adonai yat yarkik masya veyat meayki nepikhin:
Oubaou hammayim hamearerim haélleh beméayik latsbot beten velanpil yarék veamera haichcha amén amén
Veyéaloun mayya melattayya haillén bimayki laapakha mein ouleamsaa yarka vetémar itteta amén amén:
Vekatab et-haalot haélleh hakkohén basséper oumakha el-mé hammarim
Veyiktob yat levatayya haillén kahana besipra veyimkhoq lemayya merirayya:
Vehichqa et-haichcha et-mé hammarim hamearerim oubaou bah hammayim hamearerim lemarim
Veyachqé yat itteta yat mayya merirayya melattayya veyéaloun bah mayya melattayya limrirou:
Velaqakh hakkohén miyyad haichcha ét minkhat haqqenaot vehénip et-hamminkha lipné Adonai vehiqrib otah el-hammizbéakh
Veyissab kahana mida deitteta yat minkhat qinata virim yat minkhata qodam Adonai viqaréb yatah lemadbekha:
Veqamats hakkohén min-hamminkha et-azkaratah vehiqtir hammizbékha veakhar yachqeh et-haichcha et-hammayim
Veyiqmots kahana min minkhata yat adkartah veyasséq lemadbekha oubatar kén yachqé yat itteta yat mayya:
Vehichqah et-hammayim vehayeta im-nitmea vattimol maal beichah oubaou bah hammayim hamearerim lemarim vetsabeta bitnah venapela yerékah vehayeta haichcha leala beqereb ammah
Veyachqinnah yat mayya outehé im istaabat vechaqqarat cheqar bebaalah veyéaloun bah mayya melattayya limrirou veyippekhoun meaha vetitmesé yarkah outehé itteta lilvat bego ammah:
Veim-lo nitmea haichcha outehora hiv veniqqeta venizrea zara
Veim la istaabat itteta vedakyaa hi vetippoq zakkaa vetadi iddouy:
Zot torat haqqenaot acher tisteh ichcha takhat ichah venitmaa
Da orayta deqinata di tisté itteta bar mibbaalah vetistaab:
O ich acher taabor alayv rouakh qina veqinné et-ichto veheémid et-haichcha lipné Adonai veasa lah hakkohén ét kol-hattora hazzot
O gebar di tebar alohi rouakh qina viqanné yat ittetéh viqém yat itteta qodam Adonai veyebad lah kahana yat kol orayta hada:
Veniqqa haich méavon vehaichcha hahiv tissa et-avonah
Vihé zakkaa gabra mékhoba veitteta hahi teqabbél yat khobah:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél veamarta aléhem ich o-ichcha ki yapli lindor neder nazir lehazzir la-Adonai
Mallél im bené yisraél vetémar lehon gebar o itteta aré yeparéch lemiddar nedar nezirou lemézar qodam Adonai:
Miyyayin vechékar yazzir khomets yayin vekhomets chékar lo yichteh vekol-michrat anabim lo yichteh vaanabim lakhim vibéchim lo yokél
Mékhamar khadat veattiq yizzar khal dakhamar khadat vekhal dakhamar attiq la yichté vekol matrout inbin la yichté veinbin rattibin vibéchin la yékoul:
Kol yemé nizro mikkol acher yéaseh miggepen hayyayin mékhartsannim vead-zag lo yokél
Kol yomé nizréh mikkol deyitabéd miggupna dekhamra mippouretsenin vead itstsourin la yékoul:
Kol-yemé neder nizro taar lo-yaabor al-rocho ad-melot hayyamim acher-yazzir la-Adonai qadoch yihyeh gaddél pera sear rocho
Kol yomé nedar nizréh maspar la yebar al réchéh ad michlam yomayya deyanzér qodam Adonai qaddich yehé marbé péroua sear réchéh:
Kol-yemé hazziro la-Adonai al-nepech mét lo yabo
Kol yomin deyanzér qodam Adonai al napcha deméta la yéoul:
Leabiv ouleimmo leakhiv ouleakhoto lo-yittamma lahem bemotam ki nézer élohayv al-rocho
Leabouhi ouleimméh leakhouhi ouleakhatéh la yistaab lehon bemotehon aré kelila deélahéh al réchéh:
Kol yemé nizro qadoch hou la-Adonai
Kol yomé nizréh qaddich hou qodam Adonai:
Veki-yamout mét alayv bepeta pitom vetimmé roch nizro vegillakh rocho beyom tohorato bayyom hachchebii yegallekhennou
Vaaré yemout méta alohi bitkép chalou visaéb réch nizréh vigallakh réchéh beyoma didkoutéh beyoma chebiaa yegallekhinnéh:
Oubayyom hachchemini yabi cheté torim o chené bené yona el-hakkohén el-petakh ohel moéd
Oubeyoma teminaa yayté tartén chapninin o terén bené yona levat kahana litra machkan zimna:
Veasa hakkohén ekhad lekhattat veekhad leola vekipper alayv méacher khata al-hannapech veqiddach et-rocho bayyom hahou
Veyabéd kahana khad lekhattata vekhad laalata vikappér alohi middekhab al méta viqaddach yat réchéh beyoma hahou:
Vehizzir la-Adonai et-yemé nizro vehébi kebes ben-chenato leacham vehayyamim harichonim yippelou ki tamé nizro
Veyazzér qodam Adonai yat yomé nizréh veyayti immar bar chattéh laachama veyomayya qadmaé yibteloun aré istaab nizréh:
Vezot torat hannazir beyom melot yemé nizro yabi oto el-petakh ohel moéd
Veda orayta dinzira beyom michlam yomé nizréh yayti yatéh litra machkan zimna:
Vehiqrib et-qorbano la-Adonai kebes ben-chenato tamim ekhad leola vekabsa akhat bat-chenatah temima lekhattat veayil-ekhad tamim lichlamim
Viqaréb yat qurbanéh qodam Adonai immar bar chattéh chelim khad laalata veimmarta khada bat chattéh chelemta lekhattata oudekar khad chelim leniksat qoudechayya:
Vesal matstsot solet khallot beloulot bachchemen oureqiqé matstsot mechukhim bachchamen ouminkhatam veniskéhem
Vesal pattir sulta geritsan depilan bimchakh veispogin pattirin dimchikhin bimchakh ouminkhathon veniskéhon:
Vehiqrib hakkohén lipné Adonai veasa et-khattato veet-olato
Viqaréb kahana qodam Adonai veyabéd yat khattatéh veyat alatéh:
Veet-haayil yaaseh zebakh chelamim la-Adonai al sal hammatstsot veasa hakkohén et-minkhato veet-nisko
Veyat dikra yabéd niksat qoudechayya qodam Adonai al salla depattirayya veyabéd kahana yat minkhatéh veyat niskéh:
Vegillakh hannazir petakh ohel moéd et-roch nizro velaqakh et-sear roch nizro venatan al-haéch acher-takhat zebakh hachchelamim
Vigallakh nezira bitra machkan zimna yat réch nizréh veyissab yat sear réch nizréh veyittén al echchata di tekhot douda deniksat qoudechayya:
Velaqakh hakkohén et-hazzeroa bechéla min-haayil vekhallat matstsa akhat min-hassal oureqiq matstsa ekhad venatan al-kappé hannazir akhar hitegallekho et-nizro
Veyissab kahana yat deraa bechéla min dikra ougeritsta pattireta khada min salla veispog pattir khad veyittén al yedé nezira batar degallakh yat nizréh:
Vehénip otam hakkohén tenoupa lipné Adonai qodech hou lakkohén al khazéh hattenoupa veal choq hatterouma veakhar yichteh hannazir yayin
Virim yatehon kahana arama qodam Adonai qoudecha hou lekahana al khadya daaramouta veal chaqa deaprachouta oubatar kén yichté nezira khamra:
Zot torat hannazir acher yiddor qorbano la-Adonai al-nizro millebad acher-tassig yado kepi nidro acher yiddor kén yaaseh al torat nizro
Da orayta dinzira di yiddar qurbanéh qodam Adonai al nizréh bar middetadbéq yedéh kepoum nidréh di yiddar kén yabéd al orayta denizréh:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-aharon veel-banayv lémor koh tebarekou et-bené yisraél amor lahem
Mallél im aharon veim benohi lemémar kedén tebarekoun yat bené yisraél témeroun lehon:
Yebarekka Adonai veyichmereka
Yebarekinnak Adonai veyitterinnak:
Yaér Adonai panayv éléka vikhunnekka
Yanhar Adonai chekintéh levatak virakhém yatak:
Yissa Adonai panayv éléka veyasém leka chalom
Yissab Adonai appéh levatak vichavvé lak chelam:
Vesamou et-chemi al-bené yisraél vaani abarekém
Vichavvoun yat birkat chemi al bené yisraél vaana abarékinnoun:
Vayehi beyom kallot mocheh lehaqim et-hammichkan vayyimchakh oto vayeqaddéch oto veet-kol-kélayv veet-hammizbéakh veet-kol-kélayv vayyimchakhém vayeqaddéch otam
Vahava beyoma dechétsé mcheh laaqama yat machkena verabbi yatéh veqaddich yatéh veyat kol manohi veyat madbekha veyat kol manohi verabbinnoun veqaddich yatehon:
Vayyaqribou nesié yisraél raché bét abotam hém nesié hammattot hém haomedim al-happequdim
Ouqeribou rabrebé yisraél réché bét abahathon innoun rabrebé chibtayya innoun deqaymin al minyanayya:
Vayyabiou et-qorbanam lipné Adonai chéch-eglot tsab ouchené asar baqar agala al-chené hannesiim vechor leekhad vayyaqribou otam lipné hammichkan
Veaytiyou yat qurbanéhon qodam Adonai chit eglan kad mekhapyan outeré asar torin egleta al terén rabrebayya vetor lekhad veqaribou yatehon loqodam machkena:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh lemémar:
Qakh méittam vehayou laabod et-abodat ohel moéd venatatta otam el-haleviyyim ich kepi abodato
Qabbél minnehon vihon lemiplakh yat palekhan machkan zimna vetittén yatehon lelévaé gebar kemissat palekhanéh:
Vayyiqqakh mocheh et-haagalot veet-habbaqar vayyittén otam el-haleviyyim
Ouneséb mcheh yat eglata veyat toré vihab yatehon lelévaé:
ét cheté haagalot veét arbaat habbaqar natan libné gérechon kepi abodatam
Yat tartén eglata veyat arbea toré yehab libné gérechon kemissat palekhanhon:
Veét arba haagalot veét chemonat habbaqar natan libné merari kepi abodatam beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohén
Veyat arba eglan veyat temanya toré yehab libné merari kemissat palekhanhon bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Velibné qehat lo natan ki-abodat haqqodech aléhem bakkatép yissaou
Velibné qehat la yehab aré palekhan qoudecha aléhon bekatpa natelin:
Vayyaqribou hannesiim ét khanukkat hammizbéakh beyom himmachakh oto vayyaqribou hannesiim et-qorbanam lipné hammizbéakh
Veqaribou rabrebayya yat khanukkat madbekha beyoma derabbiyyou yatéh veqaribou rabrebayya yat qurbanhon leqodam madbekha:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh nasi ekhad layyom nasi ekhad layyom yaqribou et-qorbanam lakhanukkat hammizbéakh

Oumallil mcheh im bené yisraél lemebad piskha:

Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:

Veal khéla dechibta dibné binyamin abidan bar gidoni:

Ouqera yat chema deatra hahou qibré dimchaalé aré tamman qebarou yat amma dechailou:
Miqqibrot hattaava naseou haam khatsérot vayyihyou bakhatsérot
Miqqibré dimchaalé netalou amma lakhatsérot vahavo bakhatsérot:
Vattedabbér miryam veaharon bemocheh al-odot haichcha hakkuchit acher laqakh ki-ichcha kuchit laqakh
Oumallélat miryam veaharon bemcheh al ésaq itteta chappirta di nesib aré itteta chappirta dinsib rakhiq:
Vayyomerou haraq ak-bemocheh dibber Adonai halo gam-banou dibbér vayyichma Adonai
Vaamarou halekhod beram bemcheh mallil Adonai hala ap immana mallil ouchemia qodam Adonai:
Vehaich mocheh anav meod mikkol haadam acher al-pené haadama
Vegabra mcheh invetan lakhada mikkol énacha di al appé ara:
Vayyomer Adonai pitom el-mocheh veel-aharon veel-miryam tseou chelochtekem el-ohel moéd vayyétseou chelochtam
Vaamar Adonai bitkép lemcheh ouleaharon oulemiryam pouqou telatékon lemachkan zimna ounepaqou telatéhon:
Vayyéred Adonai beammoud anan vayyaamod petakh haohel vayyiqra aharon oumiryam vayyétseou chenéhem
Veitgeli Adonai beammouda daanana veqam bitra machkena ouqera aharon oumiryam ounepaqou tarvéhon:
Vayyomer chimou-na debaray im-yiheyeh nebiakem Adonai bammara élayv etvadda bakhalom adabber-bo
Vaamar chemaou kean pitgamay im yehon lekon nebiin ana Adonai bekhezyan ana mitgeli lehon bekhelmin ana memallél immehon:
Lo-kén abdi mocheh bekol-béti neéman hou
La kén abdi mcheh bekol béti mehéman hou:
Peh el-peh adabber-bo oumareh velo bekhidot outemunat Adonai yabbit oumaddoua lo yerétem ledabbér beabdi bemocheh
Mamlal im mamlal mallelna imméh bekhézou vela bekhidvan oudemout yeqara daAdonai mistakkal ouma dén la dekheltoun lemallala beabdi bemcheh:
Vayyikhar-ap Adonai bam vayyélak
Outeqip rogza daAdonai behon veistallaq:
Veheanan sar méal haohel vehinnéh miryam metsoraat kachchaleg vayyipen aharon el-miryam vehinnéh metsoraat
Vaanana istallaq méillavé machkena veha miryam khavvera ketalga veitpeni aharon levat miryam veha segirat:
Vayyomer aharon el-mocheh bi adoni al-na tachét alénou khattat acher noalnou vaacher khatanou
Vaamar aharon lemcheh bebaou ribboni la kean techavvi alana khoba deitpachna vedi serakhena:
Al-na tehi kammét acher betséto mérekhem immo vayyéakél khatsi besaro
La kean titrakhaq da mibbénana aré akhatana hi tsalli kean al bisra mita hadén di bah veyittassi:
Vayyitsaq mocheh el-Adonai lémor él na repa na lah
Vetsalli mcheh qodam Adonai lemémar élaha bebaou assé kean yatah:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh veabiha yaroq yaraq bepanéha halo tikkalém chibat yamim tissagér chibat yamim mikhouts lammakhaneh veakhar téasép
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh veillou abouhah minzap nezip bah hala titkelém chaba yomin tistegar chaba yomin mibbara lemachrita oubatar kén titkenéch:
Vattissagér miryam mikhouts lammakhaneh chibat yamim vehaam lo nasa ad-héasép miryam
Veistegarat miryam mibbara lemachrita chaba yomin veamma la netal ad deitkenéchat miryam:
Veakhar naseou haam mékhatsérot vayyakhanou bemidbar paran
Oubatar kén netalou amma mékhatsérot ouchero bemadbera deparan:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Chelakh-leka anachim veyatourou et-erets kenaan acher-ani notén libné yisraél ich ekhad ich ekhad lemattéh abotayv tichlakhou kol nasi bahem
Chelakh lak gubrin vialleloun yat ara diknaan di ana yahéb libné yisraél gabra khad gabra khad lechibta daabahatohi techallekhoun kol rabba dibhon:
Vayyichlakh otam mocheh mimmidbar paran al-pi Adonai kullam anachim raché bené-yisraél hémma
Ouchelakh yatehon mcheh mimmadbera deparan al mémera daAdonai kullehon gubrin réché bené yisraél innoun:
Veélleh chemotam lemattéh reoubén chammoua ben-zakkour
Veillén chemahathon lechibta diroubén chammoua bar zakkour:
Lemattéh chimon chapat ben-khori
Lechibta dechimon chapat bar khori:
Lemattéh yehouda kaléb ben-yepunneh
Lechibta dihouda kaléb bar yepunneh:
Lemattéh yissachkar yigal ben-yosép
Lechibta deyissachkar yigal bar yosép:
Lemattéh eprayim hochéa bin-nvn
Lechibta deeprayim hochéa bar noun:
Lemattéh binyamin palti ben-rapou
Lechibta debinyamin palti bar rapou:
Lemattéh zebouloun gaddiél ben-sodi
Lechibta dizbouloun gaddiél bar sodi:
Lemattéh yosép lemattéh menachcheh gaddi ben-svsi
Lechibta deyosép lechibta dimnachcheh gaddi bar sousi:
Lemattéh dan ammiél ben-gemalli
Lechibta dedan ammiél bar gemalli:
Lemattéh achér setour ben-mikaél
Lechibta deachér setour bar mikaél:
Lemattéh naptali nakhbi ben-vopsi
Lechibta denaptali nakhbi bar vapesi:
Lemattéh gad geouél ben-maki
Lechibta degad geouél bar maki:
élleh chemot haanachim acher-chalakh mocheh latour et-haarets vayyiqra mocheh lehochéa bin-nvn yehochoua
Illén chemahat gubrayya di chelakh mcheh leallala yat ara ouqera mcheh lehochéa bar noun yehochua:
Vayyichlakh otam mocheh latour et-erets kenaan vayyomer aléhem alou zeh bannegeb vaalitem et-hahar
Ouchelakh yatehon mcheh leallala yat ara diknaan vaamar lehon saqou da bidroma vetisqoun letoura:
Oureitem et-haarets mah-hiv veet-haam hayyochéb aléha hekhazaq hou harapeh hameat hou im-rab
Vetekhézoun yat ara ma hi veyat amma deyatéb alah hataqqip hou im khallach hazér hou im saggi:
Ouma haarets acher-hv yochéb bah hatoba hiv im-raa ouma hearim acher-hv yochéb bahénna habbemakhanim im bemibtsarim
Ouma ara di hou yatéb bah hataba hi im bicha ouma qirvayya di hou yatéb behon habbepatskhin im bikrakkin:
Ouma haarets hachcheména hiv im-raza hayéch-bah éts im-ayin vehitkhazzaqtem ouleqakhtem mipperi haarets vehayyamim yemé bikkouré anabim
Ouma ara haattira hi im miskéna hait bah ilanin im la vetitqepoun vetisseboun méibba deara veyomayya yomé bikkouré innebin:
Vayyaalou vayyatourou et-haarets mimmidbar-tsin ad-rekhob lebo khamat
Ouseliqou veallilou yat ara mimmadbbra detsin ad rekhob limté khamat:
Vayyaalou bannegeb vayyabo ad-khebron vecham akhiman chéchay vetalmay yelidé haanaq vekhebron cheba chanim nibneta lipné tsoan mitsrayim
Ouseliqou bidroma vaata ad khebron vetamman akhiman chéchay vetalmay bené gibbarayya vekhebron cheba chenin itbeniat qodam tanas demitsrayim:
Vayyaboou ad-nakhal echkol vayyikretou michcham zemora veechkol anabim ekhad vayyissaouhou bammot bichnayim oumin-harimmonim oumin-hatteénim
Vaato ad nakhala deatkala ouqetso mittamman obarta veatkal innebin khad ounetalohi baarikha bitrén oumin rimmonayya oumin teénayya:
Lammaqom hahou qara nakhal echkol al odot haechkol acher-karetou michcham bené yisraél
Leatra hahou qera nakhla deatkala al ésaq atkala diqtso mittamman bené yisraél:
Vayyachoubou mittour haarets miqqéts arbaim yom
Vetabou milleallala yat ara missop arbein yomin:
Vayyélekou vayyaboou el-mocheh veel-aharon veel-kol-adat bené-yisraél el-midbar paran qadécha vayyachibou otam dabar veet-kol-haéda vayyaroum et-peri haarets
Vaazalou vaato levat mcheh oulevat aharon oulevat kol kenichta dibné yisraél lemadbera deparan lirqam vaatibou yatehon pitgama veyat kol kenichta veakhaziunnoun yat ibba deara:
Vayesapperou-lo vayyomerou banou el-haarets acher chelakhtanou vegam zabat khalab oudebach hiv vezeh-piryah
Veichtaiou léh vaamarou aténa leara di chelakhtana veap abeda khalab oudebach hi vedén ibbah:
Epes ki-az haam hayyochéb baarets vehearim betsurot gedolot meod vegam-yelidé haanaq rainou cham
Lekhod aré taqqip amma deyatéb beara veqirvayya kerikan rabreban lakhada veap bené gibbarayya khazéna tamman:
Amaléq yochéb beerets hannegeb vehakhitti vehayebousi vehaémori yochéb bahar vehakkenaani yochéb al-hayyam veal yad hayyardén
Amalqaa yatéb baara daroma vekhittaa vibousaa veémoraa yatéb betoura oukenaanaa yatéb al yamma veal kép yardena:
Vayyahas kaléb et-haam el-mocheh vayyomer aloh naaleh veyarachnou otah ki-yakol noukal lah
Veatstsét kaléb yat amma lemcheh vaamar mésaq nésaq venirat yatah aré mékal nékoul lah:
Vehaanachim acher-alou immo amerou lo noukal laalot el-haam ki-khazaq hou mimmennou
Vegubrayya di seliqou imméh amarou la nékoul lemésaq levat amma aré taqqip hou minnana:
Vayyotsiou dibbat haarets acher tarou otah el-bené yisraél lémor haarets acher abarnou bah latour otah erets okelet yochebéha hiv vekol-haam acher-rainou betokah anché middot
Veappiqou choum bich al ara di allilou yatah levat bené yisraél lemémar ara di abarna bah leallala yatah ara meqattelat yatbaha hi vekol amma di khazéna begavvah énachin demichkhan:
Vecham rainou et-hannepilim bené anaq min-hannepilim vannehi beénénou kakhagabim vekén hayinou beénéhem
Vetamman khazéna yat gibbarayya bené anaq min gibbarayya vahavéna beéné napchana keqamtsin vekén havéna beénéhon:
Vattissa kol-haéda vayyittenou et-qolam vayyibkou haam ballayla hahou
Vaarimat kol kenichta vihabou yat qalehon oubeko amma beléleya hahou:
Vayyillonou al-mocheh veal-aharon kol bené yisraél vayyomerou aléhem kol-haéda lou-matnou beerets mitsrayim o bammidbar hazzeh lou-matenou
Veitraamou al mcheh veal aharon kol bené yisraél vaamarou lehon kol kenichta levay demitena beara demitsrayim o bemadbera hadén levay demitena:
Velama Adonai mébi otanou el-haarets hazzot linpol bakhereb nachénou vetappénou yihyou labaz halo tob lanou choub mitsrayema
Oulema Adonai maél yatana leara hada leminpal bekharba nechana vetaplana yehon lebizza hala tab lana di netoub lemitsrayim:
Vayyomerou ich el-akhiv nittena roch venachouba mitsrayema
Vaamarou gebar leakhohi nemanné récha ounetoub lemitsrayim:
Vayyippol mocheh veaharon al-penéhem lipné kol-qehal adat bené yisraél
Ounepal mcheh veaharon al appéhon qodam kol qehal kenichta dibné yisraél:
Vihochoua bin-nvn vekaléb ben-yepunneh min-hattarim et-haarets qareou bigdéhem
Vihochua bar noun vekaléb bar yepunneh min meallalé yat ara bezaou lebouchéhon:
Vayyomerou el-kol-adat bené-yisraél lémor haarets acher abarnou bah latour otah toba haarets meod meod
Vaamarou lekol kenichta dibné yisraél lemémar ara di abarna bah leallala yatah taba ara lakhada lakhada:
Im-khapéts banou Adonai vehébi otanou el-haarets hazzot ounetanah lanou erets acher-hiv zabat khalab oudebach
Im raava bana qodam Adonai veyaél yatana leara hada veyitteninah lana ara di hi abeda khalab oudebach:
Ak ba-Adonai al-timrodou veattem al-tireou et-am haarets ki lakhménou hém sar tsillam méaléhem va-Adonai ittanou al-tiraoum
Beram bemémera daAdonai la timredoun veattoun la tidkhaloun min amma deara aré bidana mesirin innoun ada taqepehon minnehon oumémera daAdonai besadana la tidkhaloun minnehon:
Vayyomerou kol-haéda lirgom otam baabanim oukebod Adonai nira beohel moéd el-kol-bené yisraél
Vaamarou kol kenichta lemirgam yatehon beabnayya viqara daAdonai itgeli bemachkan zimna lekol bené yisraél:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh ad-ana yenaatsouni haam hazzeh vead-ana lo-yaaminou bi bekol haotot acher asiti beqirbo
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh ad ématay yehon meraggezin qodamay amma hadén vead ématay la yehémenoun bemémeri bekol atayya di abadit bénéhon:
Akkennou baddeber veorichennou veeéseh oteka legoy-gadol veatsoum mimmennou
Emkhinnoun bemota vaachétsinnoun veebéd yatak leam rab vetaqqip minnehon:
Vayyomer mocheh el-Adonai vechameou mitsrayim ki-heélita bekokhaka et-haam hazzeh miqqirbo
Vaamar mcheh qodam Adonai veyichmeoun mitsraé aré asseqta bekhélak yat amma hadén mibbénéhon:
Veamerou el-yochéb haarets hazzot chameou ki-atta Adonai beqereb haam hazzeh acher-ayin beayin nira atta Adonai vaananeka oméd aléhem oubeammoud anan atta holék lipnéhem yomam oubeammoud éch layela

Veyémeroun leyatéb ara hada dichmaou aré at Adonai dichkintak charyat bego amma hadén di beénéhon khazan chekinat yeqara daAdonai vaananak mattél illavehon oubeammouda daanana at medabbar qodaméhon bimama oubeammouda deechchata beléleya:
Vehématta et-haam hazzeh keich ekhad veamerou haggoyim acher-chameou et-chimaka lémor
Outeqattal yat amma hadén kegabra khad veyémeroun ammayya di chemaou yat chema geburtak lemémar:
Mibbilti yekolet Adonai lehabi et-haam hazzeh el-haarets acher-nichba lahem vayyichkhatém bammidbar
Middelét youkela qodam Adonai leaala yat amma hadén leara di qayyém lehon veqattelinoun bemadbera:
Veatta yigdal-na koakh adonay kaacher dibbarta lémor
Oukean saggi kean khéla min qodam Adonai kema demalléleta lemémar:
Adonai erek appayim verab-khesed nosé avon vapacha venaqqéh lo yenaqqeh poqéd avon abot al-banim al-chilléchim veal-ribbéim

Adonai markhéq regaz oumasgé lemebad tabvan ouqechot chabéq laavayan velimrod oulekhobin sallakh lidtaybin leoraytéh oudela taybin la mezakké masar khobé abahan al benin meradin al dar telitaé veal dar rebiaé:
Selakh-na laavon haam hazzeh kegodel khasdeka vekaacher nasata laam hazzeh mimmitsrayim vead-hénna
Cheboq kean lekhobé amma hadén kisgiout tabvatak oukema di chebaqta leamma hadén mimmitsrayim vead kean:
Vayyomer Adonai salakhti kidbareka
Vaamar Adonai chebaqit kepitgamak:
Veoulam khay-ani veyimmalé kebod-Adonai et-kol-haarets
Ouberam qayyam ana oumalya yeqara daAdonai yat kol ara:
Ki kol-haanachim haroim et-kebodi veet-ototay acher-asiti bemitsrayim oubammidbar vayenassou oti zeh eser peamim velo chameou beqoli
Aré kol gubrayya dakhazo yat yeqari veyat atvatay di abadit bemitsrayim oubemadbera venassiou qodamay denan asar zimnin vela qabbilou bemémeri:
Im-yirou et-haarets acher nichbati laabotam vekol-menaatsay lo yirouha
Im yekhézoun yat ara di qayyémit laabahathon vekol deargizou qodamay la yekhézunnah:
Veabdi kaléb éqeb hayeta rouakh akheret immo vayemallé akharay vahabiotiv el-haarets acher-ba chamma vezaro yorichenna
Veabdi kaléb khalap dahava rouakh okhari imméh veachlém batar dakhalti vealinnéh leara di al letamman oubenohi yetarkinnah:
Vehaamaléqi vehakkenaani yochéb baémeq makhar penou ouseou lakem hammidbar derek yam-svp
Vaamalqaa oukenaanaa yatéb beméchera mekhar itpenou vetoulou lekon lemadbera orakh yamma desoup:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh veel-aharon lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh veim aharon lemémar:
Ad-matay laéda haraa hazzot acher hémma mallinim alay et-telunnot bené yisraél acher hémma mallinim alay chamaeti
Ad ématay liknichta bicheta hada di innoun mitraamin alay yat turamat bené yisraél di innoun mitraamin alay chemia qodamay:
émor aléhem khay-ani neum-Adonai im-lo kaacher dibbartem beoznay kén eéseh lakem
émar lehon qayyam ana amar Adonai im la kema di malleltoun qodamay kén ebéd lekon:
Bammidbar hazzeh yippelou pigrékem vekol-pequdékem lekol-misparkem mibben esrim chana vamaela acher halinotem alay
Bemadbera hadén yippeloun pigrékon vekol minyanékon lekol khuchbankon mibbar asrin chenin ouleélla di itraamtoun alay:
Im-attem taboou el-haarets acher nasati et-yadi lechakkén etkem bah ki im-kaléb ben-yepunneh vihochoua bin-nvn
Im attoun téaloun leara di qayyémit bemémeri leachraa yatekon bah ellahén kaléb bar yepunneh vihochua bar noun:
Vetappekem acher amartem labaz yihyeh vehébéti otam veyadeou et-haarets acher meastem bah
Vetaplekon di amartoun lebizza yehé veaél yatehon veyiddeoun yat ara di qatstoun bah:
Oupigrékem attem yippelou bammidbar hazzeh
Oupigrékon di lekon yippeloun bemadbera hadén:
Oubenékem yihyou roim bammidbar arbaim chana venaseou et-zenoutékem ad-tom pigrékem bammidbar
Oubenékon yehon meakharin bemadbera arbein chenin viqabbeloun yat khobékon ad disoupoun pigrékon bemadbera:
Bemispar hayyamim acher-tartem et-haarets arbaim yom yom lachchana yom lachchana tisou et-avonotékem arbaim chana vidatem et-tenouati
Beminyan yomayya di alleltoun yat ara arbein yomin yoma lechatta yoma lechatta teqabbeloun yat khobékon arbein chenin vetiddeoun yat deitraamtoun alay:
Ani Adonai dibbarti im-lo zot eéseh lekol-haéda haraa hazzot hannoadim alay bammidbar hazzeh yittammou vecham yamoutou
Ana Adonai gezarit bemémeri im la da ebéd lekol kenichta bicheta hada deizdammenoun alay bemadbera hadén yesoupoun vetamman yemoutoun:
Vehaanachim acher-chalakh mocheh latour et-haarets vayyachoubou vayyallinou alayv et-kol-haéda lehotsi dibba al-haarets
Vegubrayya di chelakh mcheh leallala yat ara vetabou vearimou alohi yat kol kenichta leappaqa choum bich al ara:
Vayyamoutou haanachim motsié dibbat-haarets raa bammaggépa lipné Adonai
Oumitou gubrayya deappiqou choum bich al ara bemotana qodam Adonai:
Vihochoua bin-nvn vekaléb ben-yepunneh khayou min-haanachim hahém haholekim latour et-haarets
Vihochua bar noun vekaléb bar yepunneh itqayyemou min gubrayya hainnoun daazalou leallala yat ara:
Vayedabbér mocheh et-haddebarim haélleh el-kol-bené yisraél vayyiteabbelou haam meod
Oumallil mcheh yat pitgamayya haillén lekol bené yisraél veitabbalou amma lakhada:
Vayyachkimou babboqer vayyaalou el-roch-hahar lémor hinnennou vealinou el-hammaqom acher-amar Adonai ki khatanou
Veaqdimou betsapra ouseliqou leréch toura lemémar ha anakhna saleqin leatra di amar Adonai aré khabna:
Vayyomer mocheh lamma zeh attem oberim et-pi Adonai vehiv lo titslakh
Vaamar mcheh lema denan attoun aberin al gezérat mémera daAdonai vehi la tatslakh:
Al-taalou ki én Adonai beqirbekem velo tinnagepou lipné oyebékem
La tisseqoun aré lét chekinta daAdonai bénékon vela tittabberoun qodam baalé debabékon:
Ki haamaléqi vehakkenaani cham lipnékem ounepaltem bekhareb ki-al-kén chabtem méakharé Adonai velo-yihyeh Adonai immakem
Aré amalqaa oukenaanaa tamman qodamékon vetippeloun bekharba aré al kén tabtoun mibbatar palekhana daAdonai vela yehé mémera daAdonai besadekon:
Vayyapilou laalot el-roch hahar vaaron berit-Adonai oumocheh lo-machou miqqereb hammakhaneh
Vearchaou lemissaq leréch toura vaaron qeyama daAdonai oumcheh la ado miggo machrita:
Vayyéred haamaléqi vehakkenaani hayyochéb bahar hahou vayyakkoum vayyakketoum ad-hakhorma
Ounekhat amalqaa oukenaanaa deyatéb betoura hahou oumekhunnoun outeradunnoun ad kharema:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél veamarta aléhem ki taboou el-erets mochebotékem acher ani notén lakem
Mallél im bené yisraél vetémar lehon aré téaloun laara motebanékon di ana yahéb lekon:
Vaasitem ichcheh la-Adonai ola o-zebakh lepallé-neder o bindaba o bemoadékem laasot réakh nikhoakh la-Adonai min-habbaqar o min-hatstson
Vetabedoun qurbana qodam Adonai alata o niksat qoudechayya leapracha nidra o bindabta o bemoadékon lemebad leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai min toré o min ana:
Vehiqrib hammaqrib qorbano la-Adonai minkha solet issaron baloul birbiit hahin chamen
Viqaréb dimqaréb qurbanéh qodam Adonai minkhata sulta asrona depila berabout hina michkha:
Veyayin lannesek rebiit hahin taaseh al-haola o lazzabakh lakkebes haekhad
Vekhamra leniska rabout hina tabéd al alata o leniksat qoudechayya leimmera khad:
O laayil taaseh minkha solet chené esronim beloula bachchemen chelichit hahin
O ledikra tabéd minkhata sulta terén asronin depila bimchakh taltout hina:
Veyayin lannesek chelichit hahin taqrib réakh-nikhoakh la-Adonai
Vekhamra leniska taltout hina teqaréb leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai:
Veki-taaseh ben-baqar ola o-zabakh lepallé-neder o-chelamim la-Adonai
Vaaré tabéd bar toré alata o niksat qoudechayya leparacha nidra o niksat qoudechayya qodam Adonai:
Vehiqrib al-ben-habbaqar minkha solet chelocha esronim baloul bachchemen khatsi hahin
Viqaréb al bar toré minkhata sulta telata asronin depila bimchakh palgout hina:
Veyayin taqrib lannesek khatsi hahin ichchéh réakh-nikhoakh la-Adonai
Vekhamra teqaréb leniska palgout hina qurban demitqabbél beraava qodam Adonai:
Kaka yéaseh lachchor haekhad o laayil haekhad o-lasseh bakkebasim o baizzim
Kedén yitabéd letora khad o ledikra khad o leimmar beimmerayya o beizzayya:
Kammispar acher taasou kaka taasou laekhad kemisparam
Keminyan di tabedoun kedén tabedoun lekhad keminyanhon:
Kol-haezrakh yaaseh-kaka et-élleh lehaqrib ichchéh réakh-nikhoakh la-Adonai
Kol yatstsiba yabéd kedén yat illén leqaraba qurban demitqabbél beraava qodam Adonai:
Veki-yagour ittekem gér o acher-betokekem ledorotékem veasa ichchéh réakh-nikhoakh la-Adonai kaacher taasou kén yaaseh
Vaaré yitgayyar immekon giyyora o di bénékon ledarékon veyabéd qurban demitqabbél baraava qodam Adonai kema di tabedoun kén yabéd:
Haqqahal khuqqa akhat lakem velaggér haggar khuqqat olam ledorotékem kakem kaggér yihyeh lipné Adonai
Qehala qeyama khad lekon oulegiyyora deyitgayyar qeyam alam ledarékon kevatekon kegiyyora yehé qodam Adonai:
Tora akhat oumichpat ekhad yihyeh lakem velaggér haggar ittekem
Orayta khada vedina khad yehé lekon oulegiyyora deyitgayyar immekon:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél veamarta aléhem beboakem el-haarets acher ani mébi etkem chamma
Mallél im bené yisraél vetémar lehon beméalkon leara di ana maél yatekon letamman:
Vehaya baakolkem millekhem haarets tarimou terouma la-Adonai
Vihé bemékalkon millakhma deara taprechoun aprachouta qodam Adonai:
Réchit arisotékem khalla tarimou terouma kitroumat goren kén tarimou otah
Réch atsvatkon khalleta taprechoun aprachouta kema di maprechin min idra kén taprechoun yatah:
Méréchit arisotékem tittenou la-Adonai terouma ledorotékem
Méréch atsvatkon tittenoun qodam Adonai aprachouta ledarékon:
Veki tichgou velo taasou ét kol-hammitsvot haélleh acher-dibber Adonai el-mocheh
Vaaré tichteloun vela tabedoun yat kol piqqodayya haillén di mallil Adonai im mcheh:
ét kol-acher tsivva Adonai alékem beyad-mocheh min-hayyom acher tsivva Adonai vahalea ledorotékem
Yat kol di paqqid Adonai yatekon bida demcheh min yoma di paqqid Adonai oulehalla ledarékon:
Vehaya im mééné haéda neesta lichgaga veasou kol-haéda par ben-baqar ekhad leola leréakh nikhoakh la-Adonai ouminkhato venisko kammichpat ouseir-izzim ekhad lekhattat
Vihé im mééné kenichta itabédat lechalou veyabedoun kol kenichta tor bar toré khad laalata leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai ouminkhatéh veniskéh kidkhazé outsepir bar izzé khad lekhattata:
Vekipper hakkohén al-kol-adat bené yisraél venislakh lahem ki-chegaga hiv vehém hébiou et-qorbanam ichcheh la-Adonai vekhattatam lipné Adonai al-chiggatam
Vikappar kahana al kol kenichta dibné yisraél veyichtebéq lehon aré chalouta hi veinnoun aytiou yat qurbanhon qurbana qodam Adonai vekhobathon qodam Adonai al chaloutehon:
Venislakh lekol-adat bené yisraél velaggér haggar betokam ki lekol-haam bichgaga
Veyichtebéq lekol kenichta dibné yisraél oulegiyyora deyitgayyar bénéhon aré lekol amma bechalouta:
Veim-nepech akhat tekhéta bichgaga vehiqriba éz bat-chenatah lekhattat
Veim énach khad yékhob bechalou viqaréb izza bat chattah lekhattata:
Vekipper hakkohén al-hannepech hachchogeget bekheta bichgaga lipné Adonai lekappér alayv venislakh lo
Vikappar kahana al énach deichteli bemékhabéh bechalou qodam Adonai lekappara alohi veyichtebéq léh:
Haezrakh bibné yisraél velaggér haggar betokam tora akhat yihyeh lakem laoseh bichgaga
Yatstsiba bibné yisraél oulegiyyora deyitgayyar bénéhon orayta khada yehé lekon lidyabéd bechalou
Vehannepech acher-taaseh beyad rama min-haezrakh oumin-haggér et-Adonai hou megaddép venikreta hannepech hahiv miqqereb ammah
Veénach deyabéd beréch geli min yatstsibayya oumin giyyorayya qodam Adonai hou margéz veyichtétsé anacha hahi miggo amméh:
Ki debar-Adonai baza veet-mitsvato hépar hikkarét tikkarét hannepech hahiv avona bah
Aré al mémera daAdonai besar veyat piqqodohi achné ichtétsaa tichtétsé anacha hahi khobah bah:
Vayyihyou bené-yisraél bammidbar vayyimtseou ich meqochéch étsim beyom hachchabbat
Vahavo bené yisraél bemadbera veachkakhou gabra kad megabbab ain beyoma dechabbeta:
Vayyaqribou oto hammotseim oto meqochéch étsim el-mocheh veel-aharon veel kol-haéda
Veqaribou yatéh deachkakhou yatéh kad megabbab ain levat mcheh oulevat aharon oulevat kol kenichta:
Vayyannikhou oto bammichmar ki lo porach mah-yéaseh lo
Veasserou yatéh bebét mattera aré la itperach lehon ma deyabedoun léh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh mot youmat haich ragom oto baabanim kol-haéda mikhouts lammakhaneh
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh itqetala yitqetél gabra mirgam yatéh beabnayya kol kenichta mibbara lemachrita:
Vayyotsiou oto kol-haéda el-mikhouts lammakhaneh vayyirgemou oto baabanim vayyamot kaacher tsivva Adonai et-mocheh
Veappiqou yatéh kol kenichta lemibbara lemachrita ouregamou yatéh beabnayya oumit kema di paqid Adonai yat mcheh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél veamarta aléhem veasou lahem tsitsit al-kanpé bigdéhem ledorotam venatenou al-tsitsit hakkanap petil tekélet
Mallél im bené yisraél vetémar lehon veyabedoun lehon kerousepedin al kanpé kesoutehon ledaréhon veyittenoun al kerousepeda dekanpa khouta ditkelta:
Vehaya lakem letsitsit oureitem oto ouzekartem et-kol-mitsvot Adonai vaasitem otam velo-tatourou akharé lebabkem veakharé énékem acher-attem zonim akharéhem
Vihon lekon likrousepedin vetekhézoun yatéh vetidkeroun yat kol piqqoudayya daAdonai vetabedoun yatehon vela titteoun batar hirhour libbekon oubatar khézou énékon di attoun taan batréhon:
Lemaan tizkerou vaasitem et-kol-mitsvotay vihyitem qedochim lélohékem
Bedil detidkeroun vetabedoun yat kol piqqoday outehon qaddichin qodam élahakon:
Ani Adonai élohékem acher hotséti etkem méerets mitsrayim lihyot lakem lélohim ani Adonai élohékem
Ana Adonai élahakon di appéqit yatekon méara demitsrayim leméhavé lekon léélaha ana Adonai élahakon:
Vayyiqqakh qorakh ben-yitshar ben-qehat ben-lévi vedatan vaabiram bené éliab veon ben-pelet bené reoubén
Veitpelég qorakh bar yitshar bar qehat bar lévi vedatan vaabiram bené éliab veon bar pelet bené reoubén:
Vayyaqoumou lipné mocheh vaanachim mibbené-yisraél khamichchim oumatayim nesié éda qerié moéd anché-chém
Veqamou leappé mcheh vegubrayya mibbené yisraél matan vekhamchin rabrebé kenichta mearé zeman énachin dichma:
Vayyiqqahalou al-mocheh veal-aharon vayyomerou aléhem rab-lakem ki kol-haéda kullam qedochim oubetokam Adonai oumaddoua titenasseou al-qehal Adonai
Veitkenachou al mcheh veal aharon vaamarou lehon saggi lekon aré kol kenichta kullehon qaddichin oubénéhon charya chekinta daAdonai ouma dén attoun mitrabrebin al qehala daAdonai:
Vayyichma mocheh vayyippol al-panayv
Ouchema mcheh ounepal al appohi:
Vayedabbér el-qorakh veel-kol-adato lémor boqer veyoda Adonai et-acher-lo veet-haqqadoch vehiqrib élayv veét acher yibkhar-bo yaqrib élayv
Oumallil im qorakh veim kol kenichtéh lemémar betsapra vihoda Adonai yat dekachar léh veyat deqaddich viqaréb loqodamohi veyat di yitreé béh yeqaréb lechimmouchéh:
Zot asou qekhou-lakem makhtot qorakh vekol-adato
Da ibidou sabou lekon makhteyan qorakh vekol kenichtéh:
Outenou bahén éch vesimou aléhen qetoret lipné Adonai makhar vehaya haich acher-yibkhar Adonai hou haqqadoch rab-lakem bené lévi
Vehabou behon echchata vechavviyou aléhon qetoret bousemin qodam Adonai mekhar vihé gabra deyitreé Adonai hou qaddich saggi lekon bené lévi:
Vayyomer mocheh el-qorakh chimou-na bené lévi
Vaamar mcheh leqorakh chemaou kean bené lévi:
Hameat mikkem ki-hibdil élohé yisraél etkem méadat yisraél lehaqrib etkem élayv laabod et-abodat michkan Adonai velaamod lipné haéda lecharetam
Hazzeér lekon aré apréch élaha deyisraél yatekon mikkenichta deyisraél leqaraba yatekon qodamohi lemiplakh yat palekhan machkena daAdonai ouleméqam qodam kenichta lechammachoutehon:
Vayyaqréb oteka veet-kol-akhéka bené-lévi ittak oubiqqachtem gam-kehunna
Veqaréb yatak veyat kol akhayk bené lévi immak oukean attoun baan ap kehunnata rabbeta:
Lakén atta vekol-adateka hannoadim al-Adonai veaharon mah-hv ki tallinou alayv
Bekén at vekol kenichtak deizdammintoun al Adonai veaharon ma hou aré itraamtoun alohi:
Vayyichlakh mocheh liqro ledatan velaabiram bené éliab vayyomerou lo naaleh
Ouchelakh mcheh lemiqré ledatan velaabiram bené éliab vaamarou la nissaq:
Hameat ki heélitanou méerets zabat khalab oudebach lahamiténou bammidbar ki-tistarér alénou gam-histarér
Hazzeér aré asseqtana méara abeda khalab oudebach leqattaloutana bemadbera aré itrabrabt alana ap itrabraba:
Ap lo el-erets zabat khalab oudebach habiotanou vattitten-lanou nakhalat sadeh vakarem haéné haanachim hahém tenaqqér lo naaleh
Beram la leara abeda khalab oudebach aaltana vihabta lana akhasanat khaqlin vekarmin haéné gubrayya hainnoun techallakh leavvara la nissaq:
Vayyikhar lemocheh meod vayyomer el-Adonai al-tépen el-minkhatam lo khamor ekhad méhem nasati velo haréoti et-akhad méhem
Outeqép lemcheh lakhada vaamar qodam Adonai la teqabbél beraava qurbanhon la khamara dekhad minnehon chekharit vela abéchit yat khad minnehon:
Vayyomer mocheh el-qorakh atta vekol-adateka héyou lipné Adonai atta vahém veaharon makhar
Vaamar mcheh leqorakh at vekol kenichtak hévo zeminin loqodam Adonai at veinnoun veaharon mekhar:
Ouqekhou ich makhtato ounetattem aléhem qetoret vehiqrabtem lipné Adonai ich makhtato khamichchim oumatayim makhtot veatta veaharon ich makhtato
Ousebou gebar makhtitéh outechavvoun aléhon qetoret bousemin outeqareboun qodam Adonai gebar makhtitéh matan vekhamchin makhteyan veat veaharon gebar makhtitéh:
Vayyiqkhou ich makhtato vayyittenou aléhem éch vayyasimou aléhem qetoret vayyaamdou petakh ohel moéd oumocheh veaharon
Ounesibou gebar makhtitéh vihabou aléhon echchata vechavviou aléhon qetoret bousemin veqamou bitra machkan zimna oumcheh veaharon:
Vayyaqhél aléhem qorakh et-kol-haéda el-petakh ohel moéd vayyéra kebod-Adonai el-kol-haéda
Veaknach aléhon qorakh yat kol kenichta litra machkan zimna veitgelé yeqara daAdonai lekol kenichta:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh veel-aharon lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh veim aharon lemémar:
Hibbadelou mittok haéda hazzot vaakalleh otam keraga
Itteperachou miggo kenichta hada veéchétsé yatehon kechaa:
Vayyippelou al-penéhem vayyomerou él élohé haroukhot lekol-basar haich ekhad yekhéta veal kol-haéda tiqtsop
Ounepalou al appéhon vaamarou él élaha roukhayya lekol bisra gabra khad yékhob veal kol kenichta yehé rougeza:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallél Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-haéda lémor héalou missabib lemichkan-qorakh datan vaabiram
Mallél im kenichta lemémar istallaqou missekhor sekhor lemachkena deqorakh datan vaabiram:
Vayyaqom mocheh vayyélek el-datan vaabiram vayyélekou akharayv ziqné yisraél
Veqam mcheh vaazal levat datan vaabiram vaazalou batrohi sabé yisraél:
Vayedabbér el-haéda lémor sourou na méal oholé haanachim harechaim haélleh veal-tiggeou bekol-acher lahem pen-tissapou bekol-khattotam
Oumallil im kenichta lemémar zourou kean méillavé machkené gubrayya khayyabayya haillén vela tiqreboun bekol di lehon dilma tilqoun bekol khobéhon:
Vayyéalou méal michkan-qorakh datan vaabiram missabib vedatan vaabiram yatseou nitstsabim petakh oholéhem ounechéhem oubenéhem vetappam
Veistallaqou méillavé machkena deqorakh datan vaabiram missekhor sekhor vedatan vaabiram nepaqou qayyemin bitra machkenéhon ounechéhon oubenéhon vetaplehon:
Vayyomer mocheh bezot tédeoun ki-Adonai chelakhani laasot ét kol-hammaasim haélleh ki-lo millibbi
Vaamar mcheh beda tiddeoun aré Adonai challekhanni lemebad yat kol obadayya haillén aré la méreouti:
Im-kemot kol-haadam yemutoun élleh oupequddat kol-haadam yippaqéd aléhem lo Adonai chelakhani
Im kemota dekal énacha yemoutoun illén ouseara dekal enacha yistear aléhon la Adonai challekhanni:
Veim-beria yibra Adonai oupatseta haadama et-piha oubalea otam veet-kol-acher lahem veyaredou khayyim cheola vidatem ki niatsou haanachim haélleh et-Adonai
Veim beria yibré Adonai oupetakhat ara yat poumah oubelaat yatehon veyat kol di lehon veyekhétoun kad khayyin lichol vetiddeoun aré argizou gubrayya haillén qodam Adonai:
Vayehi kekalloto ledabbér ét kol-haddebarim haélleh vattibbaqa haadama acher takhtéhem
Vahava kad chétsé lemallala yat kol pitgamayya haillén veitbezaat ara di tekhotéhon:
Vattiptakh haarets et-piha vattibla otam veet-battéhem veét kol-haadam acher leqorakh veét kol-harekouch
Oupetakhat ara yat poumah oubelaat yatehon veyat énach battéhon veyat kol énacha di leqorakh veyat kol qinyana:
Vayyéredou hém vekol-acher lahem khayyim cheola vattekas aléhem haarets vayyobedou mittok haqqahal
Ounekhatou innoun vekol di lehon kad khayyin lichol vakhapat aléhon ara vaabadou miggo qehala:
Vekol-yisraél acher sebibotéhem nasou leqolam ki amerou pen-tiblaénou haarets
Vekol yisraél di besakharanéhon araqou leqalehon aré amarou dilma tibleinnana ara:
Veéch yatsea méét Adonai vattokal ét hakhamichchim oumatayim ich maqribé haqqetoret
Veechchata nepaqat min qodam Adonai vaakalat yat matan vekhamchin gabra meqarebé qetoret bousemayya:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
émor el-elazar ben-aharon hakkohén veyarém et-hammakhtot mibbén hasserépa veet-haéch zeréh-halea ki qadéchou
Amar leelazar bar aharon kahana veyapréch yat makhteyata mibbén yeqidayya veyat echchata yarkhéq lehala aré itqaddachou:
ét makhtot hakhattaim haélleh benapchotam veasou otam riqqué pakhim tsippouy lammizbéakh ki-hiqriboum lipné-Adonai vayyiqdachou veyiheyou leot libné yisraél
Yat makhteyat khayyabayya haillén deitkhayyabou benapchatéhon veyabedoun yatehén tassin raddidin khopaa lemadbekha aré qarébunnoun qodam Adonai veitqaddachou vihevyan leat libné yisraél:
Vayyiqqakh elazar hakkohén ét makhtot hannekhochet acher hiqribou hasserupim vayeraqqeoum tsippouy lammizbéakh
Ounesib elazar kahana yat makhteyata dinkhacha deqaribou yoqidayya veraddidunnoun khopaa lemadbekha:
Zikkaron libné yisraél lemaan acher lo-yiqrab ich zar acher lo mizzera aharon hou lehaqtir qetoret lipné Adonai velo-yihyeh keqorakh vekaadato kaacher dibber Adonai beyad-mocheh lo
Dakerana libné yisraél bedil di la yiqrab gebar khillonay di la mizzara deaharon hou leassaqa qetoret bousemin qodam Adonai vela yehé keqorakh vekiknichtéh kema di mallil Adonai bida demcheh léh:
Vayyillonou kol-adat bené-yisraél mimmokhorat al-mocheh veal-aharon lémor attem hamittem et-am Adonai
Veitraamou kol kenichta dibné yisraél miyyoma debatrohi al mcheh veal aharon lemémar attoun geramtoun demit amma daAdonai:
Vayehi behiqqahél haéda al-mocheh veal-aharon vayyipnou el-ohel moéd vehinnéh kissahou heanan vayyéra kebod Adonai
Vahava beitkannachout kenichta al mcheh veal aharon veitpeniou lemachkan zimna veha khapahi anana veitgeli yeqara daAdonai:
Vayyabo mocheh veaharon el-pené ohel moéd
Veal mcheh veaharon loqodam machkan zimna:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Hérommou mittok haéda hazzot vaakalleh otam keraga vayyippelou al-penéhem
Itperachou miggo kenichta hada veéchétsé yatehon kechaa ounepalou al appéhon:
Vayyomer mocheh el-aharon qakh et-hammakhta veten-aléha éch méal hammizbéakh vesim qetoret veholék mehéra el-haéda vekappér aléhem ki-yatsa haqqetsep millipné Adonai hékhél hannagep
Vaamar mcheh leaharon sab yat makhtita vehab alah echchata méillavé madbekha vechav qetoret bousemayya veobil bipria liknichta vekappér aléhon aré nepaq rogza min qodam Adonai charé motana:
Vayyiqqakh aharon kaacher dibber mocheh vayyarots el-tok haqqahal vehinnéh hékhél hannegep baam vayyittén et-haqqetoret vayekappér al-haam
Ounesib aharon kema di mallil mcheh ourehat lego qehala veha charé motana beamma vihab yat qetoret bousemayya vekappar al amma:
Vayyaamod bén-hammétim oubén hakhayyim vattéatsar hammaggépa
Veqam bén métayya oubén khayyayya veitkeli motana:
Vayyihyou hammétim bammaggépa arbaa asar elep oucheba méot millebad hammétim al-debar-qorakh
Vahavo demitou bemotana arbeat achar alpin oucheba mea bar middemitou al pelugta deqorakh:
Vayyachob aharon el-mocheh el-petakh ohel moéd vehammaggépa neétsara
Vetab aharon lemcheh litra machkan zimna oumotana itkeli:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-mocheh lémor
Oumallil Adonai im mcheh lemémar:
Dabbér el-bené yisraél veqakh méittam matteh matteh lebét ab méét kol-nesiéhem lebét abotam cheném asar mattot ich et-chemo tiktob al-mattéhou
Mallél im bené yisraél vesab minnehon khutra khutra lebét abba min kol rabrebanéhon lebét abahathon teré asar khutrin gebar yat cheméh tiktob al khutréh:
Veét chém aharon tiktob al-mattéh lévi ki matteh ekhad leroch bét abotam
Veyat chema deaharon tiktob al khutra delévi aré khutra khad leréch bét abahathon:
Vehinnakhtam beohel moéd lipné haédout acher ivvaéd lakem chamma
Vetatsneinnoun bemachkan zimna qodam sahadouta di azammén mémeri lekon tamman:
Vehaya haich acher ebkhar-bo mattéhou yiprakh vahachikkoti méalay et-telunnot bené yisraél acher hém mallinim alékem
Vihé gabra deitreé béh khutréh yiné vaaniakh min qodamay yat toureamat bené yisraél di innoun mitraamin alékon:
Vayedabbér mocheh el-bené yisraél vayyittenou élayv kol-nesiéhem matteh lenasi ekhad matteh lenasi ekhad lebét abotam cheném asar mattot oumattéh aharon betok mattotam
Oumallil mcheh im bené yisraél vihabou léh kol rabrebanéhon khutra lerabba khad khutra lerabba khad lebét abahathon teré asar khutrin vekhutra deaharon bego khutréhon:
Vayyannakh mocheh et-hammattot lipné Adonai beohel haédout
Veatsna mcheh yat khutrayya qodam Adonai bemachkena desahadouta:
Vayehi mimmokhorat vayyabo mocheh el-ohel haédout vehinnéh parakh mattéh-aharon lebét lévi vayyotsé perakh vayyatséts tsits vayyigmol cheqédim
Vahava beyoma debatrohi veal mcheh lemachkena desahadouta veha nea khutra deaharon lebét lévi veappéq lablebin veanéts néts vekapét chigdin
Vayyotsé mocheh et-kol-hammattot millipné Adonai el-kol-bené yisraél vayyirou vayyiqkhou ich mattéhou
Veappéq mcheh yat kol khutrayya min qodam Adonai levat kol bené yisraél veichtemodaou ounesibou gebar khutréh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-mocheh hachéb et-mattéh aharon lipné haédout lemichmeret leot libné-meri outekal telounnotam méalay velo yamoutou
Vaamar Adonai lemcheh atéb yat khutra deaharon loqodam sahadouta lemattera leat leamma sarbana visoupan toureamathon min qodamay vela yemoutoun:
Vayyaas mocheh kaacher tsivva Adonai oto kén asa
Vaabad mcheh kema di paqqid Adonai yatéh kén abad:
Vayyomerou bené yisraél el-mocheh lémor hén gavanou abadnou kullanou abadenou
Vaamarou bené yisraél lemcheh lemémar ha minnana qetalat kharba ha minnana belaat ara veha minnana demitou bemotana:
Kol haqqaréb haqqaréb el-michkan Adonai yamout haim tamnou ligvoa
Kol deqaréb miqrab lemachkena daAdonai mait ha anakhna saypin limmat:
Vayyomer Adonai el-aharon atta oubanéka oubét-abika ittak tisou et-avon hammiqdach veatta oubanéka ittak tisou et-avon kehunnatkem
Vaamar Adonai leaharon at oubenayk oubét abouk immak tesallekhoun al khobé maqdecha veat oubenayk immak tesallekhoun al khobé kehunnatkon:
Vegam et-akhéka mattéh lévi chébet abika haqréb ittak veyillavou aléka vicharetouka veatta oubanéka ittak lipné ohel haédout
Veap yat akhayk chibta delévi chibta deabouk qaréb levatak veyittosepoun alak vichammechunnak veat oubenayk immak qodam machkena desahadouta:
Vechamerou michemarteka oumichmeret kol-haohel ak el-kelé haqqodech veel-hammizbéakh lo yiqrabou velo-yamoutou gam-hém gam-attem
Veyitteroun mattartak oumatterat kol machkena beram lemané qoudecha oulemadbekha la yiqreboun vela yemoutoun ap innoun ap attoun:
Venilvou aléka vechamerou et-michmeret ohel moéd lekol abodat haohel vezar lo-yiqrab alékem
Veyittosepoun alak veyitteroun yat matterat machkan zimna lekol palekhan machkena vekhillonay la yiqrab levatekon:
Ouchemartem ét michmeret haqqodech veét michmeret hammizbéakh velo-yihyeh od qetsep al-bené yisraél
Vetitteroun yat matterat qoudecha veyat matterat madbekha vela yehé od rogza al bené yisraél:
Vaani hinnéh laqakhti et-akhékem haleviyyim mittok bené yisraél lakem mattana netunim la-Adonai laabod et-abodat ohel moéd
Vaana ha qarébit yat akhékon lévaé miggo bené yisraél lekon mattena yehibin qodam Adonai lemiplakh yat palekhan machkan zimna:
Veatta oubanéka itteka tichmerou et-kehunnatkem lekol-debar hammizbéakh oulemibbét lapparoket vaabadtem abodat mattana ettén et-kehunnatkem vehazzar haqqaréb youmat
Veat oubenayk immak titteroun yat kehunnatkon lekol pitgam madbekha oulemiggav leparouketa vetiplekhoun palekhan mattena éhab yat kehunnatkon vekhillonay deyiqrab yitqetal:
Vayedabbér Adonai el-aharon vaani hinnéh natatti leka et-michmeret teroumotay lekol-qodché bené-yisraél leka netattim lemochkha oulebanéka lekhoq-olam
Oumallil Adonai im aharon vaana ha yehabit lak yat matterat aprachoutay lekol qoudechayya dibné yisraél lak yehabtinnoun lirbou velibnayk liqyam olam:
Zeh-yihyeh leka miqqodech haqqodachim min-haéch kol-qorbanam lekol-minkhatam oulekol-khattatam oulekol-achamam acher yachibou li qodech qodachim leka hou oulebanéka
Dén yehé lak miqqodech qoudechayya motar min echchata kol qourebanéhon lekol minkhathon oulekal khatvathon oulekal achamhon di yetiboun qodamay qodech qoudechin di lak hou velibnayk:
Beqodech haqqodachim tokelennou kol-zakar yokal oto qodech yiheyeh-lak
Beqodech qoudechin tékelunnéh kol dekoura yékoul yatéh qoudecha yehé lak:
Vezeh-leka teroumat mattanam lekol-tenoupot bené yisraél leka netattim oulebanéka velibnotéka itteka lekhoq-olam kol-tahor bebéteka yokal oto
Vedén lak aprachout mattenathon lekol aramout bené yisraél lak yehabtinnoun velibnayk velibnatayk immak liqyam olam kol didké bebétak yékoul yatéh:
Kol khéleb yitshar vekol-khéleb tiroch vedagan réchitam acher-yittenou la-Adonai leka netattim
Kol toub mechakh vekol toub khamar veibbour réchitehon di yittenoun qodam Adonai lak yehabtinnoun:
Bikkouré kol-acher beartsam acher-yabiou la-Adonai leka yihyeh kol-tahor bebéteka yokelennou
Bikkouré kol di bearahon di yaytoun qodam Adonai di lak yehé kol didké bebétak yékelunnéh:
Kol-khérem beyisraél leka yihyeh
Kol kherma beyisraél di lak yehé:
Kol-peter rekhem lekol-basar acher-yaqribou la-Adonai baadam oubabbehéma yiheyeh-lak ak padoh tipdeh ét bekor haadam veét bekor-habbehéma hatteméa tipdeh
Kol patakh valeda lekol bisra di yeqareboun qodam Adonai beénacha oubibira yehé lak beram mipraq tiprouq yat boukera deénacha veyat boukera dibira mesaaba tiproq:
Oupedouyav mibben-khodech tipdeh beerkeka kesep khaméchet cheqalim becheqel haqqodech esrim géra hou
Oupoureqanéh mibbar yarkha tiproq bepursanéh kesap khaméch silin besilé qoudecha asrin main hou:
Ak bekor-chor o-bekor keseb o-bekor éz lo tipdeh qodech hém et-damam tizroq al-hammizbéakh veet-khelbam taqtir ichcheh leréakh nikhoakh la-Adonai
Beram boukera detora o boukera deimra o boukera deizza la tiprouq qoudecha innoun yat dimhon tizrouq al madbekha veyat tarbéhon tasséq qoureban leitqabbala beraava qodam Adonai:
Oubesaram yihyeh-lak kakhazéh hattenoupa oukechoq hayyamin leka yihyeh
Oubisrehon yehé lak kekhadya daaramouta oukechoqa deyammina lak yehé:
Kol teroumot haqqodachim acher yarimou bené-yisraél la-Adonai natatti leka oulebanéka velibnotéka itteka lekhoq-olam berit melakh olam hiv lipné Adonai leka oulezaraka ittak
Kol aprachout qoudechayya di yiprechoun bené yisraél qodam Adonai yehabit lak velibnayk velibnatayk immak liqyam olam qeyam melakh olam hou qodam Adonai lak velibnayk immak:
Vayyomer Adonai el-aharon beartsam lo tinkhal vekhéleq lo-yihyeh leka betokam ani khelqeka venakhalateka betok bené yisraél
Vaamar Adonai leaharon bearahon la takhasin vokholaq la yehé lak bénéhon mattenan di yehabit lak innoun khouleqak veakhasantak bego bené yisraél:
Velibné lévi hinnéh natatti kol-maasér beyisraél lenakhala khélep abodatam acher-hém obedim et-abodat ohel moéd
Velibné lévi ha yehabit kol maasra beyisraél leakhasana khalap poulekhanhon di innoun palekhin yat poulekhan machkan zimna:
Velo-yiqrebou od bené yisraél el-ohel moéd lasét khét lamout
Vela yiqreboun od bené yisraél lemachkan zimna leqabbala khoba limmat:
Veabad hallévi hou et-abodat ohel moéd vehém yisou avonam khuqqat olam ledorotékem oubetok bené yisraél lo yinkhalou nakhala
